events.description: In the early morning, Ma Xiulan stretched with her husband. As usual, she added Cat-Cow and Wind-Blowing Tree poses, and her husband followed along. Afterward, she called her father to remind him to take his blood pressure. Her mother answered and said his blood pressure was normal, and she breathed a sigh of relief.

events.name: Post-processing of pickled vegetables and experience sharing
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan checked the pickling progress of each jar of pickles, turned them over with clean chopsticks, and added a small amount of brine. In the afternoon, she made a video call to Zhou Xiuqin and humbly asked for advice on how to set up a market stall, how to price items, and how to hawk. Zhou Xiuqin shared many practical tips, and the two agreed to practice vending together on the weekend if they could get the stall approved.

events.name: Preparing dinner and having a family chat.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan made the noodles with gravy that her husband loved. During the meal, she casually brought up applying for a market stall. Her husband said he fully supported it and could help carry goods; her eldest son Ma Mingxuan said he could handle the accounts; her second son clamored to be the little cashier; and her daughter also wanted to go along and act cute. The family was full of laughter.

events.name: Deep breathing as a couple before bed.
events.description: At 21:30, her husband Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to come to the bedroom and do deep-breathing exercises with Ma Xiulan. They synchronized their inhales, breath holds, and exhales. When they finished, he patted her shoulder, and no words were needed.

start_state.mood: Full of drive

end_state.mood: The warmth of being supported by family.

state.daily_exercise: Morning partner stretching for 10 minutes (including Cat-Cow pose and Swaying Tree pose)

2025-02.daily_overview: On the last day of February, Ma Xiulan's first task after stretching was to sit at her desk and review the entire month's spending. She went through the ledger entry by entry: the education savings had been deposited on time, her husband's cigarette spending had clearly dropped, and overall expenditures were within budget. Satisfied, she drew up the March budget and deliberately set aside 50 yuan for pickled vegetable ingredients. In the afternoon, she imported the February photos from her camera into her computer, sorted them into categories, and recorded the stories. In the evening, she visited her neighbor Wang Guilan across the hall, and they talked about the benefits of stretching. They hit it off immediately and agreed to start daily check-ins in the WeChat group from March to supervise each other. Before going to bed, she took a final deep breath, her heart full of anticipation for the next month.

events.name: Morning partner stretching and blood pressure monitoring
events.description: In the early morning, Ma Xiulan and her husband finished stretching. She felt light; during the stretching, she added the cat-cow pose and the wind-blowing-tree pose, and her husband followed skillfully. Afterward, she called her father to confirm his blood pressure was stable and noted that this was the last monitoring session of February.

events.name: End-of-month financial review and next month's budget
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan took out the family ledger and checked all February expenses: this month's education savings of 300 yuan were deposited on time (including 150 yuan deposited on February 15 and a supplementary deposit of 150 yuan at the end of the month, so the monthly savings target was met), her husband's cigarette expenses decreased by about 120 yuan compared with January, and adding the material costs for the pickled vegetable trial, total expenses were kept within the budget of 3,800 yuan. She then drew up the March budget, reserved funds for daily expenses, and separately listed 50 yuan for pickled vegetable materials under miscellaneous items, encouraging herself to keep advancing the side business.

events.name: Monthly family photo organization
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan imported the photos taken in February from her camera into the computer, went through them one by one, deleted the blurry and duplicate ones, kept wonderful moments such as brisk walking in the park, cooking at home, and working in the backyard, and organized them into folders such as children's growth, family food, and neighborhood daily life. She also created a text file to briefly record the story behind each photo.

events.name: Visiting Wang Guilan and agreeing to do stretching check-ins.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan took a few freshly steamed buns to visit Wang Guilan, who lives across the hall. The two shared their experiences with morning stretching from this week. Ma Xiulan said the discomfort in her shoulders and neck had completely disappeared and her body felt much more flexible. Wang Guilan was intrigued and immediately followed along to learn a move. They agreed that starting next month, they would check in daily in the WeChat group to share stretching progress, supervise each other, and learn new moves together.

events.name: Bedtime deep breathing exercise.
events.description: At 21:30 in the evening, Ma Xiulan completed the last deep breathing session of February by the bedside in her bedroom. She silently repeated "calm" and "relax," naturally fitting it into her bedtime routine and feeling that her sleep quality had improved overall. She looked forward to maintaining this in March.

start_state.mood: A strong sense of planning.

end_state.mood: Satisfied and full of hope

state.daily_exercise: Morning partner stretching for 10 minutes (including Cat-Cow pose and Swaying Tree pose)

2025-07.daily_overview: On the first day of summer vacation, Ma Xiulan got up at 5:20, stretched, and went for a brisk morning walk. After returning home, she made a summer plan and eye-care rules for the children, checked the persimmon tree, planned a healthy monthly meal plan, and in the afternoon bought coarse grains and mint seeds, setting a healthy and orderly tone for the new vacation.

events.name: Morning wake-up: stretching and a morning walk
events.description: Got up at 5:20, first did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching and 10 minutes of lower back rehab stretching (cat-cow stretch, standing side bends), then changed into sneakers and briskly walked for 18 minutes along the tree-lined Jingwen Road with deep breathing. When she got home, her forehead was slightly sweaty and her body felt light.

events.name: Make a summer vacation plan and assign tasks to the children.
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan wrote the summer rules on the small blackboard in the living room: two hours of studying, one hour of housework, and one hour of vegetable-garden work every day. She put her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, in charge of weeding the roses and checking for pests; her second son, Ma Mingzhe, was to record the watering of the cucumbers; and her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, was to tidy up toys and wipe the tables. The children listened carefully, and Mingzhe even took out a small notebook to write things down.

events.name: Summer pest and disease inspection of persimmon trees
events.description: Before the temperature rose, Ma Xiulan brought a small stool over to check the persimmon tree in the corner of the yard. She looked at the undersides of the leaves and found no insect eggs or aphids, and there were no borer holes in the trunk. She only sprayed the leaves with diluted chili water as a preventive measure and cut off two old leaves with yellow spots to improve air circulation in the canopy.

events.name: Implementing family eye-care rules.
events.description: On another small blackboard, she wrote "Family Eye-Protection Rules": watch TV no more than 30 minutes a day, no using your phone while lying down, and always turn on a desk lamp when writing. She asked her husband to help move her second son's desk to the window to ensure good lighting, and announced at least 1 hour of outdoor activity every day.

events.name: Planning the family's healthy summer diet and shopping accordingly.
events.description: After the midday rest, Ma Xiulan planned the month's diet: breakfast on every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday would be homemade yogurt mixed with multigrain congee; lunch and dinner would add cold cucumber salad and tomatoes; and she prepared to cook a red bean and coix seed soup to relieve the summer heat. Then she took her youngest daughter to Xingwang Vegetable Market and bought mung beans, red beans, coix seeds, mixed grains, fresh vegetables and fruits, plus a flowerpot and mint seeds. While chatting with the stall owner, Sun Guifang, she learned that vegetable prices had risen slightly recently.

start_state.mood: Clear-headed and positive, determined to start the summer vacation in an orderly way.

end_state.mood: Satisfied, all plans are set, looking forward to the new pace

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 18 minutes, shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, and lower back muscle stretches for 10 minutes.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, 32°C, cool breeze in the evening.

2025-07.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan supervised the children all day as they carried out the new rules, keeping a close eye on eye care and outdoor activities in the morning, noon, and evening. In the afternoon she made a cooling soup. In the evening, while checking homework, she found Mingxuan's writing posture problem. Though tired after the day, she felt reassured seeing the rules beginning to take hold.

events.name: Early morning walk and vegetable garden inspection
events.description: Got up at 5:25, finished shoulder and neck stretching and simplified lumbar muscle stretching, then walked briskly along Jingwen Road for 15 minutes. After returning home, went to the vegetable garden to check on the cucumbers and tomatoes and pulled up weeds. Seeing that the soil was moist, she knew Mingzhe had watered the garden the previous evening, and nodded with satisfaction.

events.name: Supervise eye protection and summer vacation rules.
events.description: In the early morning, she reminded the children that they could only watch TV for half an hour and to pay attention to their posture. In the morning, she urged Mingxuan and Mingzhe to do their summer homework for one hour each. At 4 p.m., she took the children to the yard for activities: Mingxuan jumped rope, Mingzhe played football, Yuxin played with sandbags, while she pruned the vegetable garden fence nearby. At 7 p.m., while checking homework, she found Mingxuan lying down looking at his phone, immediately corrected him, and made him sit up straight to write.

events.name: Cooking red bean and pearl barley soup to beat the summer heat
events.description: At 3 p.m., Ma Xiulan followed an online method: she washed the mung beans, red beans, and coix seeds and soaked them for half an hour, then brought them to a boil over high heat, turned to low heat and simmered for 40 minutes, and added a little rock sugar. After the soup cooled, she divided it into three bottles and put them in the refrigerator, and wrote down the proportions on a sticky note, planning to slightly adjust the sweetness next time. After dinner, each of the children drank a small bowl.

events.name: Check the completion of summer tasks
events.description: At 8 p.m., I looked through Mingzhe's watering record book and found he had drawn cucumber and sun pictures but was missing the date, so I taught him to add it. Then I checked Mingxuan's rose weeding report and praised him for observing carefully. Yuxin's toys had been sorted and put back, and she got a thumbs-up sticker.

start_state.mood: Calm, with the sense of mission to supervise the new regulations.

end_state.mood: Satisfied; the children behaved reasonably well, and the summer heat-relieving soup was well received.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 15 minutes, neck and shoulder stretching for 5 minutes, lower back stretching for 5 minutes, and gardening for 30 minutes

2025-07.daily_overview: After her morning walk, Ma Xiulan reviewed a few Baduanjin exercises. In the morning she planted mint, in the afternoon she sat under the veranda embroidering a handkerchief, and in the evening she took the children for a walk at the alley entrance. Her steady days were punctuated by her own little hobbies.

events.name: Morning walk and self-guided Baduanjin warm-up exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:30. After stretching, she walked briskly along Jingwen Road for 15 minutes. After returning home, in the courtyard she tried to review the Baduanjin starting posture and 'two hands holding up the sky to regulate the Triple Burner.' The movements were not smooth but were stretching. She decided to practice whenever she had free time, so she wouldn't worry about falling behind in the next class.

events.name: Plant mint on the windowsill.
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan used a newly bought flowerpot and nutrient soil to evenly scatter mint seeds, covered them with a thin layer of soil, watered them thoroughly, and placed them on the south-facing kitchen windowsill. She told the children that once leaves grew, they could brew mint water to drink, which would relieve heat and refresh the mind.

events.name: Afternoon embroidery time
events.description: In the afternoon while the children did homework, Ma Xiulan embroidered a handkerchief with plum, orchid, bamboo, and chrysanthemum motifs in a bright spot in the living room. She tried the overlock stitch she had just learned last month, and after ripping it out twice, she was finally satisfied. This handkerchief was reserved for next week’s community handicraft exchange.

events.name: Evening walk at the lane entrance and casual chat with neighbors
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., as the heat was fading, Ma Xiulan took Yuxin for a walk at the alley entrance on Jingwen Road and met Wang Guilan from across the street cooling off at her door. The two chatted about how exhausting it was to take care of children during the summer vacation, and also mentioned that Guilan's daughter-in-law might have something to discuss (only later did they learn it was the happy news of a pregnancy). Xiulan shared the recipe for the cooling soup she had made.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the new day, I want to try practicing Baduanjin.

end_state.mood: Relaxed, embroidery progress, pleasant neighborly chat

state.daily_exercise: Brisk morning walk for 15 minutes, shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, self-practice of Baduanjin for 15 minutes, and an evening stroll for 20 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Morning clear turning cloudy, afternoon thundershowers, 29°C

2025-07.daily_overview: The vegetable garden was fine in the early morning, but after a sudden rain in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan found the cucumber vines wilting. It turned out that Mingzhe had forgotten to water them. She did not scold him; she took the child to remedy the situation together, and Mingzhe admitted his mistake in tears. In the evening, she called Zhou Xiuqin to discuss partnering up on pickling.

events.name: Morning vegetable garden care and stretching
events.description: Woke up at 5:20. Because it was muggy before the rain, I only did shoulder and neck stretches and lumbar muscle stretches, and did not go out for a walk. Went to the vegetable garden to prune the tomato suckers and train the bean vines. Seeing that the cucumber leaves were upright and the soil was moist, I thought Mingzhe had already watered, so I drew a star in the notebook.

events.name: Afternoon shower and discovering the cucumbers are wilting.
events.description: At 2 p.m. a thunder shower came on quickly. After Ma Xiulan brought in the clothes that had been hung out to dry, she went to check the vegetable garden and found the cucumber vines' leaves wilted and the soil cracked. Only then did she realize that what she had thought was moisture in the morning was just dew, and that Mingzhe had been so busy playing that he had forgotten to water for two days. She called Mingzhe over. Mingzhe squatted in the corner, crying with guilt. Ma Xiulan took his hand and together they carried water buckets to water the plants again. As she watered, she said softly, "Crops are like people: when they are thirsty, they feel awful. From now on, you must remember to tend to them carefully." Mingzhe nodded with tears in his eyes.

events.name: Phone discussion with Zhou Xiuqin about cooperating during the pickled vegetable peak season
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan called her handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin. The two discussed mass production for the mid-July pickle season and decided to ask Wang Guilan to join them in an assembly-line operation. They initially planned to prepare ingredients next week and start on the 14th, with Zhou Xiuqin in charge of washing and cutting vegetables, Wang Guilan making the marinade, and Ma Xiulan packing and sealing the jars. After hanging up, she also contacted Wang Guilan, who readily agreed.

start_state.mood: Feeling fresh and clear-headed in the early morning, gratified by the growth of the vegetable garden.

end_state.mood: Gratified; the child acknowledged and corrected his mistake, and the pickled vegetable cooperation was settled.

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, 10 minutes of lower back stretching, and 20 minutes of vegetable garden work

2025-07.daily_overview: On Saturday her husband was at home. After her early morning walk, Ma Xiulan got breakfast ready for the family. After being watered again, the cucumber vine perked up. Mingzhe drew the cucumber in his diary and wrote “must not forget.” She tidied up the house in the morning, and in the afternoon she found time to embroider a lotus flower. The day was ordinary but peaceful.

events.name: Morning walk and cucumber recovery observation
events.description: Woke up at 5:30. After shoulder and neck stretches, brisk-walked along Jingwen Road for 15 minutes. After breakfast, took Mingzhe to the vegetable garden. The cucumber leaves had spread out and the vines were full of life. Mingzhe took out his diary and drew a green cucumber with colored pencils, writing "Don't forget" crookedly beside it. Ma Xiulan patted his head and said, "If you can correct your mistake, you are a good child." The mother and son also added bamboo poles to support the cucumber trellis.

events.name: Weekend family breakfast and interacting with her husband
events.description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang did not take the car out today, so Ma Xiulan specially made dough drop soup and fried sliced steamed buns. At the dining table, she asked Mingxuan to report on the week's summer gains. Mingxuan said he had learned to check whether roses had aphids. Zhiqiang praised the eldest son and reminded Mingzhe to take farm work seriously. Yuxin also clamored to massage her mother's back.

events.name: Afternoon embroidery practice
events.description: In the afternoon while the children napped, Ma Xiulan quietly embroidered a lotus flower in the living room, using pink silk thread for the petals and light green silk thread for the lotus leaves. Her stitches were slow but neat. She thought the pattern might be made into a round fan cover to display at the market.

start_state.mood: Light and cheerful; with the whole family at home at the weekend, the atmosphere is warm.

end_state.mood: Content; the children's growth is visible, and the embroidery has made new progress.

state.daily_exercise: Brisk walking for 15 minutes in the early morning, 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching, and 1 hour of simple housework.

2025-07.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan's Sunday was different because of Baduanjin. After her morning walk, she and her neighbors signed up for a free community class. Her movements were clumsy in the first class, but she found it fun. After class, the three of them went to the morning market to buy groceries. In the afternoon, she practiced a few more times at home. Her body was tired, but she felt energized.

events.name: Signed up for the community Baduanjin class
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan and her neighbors Liu Chunmei and Wang Guilan went together to the Jingwen Road community service center to sign up for the free summer Baduanjin class. The three filled out registration forms and confirmed the class time (9:00 a.m. every Sunday and Wednesday). The staff said that two other aunties had also signed up.

events.name: Baduanjin Lesson 1
events.description: The class started at exactly 9 o'clock. The coach first demonstrated the full set of movements. When Ma Xiulan followed along with 'drawing the bow left and right like shooting an eagle,' her shoulders were stiff and she stumbled two steps when turning around. An auntie in the back row jokingly said she 'waddled like a duck.' Embarrassed, she stood still. The coach patiently corrected her and stressed relaxation. By the end of the class she could barely keep up, but she knew she needed extra practice.

events.name: After class, morning market shopping with a neighbor.
events.description: After class, the three went to Xingwang Vegetable Market. Ma Xiulan bought tofu, greens, and chicken breast. She ran into Sun Guifang, who strongly recommended today's tender corn at her stall. She bought four ears, planning to boil them as snacks. Chunmei also shared some of her own sun-dried green beans.

events.name: Extra Baduanjin practice in the afternoon
events.description: In the afternoon, while the children watched cartoons, Ma Xiulan practiced in the shady spot in the courtyard from memory, repeatedly doing moves such as 'Supporting the Sky with Both Hands' and 'Single Hand Raising to Regulate the Spleen and Stomach.' She deliberately slowed down to try to make each posture standard. She decided to practice once more before bed.

start_state.mood: Excited and slightly nervous—today is the first day of Baduanjin.

end_state.mood: Pleasant and satisfied; body felt light after exercising, and she hit it off with new friends.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of brisk walking in the early morning, 1 hour of Baduanjin class, 30 minutes of extra practice, and 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, 32°C, with a light breeze in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: In the new week, Ma Xiulan called her mother in the morning to arrange to go back to her parents' home the next day. In the afternoon she practiced Baduanjin alone and cleared a corner of the living room to make space for future morning exercise. In the evening she urged the children to prepare polite phrases for going out the next day.

events.name: Called mother to arrange a visit
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ma Xiulan called her mother Li Xiuying and told her she planned to take the three children to visit her parents' home on Victory Street on the morning of July 8. Her mother happily said she would prepare watermelon and snacks, and her father Ma Jianguo also said he happened to have fixed the broken little stool. Xiulan promised to bring some of her own pickled vegetables.

events.name: Practice Baduanjin alone and tidy up the exercise area
events.description: At 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan reviewed Baduanjin in the courtyard, focusing on repeatedly practicing "drawing the bow on both sides," which was noticeably smoother than yesterday. After practicing, she moved two old bamboo chairs from the southeast corner of the yard to clear about three square meters of space, planning to practice here every morning from now on.

events.name: Remind the children to get ready with proper etiquette for visiting relatives.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan called the three children over and reminded them that when they see their maternal grandparents tomorrow, they should greet them, not rummage through things, and help set the table during meals. She had Yuxin practice saying 'Hello, Grandma,' and had Mingxuan take charge of watching over his younger siblings. The children chattered excitedly.

start_state.mood: Feeling calm and looking forward to going back to her parents' home

end_state.mood: Warm, looking forward to tomorrow's reunion.

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walking for 15 minutes, shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes, lumbar muscle stretching for 5 minutes, and Baduanjin self-practice for 25 minutes

2025-07.daily_overview: Today Ma Xiulan took her three children back to her parents' home. The children were excited on the bus ride there. At her parents' house, she helped her mother cook and learned new dishes, while her father repaired a stool. The family sat down to eat together at noon. As usual, her mother gave the grandchildren red envelopes. Xiulan declined but eventually accepted, and mentally planned to buy autumn clothes for her parents.

events.name: Getting ready to go out and preparing small gifts in the early morning.
events.description: Got up at 5:15 in the morning, did neck, shoulder, and lower back stretches, then skipped the walk. She hastily sorted out clean clothes for the children, prepared water bottles and sun hats. She took two jars of her homemade sweet garlic and pickled radish from the storage room, packed them in bags as gifts for her parents.

events.name: Taking the children by bus to the parents' home
events.description: At 8 o'clock, Ma Xiulan took the three children on Bus No. 6 in Jinghai District from Jingwen Road Station to Shengli Street Station. On the bus, the children happily talked about the big jujube tree at Grandma's house, and Ma Xiulan told them to keep quiet and sit steadily. The ride took about 20 minutes; after getting off, they walked 5 minutes to No. 45 Shengli Street.

events.name: Reunion at Her Parents' Home and Learning Cooking by Helping in the Kitchen
events.description: She arrived at 9:30. Her mother, Li Xiuying, had already prepared watermelon and grapes, and her father, Ma Jianguo, was reinforcing a small stool with wooden wedges in the yard. The children ran into the yard to play, while Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to help her mother wash vegetables. Her mother taught her a cold noodle dish she had recently learned: hand-rolled noodles rinsed in cool boiled water, topped with sesame paste, vinegar, and garlic water, and served with shredded cucumber and bean sprouts. Xiulan carefully noted down the steps.

events.name: Family lunch and casual conversation
events.description: At 12:00 noon, cold noodles, stir-fried greens, and tomato and egg soup were served. The family sat around the table. Her father praised the cold noodles as refreshing, and the children ate with relish. During the meal, they talked about Mingxuan's studies and Mingzhe's summer homework. Her mother remarked that children nowadays are smart. Xiulan mentioned the summer rules, and her parents both approved.

events.name: Farewell red envelopes and plans for the future
events.description: At 3 p.m. when saying goodbye, her mother took out three red envelopes with 200 yuan in each and pressed them into the hands of her grandchildren. Ma Xiulan quickly declined: 'Mom, don't spend so much.' Her mother insisted: 'It's for the children, for good luck.' Xiulan had no choice but to accept, silently noting that she should use the money to go to the clothing market soon to buy several sets of soft autumn clothes for her parents.

events.name: Return bus ride and home bookkeeping
events.description: At 3:30 she took the bus back. On the bus, Yuxin clutched the red envelope and wouldn't let go. After 20 minutes they arrived home. Ma Xiulan recorded the red envelope income of 600 yuan in the accounting book in the living room and wrote next to it 'buy autumn clothes for Mom and Dad.' She reminded the children that red envelope money must not be wasted and should be saved with gratitude. In the evening, she called her mother to let her know they were safe.

start_state.mood: Happy, looking forward to gathering with my parents

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Happy and grateful; family love warms the heart.

state.daily_exercise: Walking and bus round trip about 30 minutes; neck and shoulder stretch 5 minutes; lower back stretch 5 minutes.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to cloudy, 30°C, high humidity

2025-07.daily_overview: After her morning Baduanjin practice, Ma Xiulan reiterated the eye-protection rules. Later in the morning, she went to the vegetable market with Zhou Xiuqin to make a preliminary selection of ingredients for pickled vegetables. In the afternoon, she took the children out for outdoor activities, and in the evening she confiscated the phone that Mingzhe was secretly using. The day was ordinary, with a small ripple of discipline.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin exercise and eye-care reminders
events.description: Got up at 5:20 in the morning; after shoulder and neck stretches, walked briskly along Jingwen Road for 15 minutes, then practiced the full set of Baduanjin in the courtyard, with much smoother movements. At breakfast, again emphasized eye-care requirements, checked sitting posture, and announced that from today each person's desk lamp must use a timer: study 40 minutes, rest 10 minutes.

events.name: Go with Zhou Xiuqin to the vegetable market to inspect raw ingredients.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Zhou Xiuqin came to the house, and the two walked together to Xingwang Market. They visited several stalls, compared the freshness and prices of cucumbers and radishes, and finally chose cucumbers from Sun Guifang's stall and white radishes from another stall. They placed an order for a batch to pick up next week, preparing for the pickled vegetable batch processing.

events.name: Afternoon outdoor activities and supervision.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan took the children to Jinghai District Park. Mingxuan played badminton, Mingzhe rode a scooter, and she played jump rope with Yuxin. She did some stretches under the shade of the trees and watched whether Mingzhe rubbed his eyes, reminding him to look at the green trees in the distance.

events.name: Evening phone confiscation and discipline
events.description: At 7 p.m., while checking homework, Ma Xiulan found that Mingzhe had been secretly playing mini-games on his father's old phone for half an hour. She confiscated it immediately and reiterated the rule: the phone could only be used for study help, no more than 15 minutes a day. Mingzhe pouted and agreed, and Xiulan made him make up for it by washing the dishes.

start_state.mood: Clear-headed and in good spirits after morning exercise

end_state.mood: Slightly worried, but reassured by timely discipline.

state.daily_exercise: In the early morning: 15 minutes of brisk walking, 20 minutes of Baduanjin exercise, 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, and 5 minutes of lower back stretches.

2025-07.daily_overview: At the Baduanjin class, Ma Xiulan met Aunt Zhao and learned acupoint massage techniques to relieve lower back soreness, which made her very happy. Her husband's right arm had fully recovered, and he took over the heavy work of moving the pickle jars; in the afternoon, he also loosened the soil in the yard. She felt his thoughtfulness and the warmth of family cooperation, and was in a good mood all day.

events.name: Morning walk and community Baduanjin morning exercise class
events.description: Got up at 5:20, stretched, then walked briskly for 15 minutes. At 9 o'clock, Ma Xiulan went to the community fitness square in sportswear to attend the Baduanjin class. Following the instructor's lead, she completed the full set of movements and felt more practiced than in the first lesson, with her shoulders and neck feeling relaxed. During practice, she noticed an auntie in the front row whose posture was standard and expression composed.

events.name: Met Auntie Zhao during the break and learned acupressure massage
events.description: During the break, Aunt Zhao in the front row (Zhao Sufen, 65 years old, retired teacher) took the initiative to offer homemade hawthorn tea. The two chatted about traditional Chinese medicine health preservation and hit it off. Learning that Ma Xiulan often had lower back soreness, Aunt Zhao asked her to sit on the bench and demonstrated pressing acupoints such as Yaoyan and Weizhong. Xiulan tried it and indeed felt relaxed. The two agreed to come and exercise together every day from then on and added each other on WeChat.

events.name: Return home to share about the new friend and the acupoint method.
events.description: Returning home at 10 a.m., Ma Xiulan excitedly told her husband and children about meeting Aunt Zhao that day while preparing lunch, and demonstrated pressing the acupoints on her waist. Yuxin curiously imitated the movements, and Zhiqiang also laughed. Xiulan felt that having a companion made exercise more enjoyable.

events.name: Husband's right arm fully recovered, so he took the initiative to carry heavy objects.
events.description: At 11 a.m., husband Ma Zhiqiang was exercising his right arm in the yard and confirmed it had fully recovered and felt strong. He saw Ma Xiulan about to move two heavy jars of pickled vegetables, immediately stepped in and took them from her, saying, "Your back is bad — from now on, call me for anything heavy!" Xiulan felt warm inside and agreed readily.

events.name: Her husband loosened the soil in the courtyard.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Ma Zhiqiang picked up a shovel and turned over the unused plot in the yard to prepare for planting radishes in autumn. While making tea, Ma Xiulan saw his sweat-soaked back, remembered how his arm had been bothering him recently, and felt a warmth in her heart. She brought the tea over, and the two stood and talked for a while.

events.name: In the evening, her husband carried the pickling jar back.
events.description: At 6 p.m., Ma Zhiqiang moved the two jars of pickled vegetables that had been moved to a shady place during the day back to the kitchen storage room, and also checked the water seal on the jar rims. Ma Xiulan helped open the door nearby, smiling and saying that from now on this task would be entirely his responsibility.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, looking forward to morning exercise.

end_state.mood: Warm and moved: husband was considerate, new friend clicked

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of brisk walking in the morning, 1 hour of Baduanjin class, 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, 10 minutes of acupoint massage

2025-07.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan got up early and practiced Baduanjin independently, nearly completing the full routine. In the morning she sorted out the embroidery threads needed for orders. Her husband continued moving the jars, while she cleaned and prepared next week's pickling tools. In the afternoon she called Zhou Xiuqin to confirm division of labor details. Life went on as usual, laying groundwork for the upcoming busy period.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin practice is becoming more proficient.
events.description: Got up at 5:20 in the morning, did shoulder and neck stretches, then walked briskly along Jingwen Road for 15 minutes, and then practiced Baduanjin in the courtyard. She could now complete a full routine smoothly, only still feeling great pressure on her knees during "Shake the Head and Wag the Tail to Expel Heart Fire". She recorded a video and sent it to Aunt Zhao, and received the encouragement that she had made "great progress in her movements".

events.name: Husband moving the jar and the couple's unspoken rapport
events.description: At 7 a.m., before going out, Ma Zhiqiang moved the jar to the shady spot in the southeast corner, and Ma Xiulan reminded him to be careful with his back. At 5:45 p.m., Zhiqiang finished work and carried it back, and Xiulan took the opportunity to wipe the jar rim clean with a damp cloth. The two of them working together has become second nature.

events.name: Washed pickling tools and organized materials.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan took out the large vat, pickling stones, and wooden sticks used last year, washed and disinfected them with boiling water, and set them in the yard to dry. She also checked the quantities of pre-ordered cucumbers and radishes and wrote them on a sticky note. She sent Zhou Xiuqin a WeChat message to confirm that they would come to her home early on the 14th.

events.name: Preparing embroidery thread for an embroidery order
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan received a small embroidery order forwarded by Zheng Xiuying—to embroider a pair of tiger-head shoe uppers for a newborn, with a payment of 50 yuan. She found red, yellow, black and other colored silk threads, prepared stitch samples, and planned to try embroidering the shoe-toe pattern in the evening.

start_state.mood: The peace of a regular life

end_state.location: At the handicraft table at home.
end_state.mood: Fulfilling, ready for new orders of pickled vegetables and embroidery.

state.daily_exercise: In the early morning: 15 minutes of brisk walking, 20 minutes of Baduanjin exercise, 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, and 5 minutes of lower back stretches.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, 33°C, cool in the evening

2025-07.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan was busy with household chores during the day. In the evening she went to a classmates' KTV gathering, gradually loosening up from being shy and recapturing a bit of youthful joy. After returning home, she made light of it, but secretly savored the memory. Her husband, as usual, moved the jars, and she also adjusted the family's fruit distribution because Mingzhe had a sore at the corner of his mouth.

events.name: Discovered the second son's mouth corners were ulcerated and ordered fruit to be added.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan noticed that Mingzhe had red, cracked corners of his mouth and judged it was a lack of vitamins B and C. She immediately decided that from that day on, lunch and dinner must include tomato salad or a fruit platter, and urged everyone to eat an apple every day. She told her husband and eldest son about this requirement so the whole family could supervise one another.

events.name: Morning walk and moving the jar with her husband
events.description: Got up at 5:20, stretched, and then briskly walked for 15 minutes. At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Zhiqiang moved the jar out, and at 5:45 in the evening he moved it back. Xiulan took the opportunity to sweep the area around the jar clean.

events.name: Preparing to attend a classmate’s birthday party
events.description: At 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan prepared for Zhao Xiaohong's birthday KTV gathering in the evening. She changed into a light blue short-sleeved shirt with dark trousers, took 200 yuan in cash and put it in a red envelope. Before going out, she told her husband that she would be late returning from the classmates' dinner. She explained to Mingxuan the matters of checking the evening homework.

events.name: KTV gathering and singing attempt
events.description: At 6:30 in the evening, she walked to the KTV in town and waited at the door for Liu Chunmei and other classmates from the same group. Inside the private room, she felt dizzy at first from the flashing lights and music, so she sat in the corner and ate fruit. The birthday girl, Zhao Xiaohong, passed her the microphone and requested 'Sweet Honey.' She tried to decline but could not refuse, so she hid in the corner and sang a few lines softly, winning applause from everyone. She was then urged to sing a duet of 'Friends,' and the whole process was recorded on video and sent to the classmates group.

events.name: Walking home after it ended and how I felt
events.description: Near 11:30 p.m., as the gathering broke up, Zhao Xiaohong tried to persuade her to stay. Ma Xiulan waved her hand and said it was getting late. She walked home alone, humming "Sweet Honey" unconsciously along the way, feeling that it was good to "let loose" once in a while. After arriving home, she washed up quietly. Her husband woke with a start and asked why she was so late. She only said that they had chatted long at the gathering, without mentioning the KTV details.

start_state.mood: Daily household chores, with slight concern about the corners of Mingzhe's mouth

end_state.mood: A satisfying and slightly secretive ease; a rare social relaxation

state.daily_exercise: A 15-minute brisk walk in the early morning, 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, and about 30 minutes of walking to and from the KTV

2025-07.daily_overview: The Baduanjin class ended, and Ma Xiulan performed the entire routine smoothly and was praised as being like an "instructor." In the afternoon, she went through the truck's inspection documents and made photocopies, fully preparing for tomorrow's annual inspection. Her husband, as usual, moved the jars; in the evening, she embroidered tiger-head shoe uppers while thinking about tomorrow's process.

events.name: Morning walk and completion of the Baduanjin class
events.description: Got up at 5:25, stretched, then walked briskly for 15 minutes. At 9 a.m., in the last class, Ma Xiulan could already complete the entire routine smoothly, and the coach asked her to lead the Two Hands Hold the Feet to Strengthen the Kidneys and Waist move in front. During the break, she also guided a new partner in adjusting the ball-holding posture, and Liu Chunmei joked that she could already be an instructor. After the course ended, the three of them received the community fitness bag souvenirs and took photos to remember the occasion.

events.name: Organizing the truck's annual inspection paperwork
events.description: At 2 p.m., Ma Xiulan went through the drawer in the living room where her husband kept documents and found the compulsory traffic accident liability insurance policy for the truck, the vehicle license, and the vehicle registration certificate. She checked the validity dates one by one, made two copies of the key pages with the home printer, and put them in a transparent document folder. She also noted the inspection station address and the required fees in her phone memo.

events.name: Husband moving jars and checking the pickled vegetables
events.description: At 7:15 in the morning, Zhiqiang moved the jar while Xiulan handed him warm water; at 6:20 in the evening, when he moved it back, he casually opened the jar and smelled it, saying, "This batch of pickled cucumbers tastes just right." The two smiled at each other.

events.name: In the evening, embroider tiger-head shoe uppers.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ma Xiulan was embroidering tiger-head shoe uppers under the desk lamp, carefully stitching the ears, eyes, and the 'king' character stitch by stitch. At the same time, she mentally rehearsed tomorrow's annual inspection process: first queue up, then have the lights checked, and finally pay the fee and receive the sticker, determined to save the money she would have paid a middleman.

start_state.mood: Reluctant to leave the final class, but happy she stuck with it.

end_state.mood: Everything is ready, and I feel confident about tomorrow's annual inspection.

state.daily_exercise: 15-minute brisk walk in the morning, 1-hour Baduanjin class, and 5-minute neck and shoulder stretches

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, 32°C, sunny in the afternoon

2025-07.daily_overview: An important day: Ma Xiulan accompanied her husband to complete the truck's annual inspection smoothly, saving the money that would have gone to a scalper. In the morning, she bought materials with Zhou Xiuqin and Wang Guilan to prepare for making pickled vegetables, and the three divided the work clearly. At dawn, she independently completed the full set of Baduanjin for the first time. Her daily rhythm was tight but productive.

events.name: Morning walk and first independent morning Baduanjin exercise.
events.description: Got up at 5:20 a.m., did shoulder and neck stretches, then walked briskly for 15 minutes. Afterward, she practiced a set of Baduanjin alone in the courtyard. Though there was no music, her rhythm stayed steady. She felt her movement proficiency had entered a new stage and her lower back muscles were comfortable, so she decided to continue morning exercise every day after finishing the course. After practicing, she recorded her feelings in her phone memo.

events.name: Assist husband with the annual inspection of the truck.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan drove the truck from home to the Jinghai District Motor Vehicle Inspection Station with her husband Ma Zhiqiang. After arriving, she helped park the truck in the queue area and got a queue number. While waiting, following her husband's instructions, she used a screwdriver to check the headlights, turn signals, brake lights, and horn—all were normal.

events.name: Passed the annual inspection, paid the fee, and received the label
events.description: Around 10 o'clock, the truck passed the inspection line. Ma Xiulan and her husband went to the window together, paid the fee of 350 yuan, and received the inspection qualification mark and the updated vehicle license supplemental page. Her husband remarked that handling it themselves was reassuring, and Xiulan also felt relieved. After returning home, she stuck the qualification mark on the upper right corner of the windshield and put the documents back in place.

events.name: Husband moving the jars and final inventory of the pickled vegetable tools
events.description: Moving the jars in the morning as usual. At 11 a.m., Ma Xiulan checked again the vats, stones, and tools that had been cleaned and dried yesterday, and placed them on the cleared workbench in the kitchen. She called Zhou Xiuqin to confirm that they would start at 7 a.m. tomorrow.

events.name: Afternoon: buying ingredients for pickled vegetables and the final preparation meeting
events.description: At 2 p.m., Ma Xiulan, Zhou Xiuqin, and Wang Guilan separately went to Sun Guifang's stall to pick up the pre-ordered 50 jin of cucumbers and 30 jin of radishes, and also bought salt, sugar, Sichuan pepper and other seasonings. Returning to Xiulan's home, the three moved the ingredients to a cool place and finalized the process: tomorrow at 7 a.m. Xiuqin will wash and cut the vegetables, Guilan will simmer the seasoning liquid at 8 a.m., and Xiulan will pack the jars and seal them.

start_state.mood: Mind focused; the annual inspection and the pickled vegetables were beginning to make her a little tense.

end_state.mood: Successfully completed two major tasks, feeling grounded and full of energy.

state.daily_exercise: In the early morning: 15 minutes of brisk walking, 20 minutes of Baduanjin exercise, 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, and 5 minutes of lower back stretches.

2025-07.daily_overview: On the first day of the pickle-making partnership, Ma Xiulan, Zhou Xiuqin, and Wang Guilan cooperated smoothly. But because Xiuqin was absent due to something unexpected, Ma Xiulan alone took on double the tasks, continuing late into the night, and her back soreness worsened. Her husband moving jars had become routine, and she also found time to check possible corners for the reading corner. In the evening, she went over the month's income and expenses with her husband and stuck the travel fund deposit record on the refrigerator.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin and moving jars with husband
events.description: Got up at 5:20 in the morning. After stretching her neck and shoulders, she completed a set of Baduanjin (the movements slightly simplified because of fatigue), then moved the vats to a shady place with her husband. At 7, Zhiqiang set off in the truck, and Xiulan quickly swept the courtyard to make room for the pickled vegetable work.

events.name: Day one of the pickled vegetable assembly line (busy and working overtime)
events.description: At 7 a.m., Zhou Xiuqin and Wang Guilan arrived. Xiuqin was originally supposed to rinse and cut the vegetables, but at 9 she took a phone call and said she had a family emergency and needed to leave for two hours. Ma Xiulan had Guilan start simmering the seasoning liquid first, while she took over rinsing and cutting the vegetables into strips. Xiuqin returned at 12 and the three sped up, but they had fallen behind. In order to complete the plan, Ma Xiulan decided to extend the work into the late night. She handled the cutting, preparing, and jar-filling on her own, while Guilan helped simmer the liquid and seal the jars. By midnight they had only finished two-thirds of the planned amount, filling three small jars. She stood and bent down frequently, and despite wearing a back brace, her waist was noticeably sore and swollen.

events.name: At noon, husband moved the jars and had a quick meal.
events.description: At noon, Zhiqiang came back and saw the three of them busy, so he took the initiative to move the jars, then went to the kitchen and made three bowls of noodles. Everyone sat around and hurriedly ate, then continued working.

events.name: Evening: explore the reading corner and family accounts.
events.description: During a break from work, Ma Xiulan, fighting exhaustion, looked at the empty corner by the window in the living room and considered turning it into a reading nook. After dinner, she and her husband checked the expenses for the first half of July, put the 180 yuan she had saved this year from markets and embroidery into a separate Beijing travel fund envelope, and stuck a record sticker on the refrigerator door. She and her husband discussed depositing 300 yuan into the fund every month.

events.name: Insisted on doing deep breathing before bed late at night
events.description: After finishing work at 12 a.m., Ma Xiulan endured her sore back, sat quietly by the bedside in the bedroom for 5 minutes to do her pre-sleep deep breathing, and reviewed the day—tired but satisfied. It was already past midnight when she went to bed.

start_state.mood: Eager to get started—the pickled vegetable cooperation has finally begun.

end_state.mood: Tired but satisfied. There were some surprises on the first day of production, but the travel fund was launched.

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of Baduanjin morning exercise (simplified movements), 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, 5 minutes of simplified cat stretch for the lower back muscles, and about 5 hours of physical activity from pickled vegetable work.

2025-07.daily_overview: After doing shoulder and neck stretches and Baduanjin in the early morning, Ma Xiulan practiced Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao at the community square and studied acupoint massage in depth. Because her partner Zhou Xiuqin had a family emergency, she took on the pickled vegetable production task alone and worked with her neighbor Wang Guilan from dawn until the early hours. Though her back and waist were stiff, she ensured the output. In the evening, she also squeezed in time to arrange outdoor activities for the children and check their eye-care habits. Before bed, she insisted on deep-breathing relaxation. This day of physical exhaustion demonstrated her sense of responsibility and resilience.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretches and Baduanjin
events.description: After getting up at 5:15, Ma Xiulan did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch and a set of Baduanjin in the living room. Her movements were slow and focused on breathing, preparing herself for going out for morning exercise.

events.name: Practice Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao in the morning and study acupoint massage in depth
events.description: At around 6 in the morning, Ma Xiulan arrived at the community square as promised and practiced Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao. The two warmed up first, then completed two full rounds of Baduanjin, and their bodies felt slightly warm. After the exercise, Aunt Zhao taught, in the shade of a tree, the hand techniques for pressing the Zusanli and Hegu acupoints. Ma Xiulan tried repeatedly and felt warmth in her legs. The two chatted about amusing stories about their grandchildren while drinking cooling hawthorn tea, and agreed to meet again next Wednesday.

events.name: Arranged outdoor activities for the children and checked eye-care habits.
events.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan reminded the children to watch less TV and required at least one hour of outdoor activity in the afternoon. The eldest son played hide-and-seek with his younger siblings in the yard, while she sat at the door embroidering and occasionally looked up to check on them. In the evening, she checked the brightness of the desk lamps one by one, praised her eldest son for not lying in bed looking at his phone, and encouraged him to keep it up.

events.name: After her partner was absent, she took on the pickled vegetable production alone and adjusted the division of labor.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Zhou Xiuqin called Ma Xiulan to apologize because her mother had suddenly fallen ill and she had to go to the hospital. Ma Xiulan decided to take on the work alone. When her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped move the jars, he noticed there was not enough water in the jar rims, so she added water and adjusted them. She and Wang Guilan made emergency adjustments: Wang Guilan cooked the seasoning liquid, while she took on washing, cutting, preparing, filling the jars, and sealing the mouths. She worked from 7 a.m. until the early hours of the next day; her waist and back were stiff, but she persisted and got it done, and output did not drop. In the evening, her husband saw in the weather forecast that rain was coming and moved the jars back in advance; she praised him for being thoughtful.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: After working overtime until the early morning, Ma Xiulan still insisted on sitting quietly by the bedside for 5 minutes, recalling the small blessing of the day when her daughter had helped her pass the jar lid. Once her emotions calmed down, she fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.mood: Tired but satisfied.

state.daily_exercise: Baduanjin twice, about 8,000 steps of walking, shoulder and neck stretches

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with a gentle breeze in the evening.

2025-07.daily_overview: Today marked the successful completion of the week-long pickle jar moving task. Ma Xiulan specially cooked to reward her husband. In the afternoon, her partner Zhou Xiuqin came to her door to apologize. The two had a small clash over the absence incident, but after calming down they communicated frankly and established a primary-and-backup scheduling system. In the evening, she began soaking her feet in hot mugwort water to relieve the fatigue of the past few days, and her sleep quality improved noticeably.

events.name: Easy morning stretch routine
events.description: Because she was tired and got up a little late, Ma Xiulan only did 3 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches and did not do Baduanjin, but she still insisted on a 10-minute morning walk.

events.name: Successfully completed the task of moving the pickled vegetable jars and thanked her husband.
events.description: At 7:10 in the morning, her husband Ma Zhiqiang moved the jar for the last time, and Ma Xiulan took photos with her phone to mark the occasion. At 6:00 in the evening, after moving the jar back, she announced that the week-long jar-moving task had been successfully completed. She suggested making a few of her signature dishes—sweet and sour pork tenderloin and tomato and egg soup—to thank her husband for his hard work all week. At the dinner table, the couple talked about how well they worked together, and the atmosphere was warm.

events.name: Resolve cooperation friction with Zhou Xiuqin and establish primary and backup plans.
events.description: In the afternoon, Zhou Xiuqin came to apologize after handling her mother's hospitalization. Ma Xiulan couldn't help complaining that the last-minute change had almost caused problems, and Zhou Xiuqin, with red-rimmed eyes, explained the urgency of her mother's condition. After calming down, Ma Xiulan recognized the difficulty and proactively softened her tone. The two women decided on a primary-backup plan: if one had something come up, they could swap tasks in advance or postpone by half a day, and they set up a WeChat group to confirm attendance daily. They agreed to review on Sunday evenings and schedule the next week's tasks, so that productivity was maintained without hurting their relationship.

events.name: First bedtime foot soak with mugwort and hot water
events.description: Following Aunt Zhao's advice, Ma Xiulan soaked her feet in hot water with mugwort for 15 minutes before bed. While soaking, she listened to the TV news and felt completely relaxed. That night she fell asleep earlier, at 22:30, and when she woke up, the soreness in her lower back was eased.

start_state.mood: Slight fatigue

end_state.mood: Relieved and full of confidence.

state.daily_exercise: A 10-minute morning walk; the amount of housework was relatively large.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with a cool breeze in the evening.

2025-07.daily_overview: During the day, Ma Xiulan carefully prepared small samples of pickled vegetables at home. In the early evening, she cooled off and chatted with her neighbor across the landing, Wang Guilan, at the doorway, sharing homemade pickled cucumbers and sweet garlic. She unexpectedly learned the good news that Wang Guilan's daughter-in-law is pregnant, and they spontaneously agreed to make tomato sauce together. She also resumed her morning Baduanjin routine, and during her evening walk she felt her strength returning. The neighborly affection grew deeper through these daily interactions.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin and shoulder-neck stretching.
events.description: After waking up at 5:20 in the morning, Ma Xiulan did a 5-minute neck and shoulder stretch in the living room, then completed a full set of Baduanjin. Her movements were gradually becoming smoother, though she still felt a slight pulling sensation in her lower back during stretching, but overall she felt relaxed.

events.name: Prepare pickled vegetable samples and share them with neighbor Wang Guilan.
events.description: During the day, Ma Xiulan put the pickled sweet garlic and soy-pickled cucumbers into small dishes in the kitchen, choosing the best-looking ones to prepare for sharing in the evening. In the evening, Ma Xiulan carried a stool to the doorway to enjoy the cool air, and Wang Guilan also brought a stool and sat down. The two of them fanned themselves with palm-leaf fans and chatted about the children and neighborhood gossip. Ma Xiulan brought out the pickled vegetables for Wang Guilan to taste. Wang Guilan praised them again and again and happily shared the good news that her daughter-in-law was pregnant. Ma Xiulan warmly congratulated her, went home, and brought back a small jar of homemade pickled sour plums to help her daughter-in-law whet her appetite.

events.name: Agreed to make tomato sauce together
events.description: Near the end of the chat, Ma Xiulan mentioned that the tomatoes in the yard were almost ripe and she wanted to try making tomato sauce. Wang Guilan immediately said she had a traditional recipe, and the two agreed to make it together next time, with Ma Xiulan preparing the tomatoes and glass jars and Wang Guilan providing the recipe and tools. After agreeing, they each returned to their rooms, and Ma Xiulan began thinking about how soon the tomatoes would ripen.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and deep breathing
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan continued to soak her feet in mugwort water for 15 minutes, did 5 minutes of pre-sleep deep breathing, recalled the pleasant time with Wang Guilan, and fell asleep quickly.

start_state.mood: Relaxed

end_state.mood: Happy

state.daily_exercise: One set of Baduanjin, and an evening walk of about 2,500 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Morning: sunny turning cloudy; evening: showers.

2025-07.daily_overview: Saturday was the handicraft market day of the Jinghai District Folk Culture Festival. Ma Xiulan carefully prepared pickled vegetables and embroidered pieces early in the morning and set up a stall together with Zhou Xiuqin, who came to help. During the day, they enthusiastically promoted the goods at the market, selling 16 jars of pickled vegetables and receiving 3 inquiries for custom round fans, netting 180 yuan. Although an evening shower forced them to close early, she was glad to have taken a solid step in her sideline. That night, while soaking her feet, she excitedly planned for the next market.

events.name: Simple morning workout.
events.description: In order to catch the early morning market, she only did a 5-minute neck and shoulder stretch, skipped the Baduanjin exercise, but took a brisk 10-minute walk.

events.name: Carefully preparing goods for the handicraft market
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan divided and labeled the pickled cucumbers and sweet garlic in the kitchen and living room, wrapped and counted the embroidered fan panels, and brought the tablecloth and price tags, making sure the stall had a warm handmade atmosphere.

events.name: Set up a stall at the handicraft market with Zhou Xiuqin.
events.description: Ma Xiulan rode her e-bike to the market, spread a tablecloth on the stall, and arranged the goods. Zhou Xiuqin arrived a little later to help. The two received customers; Ma Xiulan enthusiastically introduced the low-salt recipe and handcrafted process of the pickles, inviting customers to taste them. She also displayed embroidered fan faces and answered price inquiries. They successfully sold 16 jars of pickles and received 3 intentions to order custom round fans (one person asked for a lotus pattern). Zhou Xiuqin helped record contact information, and the two cooperated smoothly.

events.name: Closing the stall, calculating revenue, and agreeing on future cooperation
events.description: Because of an evening rain shower, they closed the stall early and packed up the remaining items. Ma Xiulan counted the earnings and, after deducting the stall fee, netted 180 yuan. She put the cash away carefully. Delighted to have made the first contribution toward her Beijing travel goal, she agreed with Zhou Xiuqin to attend similar markets together in the future.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and reflection
events.description: While soaking her feet in the evening, she recalled the market process, recorded the income in her ledger, and decided to put 180 yuan into the travel fund as its first deposit.

start_state.mood: Eager and nervous

end_state.mood: A great sense of accomplishment

state.daily_exercise: Standing and moving around, about 12,000 steps.

2025-07.daily_overview: Sunday was family day. In the morning, she took her youngest daughter to attend a painting award ceremony. Her daughter's painting, Mom's Pickled Vegetables, won third prize, and the whole family celebrated for her. In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan officially launched the Beijing travel special savings plan, deposited the first 180 yuan, and set a monthly savings rule of 400 yuan, making the children cheer joyfully. In the evening, she also learned new Su embroidery stitches, and her husband performed truck maintenance. The couple worked in tacit understanding to advance the family's big plans. Before bed, while soaking their feet, she also reviewed acupressure.

events.name: In the early morning, practiced Baduanjin with the eldest son.
events.description: At 6:00, Ma Xiulan took her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to practice Baduanjin in the courtyard. Mingxuan initially thought it looked like old people's exercises, but after finishing, he said his shoulders felt relaxed, and afterward he would occasionally join in on his own. She also completed the entire routine smoothly.

events.name: Took her youngest daughter to the painting award ceremony.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan took her younger daughter, Ma Yuxin, to the community cultural center to attend the "Little Artist" painting awards ceremony. Yuxin's painting "Mom's Pickles" won third prize, with a set of watercolor pens as the prize. Ma Xiulan squatted down to put the medal on her daughter, and the mother and daughter took a photo together. Yuxin happily said she would draw even more of Mom.

events.name: Celebrate daughter's award and make a fruit platter
events.description: After the awards ceremony, Ma Xiulan took Yuxin to the vegetable market to buy fruit. In the afternoon, the mother and daughter cut the fruit into star and flower shapes in the kitchen and arranged them into a colorful platter. In the evening, when her husband came home, Yuxin held up the platter to show off. Her husband picked up his daughter and laughed, "Our family has produced a little painter!" and the whole family shared the joy of winning the award.

events.name: Set up a dedicated Beijing travel savings plan and make the initial deposit.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan looked through her daughter's certificates in the living room and resolved to set up a travel fund. She took out her account book, wrote the heading 'Beijing Travel Fund,' set a goal of 2,000 yuan, planned to deposit 400 yuan each month (300 yuan from her husband + 100 yuan from part-time work), and added a motivational note. She took 180 yuan of market income from her wallet and recorded it as the first deposit. She called the three children over and solemnly announced it. The children cheered, and she smiled with gratification.

events.name: Husband performed comprehensive maintenance on the truck and added safety equipment
events.description: In the morning, her husband Ma Zhiqiang had the truck fully serviced at the repair shop, replacing the engine oil and brake pads, at a cost of 800 yuan. In the evening, the couple went to a hardware supermarket and bought a vehicle fire extinguisher and a first-aid kit for a total of 120 yuan. Ma Xiulan chose the cost-effective option. After returning home, she secured the fire extinguisher next to the driver's seat and put the first-aid kit in the storage box. In the evening, she sorted the vehicle documents, put them in a clear document folder with copies, and fixed it in the glove box.

events.name: Online learning of new Suzhou embroidery stitches: rolling needle stitch and seed stitch
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan watched embroidery tutorials on her phone to learn the “rolling stitch” and “seed stitch.” She found her embroidery hoop and silk thread, and after repeatedly taking out and redoing the stitches three times, she finally embroidered a small complete flower in nearly two hours. She had a preliminary grasp of the stitches. Her eyes were a little sore, but she felt happy.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and massaging acupoints
events.description: While soaking her feet, she tried pressing Zusanli, felt warmth in her legs, and did five minutes of deep breathing. She reviewed the day and fell asleep happily.

start_state.mood: Full of anticipation

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and happy

state.daily_exercise: One round of Baduanjin, walk about 4,000 steps.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Monday, Ma Xiulan focused on following up on embroidery orders from the market fair: she contacted three interested customers in turn, finalized Ms. Li's custom lotus round fan (60 yuan), provided a sample plan for the hesitant Mr. Zhang, and though she was a little disappointed that the third customer left an invalid number, she quickly adjusted her mindset and began preparing materials. In the morning, she also helped her husband establish a formal pre-departure inspection habit for his truck. During the day, she did waist and back stretches in between tasks; in the evening, she did accounting and reflection while soaking her feet.

events.name: Morning solo practice of Baduanjin
events.description: After getting up at 5:30, I practiced Baduanjin alone in the courtyard, felt that there was no longer any problem when stretching the waist, and then did shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes.

events.name: Helped her husband establish a habit of inspecting the vehicle before departure
events.description: In the early morning, Ma Zhiqiang carried out his first formal pre-departure inspection, with Ma Xiulan assisting. Ma Zhiqiang checked the tires, oil, brakes, and lights; she checked the fire extinguisher, first-aid kit, and documents, and verbally reminded about the weather conditions. The whole process took 20 minutes and clarified their respective responsibilities.

events.name: Followed up on intended orders for embroidered round fans at the market
events.description: Ma Xiulan dug out her contact information and contacted customers one by one. She first called Ms. Li and finalized the details of the lotus round fan (20 cm diameter, 60 yuan, delivery in three days). Then she called Mr. Zhang and suggested embroidering a sample first; Mr. Zhang agreed. The third number was invalid; she sighed softly but was not discouraged. She then prepared plain round fans with lotus patterns, silk thread, and other materials, and neatly placed them in the work area.

events.name: Midday rest and daily chores
events.description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan tried extending her midday nap to 45 minutes for the first time, and felt more refreshed when she woke up. In the afternoon she did light housework and supervised the children's studies.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and a brief monthly summary.
events.description: While soaking her feet in the evening, she briefly noted down today's follow-up progress, was happy about the 60-yuan order, and planned to start embroidery the next day.

start_state.mood: In an orderly manner

end_state.mood: Satisfied, and plans are set for tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: One set of Baduanjin and household chores

2025-07.daily_overview: In the early morning, water seeping through the kitchen ceiling caught Ma Xiulan off guard. She urgently contacted Master Liu to inspect it and learned that the repair required replacing the tiles. After discussing it with her husband, she decided to spend 1000 yuan to solve the problem once and for all, and used the occasion to establish a monthly 200 yuan home repair fund. The same day, she uploaded her embroidery work to the exchange group, received advice from Aunt Wu, and arranged a video lesson. Although the leak was troubling, she kept up her afternoon nap and foot soak, and her mood gradually calmed.

events.name: Morning stretching was hurriedly canceled due to the water leak.
events.description: After discovering a leak, she dealt with it in a hurry and only did simple waist stretches, skipping Baduanjin. But after the children reminded her, she promised to make it up the next day.

events.name: Handle kitchen water seepage and agree on roof repairs
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan found a leak dripping from the kitchen ceiling and immediately called Master Liu. After inspecting, Master Liu confirmed that the heavy rain had damaged the roof tiles; three tiles needed to be replaced and waterproofing was required, and he quoted 1,000 yuan. In the evening, she discussed it with her husband, and they agreed the repair was necessary despite the large expense. She decided to set aside 200 yuan from this month as a house repair fund and recorded it in the account book.

events.name: Uploading embroidery work and receiving online guidance from Aunt Wu
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan photographed the small flower she had embroidered the day before and posted it in the embroidery group with her thoughts. Aunt Wu sent a private message to praise her and offered video guidance on complex Suzhou embroidery patterns. Ma Xiulan gladly accepted, and they agreed on a video lesson for the next week. This interaction greatly boosted her confidence.

events.name: Keep your midday nap and add heat-relieving soup
events.description: The lunch break is still set at 45 minutes. In the afternoon, cook mung bean soup for the family to relieve the heat and replenish the moisture lost from the stuffy weather.

events.name: Soaking her feet before bed and managing her emotions
events.description: While soaking her feet, she reflected on the water leakage incident, felt she had handled it well, and her mood changed from panic to relief.

start_state.mood: Got a little flustered by the water leak

end_state.mood: Peace of mind (the repair decision has been made)

state.daily_exercise: Light housework; walked about 4,000 steps

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, temperature dropping slightly

2025-07.daily_overview: Today was the official day of the roof repair work. Ma Xiulan assisted Master Liu throughout and supervised the quality to make sure the roof tiles were replaced properly. She also did not forget her parenting duties: she had the children make activity plans, took them to the park in the afternoon to play ball and identify flowers and plants, and in the evening corrected her second son's writing posture and emphasized eye protection. In addition, she resumed her morning Baduanjin practice and, as promised, practiced with Aunt Zhao in the community. In the evening, while practicing Su embroidery, she developed soreness in her right wrist and treated it with a hot compress. Life was busy but orderly.

events.name: Practiced Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao in the community.
events.description: At 6:00, Ma Xiulan arrived at the community garden as promised and practiced Baduanjin twice with Aunt Zhao. Aunt Zhao corrected her 'Shake Head and Wag Tail' movement, and she felt her lower back become more relaxed. After practice, they reviewed pressing Zusanli and agreed to continue on Sunday.

events.name: Master Liu repaired the roof by replacing tiles.
events.description: In the morning, Master Liu arrived with tools and new tiles to make repairs. He cleared away the broken tiles, laid a waterproof layer, and put on new tiles. Ma Xiulan helped by handing him tools, serving tea, and keeping an eye on the progress, occasionally sweeping up fallen debris. The weather cleared up and the work went smoothly.

events.name: Take the children for outdoor activities and correct their eye-use habits
events.description: In the morning, she had the children make an activity plan to ensure an hour outdoors. In the afternoon, she took them to the park in Jinghai District. The eldest son played badminton, the second son and the little daughter played on the slide, and she taught her daughter to recognize roses and hollyhocks. In the evening, she noticed her second son's handwriting was crooked, so she corrected him immediately and demonstrated the correct sitting posture: one foot, one inch, one fist. She also did not do handicrafts in dim light herself.

events.name: Night embroidery caused soreness in the right wrist
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan continued embroidering a lotus round fan. Because practicing seed stitch made her wrist work frequently, her right wrist became slightly sore. She realized it might be strain, stopped embroidering, applied a hot towel to the affected area, and massaged the Hegu acupoint. She decided to reduce her embroidery time the next day.

events.name: Before-Bed Foot Soak and Wrist Care
events.description: While soaking her feet, she continued to apply a warm compress to her wrist. Feeling the soreness ease, she decided to use a wrist brace.

start_state.mood: Preparing for construction to begin

end_state.mood: Relieved (construction is going smoothly), slight concern about the wrist.

state.daily_exercise: Baduanjin twice; walked to the park and back with the children, about 5,000 steps.

2025-07.daily_overview: In the afternoon, Master Liu finished the roof repair. Ma Xiulan inspected and accepted the work and paid the 1000 yuan repair fee in full, feeling a weight lifted. In the evening, she continued making lotus round fans, wearing a wrist brace to control the time spent. She filed the repair receipt and officially started the record for the housing maintenance fund. She also kept up her morning Baduanjin and lunch break, and while soaking her feet before bed, she planned tomorrow's photo sorting.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin fine-tuning
events.description: Got up at 5:40, practiced Baduanjin in the living room. Because of wrist problems, she reduced the range of hand movements and focused more on stretching her legs and waist.

events.name: Roof repair completed and repair costs paid.
events.description: In the afternoon, Master Liu finished replacing the tiles and asked Ma Xiulan to inspect. She carefully checked the new tiles and waterproofing, confirmed no leaks, was very satisfied, and paid 1,000 yuan on the spot. Master Liu wrote a receipt and promised to be available if any problems arose. Looking at the repaired roof, she felt the money was well spent.

events.name: Rush to make embroidered round fans and organize family receipts
events.description: In the evening, while embroidering the lotus round fan, she wore a wrist guard and worked in short, frequent sessions, mainly using rolling stitch instead of seed stitch. She also put the roof repair receipt into the receipt pouch and recorded the first month's reserve of 200 yuan as the starting amount on the housing repair fund page of the ledger.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and planning for tomorrow
events.description: While soaking her feet, she realized that half the year had passed and decided to sort and print photos tomorrow and continue maintaining the reading corner.

start_state.mood: A bit more relaxed

end_state.mood: Grounded

state.daily_exercise: One session of Baduanjin, and about 3,000 steps going up and down stairs.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with rosy clouds at dusk.

2025-07.daily_overview: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan sorted through the family photos from the first half of the year, selected 20 to have printed, and decorated an old photo album together with her younger daughter, reminiscing about family moments. In the evening, she noticed the children's writing was dry and dull, realized there wasn't enough of a reading atmosphere, immediately tidied up the old bookshelf, created a reading corner in the living room, and started a daily half-hour family reading session that very night. The whole family sat together turning pages, and the atmosphere was warm and cozy. She also kept up her morning exercise, afternoon nap, and foot soaking, and her wrist soreness has eased.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin and shoulder-neck stretching.
events.description: After getting up early at 5:30, she did a complete round of Baduanjin, felt light in body, and did the shoulder and neck stretches as usual.

events.name: Organize the family photos from the first half of the year and make a physical photo album
events.description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan looked through photos from the first half of the year on her phone and camera and selected 20 (her husband drinking chicken soup with a bandage on, her eldest son's report card, spinach in the courtyard, her daughter holding up her bellyband, etc.). She walked to the photo printing shop to have them printed. On the way, she bought candy-colored stickers and photo corners.
