In the evening, she and her youngest daughter Yuxin fixed the photos into an old album with photo corners, and Yuxin decorated it with flower stickers. The album became thicker, and flipping through it, she felt how precious these days are.

events.name: Recognized the reading issue and started building a family reading corner.
events.description: While grading homework in the evening, she found that the children's writing was dry and they did not like reading. She immediately tidied up the unused old bookshelf, wiped it clean, and moved it to the living room by the window. After clearing space from the clutter, she decided to go to her younger sister's house tomorrow to borrow books.

events.name: Officially launched the family's daily reading time.
events.description: At 8 o'clock that evening, she gathered the children in the new reading corner and announced that from 8:00 to 8:30 every evening would be reading time, with her accompanying them. The rules: take turns choosing books, stay quiet, and share after finishing. The eldest son chose Andersen's Fairy Tales, while the second son and daughter pestered her to tell stories. Amid laughter and joy, the reading corner was inaugurated.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and refining the reading corner plan.
events.description: While soaking her feet, she thought about going to her younger sister's house tomorrow to borrow some children's books to fill up the bookshelf.

start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.mood: Full of warmth and determination

state.daily_exercise: One set of Baduanjin exercises; walking to the photo printing shop about 3,000 steps

2025-07.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ma Xiulan made good on her promise to take the children on a short trip to her younger sister's home in Tanggu. In the early morning they set off by bus, and the sisters were delighted to meet. During the day they went shopping at the mall together; her sister bought summer clothes for the children, and Ma Xiulan gave her a gift box of homemade pickled vegetables in return. She also borrowed more than a dozen classic children's books from her sister's home. In the evening they stayed overnight at her sister's house. The cousins played together, and the two sisters chatted late into the night. After getting up in the morning, she still found time to practice Baduanjin in her sister's courtyard, keeping up her habit.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin exercise before leaving.
events.description: Got up at 5:30 on time, practiced Baduanjin in her own courtyard, and did 5 minutes of stretching to build up energy for the trip.

events.name: Take the children by bus to the younger sister's home in Tanggu.
events.description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan took the three children, carrying homemade pickled vegetable gift boxes, and took the early bus from Jinghai Bus Station to Tanggu. The children excitedly talked about seeing their aunt, and she looked out the window in a happy mood.

events.name: Went shopping with her younger sister and exchanged gifts
events.description: After arriving, her younger sister Ma Xiufen was already waiting at the station and affectionately pressed some snacks into their hands. The sisters took the children to the shopping mall; Ma Xiufen bought summer clothes for the kids, and Ma Xiulan gave her a gift box of pickled vegetables in return. While the children played in the play area, the sisters strolled and chatted about family life.

events.name: Borrowed classic children's books from younger sister's home
events.description: After shopping, she went to her younger sister's home. Ma Xiulan said she wanted to borrow books for the reading corner. Her sister found more than ten children's books, including Andersen's Fairy Tales and One Hundred Thousand Whys, and lent them all to her. She was as delighted as if she had found treasure, and carefully wrapped them in a cloth bag.

events.name: Dinner and overnight stay at younger sister's home
events.description: In the evening, her younger sister made a table of home-style dishes, and the children had a great time playing with their cousins. Ma Xiulan chatted with her sister until late, and they agreed to go to Haihe Bund Park the next morning. Before bed, she did some simple stretches but did not soak her feet (because the conditions were inconvenient).

start_state.mood: Looking forward to a short trip

end_state.location: Guest room at younger sister Ma Xiufen's home
end_state.mood: Content and relaxed

state.daily_exercise: One set of Baduanjin, and about 8,000 steps walking around shopping

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with increasing clouds in the afternoon

2025-07.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Ma Xiulan said goodbye to her younger sister and took the bus back to Jinghai with borrowed children's books and a heart full of warmth. In the afternoon, she played freely with the children at Haihe Bund Park; the children splashed in the water and built sandcastles while she took photos. When she got home in the evening, she placed the children's books in the reading corner, filling out the small bookshelf. At night, she resumed her habit of soaking her feet and planned the next day's online promotion. Though tired, she felt happy.

events.name: Simplified Baduanjin at younger sister's family courtyard
events.description: In the early morning in her younger sister's courtyard, she did a set of Baduanjin and taught her nephew some simple movements, making up for the inconvenience of being away from home.

events.name: Saying goodbye to her younger sister and returning to Jinghai
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan packed up the borrowed books and said goodbye to her sister's family. Her sister pressed boiled eggs and fruit into her hands. They took the bus back to Jinghai and arrived home at noon.

events.name: Parent-child water play at Haihe Bund Park
events.description: Before setting off, the sisters took the children to Haihe Bund Park. The children ran and splashed on the sand and built sandcastles. Ma Xiulan sat on the stone steps taking photos, while her younger sister watched over the children. They played until eleven o'clock, had a simple snack, and then her sister walked them to the bus stop.

events.name: Arrange children's books in the reading corner.
events.description: Arriving home in the evening, though exhausted, she immediately put the borrowed children's books and the old books from home onto the bookshelf by category, decorating them with colorful star stickers. The reading corner had begun to take shape, and she clapped her hands in satisfaction.

events.name: Resume foot-soaking and tomorrow's plan
events.description: In the evening, she soaked her feet in mugwort water and decided to start recording short videos about pickled vegetables tomorrow and contact Aunt Wu.

start_state.location: Guest room at younger sister Ma Xiufen's home
start_state.mood: Relaxed and content

end_state.mood: The trip was pleasant but a bit tiring.

state.daily_exercise: One round of Baduanjin, and about 6,000 steps walking on the beach.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Monday, Ma Xiulan devoted her energy to online promotion of pickled vegetables and the launch of a family reading corner: she recorded her first short video on making pickled radish and posted it to the group chat. Aunt Wu gave her tips on washing techniques, and late into the night the two chatted congenially and agreed to meet in person. At 8 p.m., she officially announced the start of family reading time, and the three children opened their books in the new reading corner. Throughout the day she kept up her morning exercise, afternoon nap, and foot soaks, and her wrist had fully recovered.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin and acupoint review
events.description: Got up at 5:25, practiced Baduanjin in the living room, rubbed Zusanli and Hegu acupoints, and felt refreshed and clear-headed.

events.name: First time recording a short video on making pickled radish.
events.description: In the morning, she prepared the ingredients and tools in the kitchen, set up her phone to record the entire process of washing, cutting, drying, mixing the sauce, and packing the jars, explaining as she worked. She made a 3-minute video and sent it to the pickle group, and the group members all praised it.

events.name: Aunt Wu sent private messages to teach radish cleaning tips and they had an in-depth exchange.
events.description: Aunt Wu sent a private message teaching a labor-saving trick: soak in salt water for half an hour before scrubbing. Ma Xiulan followed the same method and got good results, so she thanked her and shared her experience. The two chatted about everyday life. Aunt Wu wanted to see her embroidery works, and they agreed that Aunt Wu would come visit after the weather turns cool in autumn. They chatted late into the night.

events.name: Keep up family reading time
events.description: At 8 p.m., she called the children to the reading corner and once again emphasized the reading rules. The eldest son read One Hundred Thousand Whys, the second son and the daughter looked through picture books, and she read with them for half an hour, sharing interesting passages.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and maintaining relationships
events.description: While soaking her feet, she sent a WeChat message to Zhou Xiuqin to confirm tomorrow's pickled vegetable production schedule; everything went smoothly.

start_state.mood: Full of drive

end_state.mood: Fulfilled, full of hope for the new habits

state.daily_exercise: One set of Baduanjin, standing and walking about 5,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with a brief afternoon shower.

2025-07.daily_overview: Tuesday life settled back into its routine: in the morning Ma Xiulan continued working on the lotus round fan, more than halfway done; in the afternoon, after the rain, she went to the vegetable market to stock up on ingredients and confirmed with Wang Guilan the time for making tomato sauce (set for Friday); in the evening, after reading with the children, she organized this month's pickled vegetable production ledger and revised the schedule with Zhou Xiuqin. Because the weather was hot and humid, she cooked a cooling sour plum drink after the afternoon nap, and the family loved it.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin and enjoying the cool with mother-in-law.
events.description: After exercising early in the morning, she chatted with a neighbor grandmother who was outside enjoying the cool air about some community news.

events.name: Rushing to complete Ms. Li’s lotus round fan.
events.description: In the morning she sat by the window embroidering. She used seed stitches for the flower stamens and rolling needle stitches for the lotus leaves; the fan face gradually became more vivid. It is expected to be finished tomorrow.

events.name: Shopped at the vegetable market and finalized the tomato sauce plan with Wang Guilan.
events.description: In the afternoon, the rain shower stopped. I rode the e-bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market and bought fresh vegetables and pork ribs at Sun Guifang's stall. Passing by Wang Guilan's house, I stopped the bike and chatted. We agreed to make tomato sauce together on Friday afternoon, and Wang Guilan said the tools and recipe were already prepared.

events.name: Organizing the pickle production ledger and revising the work schedule.
events.description: After the evening reading time, Ma Xiulan opened a new page by the accounting notebook, tallied this month's pickled vegetable production and sales, and recorded the division of labor with Wang Guilan and Zhou Xiuqin. She used WeChat to confirm next week's schedule with Zhou Xiuqin, and the primary and backup plans ran smoothly.

events.name: Made sour plum soup to relieve the summer heat and shared it
events.description: After the afternoon nap, she used her homemade sour plum paste to make a large pot of sour plum drink, brought a pot to Wang Guilan, and Wang Guilan gave her homegrown cucumbers in return.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and keeping accounts
events.description: While soaking her feet, she recorded today's shopping expenses in the ledger and checked the wallet balance.

start_state.mood: Peaceful

end_state.mood: The peace of mind that comes from being well organized

state.daily_exercise: One set of Baduanjin, went out on an electric bike, walked about 3000 steps.

2025-07.daily_overview: On the penultimate day of the month, Ma Xiulan continued her handicrafts during the day (finished the round fan and delivered it to Ms. Li, receiving 60 yuan). In the early evening, she met her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to watch the outdoor movie Liu Sanjie, reliving their girlhood. After the movie, the two agreed to meet again, and she went home with a sense of nostalgia. Later in the evening, she checked compliance with the eye-care rules, awarded a homemade little certificate, and completed the second Baduanjin practice of the week with Aunt Zhao.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin exercise with Aunt Zhao and bidding farewell to July
events.description: At 6:00, completed the last joint practice session of July with Aunt Zhao in the community garden. The two repeated the Zusanli acupoint pressing, and Aunt Zhao reminded her to continue in August.

events.name: Completed and delivered the lotus round fan
events.description: In the morning, finished the last few stitches of the round fan, ironed the fan surface smooth with a steam iron, and put it into a cloth bag. In the afternoon, contacted Ms. Li and met at the corner of Jingwen Road, handing over the goods and collecting the money on the spot. Ms. Li praised the exquisite craftsmanship. Ma Xiulan recorded the 60 yuan as part-time income for the month.

events.name: Watched an outdoor movie with childhood friend Liu Chunmei.
events.description: In the evening, Liu Chunmei called to invite her to watch the public welfare film Liu Sanjie at Jinghai Square. She found two small stools and some sunflower seeds in the storage room and walked over. The two of them cracked sunflower seeds while watching, recalling funny stories from their teenage years, and laughed constantly. After the screening, they cleaned up the trash. Liu Chunmei said they would arrange another get-together, and she said goodbye at the intersection and went home with a warm heart.

events.name: Check implementation of the eye-care rules and encourage the children
events.description: In the evening, she summarized the eye-care situation: the children had been watching less TV. She then took out handmade certificates, writing "Little Eye-Protection Guard", "Little Posture Role Model", and "Little Outdoor Expert" on them, and awarded them to the three children to encourage them to keep it up.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and reflecting on the movie
events.description: While soaking her feet, she recalled the movie plot and decided to participate in more community activities in the future.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the evening movie

end_state.mood: Warm and nostalgic, full of tenderness.

state.daily_exercise: Baduanjin twice, and walking to the square and back, about 4,000 steps

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with clouds in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: On the last day of July, Ma Xiulan taught her younger daughter simple Baduanjin moves in the early morning, and their mother-daughter interaction was warm; in the morning she tidied the vegetable garden and prepared for tomato sauce; in the evening she and her husband reviewed the July family accounts together, posting the record of the travel fund deposit on the refrigerator as a family incentive; at night she reviewed how the healthy eating plan had been carried out, found that spending had decreased and her family members' complexions had improved, and decided to keep it up in August. She also completed her full morning exercise routine and an evening walk, ending July in perfect form.

events.name: Morning walk and parent-child Baduanjin time
events.description: After getting up at 5:20, she stretched her shoulders and neck for 5 minutes and practiced Baduanjin in the courtyard. Her youngest daughter Yuxin came out to watch. She taught her daughter simple moves such as Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner. Yuxin imitated her with proper form, and mother and daughter beamed. Then she went alone to the tree-lined path on Jingwen Road for a 15-minute brisk walk.

events.name: Tidy up the vegetable garden and prepare for tomato sauce
events.description: In the morning, she picked cucumbers and green beans in the yard and checked how ripe the tomatoes were; more than a dozen had turned fully red. She noted the count and planned to pick them on Friday when she would make sauce with Wang Guilan. She watered and weeded, and took the opportunity to teach her daughter to identify the vegetable seedlings.

events.name: Checked the July accounts with my husband and boosted the travel fund.
events.description: In the evening, the couple sat in the living room going through the account book to check July income and expenses. She pointed to the 'Beijing Travel Fund' page, showing the 180 yuan already saved and the plan of 400 yuan per month, and put a sticky note on it. Her husband promised to deposit 300 yuan as soon as he received his August salary. She stuck a card reading 'Travel Fund: goal 2,000 yuan, saved 180 yuan' on the refrigerator door, where the whole family could see it.

events.name: Compile the results of the healthy diet plan implementation
events.description: In the evening, she calculated that this month's total food expenditure was 50 yuan less than last month. She happily told her husband that the low-salt, low-fat plan saved money, made the family look better, and that her second son's mouth ulcer had healed. She decided to continue the plan in August and adjust the varieties of summer heat-relieving soup.

events.name: Evening family walk and foot soaking
events.description: After dinner, she took her husband and children for a 20-minute slow walk along the community path, chatting and watching the clouds. After returning home, she soaked her feet and thought back on the changes of the past month, feeling full of fulfillment. Before bed, she did deep breathing for 5 minutes and pressed and massaged the Hegu point.

start_state.mood: Full of drive to write the summary.

end_state.mood: Satisfied and resolute (full of anticipation for August)

state.daily_exercise: Full set of Baduanjin, 15-minute morning walk, 20-minute evening walk, and about 4,000 steps of garden work

2025-06.daily_overview: On the morning of Children's Day, after her usual walk, Ma Xiulan was pleasantly surprised to see the roses in the courtyard just starting to bloom, and then she handled orders for pickled radish. She tried multigrain porridge for the first time, and her homemade yogurt also came out perfectly. In the morning, she walked with her three children to the amusement park and played to their hearts' content, taking more than thirty photos of smiling faces. Returning home in the evening, she organized the photos, feeling fulfilled and satisfied.

events.name: Morning stroll and the first roses in bloom
events.description: After getting up at 5:50, Ma Xiulan briskly walked for 20 minutes along the tree-lined path on Jingwen Road. When she got home and watered the flowers and plants in the courtyard, she found the first rose in bloom, with pink petals covered in dew. She took a photo and sent it to the family group, and her husband and children liked it.

events.name: Handle the pickled radish order and deliver it to the supermarket
events.description: After the walk, she put labels on the 10 jars of pickled radish she had prepared in advance, rode her electric bike to deliver them to Zhang Shufen's convenience store for restocking, and Zhang Shufen said that 6 jars had been sold last week and suggested adding a garlic-flavored variety.

events.name: Make multigrain porridge and homemade yogurt
events.description: For breakfast, tried a multigrain porridge with millet, brown rice, and red beans, and made yogurt according to the optimized recipe (shortened fermentation time). The children's feedback was good.

events.name: Preparing for the amusement park outing
events.description: She prepared snacks, water, and wet wipes, and walked with the children to Jinghai Town amusement park, using 200 yuan saved from pickles and embroidery to buy tickets.

events.name: Playing at the amusement park
events.description: The children took turns playing on the inflatable castle, bumper cars, and the small roller coaster. Ma Xiulan watched them, took photos, bought a bubble machine for her daughter, and sat on a bench for a short rest.

events.name: Return home and organize photos.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, she imported more than thirty photos into the computer, picked out three to print tomorrow, and created a photo album folder named June.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to Children's Day, full of energy

end_state.mood: Content and tired, savoring parent-child time

state.daily_exercise: A brisk 20-minute walk in the early morning, about 4 kilometers walking round trip to the amusement park, and standing and moving about throughout the day

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, temperature 20-30°C, southeast wind level 2.

2025-06.daily_overview: On the Dragon Boat Festival, Ma Xiulan boiled zongzi early in the morning and hung mugwort. In the morning, she printed out yesterday's amusement park photos, then rode her bike to her parents' home to deliver zongzi and measure their blood pressure. In the afternoon, she went home to check on the yogurt. During dinner, she pasted photos into the album. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, said, 'When I grow up and earn money, I'll take you to ride the Ferris wheel,' which warmed her heart.

events.name: Boil zongzi and hang mugwort for the Dragon Boat Festival
events.description: Got up at 5:40 in the morning, put the pre-wrapped zongzi into the pot, and hung mugwort at the door. The children smelled the fragrant zongzi and were very excited.

events.name: Early morning walk and stretches.
events.description: While the zongzi were cooking, she did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches in the courtyard, then walked briskly along Jingwen Road for 20 minutes, adjusting her breathing.

events.name: Develop photos and go to parents' home
events.description: In the morning she went to the print shop to develop three photos, then rode her e-bike to her parents' home on Shengli Street, bringing freshly made yogurt and zongzi, and measured her father's blood pressure (128/82, stable).

events.name: Check the homemade yogurt.
events.description: After returning home, she checked the yogurt fermentation; it had set well. She divided it into portions and chilled it. In the afternoon she let the children taste it. Her second son found it a little sour, and she noted that next time she could add a little honey.

events.name: Pasting photos and the second son's heartwarming promise.
events.description: During dinner, the family gathered around to look at the developed photos pasted into the album. Mingzhe whispered that when he grew up he would take his mother on a Ferris wheel. Ma Xiulan hugged her son, her eyes moist.

start_state.mood: Busy and fulfilling, festive atmosphere

end_state.mood: Touched and warmed by the second son's promise

state.daily_exercise: Morning brisk walk for 20 minutes, cycling to parents' home and back about 3 kilometers, household chores.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to thundershowers, temperature 22-28°C, south wind force 3-4

2025-06.daily_overview: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang suffered a bruise on his right arm when a tire blew out on the truck during a short-haul trip. After receiving the call, Ma Xiulan settled him down to recuperate and then took the children to school in the rain. At breakfast she used the trip to Beijing to motivate the children, and her eldest son Mingxuan volunteered that he would work hard. In the evening she discussed buying accident insurance with her husband, and this awakened the family's awareness of protection.

events.name: Husband came home injured.
events.description: At 9 a.m., her husband's workmate called to say that Ma Zhiqiang had bruised his right arm in a tire blowout. She hurried to wait at the door, helped him inside to lie down, and went to the clinic to get anti-inflammatory medicine and plasters.

events.name: Morning school run in the rain and breakfast encouragement
events.description: At breakfast she reminded the children of the earlier promise to go to Beijing, and all three nodded. Then she walked them to school in the rain, giving each of them reminders along the way.

events.name: Courtyard drainage and indoor cleaning.
events.description: A thundershower caused water to accumulate in the courtyard. She unclogged the drain and brought in the clothes that had been hung out to dry. Since she could not go out on the rainy day, she stayed home wiping and sweeping, and did shoulder and neck stretches in between.

events.name: Discuss buying accident insurance
events.description: In the evening, after changing her husband's dressing, the two talked about the accident. Ma Xiulan insisted on buying him an accident insurance policy, and Ma Zhiqiang finally relented and agreed to let her inquire about it.

start_state.mood: As usual, unaware of the accident to come.

end_state.mood: Worried but determined, planning to firm up the insurance as soon as possible.

state.daily_exercise: Walked 2 km round trip in the rain to take the children to school, did housework, and cleared the courtyard drain.

date_attribute.weather: Showers turning to cloudy, temperature 20-26°C, north wind force 3-4

2025-06.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan continued to refine the yogurt recipe. After adding a little sugar, the taste improved noticeably and won the recognition of the whole family. In the afternoon, she mixed the remaining yogurt with fruit as a snack for the children, and rode her bike to the market to buy whole grains. In the evening, she took out the fabric for the embroidery orders to prepare for the upcoming rush.

events.name: Making yogurt for the second time and adjusting the multigrain porridge.
events.description: Following the improved recipe (shorter fermentation and added sugar), she made yogurt in the morning and cooked millet and oat porridge. Her husband praised that his stomach felt comfortable, and the children also liked the new flavor.

events.name: Purchase miscellaneous grains and non-staple foods.
events.description: Rode a bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market, bought sweet potatoes and corn at Sun Guifang's stall, then weighed millet and oats at Zhang Shufen's supermarket, spending 42 yuan in total.

events.name: Yogurt, fruit, and snacks.
events.description: In the afternoon, I mixed the leftover yogurt with diced apples and strawberries. The three children rushed to eat it after school, and my daughter got it smeared all over her face—heartwarming and funny.

events.name: Prepare embroidery materials.
events.description: In the evening, she opened her embroidery hoop, compared it with the doudou pattern sent by Zhou Xiuqin, sorted the silk threads, and decided to officially start embroidering the next day.

start_state.mood: Stable, starting dietary improvements

end_state.mood: Satisfied, the dietary improvements were well received

state.daily_exercise: Cycled about 3 km round trip to the market and did housework.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, temperature 22-31°C, southwest wind level 2.

2025-06.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan secretly used her embroidery savings to buy accident insurance for her husband, adding extra security to the family. When she picked up the children in the afternoon, she learned that her eldest son had organized his wrong-answer notes and that her second son's handwriting was neat. The newly sown flower seeds in the courtyard had also put out little colorful blossoms. She felt that although life was busy, there was hope.

events.name: Purchase accident insurance for her husband
events.description: In the morning, she took 150 yuan in cash and rode her electric bike to the insurance company's business hall, where she bought an accident insurance policy for Ma Zhiqiang with an annual premium of 150 yuan and coverage of 100,000 yuan. After receiving the policy, she felt reassured.

events.name: Eldest son takes initiative in studying and correcting mistakes
events.description: After school, Ma Mingxuan took the initiative to finish his math homework, then reviewed definitions and organized his notebook of wrong answers. When he encountered difficult problems, he actively asked for help. Ma Xiulan was very pleased.

events.name: Second son's improvement in homework
events.description: Ma Mingzhe also carefully wrote the new characters and got all the math mental arithmetic correct. She praised the two brothers and showed them the travel promise card.

events.name: New flowers blooming in the courtyard
events.description: While watering in the evening, she discovered that the flower seedlings had bloomed into small orange, purple, and white flowers. She made a short video and posted it to her Moments, earning praise from relatives and friends.

start_state.mood: Worried about the accident, but determined

end_state.mood: Steadiness, security, and children's progress bring comfort

state.daily_exercise: Running errands by electric bike, loosening the soil and watering flowers in the courtyard, and walking to pick up the children.

2025-06.daily_overview: Her husband's injury was gradually healing. In the morning, Ma Xiulan helped the children with their weekend homework; in the afternoon, she organized her embroidery tools and began stitching cloud patterns. In the evening, her childhood friend Liu Chunmei called and arranged to meet on Sunday. Several more roses bloomed in the courtyard, and she put some in a vase to decorate the living room.

events.name: Help with weekend homework.
events.description: In the afternoon, she urged Mingxuan and Mingzhe to finish part of their weekend homework. Mingxuan worked out a math problem on his own. Mingzhe wrote 'My Mother' in crooked but careful handwriting. She pointed out the wrong characters and encouraged him.

events.name: Starting to embroider a bellyband
events.description: After her nap, she began stitching in a well-lit spot in the living room, embroidering an auspicious cloud pattern. Every 30 minutes she looked into the distance and rubbed her wrists.

events.name: Phone call with Liu Chunmei
events.description: Liu Chunmei called and talked about funny things at work in the supermarket. She invited Chunmei to come on Sunday to try the newly made pickled cucumbers, and said she planned to put her pickled vegetables on consignment at Chunmei's supermarket. Chunmei readily agreed to help.

events.name: Chinese roses in a vase
events.description: Cut three newly bloomed roses and put them in a blue vase; her husband said at once that the room brightened up.

start_state.mood: Uneventful, routine

end_state.mood: Peace, contact with friends, and little joys.

state.daily_exercise: Pruning the courtyard, housework, and shoulder and neck stretches after sitting for a long time doing embroidery

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, 24-34°C, south wind force 2

2025-06.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan took the children to her parents' home for a family reunion. She made dumplings with her mother, while her father took the grandchildren out to fly kites. At noon, the whole family sat together for a reunion meal, and she took a family photo. In the evening, her mother pressed a bag of pickled vegetables into her hands. The warmth of family love made her forget her fatigue.

events.name: Return to parents' home for a family gathering
events.description: In the morning, she rode her electric bike with the three children to her parents' home on Shengli Street. Her father was already waiting at the door, looking out.

events.name: Making dumplings and flying kites
events.description: She and her mother rolled wrappers and made dumplings while the children played with dough; her father brought out an old kite and took his grandsons to the yard to test-fly it. Laughter continued nonstop, and Ma Xiulan recorded a video.

events.name: Taking photos at the family meal.
events.description: For lunch, they had dumplings with cucumber salad and braised pork ribs. Father sighed that a family together is a blessing. She took photos of the entire family, and also took separate photos with her father and the children.

events.name: Mother gave vegetables and I returned home.
events.description: In the evening before parting, her mother Li Xiuying gave her a bag of pickled vegetables and freshly picked scallions, and told her to take good care of the family. She rode back with the children.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to being reunited with parents

end_state.mood: Warm and happy, nourished by family affection.

state.daily_exercise: Brisk walk for 15 minutes in the early morning, round trip by electric bike, making dumplings while standing.

2025-06.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan went to Zhou Xiuqin's home to learn double-sided embroidery. After practicing hard for three hours and pricking her fingers several times, she finally embroidered a petal and gained a lot. After returning home, she made yogurt and gave some to her parents and Wang Guilan, and in return received cucumbers from Wang Guilan.

events.name: Learning double-sided embroidery
events.description: In the morning she walked to Zhou Xiuqin's home to study a peony embroidery piece. Zhou Xiuqin taught her hand-by-hand such stitching techniques as splitting the silk thread and concealing thread ends. Ma Xiulan practiced repeatedly, and after three hours successfully embroidered a double-sided petal sample.

events.name: Making yogurt on Sunday
events.description: In the afternoon, she made yogurt as usual. This time she made two extra jars and had Mingxuan deliver one jar to his grandparents. After receiving it, Wang Guilan reciprocated with freshly picked cucumbers from her own garden.

events.name: Discussed the market with Zhou Xiuqin.
events.description: During a study break, the two agreed to set up a stall together at the community handicraft market next Saturday, where Ma Xiulan could display her pickles and embroidery.

start_state.mood: Filled with eagerness to learn new skills.

end_state.mood: Contentment, skill improvement, and neighborly warmth

state.daily_exercise: Walk to Zhou Xiuqin's house and back, about 2 kilometers; stretch after prolonged sitting

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, temperature 25-34°C, south wind level 2

2025-06.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan went to the vegetable market at dawn to select fresh tender cucumbers and spices, preparing ingredients for a trial batch of soy-pickled cucumbers. After returning home, she cleaned the pickling jar and prepared seasonings. In the afternoon she continued working on the embroidered bellyband, and in the evening she discussed the initial costs of the micro-business with her husband.

events.name: Purchase ingredients for pickled cucumbers
events.description: Cycled to Xingwang Vegetable Market, bought 8 jin of tender local cucumbers at Sun Guifang's stall, and then went to a seasoning shop to stock up on low-salt soy sauce, black vinegar, white sugar, garlic cloves, and so on.

events.name: Washing ingredients, prepping, and recording expenses
events.description: After returning home, she washed and dried the cucumbers, checked the pickling jar, and recorded the purchase expenses in detail in her notebook (38 yuan in total), preparing for later cost accounting.

events.name: Rush to make embroidered bellybands
events.description: In the afternoon she embroidered for about 3 hours straight and completed the outline of the main flower on the chest. During that time she got up and moved around every half hour; her waist was a bit sore, but she didn't pay much attention to it.

events.name: Husband and wife discuss starting a business
events.description: After dinner, she calculated the cost of pickled cucumbers in detail for Ma Zhiqiang, planning to price them at 8 yuan per jar. If she produced 20 jars a week, the gross profit would be about 60 yuan. Her husband reminded her to take care of her health.

start_state.mood: Full of drive, planning to trial-produce new products

end_state.mood: Anticipation and hope for the pickled cucumbers

state.daily_exercise: Rode a bicycle to and from the market, about 4 km round trip; did housework; sat for a long time doing embroidery.

2025-06.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan's trial batch of soy-pickled cucumbers was a great success; the crisp texture won praise from the whole family. In the afternoon, when she picked up her daughter, she was praised by the teacher. The courtyard flowers were in full bloom, and she carefully took a series of photos to share with her mother, and remembered that she should make yogurt tomorrow.

events.name: Trial-making soy-sauce cucumbers
events.description: In the morning, in the kitchen, she cut the cucumbers into strips according to the recipe, salted them, squeezed out the water, then poured in the cooked sauce, sealed it, and put it in the fridge. After 6 hours she took them out to taste—crisp, tender, salty and sweet. She adjusted the amount of garlic, and after tasting it her husband said it would go well with drinks.

events.name: Picking up daughter and receiving praise
events.description: In the afternoon, she went to the kindergarten. The head teacher said Xinxin performed well in the handicraft class and took the initiative to help the teacher clean up. Her daughter held up a sticker collage and gave it to her, and Ma Xiulan kissed her daughter.

events.name: Photographing courtyard flowers.
events.description: When watering in the evening, she saw that the roses, the flowers grown from seed, and the potted plants were all in full bloom. She put the pots together, used her phone to take a panoramic photo and a video of bees gathering nectar, and sent them to the family group.

start_state.mood: Eager to try, ready to start pickling.

end_state.mood: Excited and satisfied: the pickles succeeded and the flowers bloomed

state.daily_exercise: Standing for a long time while pickling in the kitchen, walking to pick up her daughter, and moving flowerpots in the yard

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, 24-32°C, south wind force 2-3

2025-06.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Ma Xiulan made yogurt as usual. She went to the market early in the morning to replenish milk and chatted with Sun Guifang about pickled cucumbers. In the afternoon, she tidied the vegetable garden, picked some baby bok choy and chives for dinner. In the evening, after checking the children’s homework, she went to bed early.

events.name: Make yogurt and share it
events.description: In the morning, she rode her bike to buy two liters of fresh milk, made yogurt according to the process, and after it set in the afternoon, packed it into portions. As usual, she gave some to her parents and neighbors, and Wang Guilan gave her green beans in return.

events.name: Chatting with Sun Guifang
events.description: While buying milk, Sun Guifang asked about the cucumbers. Ma Xiulan excitedly agreed to bring her the finished product to taste next time. Sun Guifang said that if it sold well, she could help spread the word.

events.name: Pick vegetables from the courtyard garden.
events.description: While the yogurt was fermenting, she went to the vegetable garden to pick bok choy and chives. At noon, the cold-tossed bok choy was refreshing and delicious.

start_state.mood: Regular; act according to habit.

end_state.mood: Peaceful, daily life is orderly

state.daily_exercise: Cycling back and forth to the market and working in the yard.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, temperature 25-33°C, southeast wind level 2.

2025-06.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan saw the heartwarming scene of her eldest son patiently teaching his younger brother to memorize English words, and rewarded them with fruit. She used vegetables grown in her own courtyard to enrich the dining table, and cleverly made vegetable pancakes from leftover congee as a snack. In the afternoon, she continued embroidering. The soreness in her lower back grew more noticeable, but she still pushed through to complete the day's progress.

events.name: Brothers helping each other study English.
events.description: In the evening, Mingzhe was struggling to memorize vocabulary words. Mingxuan took the initiative to teach him, making up a mnemonic rhyme to help him remember. Mingzhe successfully read out all the words, and she laughed with joy in the kitchen when she heard them.

events.name: Garden Vegetables in Home Cooking
events.description: In the morning I picked baby bok choy, chives, and cilantro. I made a cold dressed baby bok choy salad with multigrain porridge. At noon, I added chopped chives to the leftover porridge and pan-fried it into multigrain vegetable pancakes, which the kids devoured.

events.name: Embroidery progress and lower back discomfort.
events.description: In the afternoon she continued embroidering the bellyband and finished the interlocking branch pattern. Because she had been sitting for a long time, her waist began to feel sore. She stood up and stretched, which eased it a little, but she did not stop working.

start_state.mood: As usual, prepared breakfast.

end_state.mood: Pleased; the children helped each other; waist a little sore.

state.daily_exercise: Picking vegetables in the courtyard, doing housework, and sitting for a long time doing embroidery.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy with overcast spells, 23-30°C, east wind force 3.

2025-06.daily_overview: To prepare for discussing consignment selling with Chunmei tomorrow, Ma Xiulan went to the market early in the morning and bought 10 jin of cucumbers and 10 glass jars. In the morning, she batch-pickled the cucumbers in soy sauce and labeled them. In the afternoon, she sent samples to Chunmei for a taste test and received high praise. Her lower back was still sore, but she relieved it with a hot compress.

events.name: Purchase materials in bulk.
events.description: Rode her bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market, bought 10 jin of cucumbers at Sun Guifang's stall, then went to the grocery store to buy glass jars and label paper. Sun Guifang reserved two jars.

events.name: Batch pickling and labeling.
events.description: After returning home, she strictly followed the successful recipe and pickled 10 jars of soy-sauce cucumbers. She stuck a handwritten label reading 'Xiulan's Handmade Soy-Sauce Cucumbers · Low-Salt and Crisp' on each jar and took photos to send to Chunmei.

events.name: Deliver samples to Liu Chunmei.
events.description: In the afternoon, I rode my bike to Hualian Supermarket. Chunmei tasted it and was full of praise; she immediately agreed to persuade the supervisor to give two shelf spaces and arranged to supply three times a week.

events.name: Apply a hot compress to the lower back
events.description: Because her waist was noticeably sore from embroidering and standing for long periods, she applied a hot water bottle in the evening, and her husband helped massage it. She planned to go to the clinic if it did not improve in a few days.

start_state.mood: Clear plan and full of drive.

end_state.mood: Anticipation; the side business is about to go live, but the back soreness has not gone away.

state.daily_exercise: Cycled about 6 kilometers round trip between the market and the supermarket; stood for a long time while pickling.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, temperature 24-32°C, southwest wind level 2.

2025-06.daily_overview: In the morning, Ma Xiulan held a family summary meeting. The children showed the results of two weeks of effort, and she officially announced that the promised trip to Beijing would be fulfilled soon. The courtyard was still full of flowers, and she enjoyed sitting quietly and admiring them. In the afternoon, she made her regular yogurt. Her father came by for a visit and took two jars, and the neighborhood was warm as usual. The soreness in her lower back had still not eased, so she decided to go to the clinic tomorrow.

events.name: Family summary and praise meeting
events.description: In the morning, she brought the children together. Mingxuan showed his mistake notebook and formulas, Mingzhe took out a math card with all correct answers, and Yuxin performed a nursery rhyme. She then took out the travel commitment card, had the three of them sign it, and announced that she would plan the trip soon.

events.name: Sitting quietly in the courtyard to enjoy the flowers.
events.description: After the meeting, she moved a small stool and sat by the flower beds. She looked back at the photos of flowers blooming from the beginning of the month, put together an album called "June Blooms," and posted it on WeChat Moments, feeling calm.

events.name: Saturday: making yogurt and father's visit.
events.description: In the afternoon, she made yogurt for the second time this week. Her father Ma Jianguo came by for a visit and took two jars for his wife. Wang Guilan, as usual, gave eggs in return.

events.name: Lower back soreness and heaviness worsened.
events.description: When she got up from her afternoon rest, her lower back suddenly ached sharply. She managed to finish the housework but had to hold the handrail when going upstairs. She decided to go to the community clinic tomorrow to see Dr. Wang.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the wrap-up meeting, but the lower back still feels uncomfortable.

end_state.mood: Relieved and calm; lower back soreness worsened and requires medical attention.

state.daily_exercise: Watering plants and moving pots in the courtyard; light housework.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Father's Day, Ma Xiulan went to the market early in the morning and carefully cooked sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin and noodles with gravy, which her husband loved. In the morning, she cut hydrangeas from the courtyard, arranged them in vases, and gave some to neighbors; the children presented hand-drawn greeting cards. More importantly, she discussed the details of consigning her pickled vegetables with Liu Chunmei, preparing for the official launch. Her micro-business was about to get off the ground. In the evening, the family had a warm dinner together and took a family photo. Although her backache was getting worse, she felt it was all worth it.

events.name: Purchased ingredients and prepared dinner.
events.description: Got up at 5:15 a.m., walked for 15 minutes, then biked to the vegetable market to buy pork, flour, and other items. Sun Guifang gave her a small bunch of cilantro. She spent a busy morning at home making sweet-and-sour pork, noodles with thick gravy, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables.

events.name: Picking hydrangeas in the courtyard to give to neighbors.
events.description: In the morning, she cut some blue-purple hydrangeas and put them in a vase on the dining table. Zhang Shufen passed by and praised them, so she picked a few more, wrapped them in newspaper, and gave them to her. The two chatted at the doorway.

events.name: The children making greeting cards
events.description: In the afternoon, the children made Father's Day cards with colored paper and markers. Mingxuan wrote the words, Mingzhe drew a car, and Yuxin added stickers. When they finished, they hid the cards and waited for Dad to get off work.

events.name: Pickled cucumbers on supermarket shelves (preliminary)
events.description: At 10 a.m., Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Hualian Supermarket with two jars of pickled cucumber samples to find Liu Chunmei, and the two discussed the consignment details. Liu Chunmei had already spoken with the supervisor, who agreed to free up two shelf spaces in the condiment section. They agreed that the products would officially go on the shelves next Monday, June 16. Ma Xiulan left the samples for Chunmei to taste, and after returning home she began preparing for batch production.

events.name: Father's Day dinner and family portrait
events.description: In the evening, when her husband got off work, the children gave him greeting cards. Ma Zhiqiang's eyes reddened slightly, and the family enjoyed a low-salt meal. After dinner, she used her phone's timer to take a family photo and posted it to the group chat, earning praise.

events.name: Early signs of lumbar strain confirmed.
events.description: In the afternoon, because of continuous bending and standing, the soreness in her lower back turned into a dull pain. She applied a hot compress again, but still insisted on finishing dinner. Before going to bed, she decided she must go to the clinic tomorrow.

events.name: Yogurt standardization and tourism commitment.
events.description: She officially decided to make yogurt every Wednesday and Sunday, adding homemade strawberry jam; at dinner she announced that next week she would start planning the Beijing trip, and the children cheered.

start_state.mood: With a strong sense of ceremony, she was determined to make the festival enjoyable for her husband

end_state.mood: Content and inspired; family warmth and a new business venture are about to take off, but early signs of lumbar muscle strain need attention.

state.daily_exercise: Brisk walk for 15 minutes in the early morning, rode an electric bike about 3 km to deliver pickles, stood for long periods doing housework and cooking, and picked flowers in the courtyard

2025-06.daily_overview: The official launch day of the pickled vegetable business. After her morning walk and stretching, Ma Xiulan went to the clinic in the morning, then made her first batch of pickled cucumbers and personally delivered them to the supermarket on consignment in the afternoon. The clinic visit put her mind at ease about her back discomfort, and together with her childhood friend she took the first step.

events.name: Early morning walk and stretches.
events.description: Ma Xiulan set out at 5:20 and walked briskly for 18 minutes along the tree-lined avenue on Jingwen Road, with a slightly faster cadence. After returning home, she did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching in the living room — shoulder rolls and neck side bends — while planning the day's pickle preparations.

events.name: Went to the clinic to see a doctor.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Ma Xiulan walked to the community clinic as she had decided the previous two days to see Dr. Wang. After an examination, Dr. Wang diagnosed her with lumbar muscle strain, advised her to avoid prolonged bending, get up and move every 30 minutes, and taught her a few simple stretching exercises. Ma Xiulan got some medicated plasters for 35 yuan. After returning home, she adjusted the height of the kitchen counter and raised the cutting board to reduce bending.

events.name: Making the first batch of pickled cucumbers and putting them into jars
events.description: In her own kitchen, Ma Xiulan, following the recipe agreed upon with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, washed and cut fresh cucumbers into pieces, salted them to draw out the water, drained them, then mixed them in proportion with soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, garlic, and other seasonings. She carefully packed them into jars and sealed them, making 10 jars of soy-pickled cucumbers in total. Remembering the doctor's advice, she sat down to rest for a few minutes every half hour and did a few backward-leaning stretches with her hands on her lower back. While working, she noted down the ingredient ratios for later adjustments.

events.name: Rode an electric bike to deliver soy-pickled cucumbers to the supermarket for consignment.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan packed the finished products into a cardboard box and cycled to Hualian Supermarket in Jinghai District. After finding Liu Chunmei, the two together displayed the pickled cucumbers side by side with the existing pickled radishes in the condiment section, and handwrote price tags and ingredient descriptions. Liu Chunmei handled checkout and recommended the products on the spot, while Ma Xiulan briefly introduced the features of her homemade pickles to several familiar customers. Then she returned home.

events.name: Evening walk and relaxation
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan took the children for a 20-minute slow walk on the community walking path, chatting as they walked. After returning home, she sat quietly on the bed for 5 minutes doing deep-breathing relaxation and reflecting on the day's little blessings, then went to bed at 23:00.

start_state.mood: Feeling slight discomfort in her lower back, but has decided to go to the clinic.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and content; lower back is sore, but at ease because of the doctor's visit.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 18 minutes, morning shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, evening walk for 20 minutes, and deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy, 27°C to 35°C, south wind level 2

2025-06.daily_overview: During her daily shopping, she looked for a breakthrough in travel efficiency. While shopping at the neighborhood supermarket, she took the opportunity to ask about the second-hand car market and got a reliable lead. Then, as usual, she went to her parents' home to deliver yogurt and share updates.

events.name: Morning walk and shoulder and neck stretches
events.description: Got up at 5:25, walked briskly along Jingwen Road for 15 minutes, and returned early because the temperature was a bit high. After getting home, I stretched for 5 minutes and added some simple scapular squeezes.

events.name: Making multigrain porridge and yogurt to give to her parents
events.description: Ma Xiulan got up early to cook multigrain porridge, took out a portion of the yogurt packed the day before, and rode her bicycle to her parents' home. Her mother, Li Xiuying, was very happy and let her take some home-grown garland chrysanthemum. The mother and daughter chatted for half an hour.

events.name: Shopping at the convenience supermarket and asking about electric bike prices.
events.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan went to Zhang Shufen's convenience supermarket to buy eggs and seasonings. While paying, she casually asked Shufen about the recent market for second-hand electric bikes in the community. Zhang Shufen told her that a household in the same community that was moving was selling a 70% new Yadea electric bike, and suggested a reasonable price of around 400 yuan. Ma Xiulan carefully wrote down the house number and contact time, and decided to go see the bike herself the next day.

events.name: Go home and discuss buying a car with her husband
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan told her husband Ma Zhiqiang about her intention to buy an electric bike, explaining that it would save time picking up the children and buying groceries. Her husband expressed support and reminded her to pay attention to the brakes and battery when test-riding. The two briefly calculated the family's cash on hand and confirmed that the budget was sufficient.

events.name: Evening stroll
events.description: After dinner, she took the children for an 18-minute brisk walk around the neighborhood; her husband also joined in, chatting while helping with digestion.

start_state.mood: Calm, with daily chores and grocery shopping on her mind.

end_state.mood: Feeling hopeful, hoping to buy an electric bike smoothly tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of morning walk, 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching, 18 minutes of evening walk, 5 minutes of deep breathing before bed

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, with a brief thundershower in the evening, 25°C~33°C

2025-06.daily_overview: An efficient day. In the morning, she finalized the market stall, successfully bought a commuter electric scooter, and shared healthy eating tips that won praise from neighbors, bringing new changes to both her side business and family life.

events.name: Morning walk (brought forward to 5:15)
events.description: To catch the morning market for groceries, Ma Xiulan got up at 5:15 and power-walked along Jingwen Road for 18 minutes. The air quality was good and her pace was steady.

events.name: Received the market notice and decided to attend.
events.description: Ma Xiulan received a phone call from community grid worker Zheng Xiuying, who notified her that the Jinghai District Cultural Square would hold a summer handicraft market on June 20 and asked if she would like to participate. Ma Xiulan immediately agreed and told Sister Zheng that she would prepare her own stall supplies. After hanging up, she immediately contacted her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin to discuss borrowing a stall spot.

events.name: Went to look at and buy a used electric bike.
events.description: Based on the lead from Zhang Shufen, Ma Xiulan went in the morning to the home of a household in the same community that was moving, to look at a Yadea electric bike for sale. She carefully inspected the bike's appearance, tire wear, brake responsiveness, and battery range, and test-rode it for a distance, confirming it was in good condition. She then agreed with the seller on a price of 400 yuan, paid the full amount with the money she had earned earlier from selling pickled cucumbers, completed a simple handover on the spot, and rode the electric bike back home.

events.name: Make and share multigrain porridge and yogurt
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan made an extra serving of multigrain porridge and homemade yogurt. At 10 a.m., she knocked on her neighbor Wang Guilan's door carrying the hot porridge and a jar of yogurt, sharing the results of her healthy eating. Wang Guilan tasted it and praised it highly. The two chatted at the door for more than half an hour, and Wang Guilan asked about the exact combination of grains in the multigrain porridge. Ma Xiulan explained the proportions and steps in detail and promised to teach her how to make yogurt next time.

events.name: Confirm stall details with Zhou Xiuqin.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan contacted Zhou Xiuqin again to confirm the stall location and setup time. Zhou Xiuqin told her in detail what to pay attention to and encouraged her to bring more items. Ma Xiulan then began sorting out the embroidered pieces and pickled vegetables she would take.

events.name: Evening walk (shortened by rain)
events.description: After dinner, because of a rain shower, we only walked slowly in circles in the courtyard for 10 minutes and observed the new leaves after the rain with the children.

start_state.mood: Energetic and full of plans.

end_state.mood: Excited and slightly tired, happy about today's gains

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk 18 minutes, neck and shoulder stretches 5 minutes, evening walk 10 minutes, deep breathing before bed 5 minutes.

2025-06.daily_overview: A day of double happiness. The eldest son achieved excellent results in the high school entrance examination, and the whole family was immersed in joy; at the same time, the market preparations were steadily advancing, and the convenience of the electric bike had already begun to show. She went to her parents' home to share the good news, as usual.

events.name: Early morning walk and stretches.
events.description: Got up at 5:20. Due to the high temperature, adjusted the route to a more shaded area and walked briskly for 16 minutes. Stretched for 5 minutes at home, and added neck circles to the routine.

events.name: Adjusting the flavor of pickled cucumbers and making trial products for sale
events.description: In the morning, based on the customer feedback Liu Chunmei had passed on in the previous days (the spiciness was too high), Ma Xiulan deliberately reduced the amount of chili pepper and added a little sugar to balance the flavor. She pickled a separate jar, labeled it "mild version," and used it as a trial item. She took the jar of soy-pickled cucumbers to the supermarket and asked Liu Chunmei to recommend it first to regular customers.

events.name: Go to Zhou Xiuqin's house to borrow the stall permit.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Zhou Xiuqin's house to explain her need for a market stall. Zhou Xiuqin happened to have an extra stall permit and readily agreed to lend it to her, reminding her that the market opens at 7 a.m. and that she needed to bring her own tablecloth and change. The two also exchanged recent embroidery patterns, and Ma Xiulan learned a few new stitch techniques.

events.name: Organize items for the market and prepare small change.
events.description: At her handicraft corner at home, Ma Xiulan selected three finely made embroidered pieces (a handkerchief, a coaster, and a small ornament), and checked the air-dried soy-pickled cucumbers, choosing two well-sealed jars as samples. She put everything into a woven basket and prepared small change and the payment QR code.

events.name: First time riding an e-bike to take my daughter and buy groceries
events.description: Ma Xiulan rode her newly bought electric bike for the first time to take her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to kindergarten, then stopped by the vegetable market on the way to buy groceries. She found that the round trip by electric bike took only 10 minutes, saving nearly half an hour compared with walking. After returning home, she did the math: she could save about 60 yuan per month on taxi fares, and the time saved could be used to make more pickled vegetables and embroidery.

events.name: Learned that her eldest son achieved excellent results in the mini high school entrance exam
events.description: In the morning, while shopping at Xingwang Vegetable Market, Ma Xiulan received a call from Han Mei, the head teacher of her eldest son. Teacher Han excitedly told her that Ma Mingxuan had received an A in both biology and geography and was a role model for the class. Ma Xiulan was so moved that she thanked her repeatedly and immediately decided to buy a free-range chicken to celebrate at home.

events.name: Buy a free-range chicken and simmer chicken soup.
events.description: Ma Xiulan picked out a plump, fresh free-range chicken at the market. After returning home, she carefully cleaned and blanched it, then put it in a pot with ginger slices and goji berries to simmer slowly over low heat. The kitchen was filled with a rich aroma all afternoon. She carefully regulated the heat, preparing the main course for the family dinner in the evening.

events.name: Bring chicken soup to her parents' home to share the good news and deliver a meal.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan ladled out a large bowl of chicken soup and some pickled cucumbers, then rode her electric bike to her parents' home. Her mother and father were so happy they beamed. Her father, Ma Jianguo, kept saying, 'My grandson has a bright future,' and asked her to bring the children next time for a meal.

events.name: Family celebratory dinner
events.description: In the evening, the family of five sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan brought out steaming hot chicken soup. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang raised his bowl and praised his son for bringing honor to the family. Mingxuan scratched his head shyly, while his younger siblings curiously asked for more details about the exam. The room was filled with laughter and cheerful conversation.

events.name: Evening stroll
events.description: After dinner, the whole family took a slow 18-minute walk around the neighborhood to digest the hearty meal. On the way, Mingzhe imitated his older brother taking an exam, and there was constant laughter.

start_state.mood: Busy but with a clear goal, preparing for the market and the family.

end_state.mood: Excited and happy, immensely gratified by her eldest son's achievements.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 16 minutes, shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes, evening walk for 18 minutes, and deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, 26°C–34°C, occasional light breeze

2025-06.daily_overview: The first market experience achieved a small success. Not only did she sell her works and earn income, but she also made new friends and received an invitation to next month's event. In the afternoon, she gathered with her childhood friend in the courtyard, exchanging ideas about handicrafts and business, and their friendship grew stronger.

events.name: Morning walk and shoulder and neck warm-up
events.description: Got up at 5:40, and to save time, only brisk-walked in the courtyard for 8 minutes, then did 5 minutes of stretching, focusing on shoulder exercises.

events.name: Attending the summer handicraft market
events.description: At 6 a.m., Ma Xiulan walked 15 minutes with a basket to the Cultural Square in Jinghai District. At Zhou Xiuqin's stall, she spread out a tablecloth, neatly arranged the embroidered pieces and pickled cucumbers, and hung up handwritten price tags. After the market opened, she enthusiastically introduced her works to passing residents and demonstrated simple embroidery stitches on the spot. A middle-aged woman (Director Li) stopped to praise her craftsmanship and invited her to attend the Jinghai District Folk Culture Festival held the following month.

events.name: Market sales and exchanges
events.description: At the market, Ma Xiulan sold embroidered handkerchiefs (30 yuan), a pair of coasters (40 yuan), small pendants (25 yuan), and two jars of sauce-pickled cucumbers (85 yuan), with total income of 180 yuan. Several citizens who love traditional handicrafts exchanged stitching techniques with her, and she carefully noted the customers' suggestions.

events.name: Return the stall after the market ends and record the accounts
events.description: After the afternoon market ended, Ma Xiulan packed up the remaining items, met Zhou Xiuqin to return the stall permit, and thanked her. After walking home, she took out the 180 yuan of income, recorded it in the family account book, and put the remaining embroidered items and pickled vegetables back in their original places.

events.name: Embroidery with childhood friend Liu Chunmei in the courtyard
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan invited Liu Chunmei via WeChat to come to the courtyard at home to do embroidery together. Liu Chunmei arrived with homemade sour plum drink. The two sat on rattan chairs beside the hydrangea flowers, practicing the newly learned lotus pattern while chatting about their children and town anecdotes. During the gathering, they also exchanged customer feedback on the pickled cucumbers and discussed follow-up promotions. The activity lasted until sunset. After seeing Chunmei off, Ma Xiulan tidied up the courtyard tools.

events.name: Evening Walk and Deep Breathing
events.description: After dinner, take a 15-minute slow walk around the neighborhood; before bed, sit quietly on the bed for 5 minutes, breathing deeply, recalling the gains from the market.

start_state.mood: A little nervous but full of anticipation, and well prepared.

end_state.mood: Satisfied and relaxed; the success of the market and the reunion with her childhood friend lifted her spirits.

state.daily_exercise: 8 minutes of brisk walking in the courtyard, 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, 15 minutes of evening walk, 5 minutes of deep breathing before bed

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy with sunny spells, 27°C to 33°C, with showers in the afternoon.

2025-06.daily_overview: A warm family day, witnessing the important moment of the youngest daughter's kindergarten graduation, with the whole family turning out to cheer her on. In the afternoon, took the granddaughter to visit the elderly, with three generations sharing joy together.

events.name: Morning walk (a little late)
events.description: Because it was the weekend and the graduation ceremony, she got up at 6:00, walked along Jingwen Road for 15 minutes, and then did some simple stretches.

events.name: Attend the kindergarten graduation ceremony of her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan went with her husband and two sons to Yangguang Kindergarten in Jinghai District to attend Ma Yuxin's graduation ceremony. As one of the lead reciters, Ma Yuxin performed in the program 'The Promise of the Rainbow.' Ma Xiulan held up her phone and recorded the whole time, her eyes slightly moist. After the ceremony, Ma Yuxin threw herself into her mother's arms, and Ma Xiulan praised her as the best little girl. The family took a group photo at the kindergarten gate.

events.name: Tidied the garden flowers and plants and prepared a simple lunch.
events.description: After going home at noon, Ma Xiulan watered the hydrangeas and green beans in the courtyard and picked a few roses that were in full bloom to put in a vase. She made a simple noodle dish with gravy, and the whole family ate while recalling funny stories from the children's early years. In the afternoon a sudden shower came down, and the family curled up in the living room watching TV. Ma Xiulan did a few stitches of embroidery in her spare time.

events.name: Taking my daughter to my parents' home
events.description: After the rain stopped in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan rode the electric bike with Yuxin to her parents' home so that the grandparents could see their granddaughter wearing her graduation gown. Her mother, Li Xiuying, held Yuxin and praised her repeatedly, and her father, Ma Jianguo, gave her a handmade wooden rocking horse toy. Ma Xiulan also helped her mother organize the storage room and chatted about summer vacation plans.

events.name: Evening stroll
events.description: After dinner, took a slow 18-minute walk around the neighborhood. The air was fresh after the rain, and children were chasing and playing.

start_state.mood: Feeling gratified and emotional, looking forward to my daughter's graduation performance.

end_state.mood: Warm and satisfied, proud of her children's growth.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of morning walk, 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching, 18 minutes of evening walk, 5 minutes of deep breathing before bed

2025-06.daily_overview: A parent-child working day from the vegetable garden to the dining table: the whole family worked together to harvest spinach and make steamed buns, filled with joy. In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan went to Hualian Supermarket to finalize the pickled vegetable promotion with Liu Chunmei for next Saturday, and after returning home she immediately prepared the pickled vegetables and tasting samples.

events.name: Early morning walk
events.description: At 5:40, she power-walked for 16 minutes on Jingwen Road. Because there was farm work today, she quickened her pace. After returning home, she stretched for 5 minutes.

events.name: Leading the children to harvest spinach
events.description: At 6 a.m., Ma Xiulan took out a vegetable basket, scissors, and gloves from the storage room, called her second son Ma Mingzhe and her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, and went together to the courtyard vegetable plot. She taught the children, hand over hand, to cut the spinach from the roots with scissors. Talking and laughing, the three of them harvested the entire vegetable bed, filling two baskets.

events.name: Guided the children to trim and wash spinach.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan taught Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin by the kitchen sink to pick off the old roots and yellow leaves of spinach, then rinse it repeatedly with clean water three times. She demonstrated while reminding them to be careful, and the two children worked with great enthusiasm.

events.name: Making spinach steamed buns and tasting them with the family
events.description: At 11 a.m., Ma Xiulan chopped half of the spinach, mixed it with flour, yeast, and salt, and kneaded it into a green dough. After proofing, she shaped it into small mantou buns and steamed them over high heat for 15 minutes. At noon, she brought them to the table. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang took a bite and praised, 'More fragrant than store-bought ones.' Her little daughter held up a bun and said, 'Mom's vegetables taste the best.' The whole family was happy and harmonious.

events.name: Save the leftover spinach.
events.description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan blanched the leftover spinach, squeezed it dry, shaped it into balls, wrapped them in plastic wrap, and put them in the freezer to save for making dumplings later.

events.name: Finalized the pickled vegetable promotion plan with Liu Chunmei and prepared samples for tasting.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan went to Hualian Supermarket to find Liu Chunmei. The two discussed and finalized the details of the pickled vegetable promotion for next Saturday (June 28), including setting up a tasting station and a “buy two get one free” plan. After returning home, Ma Xiulan immediately followed the plan and pickled an extra ten jin of pickled cucumbers, then portioned out about 200 tasting samples (about 30 grams each) into small food bags, labeled them with the promotion date, and put them in the refrigerator for later.

events.name: Make yogurt and share it
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan made this week's yogurt as usual, still sticking to the plain flavor this time. She gave portions of the yogurt to her parents and her neighbor Wang Guilan, and Wang Guilan gave her a small bag of sweet potatoes from her own garden in return.

events.name: Evening stroll
events.description: After dinner, took the children for a slow 12-minute walk in the courtyard, shortening the route because of the day's high physical exertion.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, planning to take the children to experience the joys of farm work.

end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled, confident about the weekend promotion

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 16 minutes, shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes, evening walk for 12 minutes, and deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning cloudy, 24°C to 30°C, cool breeze

2025-06.daily_overview: A plain and routine family day. Ma Xiulan used her free time to organize handcraft materials. Because her waist was sore, she tried hot compresses and rested. She called her mother to chat about everyday things, and also supervised the children's homework.

events.name: Morning walk (shortened due to back soreness)
events.description: Left at 5:50, walked slowly on Jingwen Road for 12 minutes, but returned early due to a faint soreness on the right side of my lower back. After getting home, did neck and shoulder stretches and gently massaged my waist with my hands.

events.name: Organize craft materials and embroidery pieces in progress
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan sorted and stored the leftover fabric and embroidery thread from last week in her craft corner, put away two unfinished embroidery hoops, and gestured as she sketched out the pattern for the next design. She got up and walked around every 20 minutes, and did several backward leans using the back of a chair for support.

events.name: Apply a hot compress to her lower back by herself
events.description: At noon, her waist was still sore and swollen. Ma Xiulan wrapped a towel around a hot water bottle and applied it to the painful area for 15 minutes. She felt the muscles relax a bit, but it was not fundamentally relieved. She decided to see a doctor if it continued to worsen.

events.name: Talked on the phone with mother Li Xiuying
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan called her mother, talked about recent family matters, and mentioned that her waist was uncomfortable. Her mother urged her not to overwork herself, get more rest, and said there were pain relief patches at home for her to pick up. Ma Xiulan agreed to go in a couple of days.

events.name: Supervise the children's homework and prepare dinner
events.description: At 4:30 in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan checked her younger daughter's calligraphy practice book and urged her second son to recite an ancient poem. Then she started preparing dinner. She thawed the spinach balls left from a few days earlier and made spinach and egg dumplings. During the process, she sat down to rest several times to avoid standing too long. The family enjoyed the meal very much.

events.name: Evening walk canceled; replaced with deep breathing relaxation.
events.description: Due to lower back discomfort, Ma Xiulan decided to suspend her evening walk. She only did 5 minutes of deep-breathing relaxation in bed and recalled the day's small blessings, then went to bed early at 22:10.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, but a little concerned about the discomfort in her lower back

end_state.mood: Calm with a hint of worry, hoping her waist gets better

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 12 minutes, shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, and deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed (evening walk suspended due to lower back soreness).

2025-06.daily_overview: Monthly summary day for the healthy eating plan. The whole family agreed to continue the mixed-grain porridge and homemade yogurt. Ma Xiulan shared this successful experience with her mother and sister, and became more confident in managing the family's health. As usual, she went to her parents' home to deliver yogurt and help out.

events.name: Morning walk (persisted)
events.description: At 5:30, I brisk-walked for 15 minutes on Jingwen Road; my lower back was still a bit sore, so I walked a little slower. After getting home, I did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches and tried a few gentle cat-cow stretches on my own.

events.name: Hold a family meeting to review dietary changes
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan gathered the family for a brief family meeting in the dining room. She opened her journal and tallied up: the multigrain porridge had been kept up for 28 days, homemade yogurt had been made 8 times, and the total cost of ingredients was about 180 yuan, saving about 60 yuan compared with buying fried dough sticks and supermarket yogurt before. The children's weights were stable and their bowel movements were regular; her husband also said he was less likely to feel sleepy while driving during the day. The whole family agreed to keep multigrain porridge and homemade yogurt as a long-term habit.

events.name: Share the summary with her mother and older sister
events.description: After the meeting, Ma Xiulan took a photo of her journal entries and sent it to the family WeChat group. She also separately called her mother Li Xiuying and her older sister Li Xiuyun to share the joy. Her mother praised her for being good at running the household, and her sister suggested that she could add some honey or fruit to the yogurt. Ma Xiulan kept every suggestion in mind.

events.name: Go to parents' home to deliver yogurt and help with trimming vegetables.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to her parents' home, bringing two boxes of yogurt and multigrain porridge, and helped her mother pick water spinach. Her mother gave her some garland chrysanthemum and scallion seedlings. During the visit, she demonstrated a few stretching moves to her mother, who learned them earnestly.
