events.name: Daily housework and courtyard tidy-up.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan did laundry, cleaned up, and went to the courtyard to pollinate the newly bloomed cucumber flowers. She also picked a few tender cucumbers to use for pickled vegetables the next day. While working, she was careful not to bend over continuously.

events.name: Evening stroll
events.description: After dinner, took a slow 18-minute walk in the neighborhood. The soreness in her waist eased somewhat, but she avoided taking large strides. Before bed, she sat quietly in the bedroom and did deep breathing for 5 minutes.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, ready to hold a family review meeting

end_state.mood: Full of a sense of achievement; family health has reached a new level.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 15 minutes, shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes plus an attempt at cat stretch, evening walk for 18 minutes, and deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, with brief thundershowers in the afternoon, 24°C~32°C

2025-06.daily_overview: A day of dual planning for health and finances. In the morning, a follow-up check showed the anemia had improved, but she was diagnosed with lumbar muscle strain and had to start daily stretching; in the evening, she formally drew up a family travel budget for Beijing, turning the short-term goal into quantifiable actions.

events.name: Morning walk and stretching (cautious due to lower back pain)
events.description: Got up at 5:15, strolled for 18 minutes on Jingwen Road, and still felt a dull ache in her lower back. After returning home, she didn't do shoulder-neck stretches; instead, she applied a hot compress.

events.name: Go to the community health service center for a follow-up routine blood test
events.description: Ma Xiulan sorted out her medical records and medical insurance card at home and walked to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center. After registering, she had blood drawn in the laboratory department, waited about half an hour, and received the lab report showing that her hemoglobin had rebounded to 105 g/L.

events.name: Consult the general clinic about lower back soreness.
events.description: Ma Xiulan took her lab test results to the general clinic. Dr. Wang looked at them and happily said her anemia had improved significantly, and reminded her to continue paying attention to her diet. Ma Xiulan then mentioned that she had recently been experiencing soreness and swelling in her lower back due to long periods of bending over while embroidering and making pickles. Through consultation and a simple physical examination, Dr. Wang diagnosed lumbar muscle strain and advised her to reduce continuous bending and start stretching exercises.

events.name: Learn lumbar muscle stretching exercises and practice them at home
events.description: Dr. Wang taught two movements in detail: cat stretch and wall-assisted waist twist, emphasizing that persisting every morning and evening can promote blood circulation. Ma Xiulan carefully noted the key points and, after returning home, immediately tried a few sets on the living room carpet. Although her movements were unfamiliar, her waist felt slightly warm after finishing. She then checked the placement height of the embroidery frame and the pickle jar, and decided to get up and move every 30 minutes from now on.

events.name: Make a Beijing travel budget in the evening.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan took out her account book in the study and carefully estimated the cost of taking the whole family to Beijing for a summer trip: hard-seat train tickets round trip about 200 yuan, two nights of accommodation about 400 yuan, tickets and meals about 500 yuan, totaling about 1,100 yuan. She checked the education fund savings record (already saved 2,400 yuan), decided to set aside 600 yuan from it as a special travel fund, and planned to regularly set aside 100 yuan from her monthly part-time income to supplement the travel fund.

events.name: Sharing travel plans with her husband
events.description: Ma Xiulan told her husband Ma Zhiqiang about the budget and savings plan she had written. Ma Zhiqiang expressed support and promised to make several more long-distance trips to increase the family income. The two initially agreed to try to make the trip happen by the end of the summer vacation.

events.name: Evening walk (lower back pain slightly relieved)
events.description: After dinner, due to thundershowers, she stayed indoors and just walked slowly around the living room for 10 minutes. Before bed, she did one set of cat stretches and wall-assisted waist twists, 10 repetitions per side, 10 minutes in total.

start_state.mood: Worried about the health results, a little tense.

end_state.mood: Feeling grounded and motivated, with clear direction for both health and goals.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 18 minutes, shoulder and neck stretches paused, cat stretch and wall-supported waist twists 10 minutes each in the morning and evening, slow indoor walking for 10 minutes, deep breathing before bed for 5 minutes

2025-06.daily_overview: Rehabilitation exercise kickoff day. Persisting with stretching morning and evening is still clumsy, but my lower back already feels relieved. Went to my parents' home to share the stretching routine, and my husband's teasing made the exercise more fun for the family. In the afternoon, I recommended a yoga studio to my childhood friend Liu Chunmei.

events.name: Morning walk and first formal stretching.
events.description: At 5:25, she briskly walked for 15 minutes on Jingwen Road. After returning home, she practiced cat stretches and wall-assisted waist twists on a mat in the courtyard. The movements were still rough, but more familiar than yesterday. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang passed by and joked that she looked like she was worshiping Buddha. Ma Xiulan retorted that Dr. Wang taught her, and went on to do two more sets.

events.name: Pay attention to adjusting your working posture during the day.
events.description: While doing housework and embroidering, Ma Xiulan remembered the doctor's advice. Every half hour she got up and walked around, and did several simple backward leans against the wall. At noon, during breaks while cooking, she did a few more stretches.

events.name: Go to parents' home to deliver yogurt and teach mother stretching exercises
events.description: In the morning, she took homemade yogurt and multigrain porridge to her parents' home. Her mother, Li Xiuying, also had a chronic lower back problem. Ma Xiulan taught her mother the cat stretch she had learned, and the mother and daughter practiced together on the floor while her father watched and smiled.

events.name: Recommended the yoga studio to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan called her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, shared her experience with stretching exercises, and recommended the yoga studio Dr. Wang had mentioned, suggesting she try it together. Liu Chunmei was interested, and they agreed to go for a trial class on the weekend.

events.name: Did stretching exercises again before bed
events.description: Before going to bed that night, Ma Xiulan practiced cat stretches and wall-supported waist twists by the bedside again. This time her movements were slightly more practiced than in the morning, so she deliberately slowed down to feel the stretch in her waist muscles. After finishing, she felt much more relaxed in her lower back.

events.name: Brought home the dumplings her mother had made from her parents' house.
events.description: Her mother knew she had back problems, so she specially made fennel and pork dumplings for her to take home. Ma Xiulan was touched, and the whole family shared them at dinner.

start_state.mood: Keeping a calm mind and looking forward to today's exercise.

end_state.mood: A small sense of achievement, and the waist discomfort seemed to have eased.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 15 minutes, shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes, lower back muscle stretching for 20 minutes total in the morning and evening, evening walk for 18 minutes, deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed.

2025-06.daily_overview: Stretching exercises were woven into the gaps of daily life, done regularly in the morning and evening, and squeezed in whenever possible during the day. The soreness and tightness in her waist were significantly relieved, and Ma Xiulan gained confidence in sticking with exercise. On hot days, she switched to indoor activities.

events.name: Morning stretching in the courtyard plus light exercise
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan first did cat stretch and wall-supported waist twists for 10 minutes in a shady spot in the courtyard, then watered the flowers and plants and picked a few cucumbers. Because the temperature was high, she didn't go out for a walk and instead substituted courtyard work.

events.name: Doing side waist stretches between household chores
events.description: During a break from housework in the morning, Ma Xiulan did several sets of side waist stretches while holding the door frame in the living room, feeling her stiff muscles gradually loosen. She also tried doing twists on a chair.

events.name: High temperature canceled going out; she did handicrafts indoors.
events.description: Because the midday temperature reached 36°C, Ma Xiulan canceled her original plan to go to the vegetable market and instead embroidered at home, getting up to stretch every 20 minutes. She began embroidering a new twin-lotus coaster.

events.name: Invited her daughter to join her for fun exercise in the evening
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan did formal stretching exercises again in the bedroom. This time she invited her younger daughter Ma Yuxin to do cat-cow stretches together as a game, correcting her daughter's posture while completing a relaxed 15-minute session. After the day's practice, she felt that the soreness and tightness in her lower back had been significantly relieved.

events.name: Talked with her younger sister Ma Xiufen on the phone
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiufen called. The sisters talked about a new free trial class at the yoga studio, and her younger sister strongly urged her to try it together. Ma Xiulan was a bit tempted and agreed to go if tomorrow's promotion went well.

start_state.mood: Calm, determined to keep exercising

end_state.mood: Feeling gratified; the positive feedback from her body encouraged her.

state.daily_exercise: Courtyard work replaced the morning walk; neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes; lower back stretches three times totaling 35 minutes; evening walk canceled (due to high temperature); deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast with showers turning to cloudy, 25°C~31°C, high humidity.

2025-06.daily_overview: A cross-boundary experience day. In the morning, the supermarket promotion doubled pickle sales, deepening cooperation with the supermarket; in the afternoon, her younger sister dragged her to a yoga studio, and although she made a spectacle of herself, it unexpectedly broadened her fitness horizons. She did not forget to let her parents know she was safe.

events.name: Morning walk and stretching (taking advantage of the rain break)
events.description: At 5:50, seeing the rain had stopped, Ma Xiulan went out and power-walked for 15 minutes on the wet tree-lined path. Then she returned home and did shoulder and neck stretches and cat-cow stretches for 10 minutes, preparing for the promotion.

events.name: Go to the supermarket to run the pickled vegetable promotion.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ma Xiulan arrived at Hualian Supermarket with the prepared pickled cucumber samples and a 'Buy Two, Get One Free' poster. Liu Chunmei helped set up the tasting table in the dry goods section. The promotion started at 9:30. Ma Xiulan was in charge of cutting the pickled cucumbers, inviting customers to sample them, and explaining how they were made. Customers responded enthusiastically, and morning sales quadrupled compared with usual. After the event, Liu Chunmei suggested establishing a long-term promotional partnership, and Ma Xiulan happily agreed.

events.name: My younger sister came to visit and dragged me to the yoga studio.
events.description: Shortly after returning home at noon, her younger sister Ma Xiufen came over and excitedly urged Ma Xiulan to try a free class at the newly opened Hehe Yoga Studio in Jinghai Town. Ma Xiulan hesitated at first, but could not resist her sister's persistent coaxing and finally agreed. The two walked there together.

events.name: Changing clothes at the yoga studio and attending a Hatha yoga class
events.description: After arriving at the yoga studio, the two sisters changed into borrowed sports clothes in the locker room. Ma Xiulan felt the clothes were tight and a bit uncomfortable, but still put them on neatly. Entering the classroom, she followed the teacher's instruction in Hatha yoga. Her hands trembled during Downward-Facing Dog, but when it came to the Cat-Cow stretch, she was especially attentive because she remembered Dr. Wang's advice. During the final Savasana, she actually relaxed so much that she fell asleep, and her younger sister found out and teased her about snoring. The whole class lasted about 60 minutes.

events.name: After-class exchanges and calling parents
events.description: After the class, Ma Xiufen teased her elder sister for falling asleep in class. Ma Xiulan was a bit embarrassed but candidly said that this experience made her realize the benefits of active exercise. Although she hadn't fallen in love with yoga, she was willing to try other sports. After returning home, she recommended the yoga studio's free trial class to her neighbor Liu Chunmei via a WeChat voice message. Then she called her parents, told them the promotion was successful, and promised to bring the pickled vegetables over tomorrow.

events.name: Evening stretching practice
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ma Xiulan practiced stretching alone on the bedroom bed, focusing on posterior hip stretches and waist twists for 12 minutes. She clearly felt that compared with the previous two days, the soreness in her waist had greatly eased, and the pain during movements was lighter. Before bed, she took deep breaths for 5 minutes, and recalling the joke from yoga class, she couldn't help laughing.

start_state.mood: Busy and expectant, hoping for a successful promotion

end_state.mood: Excitement and humor were interwoven, and both mind and body gained something new

state.daily_exercise: 15-minute morning walk, 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch, 10-minute waist muscle stretch (morning), 60-minute yoga class, 12-minute pre-sleep stretch, 5-minute deep breathing

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, 27°C~34°C, weather improving

2025-06.daily_overview: Home Renewal Day. The whole family pitched in for the quarterly deep cleaning, and with great enthusiasm they made the house spotless. Giving old clothes to a neighbor unexpectedly brought an opportunity to promote her products, further expanding the sales channels for her pickled vegetables.

events.name: Morning reinforcement stretching, movements are now smooth
events.description: Ma Xiulan proactively stretched in the courtyard at 5:40 in the morning. Now she is very skilled at every movement, able to complete it precisely and hold it for 30 seconds to 1 minute, for a total of 10 minutes. She felt that the soreness in her lower back had basically disappeared and her posture had become more upright. Then she walked on Jingwen Road for 15 minutes.

events.name: Gathered the whole family and assigned spring-cleaning tasks.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Ma Xiulan gathered her husband and three children and announced that today was the quarterly deep cleaning. She assigned tasks in detail: her husband would clean windows and move heavy items, the eldest son would tidy the bookshelves and desks, the second son would organize toys and sweep the floor, the youngest daughter would wipe down tables and chairs, and she herself would focus on kitchen grease and courtyard clutter.

events.name: Deep clean the kitchen and courtyard
events.description: After dividing up the tasks, Ma Xiulan first sprayed the stove, range hood, and cabinets in the kitchen with a strong degreaser, scrubbed repeatedly with a steel wool ball to remove the grease, and then wiped everything clean with a damp cloth and clean water. Then she went to the courtyard, sorted and cleared away accumulated clutter such as old flowerpots, dead branches, and fallen leaves, swept the ground clean, and rinsed the cement ground with water. The whole process took about 3 hours, during which she stopped to drink water and rest several times.

events.name: The children completed their respective tasks
events.description: The three children worked simultaneously: eldest son Ma Mingxuan sorted and wiped the books on the bookshelf; second son Ma Mingzhe sorted toys into storage bins and swept the floor; youngest daughter Ma Yuxin carefully wiped the living room tables and chairs with a damp cloth. Ma Xiulan checked and guided them midway, and the children finished in about two hours. Her husband, meanwhile, cleaned all the windows in the house with a squeegee and moved furniture to make cleaning easier, finishing within one hour.

events.name: Gave old clothes to a neighbor and received a gift in return
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan picked out a dozen or so old clothes in good condition from the wardrobe and storage room (including adult T-shirts and children's jackets) and personally delivered them to Wang Guilan's home across the hall. Wang Guilan thanked her repeatedly, then turned and went back inside to bring out a small jar of homemade rice wine as a gift in return. She also offered that her daughter, who worked in the canteen of her workplace, could help promote the pickled cucumbers to the canteen. Ma Xiulan was overjoyed and thanked her again and again.

events.name: The whole family inspects the results and puts away the tools.
events.description: At 6 p.m., the whole family inspected every room and the courtyard, confirming the windows were bright, the floors clean, and everything in its place. Then they put away the cleaning tools and packed out the trash. Everyone was satisfied, and the house looked brand new.

events.name: Evening family walk and stretching
events.description: After dinner, the whole family took a leisurely 20-minute stroll around the neighborhood, chatting and laughing. Before bed, Ma Xiulan did 10 minutes of cat stretch and waist twists, felt relaxed, and went to bed at 22:30.

start_state.mood: Full of energy and looking forward to new changes at home

end_state.mood: Body and mind at ease, home and heart clean, and mutual help from neighbors brought an extra surprise

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 15 minutes, back and waist stretches for 10 minutes (morning). Spring cleaning was physically demanding. Evening walk for 20 minutes, stretching before bed for 10 minutes, deep breathing for 5 minutes.

2025-06.daily_overview: Month-end wrap-up day. In the morning, an urgent trip to get the second son fitted for glasses drew the family's attention to eye care. In the afternoon, the settlement of pickled vegetable sales showed steady revenue growth. In the evening, a detailed financial review established the discipline of 'same-day accounts, same-day recording,' drawing a fulfilling close to June.

events.name: Morning walk and stretching summary.
events.description: At 5:20, she walked briskly for 15 minutes on Jingwen Road. Her waist no longer felt sore, and her steps were light. After returning home, she did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches and 10 minutes of cat stretch, feeling that her body was in great shape. She took a selfie of the blooming roses in the courtyard and posted it to her Moments with the caption, 'Last day of June, persistence is victory.'

events.name: Discovered her second son was nearsighted and took him to the doctor.
events.description: In the morning, while tidying clothes in the study, Ma Xiulan noticed that her second son, Ma Mingzhe, was writing at his desk with his head almost touching the exercise book. She immediately reminded him to sit up straight, but concern rose in her heart. After a simple inquiry and test, she suspected the child was nearsighted and immediately decided to take him to the ophthalmology department of Jinghai District People's Hospital. She walked there holding Ma Mingzhe's hand. After registering and waiting in line, the doctor performed cycloplegic refraction and diagnosed myopia of 150 degrees in both eyes. The doctor reassured her that this is common myopia in school-age children and recommended glasses and regular follow-up examinations.

events.name: Go to the optical shop to get glasses fitted.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Ma Xiulan took Ma Mingzhe out of the hospital and walked to Mingshi Optical on Shengli Street. She had her son try on several lightweight plastic-frame glasses, and Ma Mingzhe picked a pair of blue semi-rimless glasses. Ma Xiulan bargained with the clerk and finally closed the deal at 350 yuan. After putting on the new glasses, Ma Mingzhe said in surprise, 'So this is how clearly the teacher writes!' Ma Xiulan responded with a wry smile, 'Now he'll be even more dependent on me.' After getting home, she put the glasses away carefully and urged her son to wear them when doing homework and to maintain a proper sitting posture. In the evening, after her husband and eldest son came home, Ma Xiulan blamed herself for not noticing earlier. Her husband comforted her and reminded her to control the children's phone use from now on. The family briefly discussed ways to protect their eyesight.

events.name: Went to the supermarket to settle the pickle account
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan stopped by Hualian Supermarket on the way to check this month's pickled vegetable sales ledger with Liu Chunmei and the accounting staff. After calculation, the total income from pickled vegetables in June was stable at about 250 yuan, with pickled cucumbers contributing most of the growth, nearly doubling compared with the previous month. After receiving the cash settlement, Ma Xiulan thanked them repeatedly and planned to try adding a spicy and numbing flavor and expanding the supply next month.

events.name: Evening review of June finances
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan took out her account book and all of this month's income documents (the pickled cucumber consignment records, embroidery order receipts, and the social security subsidy notice) and spread them out on the dining table. She went through each item: pickled vegetable consignment income of 250 yuan, embroidery order net income of 250 yuan, and social security subsidy of 200 yuan, for a total side income of 700 yuan. Then she listed the major expenses: 400 yuan for the electric bicycle, 350 yuan for her second son's glasses, 150 yuan for her husband's annual accident insurance, 200 yuan for the Children's Day amusement park, and about 1,200 yuan for daily living expenses. After calculating, she marked the overspending in her account book, but still resolved to squeeze out 150 yuan from daily savings to deposit into the dedicated education fund account and another 50 yuan as the family emergency reserve. She also wrote down the new principle: 'Record the day's accounts on the same day.' She opened mobile banking, completed the transfer, and recorded it in her account book after confirming. Finally, she closed the account book and silently resolved: next month she would increase consignment sales of pickled vegetables by another 10 percent and continue taking embroidery orders, striving to bring total side income in July to over 800 yuan.

events.name: Summarized the effects of the lower back muscle exercises and planned for the future.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan sat on a low stool in the yard to rest. She felt that the soreness in her lower back had completely disappeared, and she could maintain proper posture longer while embroidering. She decided to stick to stretching every day from now on, and considered buying a lumbar support cushion. Before bed, she did 10 minutes of cat stretch and wall-assisted waist twists, then sat quietly and breathed deeply for 5 minutes. Reviewing the whole of June, she felt fulfilled and lucky.

events.name: Calling her older sister to finalize summer vacation travel details
events.description: Before going to bed, her elder sister Li Xiuyun made a WeChat video call, and the two discussed the dates and accommodation for taking the whole family to Beijing during the summer vacation. Xiuyun invited them to stay at her home. Ma Xiulan happily agreed and began thinking about what local specialties to bring her.

start_state.mood: Mild anxiety, sudden worry about the child's eyesight

end_state.mood: Though there are some regrets, overall satisfied; finances are secure, and health management is on track.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 15 minutes, shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, waist and back stretches for 10 minutes, evening walk (only 10 minutes of slow walking in the courtyard due to being busy with glasses fitting), and 5 minutes of deep breathing before bed.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ma Xiulan officially launched her morning walk and pickled vegetable trial production plans. She obtained a traditional recipe from her neighbor Wang Guilan and tried her hand at making soy-pickled radish for the first time. At the same time, she began studying Alipay's payment collection QR code, taking the first step toward a side business.

events.name: Morning walk begins.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm clock rang. Ma Xiulan shook off the early spring drowsiness, put on her sneakers, and went to the courtyard. She walked along the community path on Jingwen Road for 15 minutes, breathing in the cool air, noticing the new buds on the courtyard roses and the grass turning green along the roadside. After the walk she felt refreshed and full of anticipation for her new plan. After returning home, she did her usual 5-minute shoulder and neck stretches and felt her body gradually waking up.

events.name: Ask a neighbor for pickled vegetable recipes.
events.description: At around 9 a.m., Ma Xiulan went to the home of Wang Guilan, her neighbor across the way, to ask specifically for the secret recipe for traditional Tianjin pickled vegetables. Wang Guilan warmly brought out her old pickling jar, explained in detail the proportions of salt, sugar, and soy sauce, and demonstrated how to use salt to draw out the water and remove the astringent taste from the radishes. Ma Xiulan took careful notes in her phone's notepad and asked for the exact amounts of the spices. When she left, Wang Guilan gave her a small bag of homemade five-spice powder, which deeply moved her.

events.name: First time making soy-pickled radish
events.description: After learning the technique, she immediately went to the vegetable market and bought white radishes and carrots. Following what she had learned, she first salted them to draw out the water, then mixed a pickling liquid with soy sauce, sugar, and rice vinegar, packed the vegetables into a clay jar, sealed it, carefully wrote down the date, and began the two-week pickling. She was so focused throughout the whole process that she almost didn't hear her youngest daughter calling her.

events.name: Research Alipay payment QR code.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa and searched for "Alipay personal payment QR code application" on her phone. After browsing the official tutorial and confirming that it was free and that she met the personal requirements, she decided to submit the application the next day. She also took the opportunity to learn about WeChat's payment code to make more preparations for her future market stall.

events.name: Mother called to chat about everyday things
events.description: In the evening, her mother Li Xiuying called and chatted about neighborhood trivia and the children's amusing stories, casually mentioning that her father Ma Jianguo had recently said he sometimes felt dizzy. Ma Xiulan told her mother to keep an eye on it, but did not take it too seriously, thinking that her father had always been robust and was just tired from work.

start_state.mood: Full of anticipation

end_state.mood: Satisfied and fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Walked for 15 minutes, stretched shoulders and neck for 5 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, light rain in the evening.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan's early morning walk went smoothly. She followed the tutorial to submit an application for an Alipay payment QR code. In the afternoon she played with her youngest daughter in the courtyard, recording warm moments, and in the evening she sorted out the family expenses.

events.name: Morning walk continued.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, without an alarm, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally, put on her sneakers, walked slowly in the courtyard for a few minutes, then went out the gate. Today she went around to the eastern section of the community path and saw willow trees sprouting new branches and sparrows hopping on the branches. She returned home after 15 minutes, feeling her steps lighter than yesterday. While stretching, she added a new side-bend movement and felt her waist loosen up as well.

events.name: Submitted the Alipay collection QR code application.
events.description: In the morning, she opened Alipay and, following the steps she had researched the day before, went to the 'Collect Money' code page, filled in her ID information, uploaded a photo, chose a simple style, and submitted the application. The system prompted that review would take 1-2 business days. She also set up voice alerts for incoming payments on her husband's phone, preparing for when he would help sell pickled vegetables in the future.

events.name: Mother and Daughter Playing in the Courtyard
events.description: In the afternoon the sun was warm. Her younger daughter Yuxin pestered her mother to draw in the courtyard. Ma Xiulan took chalk and taught her to draw small flowers on the ground, and used her phone to take a mother-daughter photo. She remembered that she wanted to take one family photo every month, so she saved this one into the 2025 folder, feeling that even the trivial bits of life are worth recording. In the evening a light rain began, and the two had to stop in a hurry, with Yuxin still not having had her fill.

events.name: Organize household expenses
events.description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan took out her ledger and carefully checked February's expenses. She found that her husband's cigarette spending was still over budget, and she decided to have a proper talk with him tomorrow evening. She highlighted the March education savings goal of 150 yuan in red, reminding herself not to touch it.

start_state.mood: Relaxed

end_state.mood: Warm and cozy

state.daily_exercise: Walked for 15 minutes, stretched shoulders and neck for 5 minutes

2025-03.daily_overview: On a Monday workday, Ma Xiulan met a neighbor during her morning walk, took care of household chores after sending the children off, bought seasonal vegetables in the evening, cooked noodles with gravy for the family, and talked with her husband in the evening about controlling his cigarette spending.

events.name: Ran into Wang Guilan during morning exercise.
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., Ma Xiulan had just stepped out of the courtyard gate when she ran into Wang Guilan, who was returning from the vegetable market. The two stood by the roadside and chatted for a while. Knowing that Xiulan was doing morning exercise, Wang Guilan smiled and said, 'You look more and more energetic.' After chatting, Ma Xiulan continued along the community path for 15 minutes. Because she had someone to talk to, the walk felt especially short, and she felt that this kind of neighborly interaction made getting up early more meaningful. While stretching, she thought about writing up the stretching instructions for Wang Guilan too.

events.name: Taking the children to school
events.description: At 7:30 a.m., Ma Xiulan punctually urged her second son Ma Mingzhe to pack his schoolbag, picked up her younger daughter Yuxin and put her on the electric bike, first took her second son to the elementary school, then sent her daughter to kindergarten, and on the way went to Sun Guifang's vegetable market to buy fresh vegetables and meat filling. Today Aunt Sun gave an extra bunch of scallions, saying they were left over from the weekend.

events.name: Managing household chores and preparing dinner
events.description: All morning she swept the floor, did laundry, and tidied the rooms at home. After picking up the children in the afternoon, she began preparing dinner. Today she specially made the family’s favorite noodles with thick gravy, using seasonal spinach recommended by Aunt Sun at the market. The family ate it happily. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who rarely came home early, also praised the noodles.

events.name: Talking to her husband about cigarette money
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan pulled her husband into the courtyard and carefully went over the amount overspent on cigarettes last month with him, taking out the account book. Her husband was a little embarrassed and promised that starting tomorrow he would take only 10 yuan a day for cigarettes and put the saved money into the education fund. Ma Xiulan smiled and patted him on the shoulder.

start_state.mood: Slightly hurried

end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Walked for 15 minutes, stretched shoulders and neck for 5 minutes

2025-03.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Ma Xiulan kept up her walk in the light rain. She was delighted after receiving the Alipay payment code sticker. In the afternoon she found some time to do a few stitches of embroidery, and in the evening she received a call from Zheng Xiuying and learned about the community handicraft market.

events.name: Walking in the rain
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, a light rain began to fall. Ma Xiulan hesitated for a moment but still went out with an umbrella. She walked slowly along the community path, listening to the rain tapping on the umbrella, and saw winter jasmine buds covered with water droplets. She returned home after 15 minutes, trouser cuffs slightly wet but feeling refreshed. While stretching, she deliberately did a few extra chest-opening exercises to ward off the damp chill.

events.name: Received the payment code sticker.
events.description: In the afternoon, the courier delivered a thin envelope containing the physical payment QR code sticker sent by Alipay. Ma Xiulan happily stuck it on the side of the cabinet and scanned it with her phone to confirm that it correctly jumped to the payment page. She thought, "The pickled vegetable business will be more convenient now." She also took a photo of the sticker and sent it to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei.

events.name: Afternoon embroidery time
events.description: After finishing the chores, Ma Xiulan took out her unfinished embroidery sample and embroidered by the window for over half an hour, repairing a few petals. She enjoyed the peace of the needle and thread moving through her fingers, and planned that once the pickled vegetables were ready, she could embroider a few pieces to bring to the handicraft market for display. Meanwhile, the rain stopped, and sunlight slipped through the gaps in the clouds.

events.name: Zheng Xiuying called.
events.description: In the evening, Zheng Xiuying called, saying the community planned to hold a handicraft market in late March and asked whether she was interested in signing up. Ma Xiulan readily agreed and immediately decided to work on both pickled vegetables and embroidery. The two arranged to meet in a few days to discuss the stall setup in detail.

start_state.mood: Spirit

end_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

state.daily_exercise: Walked for 15 minutes, stretched shoulders and neck for 5 minutes

2025-03.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally and did morning exercise, discussed the pickled vegetable promotion intention with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei on WeChat, and successfully tested the payment QR code in the evening. The side-business plan gradually became clear, and before bed she also recorded today's weight change.

events.name: Morning exercise after waking up naturally
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up without relying on an alarm clock; her body had adapted to getting up early. She walked briskly for 15 minutes on the community path, her heartbeat slightly quickening. After returning home, she calmly prepared breakfast: cooked millet porridge and mixed the pickled vegetables her husband had brought back last night. She silently resolved to stick to this good habit. While stretching, she tried standing on one leg with her eyes closed, almost lost her balance, and made her youngest daughter laugh heartily.

events.name: Payment QR code is now officially in use
events.description: In the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from delivering goods. Ma Xiulan asked him to scan a QR code sticker with Alipay and transfer 1 yuan as a test. With a 'ding', the money arrived. She happily confirmed that her payment collection code worked, and her husband even gave a rare compliment: 'quite trendy'. She then asked him to scan and pay 5 yuan, saying she would record it as the first advance income from the pickles.

events.name: Discuss consignment sales with a childhood friend.
events.description: During the afternoon tea break, Ma Xiulan chatted with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei on WeChat and mentioned that she was making pickled vegetables and wanted to find sales channels. Liu Chunmei volunteered that she worked at Hualian Supermarket and could ask the purchasing department whether they could sell farm products on consignment. Ma Xiulan thanked her repeatedly, and the two agreed to meet on the weekend for a detailed discussion. She also sent a photo of the ceramic pickle jar.

events.name: Record weight changes
events.description: Before bed, Ma Xiulan stepped on the scale and saw 56.1kg, a little lighter than at the beginning of the month. Satisfied, she wrote it down in her health journal and made a note: walking is effective.

start_state.mood: Nature

end_state.mood: Gratified

state.daily_exercise: Walked for 15 minutes, stretched shoulders and neck for 5 minutes

2025-03.daily_overview: On Thursday, Ma Xiulan tidied the courtyard while taking a walk. In the afternoon, she received feedback from Liu Chunmei about supermarket consignment sales. In the evening, she checked the pickled vegetables and had an initial idea for the market stall.

events.name: Morning exercise and courtyard upkeep
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan took her usual walk. Today she deliberately paused in the courtyard for a while, admiring the vegetable seedlings that had just emerged and the new leaves of the roses, and pulled out a few weeds along the way. She walked lightly for 15 minutes and felt refreshed all over. After stretching, she also watered the roses and watched water droplets roll on the leaves.

events.name: Received feedback on the supermarket consignment.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan received a WeChat message from Liu Chunmei, and learned that she had asked a colleague in the supermarket's purchasing department about the consignment process for pickled vegetables. The colleague said they needed to see samples and check hygiene conditions, and that it could be done through retail consignment. Chunmei also sent a voice message: "Your pickles are definitely fine. Let's meet up on the weekend." Ma Xiulan was touched and replied, "Thanks, let's meet at Square 15."

events.name: Check on the pickled vegetables
events.description: In the evening, she could smell the pickled fragrance through the clay jar. She couldn't help gently prying open a corner with clean chopsticks and saw that the radishes had turned a dark color, with an enticing aroma, but were not yet translucent enough. She resealed the jar and patiently waited for the day to open it. At the same time, she sketched a simple stall layout on paper, marking the display areas for pickled vegetables and embroidery.

start_state.mood: Cozy and relaxed.

end_state.mood: Gratitude

state.daily_exercise: Walked for 15 minutes, stretched shoulders and neck for 5 minutes

2025-03.daily_overview: On Friday, Ma Xiulan completed the first week of her walking plan and adapted well. At noon she adjusted the pickling of the vegetables; in the afternoon she had her blood pressure measured at the clinic and asked about low-salt tips, preparing for both health and her side business; in the evening the whole family watched TV programs.

events.name: First-week morning exercise summary.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan completed her seventh walk of the week. She strolled along the community path and reflected on the past week, from struggling to getting used to it, and felt her stamina had improved a lot. She decided to keep it up next week and planned to add stretching exercises occasionally. While stretching, she found her neck could turn much more freely and secretly rejoiced.

events.name: Adjust the pickled vegetable curing
events.description: At noon, she carefully opened a corner of the clay jar and used clean chopsticks to take out a piece of radish to observe: the color had deepened and it had a savory sauce aroma, but it was not yet fully cured. She gently turned the vegetables to make sure the liquid covered all the ingredients, resealed the jar, and carefully wiped the rim to prevent mold. She also took a photo of the jar, intending to send it to her mother.

events.name: Measure blood pressure at the community clinic.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan went to the community clinic and had her blood pressure measured by Dr. Wang. It was all normal. She also asked about precautions for a low-salt diet. Dr. Wang gave her a few leaflets, and she planned to have her father get a check-up too when he came. Dr. Wang also praised her complexion, saying that insisting on walking was right.

events.name: Family TV night
events.description: In the evening, the whole family sat around watching TV. A local Tianjin news segment was airing a story about a handmade pickled vegetable shop. Ma Xiulan watched intently, and the children also clamored for their mother to open a shop. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang laughed beside them, saying that opening a shop was not that easy. But Ma Xiulan silently remembered the name of the pickled vegetable shop.

start_state.mood: Sense of achievement.

end_state.mood: Peace of mind

state.daily_exercise: Walked for 15 minutes, stretched shoulders and neck for 5 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, with evening showers

2025-03.daily_overview: On Saturday, after her morning walk, Ma Xiulan helped a neighbor buy an apron online. Unexpectedly, her father was hospitalized with a sudden onset of high blood pressure. She rushed him to the hospital and began to stay with him. Only in the evening did she have time to check the tree-planting notice, and her daily rhythm was suddenly disrupted.

events.name: Early morning walk
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan strolled along the community paths for 15 minutes with practiced ease. She noticed a few small purple flowers blooming in the flower beds beside the road and thought that spring had truly arrived. She was especially focused during stretching, because today she planned to take the children to the park.

events.name: Help Wang Guilan order an apron online
events.description: After returning from a walk, neighbor Wang Guilan knocked on the door and said she didn't know how to shop online and wanted to buy a plain apron. Ma Xiulan readily agreed, used her phone to search on Taobao, and with Wang Guilan picked out a light gray cotton apron, placed the order and paid (spending 28 yuan). Wang Guilan insisted on giving cash, and Ma Xiulan accepted after declining politely. "I'll bring it to you when it arrives."

events.name: Father was hospitalized due to a sudden spike in high blood pressure
events.description: Around 10 a.m., her mother Li Xiuying called in a panic, saying that her father Ma Jianguo had felt dizzy and couldn't stand when he got up in the morning, and they were on their way to the community clinic. Ma Xiulan's heart tightened. She hurriedly rode her electric bike to her parents' home, and seeing that her father was pale and had very high blood pressure, she and her sister Ma Xiufen, who had also rushed over, hailed a taxi to take him to Jinghai District People's Hospital. The emergency doctor diagnosed stage II hypertension, requiring hospitalization for observation. Ma Xiulan ran around handling the admission procedures and stayed by the hospital bed all afternoon until her husband Ma Zhiqiang arrived after work to take over. Only then did she go home to make dinner for the children.

events.name: Check the tree-planting notice
events.description: After returning home in the evening, she saw a notice posted by the neighborhood committee on the bulletin board in the hallway about free saplings being distributed for Arbor Day, with the event at 9 a.m. the next day. Although she was worried about her father, she decided to go get a sapling to add some greenery to the home, hoping it might ward off bad luck.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and pleasant

end_state.mood: Anxious and worried.

state.daily_exercise: Walked for 15 minutes, stretched shoulders and neck for 5 minutes

2025-03.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan went to the hospital to deliver meals in the early morning, then took part in a tree-planting activity. She brought back persimmon saplings, and the whole family worked together to plant a tree of hope. In the evening, she went to the hospital again to accompany the patient. Despite being busy, she still felt a little comforted.

events.name: Early morning hospital meal delivery
events.description: At 6:00 a.m., Ma Xiulan got up, cooked millet porridge, packed it into an insulated container, and rode her electric bike to the hospital. Her father's blood pressure had dropped slightly, but he still needed to stay in bed. She fed him breakfast, handed over to her younger sister Ma Xiufen who had been on the night shift, and promised to come again at noon. Before leaving, she walked briskly for 10 minutes in the hospital garden, counting it as her exercise for the day.

events.name: Collect persimmon saplings
events.description: At 9 a.m., she hurried to the neighborhood committee compound, queued up with her ID card, and received a persimmon sapling about one meter tall. The staff reminded her of planting precautions. She carefully carried the sapling home on foot, thinking about where in the courtyard to plant it. On the way she met her neighbor Zhang Shufen, who said the sapling was good and would bear fruit in autumn.

events.name: The whole family planted the first persimmon tree
events.description: After returning from delivering lunch to the hospital, she and her husband and second son Ma Mingzhe chose a spot in the southeast corner of the courtyard. Her husband dug the hole, her second son held the tree upright, Ma Xiulan filled in soil, and then they watered it thoroughly to settle the roots. Her husband built a windbreak support with wooden sticks and twine. Ma Xiulan smiled and said to her second son, 'When the trunk grows thicker, it will bear fruit, and then we will have our own persimmons to eat.' She also wrote 'Planted on March 9, 2025' on a small wooden sign and hung it on the support.

events.name: Visit father again in the evening.
events.description: At a little past 4 p.m., she went to the hospital again to bring dinner and kept her father company, telling him the sapling had been planted. Her father managed a faint smile. Ma Xiulan silently prayed that her father would recover soon and come home to see it. On the way back she dragged her feet, but when she saw the sapling by the front door, she felt there was hope.

start_state.mood: Busy but determined

end_state.mood: Concerned but somewhat relieved

state.daily_exercise: Took a 10-minute walk; did quite a lot of walking around the hospital.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Monday, because her father was hospitalized and needed full-day company for care, Ma Xiulan asked her neighbor Wang Guilan to help with picking up and dropping off her youngest daughter. She herself stayed at the hospital carefully caring for her father, while her husband took the initiative to share the housework. The family mutual-help model was activated.

events.name: Entrusted the neighbor with the daughter's drop-off and pick-up.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan took her youngest daughter Yuxin to kindergarten. On the way, she specially asked Wang Guilan, their neighbor across the hall, to pick up her child in the afternoon, explaining that her father was hospitalized and needed care. Wang Guilan readily agreed and said, "A close neighbor is better than a distant relative—don't be so formal." Ma Xiulan thanked her gratefully. After dropping off the child, she walked briskly for 10 minutes near the hospital and then entered the ward.

events.name: All-day hospital companionship.
events.description: After dropping off the children, she went straight to the hospital, relieved her mother, and began a full day of care. Following the doctor's orders, she measured her father's blood pressure every 2 hours and recorded it in a small notebook; she gave him medicine, wiped his face, and helped him to the bathroom. At noon, while her father was asleep, she went to the cafeteria to buy light meals and quickly ate a few bites herself. In the afternoon, the nurse taught her how to massage his legs to prevent blood clots, and she learned seriously.

events.name: Husband proactively shares the load
events.description: At 4 p.m., Wang Guilan picked up Yuxin, and Ma Xiulan hurried home to make dinner. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang deliberately finished work early today and took the initiative to buy a fish at the market, saying he wanted to make soup for his father-in-law. At the table, he even helped his second son with math homework for the first time. Ma Xiulan felt that her husband was also supporting her through his actions. After dinner, she called her mother to report she was fine, and reminded her younger sister to bring the blood pressure record book tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Great responsibility

end_state.mood: Tired but warm at heart

state.daily_exercise: Brisk walking for 10 minutes; also walked around a lot in the hospital

2025-03.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Ma Xiulan accompanied her father in the hospital all day, video-called her elder sister Li Xiuyun to discuss his condition, accompanied her father to examinations in the afternoon, and after returning home in the evening began learning low-salt recipes to prepare for her father's recovery.

events.name: Hospital caregiving and connecting with sisters
events.description: Ma Xiulan got up at 6:00 in the morning, made breakfast, and after taking the children to school went straight to the hospital. Today her father was in better spirits and could sit up and talk. At noon, her elder sister Li Xiuyun called by video from Beijing and was relieved to see that their father was stable. The three sisters agreed that Ma Xiulan and her younger sister would take turns providing daytime care, while their mother would bring dinner at night. After hanging up, Ma Xiulan walked slowly in the corridor for 10 minutes to relax.

events.name: Accompany my father to have an electrocardiogram.
events.description: In the afternoon, the doctor arranged for her father to have an electrocardiogram. Ma Xiulan carefully helped him to the examination room. While waiting for the test, her father said he wanted to eat the pickled vegetables from home. She smiled and promised that when they opened the jar, she would use less salt and bring some to satisfy his craving. The test results were normal, and she breathed a sigh of relief.

events.name: Learn low-salt recipes
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Ma Xiulan searched her phone for "low-salt recipes for hypertension" and noted down a few simple dishes such as cold dressed black fungus and stir-fried celery with pork, and calculated the amounts of oil and salt. She planned to adjust the family's diet starting the next day to help her father control his blood pressure. She also specifically consulted Dr. Wang over WeChat to confirm whether a few dishes were suitable.

start_state.mood: Hard work

end_state.mood: Felt a little relieved.

state.daily_exercise: Walk slowly in the hallway for 10 minutes.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Wednesday, her father was moved to a regular ward. Relieved, Ma Xiulan learned how to use the blood pressure monitor from the nurse and made a low-salt diet plan for the family. In the evening she returned home and briefly explained Grandpa's condition to the children.

events.name: Father’s condition has improved
events.description: During the morning ward rounds, the doctor said her father's blood pressure was well controlled and he could be transferred to a general ward for another week of observation. Ma Xiulan helped the nurse move his things and felt a bit more relieved. She immediately posted the good news in the family WeChat group, and her older sister replied, “That's great, Xiulan, you've worked hard.” She walked for 15 minutes downstairs from the new ward and felt that even the sunlight was unusually bright.

events.name: Learned to use the electronic blood pressure monitor.
events.description: In the afternoon, the nurse taught her how to use a wrist electronic blood pressure monitor, emphasizing the importance of measuring in the morning and evening and recording the readings. Ma Xiulan practiced several times carefully, noted the key points in her phone memo, and planned to supervise her father's self-measurement in the future. She also measured herself; the reading was normal, which put her mind at ease.

events.name: Develop a low-salt family menu
events.description: During a break in her caregiving duties, based on the recipes she had looked up the day before, she drafted a week-long low-salt menu in her journal: multigrain porridge for breakfast, one meat and two vegetable dishes with limited oil for lunch, and light soup noodles for dinner. She decided to start the trial once she got home and to keep an eye on her husband to use less soy sauce. She took a photo and sent it to her mother, who responded with a thumbs-up emoji.

events.name: Evening communication with the children.
events.description: Back home that evening, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan asked about Grandpa, and Ma Xiulan said he was much better. She told her second son Mingzhe to keep taking good care of the persimmon tree, which was planted for Grandpa. She also helped her youngest daughter Yuxin make a get-well card for Grandpa, on which Yuxin drew a big sun and Ma Xiulan wrote beside it: 'Wish Grandpa good health.'

start_state.mood: A little calmer

end_state.mood: Gratified

state.daily_exercise: Walk for 15 minutes

2025-03.daily_overview: On Thursday, Ma Xiulan continued her daytime caregiving. After returning home in the evening, she and her second son tended the persimmon tree. At night, she had a video call with her handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin, exchanging embroidery ideas and agreeing to meet in person, regaining a bit of life's enjoyment.

events.name: Hospital companionship and rehabilitation encouragement
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan took a low-salt lunch to the hospital. Her father was able to get out of bed and walk today. She walked two slow laps with him in the corridor, encouraging him to keep up with rehabilitation. In the afternoon, the wrist blood pressure monitor her sister had mailed from Beijing arrived. She took it to the hospital to calibrate it. After her father took a measurement, the readings were stable. Before going home, she took a brisk 15-minute walk in the hospital garden and worked up a slight sweat.

events.name: Tended to the persimmon tree and took photos.
events.description: After school in the evening, her second son Ma Mingzhe, as agreed, watered the persimmon tree planted on March 9 by himself. Ma Xiulan checked whether the sapling was firmly in place and taught her son to pull up the weeds around it. She was pleased that her son was taking the initiative to care for the sapling, and took a night photo of it with her phone, planning to share it with her handicraft friends later. She also noticed that the sapling had sprouted a few new buds and, surprised and delighted, called her husband to come see.

events.name: Video chat with Zhou Xiuqin about embroidery
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ma Xiulan contacted her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin in the courtyard via a WeChat video call. She excitedly showed off the newly planted persimmon sapling. Zhou Xiuqin suggested embroidering a 'Persimmons for Good Fortune' pattern to record the moment. The two chatted and laughed while exchanging needlework techniques. Before hanging up, they agreed to meet offline next week to design embroidery patterns together. Zhou Xiuqin also said she had a few old embroidery pattern books at home that she could lend her.

start_state.mood: Nervous at the hospital, relaxed at home

end_state.mood: Fulfilling

state.daily_exercise: Brisk walking for 15 minutes

2025-03.daily_overview: On Friday, Ma Xiulan and her husband brought back two persimmon saplings. During the day she continued to accompany her father, and in the afternoon she went home to make careful preparations for opening the jar of pickled vegetables the next day, inviting the family to taste them. In the evening, the whole family enjoyed a rare relaxed time.

events.name: Collect persimmon tree saplings again
events.description: In the morning, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was off work. The two rode an electric bicycle together to the community greening station and, with their ID cards, received two more persimmon saplings. Ma Xiulan carefully checked that the root systems were intact, wrapped the roots in a damp cloth, and took them home to temporarily place in a cool, shaded spot. After returning home, she did a simple 10-minute stretching routine, then hurried to the hospital.

events.name: Afternoon hospital visit to accompany a patient
events.description: After collecting the saplings, she went to the vegetable market to buy eggplants her father liked, went home to make a low-oil version of braised eggplant, put it in an insulated lunch box, and took it to the hospital. During the afternoon care visit, she helped her father wash up and read him a few passages of livelihood news from her phone. It was after 3 o'clock when her mother came to take over the shift, and she finally went home. Before leaving, her father held her hand and said, "You've worked hard." Her eyes reddened.

events.name: Preparing to open the jar of pickled vegetables
events.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan made preparations for tomorrow's jar-opening ceremony. She cleaned the white porcelain plates and clean chopsticks, and took out two small glass jars for separate portions. She notified her husband Ma Zhiqiang to come home on time at noon to taste it, and sent a WeChat message to her younger sister on duty at the hospital, asking her to bring a portion of the pickled vegetables to their father for a taste tomorrow noon. She also found a piece of red cloth from the cabinet to cover the jars tomorrow, adding a sense of ceremony.

events.name: Family dinner and casual chat
events.description: In the evening, her husband suggested not cooking that day, so they went to the alley entrance and bought a few jin of dumplings. The family sat around eating and chatting. Ma Xiulan told them the news that her father was getting better, and the children were all very happy. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, also took out the award certificate from school, saying he scored 95 on math. Ma Xiulan happily gave him a kiss. Before going to bed, she weighed herself, 55.8kg, and recorded it.

start_state.mood: Busy and fulfilling

end_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

state.daily_exercise: Stretch for 10 minutes

2025-03.daily_overview: On Saturday, after Ma Xiulan took a morning walk, the whole family planted new saplings. At noon, the pickled vegetables were opened from the jar and received praise. In the afternoon, she met with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei and finalized the intention for consignment sales, and insisted on depositing into the education savings. Both her sideline business and family made progress.

events.name: Increase the intensity of morning exercise.
events.description: At 6:15 in the morning, Ma Xiulan was woken by birdsong outside the window. She went out for a 15-minute walk and deliberately quickened her pace today, feeling her heartbeat speed up slightly and a light sweat on her forehead. After returning home, she added 5 minutes of stretching in the courtyard, including leg presses, chest expansion, and waist twists, and felt her body loosen up. She decided to add intensity variations every other day from now on. While stretching, she looked at the three persimmon trees and imagined them heavy with fruit in autumn.

events.name: The whole family planted new saplings
events.description: At 9 a.m., the family of five gathered in the courtyard. The husband and the two sons and the little daughter worked together to plant the two saplings they had brought back yesterday in the empty spot in the courtyard. The husband dug the holes, the second son held the trees straight, the eldest son filled in the soil, and the little daughter watered them. Ma Xiulan directed and took photos to remember the occasion. From then on, the courtyard had three persimmon trees, full of spring vitality. The second son, Mingzhe, volunteered to take on the daily watering task for all the saplings. Ma Xiulan hung a small tag on each tree.

events.name: Opening the pickle jar and tasting the pickles
events.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan ceremoniously opened the clay jar. The rich pickle aroma filled the air, and the radishes and carrots looked translucent and tasted crisp. She picked out a few pieces for her husband and children to taste, and everyone said they were better than store-bought. She immediately filled a small bowl, sealed it with plastic wrap, and asked her husband to take it to the hospital so her father could have a taste. Her father also praised it repeatedly, saying it was just right to go with rice. Ma Xiulan then packed another jar to take to Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hall. Wang Guilan tasted it and said it was even better than her own recipe.

events.name: Discuss consignment matters with a childhood friend
events.description: At 3 p.m., Ma Xiulan picked the best-looking pickled vegetables, put them into two small glass jars, and brought them to the Jingwen Road community square. Her childhood friend Liu Chunmei was already waiting on the bench. After tasting, Liu Chunmei praised the flavor and said she could take them to Hualian Supermarket and try; she would bring samples to the purchasing department next Monday. Ma Xiulan was very grateful, and the two also agreed to visit a local handicraft market together next week. When saying goodbye, Chunmei pressed a bag of homemade date cake into her hands.

events.name: Continue education savings
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Ma Xiulan deposited 150 yuan into the education savings account through mobile banking as this month's fixed deposit. Although her father's hospitalization had cost some money, she adjusted other expenses in her account book and was determined not to let the children's education fund stop no matter what. After saving the money, she drew a smiley face in her journal and wrote: I will definitely save up 5000.

events.name: Bedtime family memories
events.description: In the evening, she dug out old photo albums and looked at past photos with the children, telling stories about when they were little. The youngest daughter Yuxin giggled when she saw a baby photo of herself. Ma Xiulan sighed at how time flew, but seeing her healthy and happy children beside her, she felt all the hard work was worth it. Before bed, she did 5 minutes of deep-breathing relaxation with her husband, and then went to rest early.

start_state.mood: Full of fighting spirit

end_state.mood: A great sense of accomplishment

state.daily_exercise: Walk for 15 minutes, stretch for 5 minutes, and do deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed

2025-03.daily_overview: On a clear Sunday, Ma Xiulan got up early, started with shoulder and neck stretches and a morning walk, then took out a jar of newly opened pickled vegetables and gave some to neighbor Wang Guilan. She tasted a little herself, which caused mild acid reflux, but she felt better after resting for a while. In the afternoon, she took her second son Mingzhe to the hospital to visit her hospitalized father, sharing the good news about planting persimmon trees, and the ward was filled with warmth.

events.name: Morning stretching and walking
events.description: After getting up at 6:10, Ma Xiulan did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch in the living room, then walked briskly in the courtyard for 15 minutes, feeling her body relaxed.

events.name: Sending pickled vegetables to thank her neighbor Wang Guilan.
events.description: Ma Xiulan filled a bowl with her homemade pickled vegetables and took it to Wang Guilan's home across the hall, thanking her for helping pick up her daughter a few days earlier. Wang Guilan happily accepted it and gave her a few salted duck eggs in return. The two stood at the doorway chatting about everyday things. Ma Xiulan took a bite of her own pickled vegetables; a few minutes later, she unexpectedly felt a sour sensation in her stomach. She went home, drank some warm water, and rested about half an hour before it subsided.

events.name: Visited my father in the hospital.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan took her second son, Ma Mingzhe, carrying pickled vegetables and fruit, to the inpatient department of Jinghai District People's Hospital. In the ward, she vividly described planting the persimmon sapling at home. Mingzhe spoke up eagerly, saying he had taken on the job of watering it every day. Her father smiled with relief, told them to take good care of the sapling, and said they must taste the fruit once it bore fruit.

start_state.mood: Peaceful

end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 15 minutes, neck-shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, about 40 minutes of walking round trip to the hospital, daily housework

2025-03.daily_overview: A new week began. During her morning walk, Ma Xiulan ran into Wang Guilan, and the two exchanged exercise tips. Then her pickled vegetable side business saw a breakthrough: with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei making the introduction, the first batch of 5 jars of pickled vegetables was put on trial sale at a community supermarket. Ma Xiulan personally attached handwritten labels, taking the first step toward entrepreneurship.

events.name: Morning stretching and walking, met Wang Guilan
events.description: In the early morning, after finishing her shoulder and neck stretches, Ma Xiulan briskly walked for 15 minutes on the community path and ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan, who was returning from buying groceries. She shared how her energy had improved after walking, and Wang Guilan, hearing this, also became interested in morning exercise.

events.name: Discussed consignment at the supermarket with childhood friend Liu Chunmei
events.description: After breakfast, Liu Chunmei sent a WeChat message suggesting that Ma Xiulan's homemade pickled vegetables be sold on consignment at Hualian Supermarket, where she worked. The two discussed the quantity, pricing, and packaging over the phone, and Ma Xiulan decided to start with 5 jars on a trial basis.

events.name: Preparing for trial sales of the pickled vegetables and labels.
events.description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Xiulan selected 5 jars of fully pickled vegetables, carefully washed the jars, and checked the seals. She found some white paper and watercolor pens, wrote labels by hand, and borrowed her neighbor Wang Guilan's name to call the brand "Guilan Sauce Garden," noting the name of the pickles and a simple shelf-life explanation.

events.name: Liu Chunmei communicating with the store manager
events.description: During a break in the morning, Liu Chunmei found Zhang Jianmin, the supermarket store manager, gave a detailed introduction to the features of her friend's handmade pickled vegetables, and proactively suggested placing 5 jars on a trial basis without needing to advance any cost, with the proceeds to be shared proportionally after sales. After tasting, the store manager nodded and agreed.

events.name: Put pickled vegetables on supermarket shelves for trial sales.
events.description: After receiving the confirmation, Ma Xiulan packed the 5 jars of labeled pickled vegetables in a basket and walked to Hualian Supermarket. Guided by Liu Chunmei, she finalized the price and revenue share with the store manager in person, personally placed the pickled vegetables on the shelf in the condiment section, and felt full of anticipation as she watched her products appear in the supermarket for the first time.

start_state.mood: Relaxed

end_state.mood: Excited and looking forward

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk 15 minutes, shoulder and neck stretches 5 minutes, walking to the supermarket and back about 20 minutes

2025-03.daily_overview: Tuesday brought good news: after ten days in the hospital, her father was finally able to be discharged. Ma Xiulan got up early and hurried to the hospital to handle the procedures and bring him home. In the afternoon, her second son Mingzhe was praised at school as a "Little Guardian of Green" for taking care of the persimmon tree. The whole family was immersed in the joy of recovery and growth.

events.name: Get up early, stretch, and take a short walk.
events.description: Because she had to go to the hospital, Ma Xiulan did 5 minutes of stretching, then only brisk-walked for 10 minutes before hurrying home to get ready.

events.name: Pick up my father from the hospital upon discharge.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan hurried to the hospital, helped her father pack his clothes, and completed the discharge procedures. She carefully noted the doctor's orders: continue taking medication, follow a low-salt diet, and have regular checkups. She supported her father out of the inpatient building, took a taxi to her parents' home, and only left after making sure he was settled.

events.name: Second son praised
events.description: After school in the afternoon, her second son Ma Mingzhe ran home excitedly holding a commendation letter. It turned out that because he had taken care of the persimmon saplings every day, the teacher praised him as the 'Little Guardian of Green'. Ma Xiulan happily patted his head and pressed the letter under the glass desk pad.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous

end_state.mood: Gratified

state.daily_exercise: A 10-minute morning walk, 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, and quite a bit of walking while shuttling between the hospital and home.

2025-03.daily_overview: It was overcast and slightly cool, but Ma Xiulan's heart was ablaze. After finishing her morning stretches and walk, she made a special trip to attend a community health lecture and systematically learned about hypertension care. After returning home, she immediately relayed the information to her mother and adjusted her father's dinner menu.

events.name: Morning stretching and walking
events.description: Ma Xiulan did her usual shoulder and neck stretches and a 15-minute brisk walk, feeling especially energetic today.

events.name: Prepare for the health lecture.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan confirmed that the community health service center was holding a hypertension lecture by Dr. Wang in the afternoon. She found her father’s previous inpatient blood pressure records, brought a notebook and pen, and wrote down the questions she wanted to ask.

events.name: Walk to the lecture and run into a neighbor.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan walked to the community health service center. On the way, she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan, exchanged a few pleasantries, and they agreed to go for a walk together next time. After arriving, she signed in and picked up the materials.

events.name: Listen attentively to the lecture and ask questions
events.description: At the lecture, Dr. Wang explained in detail the key points of hypertension care and a low-salt diet. Ma Xiulan took careful notes and, during the Q&A session, asked about her father's recent dizziness. Dr. Wang suggested measuring blood pressure regularly in the morning and evening and recommended several low-salt recipes.

events.name: Return home, share, and adjust father's diet
events.description: After the lecture, Ma Xiulan hurried back to her parents' home and explained the notes to her mother Li Xiuying in detail. The mother and daughter together changed the dinner menu to stir-fried seasonal vegetables and multigrain rice, greatly reducing the use of soy sauce and salt. Ma Xiulan also called her father to remind him to take his medicine on time.

start_state.mood: Focus

end_state.mood: Fulfilling

state.daily_exercise: Took a 15-minute morning walk, did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, and walked about 30 minutes round trip to the health center.

2025-03.daily_overview: A busy and hopeful Thursday: Ma Xiulan accompanied her father to the community clinic for a follow-up checkup early in the morning, and all his indicators were well controlled. In the afternoon, she received the news that her stall at the handicraft market had been approved, an important milestone for her pickled vegetable side business. In the evening, she had a lively discussion with her husband about the sales plan and sat at her desk to write out the first production plan.

events.name: Accompanied father for a follow-up checkup and got good results
events.description: In the early morning, Ma Xiulan prepared her father's medical records and medical insurance card in advance and reminded him not to eat. She helped him walk to the community service center, comforting him along the way. After registering, she accompanied her father through blood pressure, blood sugar, and electrocardiogram tests. Dr. Wang looked at the results and smiled, saying his indicators were well controlled and that as long as he continued taking his medication on time and eating a light diet, he would stay stable. Ma Xiulan turned to her father and said, "See, I told you so." Her father rarely showed a smile.

events.name: Agreed on a monthly follow-up day with her father.
events.description: After leaving the consulting room, Ma Xiulan discussed with her father and decided to come back for follow-up appointments around the 20th of every month. She marked the next date on the family calendar. Because the checkup had required fasting, Ma Xiulan herself felt a bit dizzy and hurriedly ate a few crackers after getting home.

events.name: Received the good news that the market stall had been approved
events.description: Just after sending her father home, Ma Xiulan received a call from Zheng Xiuying at the community service center, who excitedly told her that the handicraft market stall she had applied for had been approved and scheduled for the first weekend of April. Sister Zheng explained in detail the stall fee and the need to bring her own tables and chairs, and urged her to prepare products as soon as possible.

events.name: Discussing sales strategy with her husband
events.description: In the evening, as soon as her husband Ma Zhiqiang came in from work, Ma Xiulan could not wait to share the good news. In the bedroom, the two carefully calculated: they would focus on pickled vegetables, make an initial batch of 50 bottles, price each bottle at 15 yuan, and plan out the ingredient costs and production time.

events.name: Draft the production plan for the first batch of pickled vegetables.
events.description: After the family fell asleep, Ma Xiulan sat at her desk and spread out paper and pen, listing the ingredients in detail: 10 jin of cucumbers, 5 jin of peppers, salt, sugar, soy sauce, etc.; she noted the need to purchase 50 glass jars and design labels. She posted the list on the refrigerator, ready to act the next day.

start_state.mood: Concern

end_state.mood: Excited and full of energy

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, walking to and from the health center, and busy housework.

2025-03.daily_overview: On the final consolidation day of continuing the morning walking habit, Ma Xiulan was pleased to see her physical fitness improve; afterwards she bustled about shopping for her father's 68th birthday family dinner and prepared a low-sugar cake; in the afternoon, as planned, she went to the vegetable market to buy ingredients for pickled vegetables, and the home began to fill with the fresh scent of washed vegetables.

events.name: The whole family went out to sweep tombs and honor ancestors. On the way back, picking shepherd's purse was full of rustic charm. In the evening, making wontons together brought joy, fully showing the warmth of a traditional family.
events.description: On the final day of the habit-formation period, Ma Xiulan, as usual, stretched after getting up early, then briskly walked for fifteen minutes along the community path and tried some high-knee lifts. Looking back over the changes of the past two weeks, from being slightly out of breath at first to now walking with light steps, she felt satisfied and decided to maintain this habit in the long term.

events.name: Purchase ingredients for father's birthday banquet and prepare a cake
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan went to Xingwang Vegetable Market to choose fresh vegetables, fish, and Chinese yam. After returning home, she used mashed Chinese yam to bake a low-sugar, oil-free healthy cake, and marinated the pork tenderloin in light soy sauce, planning to make a low-salt version of sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin.

events.name: Purchasing ingredients for pickled vegetables
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan pulled a small cart to Xingwang Vegetable Market again and went straight to the vegetable stall of Sun Guifang, the longtime vendor. She picked out 10 jin of cucumbers and 5 jin of chili peppers according to her list, and also bought garlic and ginger. Aunt Sun rounded off the odd change and charged 35 yuan in total.
