Ma Xiulan pulled the vegetables home, washed them carefully, and drained them for later use.

start_state.mood: Positive

end_state.mood: Tired but orderly

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 15 minutes, shoulder and neck stretch for 5 minutes, walk to and from the vegetable market.

2025-03.daily_overview: On the actual day of her father's 68th birthday, Ma Xiulan brought low-salt dishes and a cake she had prepared herself back to her parents' home, gathering with her sisters. The warm family dinner made her recovering father especially happy. In the evening, she used her phone to learn new pickle recipes and successfully ordered glass jars from her neighbor Zhang Shufen, all to build momentum for the market.

events.name: Learn a new pickled vegetable recipe.
events.description: During a break, Ma Xiulan used her phone to watch short videos about long-term preservation techniques for spicy cucumber strips and sweet-and-sour garlic, and wrote down two new recipes to try later.

events.name: Holding a family birthday dinner for her father's 68th birthday
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan arrived at her parents' home with the prepared dishes and a cake, and joined her elder sister Li Xiuyun (participating via video) and her younger sister Ma Xiufen's family. In her mother's kitchen, she cooked a low-salt version of sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, steamed fish, and longevity noodles. The whole family sat around and tasted the food; her mother, Li Xiuying, wiped the corner of her eye as she watched her husband recover. During the family banquet, her father talked about stories from his youth, and everyone laughed constantly. Ma Xiulan and her younger sister quietly agreed to supervise their parents' health checkup together next month. After the meal, her father's blood pressure was 135/85, and only then did everyone truly breathe a sigh of relief.

events.name: Cleaning up after the family dinner and chatting with family.
events.description: After the meal, the three sisters cleared the table and washed the dishes together, while the children played in the yard. The adults sat around drinking tea, talking about their parents' health, their children's studies, and the pickled vegetable business. As evening fell, each family took their leave one after another.

events.name: Ordering glass jars for pickled vegetables.
events.description: On the way home, Ma Xiulan stopped by Zhang Shufen's convenience supermarket diagonally across the street and ordered 50 glass jars with lids, 500ml each. Zhang Shufen readily offered a wholesale price of 60 yuan, and they agreed to pick them up in two days. Ma Xiulan also replenished salt, white sugar, and soy sauce, spending about 20 yuan. After arriving home, she re-covered the vegetables that had been salted to draw out water, making final preparations for the formal pickling.

start_state.mood: Zheng Zhong

end_state.mood: Happy and fulfilled.

state.daily_exercise: Fifteen minutes of morning walking, five minutes of neck and shoulder stretching, walking round-trip to her parents' home, and household chores.

2025-03.daily_overview: On a sunny spring Sunday, Ma Xiulan brought her parents, who had just been discharged from the hospital, to stay at her home. The whole family did a quarterly deep cleaning together. When the windows were clean and the rooms were bright, the three sisters seriously discussed their father's health management plan and set up a routine of daily blood pressure measurement and a monthly low-salt family dinner.

events.name: Bring parents over for a short stay at home.
events.description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan walked to her parents' home and told her father that since today was a big cleanup day, she would take them to stay at her home for a few days and let the old house be thoroughly aired and dusted. Her father gladly agreed. She supported her father while her mother followed, and they slowly walked back to 156 Jingwen Road.

events.name: Whole-family quarterly deep cleaning
events.description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang wiped the high windows and moved the heavy furniture. The eldest son Ma Mingxuan organized the study bookshelves and wiped the photo frames. The second son Ma Mingzhe cleaned his toy box and then swept the floor. The youngest daughter Ma Yuxin wiped the low living room table with a rag. Ma Xiulan focused on the kitchen grease and yard clutter. The family was busy but not chaotic. In the midst of the work, Ma Xiulan felt some stiffness in her shoulders and neck, but she still kept going until it was done.

events.name: Carefully cleaned the parents' temporary residence
events.description: After cleaning the common areas, Ma Xiulan specially prepared the south-facing room on the second floor for her parents. She carefully wiped the wardrobe and nightstands, swept and mopped the floor, then put on freshly sun-dried clean sheets, duvet covers, and pillow towels. She also opened the window for ventilation, letting the scent of courtyard plants drift into the room.

events.name: Thorough cleaning finished, the whole family rests.
events.description: All the tools were put back in place, and Ma Xiulan checked to confirm there were no missed spots. Her father Ma Jianguo looked at the completely refreshed room and kept nodding and smiling, and her mother Li Xiuying also praised again and again. The whole family gathered in the living room to drink tea and rest, with the children crowding around their grandparents.

events.name: Sisters agreed on a health management system for their father.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan sat down to discuss with her elder sister Li Xiuyun (via video) and her younger sister Ma Xiufen. They decided: their mother would supervise their father in measuring his blood pressure once in the morning and once in the evening every day, and send the readings to the family WeChat group; the three sisters would take turns going back to their parents' home at least once a month to cook a low-salt home-style meal together, with Ma Xiulan cooking first in the rotation. That evening, Ma Xiulan deliberately did an extra round of shoulder and neck stretches to relieve the stiffness from the day.

start_state.mood: Busy but orderly

end_state.mood: Tired but at ease

state.daily_exercise: Deep cleaning (heavy physical activity), shoulder and neck stretches once each morning and evening.

2025-03.daily_overview: Preparing the pickled vegetable stock officially began. After her morning workout, Ma Xiulan went to the vegetable market to replenish ingredients, then in the kitchen handled them strictly according to the recipe and pickled 20 jars of pickled vegetables in one go. Her second son Mingzhe helped write labels by hand. Mother and son chatted and laughed while they worked, and the first batch of goods for the market was neatly lined up in the storage room.

events.name: Replenish ingredients and sealing jars
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan pushed her bicycle to Xingwang Vegetable Market, bought 5 jin of white radishes and a few cucumbers from Sun Guifang's stall, and also purchased 20 glass jars. After returning, she washed and cut all the vegetables into strips, preparing to pickle them in large batches.

events.name: First batch of pickled vegetables made in bulk
events.description: At the stove, Ma Xiulan followed the recipe and used a large basin to salt the vegetables, then mixed in the sauce, and filled jars one by one, pressing and sealing them. In the midst of the work, the kitchen knife cut a small piece of skin from her finger; she bandaged it with a Band-Aid and continued. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, came home from school and helped by neatly writing "Xiulan Handmade Pickles" and the flavors on handwritten labels with a marker, then stuck them on each jar. Mother and son chatted while working, and before evening, 20 jars of pickles were neatly arranged on the shelves of the cool storage room.

start_state.mood: Full of drive

end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: 15-minute morning walk, 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch, shopping by bike, and standing the whole time while doing the pickling

2025-03.daily_overview: On a drizzly day, Ma Xiulan went to the supermarket with an umbrella to collect feedback on the trial sales. She learned that 3 jars had been sold and noted down customers' suggestion to increase the spiciness. Her right wrist was sore from continuous chopping, so she applied a hot compress after returning home.

events.name: Preparing to collect feedback
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan put her notebook and pen into a cloth bag and decided to go to the supermarket to see how the pickled vegetables were selling and to listen to customers' feedback.

events.name: Go to the community supermarket
events.description: Ma Xiulan walked to Hualian Supermarket holding an umbrella, carefully avoiding puddles on the way. She nearly slipped on a patch of accumulated water; her right hand instinctively reached out to steady herself against the wall, straining her wrist and sending a jolt of soreness through it.

events.name: Asked the store manager about sales
events.description: At the supermarket, Ma Xiulan found the store manager Zhang Jianmin and politely asked about the consignment of pickled vegetables. The manager told her that 3 of the 5 jars had been sold, and customers had given good feedback, especially liking the crispy texture. He said she could bring a few more jars tomorrow. Ma Xiulan thanked him repeatedly and noted the feedback.

events.name: Collect customer feedback on-site.
events.description: After getting permission, Ma Xiulan stood by the condiment section and chatted with several customers choosing pickled vegetables. A middle-aged woman, Li Xiufang, said bluntly that the taste was pretty good, but it wasn't spicy enough and hoped she would add more chili. Ma Xiulan agreed with a smile and noted down her suggestion.

events.name: Organizing feedback notes
events.description: Sitting on the rest chair in the corner of the supermarket, Ma Xiulan organized the feedback from the store manager and customers one by one into her notebook: 3 jars sold, overall good reviews, and strong demand for spiciness. Beside it, she marked, "Next time try adding chili at 10%."

events.name: Returned home in the rain and treated the wrist.
events.description: The rain gradually let up. Ma Xiulan closed her umbrella and walked home, mulling over recipe adjustments along the way. After getting home, her right wrist still ached. She applied a hot towel for half an hour and decided to stop making pickled vegetables to let her wrist rest.

start_state.mood: Curious

end_state.mood: Thinking

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes; walked to and from the supermarket for about 25 minutes (wrist was sore, did not go for a walk).

2025-03.daily_overview: After the weather cleared up, Ma Xiulan sought a balance between family and side business: in the morning she washed the piled-up pickled vegetable pots and jars, and followed up with Liu Chunmei on WeChat about the supermarket's willingness to restock; in the afternoon she tutored her second son's homework; in the evening she cooked a low-salt dinner for the family as usual; and before bed she loosened the soil and watered the persimmon tree.

events.name: Morning exercise and household chores
events.description: Her wrist was still uncomfortable, but Ma Xiulan still insisted on doing shoulder and neck stretches and a morning walk (changed to a slow stroll), then went home to wash the basins and jars used for pickling yesterday and set them on the rack to dry.

events.name: Clean the utensils and contact Liu Chunmei
events.description: She sent a WeChat message to Liu Chunmei asking whether the store manager had shown any interest in ordering more after those 3 jars were sold. Liu Chunmei replied that the manager was off today and would ask tomorrow, and also praised her pickled vegetables for having many repeat customers.

events.name: Help my second son with his homework.
events.description: In the afternoon, after her second son Ma Mingzhe came home from school, Ma Xiulan sat beside him to check his math homework and patiently explain the wrong answers. Mingzhe was a bit playful; she gently patted his head before he settled down, and after forty minutes he finally understood.

events.name: Preparing a low-salt dinner
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan took out tofu, greens, and lean meat. Following the low-salt principle, she used only a little light soy sauce for seasoning and made three dishes and a soup. At the dinner table, her husband gave rare praise, saying that the recent light meals made his stomach feel comfortable.

events.name: Taking care of the persimmon tree
events.description: Before dark, Ma Xiulan carried a small shovel and a watering can to the courtyard, loosened the soil around the persimmon tree, and watered it thoroughly. She noticed the sapling had sprouted a few new leaves and touched them with satisfaction.

start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.mood: Peaceful and at ease

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 15 minutes (slow pace), neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, washing utensils, and tending the small vegetable garden.

2025-03.daily_overview: On a warm evening, Ma Xiulan invited her childhood friend Liu Chunmei over for a girls' craft night. The two chatted while doing embroidery in the living room. Ma Xiulan hurriedly made a peony pillowcase for her mother, while Liu Chunmei showed off her newly learned beading skills. They laughed and talked until late, then parted reluctantly.

events.name: Daily exercise and preparation
events.description: She finished stretching and a walk in the morning, and her wrist was much better. After dinner, she took out an embroidery hoop, silk thread, and cotton cloth from the cabinet, planning to embroider a pair of peony pillowcases as a birthday gift for her mother. She tidied the tea table, brewed flower tea, and quietly waited for her friend.

events.name: Invite Liu Chunmei and have a get-together
events.description: Ma Xiulan invited Liu Chunmei via WeChat to come to her home to do handicrafts together. Liu Chunmei happily came with newly bought colorful seed beads and fishing line. The two sat face to face in the living room. Ma Xiulan stretched the fabric on an embroidery hoop and worked swiftly with the needle, while Liu Chunmei threaded beads, intending to weave a phone charm. They exchanged tips: Ma Xiulan taught Liu Chunmei how to embroider leaf veins, and Liu Chunmei shared insights on bead color matching. Their teacups were refilled again and again until late at night.

events.name: Late-night farewell and tidying up
events.description: Before they knew it, it was nearly midnight, and the two women laughingly packed up their needlework. Ma Xiulan carefully put the unfinished pillowcase into her embroidery basket, and Liu Chunmei put the beads into her small bag. After admiring each other's work, Ma Xiulan walked Liu Chunmei to the door, and they agreed to exchange skills next time. Returning to the living room, she gave the table a quick wipe before going back to her room to rest.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

end_state.mood: Pleasure and relaxation

state.daily_exercise: 15-minute morning walk, 5-minute shoulder and neck stretches, daily housework

2025-03.daily_overview: Friday's focus was on health and products: Ma Xiulan checked the pickling status of the preserved vegetables one by one, and after confirming they met the standard, sealed and labeled them, lining them up neatly for the market; in the afternoon she went out specially to buy an electronic blood pressure monitor and earnestly consulted the doctor; in the evening she taught her father to measure his own blood pressure step by step, and also measured her own blood pressure, which was normal.

events.name: Morning routine and checking the pickled vegetables
events.description: After getting up early, stretching, and taking a walk, Ma Xiulan opened the storage room, unscrewed the jar lids one by one to check the color of the pickles, tasted them to confirm they were fresh, crisp, and well seasoned, then tightened the lids and wiped the jars clean. She neatly stacked the 20 jars of pickles as final preparation for the market sale.

events.name: Purchase an electronic blood pressure monitor.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan made a special trip to a medical device store in Jinghai District, spent 280 yuan to pick out an easy-to-use electronic blood pressure monitor, and, under the guidance of the salesclerk, took a measurement herself. The reading was 120/80. She put away the instruction manual with satisfaction. Then she went to the vegetable market and bought some low-sodium salt and vegetables such as celery and wood ear mushrooms.

events.name: Teach father to use the blood pressure monitor.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan returned to the room where her parents were temporarily staying, carrying a blood pressure monitor. Using a teaching diagram she had prepared on her phone, she taught her father step by step how to wrap the arm cuff and press the start button. At first her father was nervous, and the first two readings were both high. Ma Xiulan smiled and reassured him to relax; on the third try, the reading finally came out normal: 135/85. She asked her father to write the steps on a piece of paper and stick it to the bedside, and reminded him to take a measurement every morning and evening, saying she would come every night to check the records.

start_state.mood: Careful

end_state.mood: Comfort

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 15 minutes, neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, then walked to the medical equipment store and the vegetable market.

2025-03.daily_overview: On a peaceful Saturday, Ma Xiulan ordered next week's fresh vegetables from Aunt Sun when she went to the vegetable market in the morning, and added some daily necessities for the household. In the afternoon, she made collages from cloth scraps with her younger daughter Yuxin, and the two of them enjoyed themselves. In the evening, the whole family took a walk in the community garden, and her father also slowly followed for two laps.

events.name: Shopping and placing orders at the vegetable market
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan took a cloth bag and went to Xingwang Vegetable Market. She first went to Aunt Sun Guifang's vegetable stall and picked out several seasonal vegetables, and made an appointment with Aunt Sun to come back next weekend to pick up 20 jin of cucumbers and 10 jin of chilies for the next batch of pickled vegetables. Aunt Sun agreed readily and even gave her a bunch of scallions. Then she stopped by the supermarket and bought two rolls of toilet paper and a bag of laundry detergent.

events.name: Made a handmade collage with her daughter
events.description: In the afternoon, her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin pestered her mother to 'make art'. Ma Xiulan brought out the leftover scraps of embroidery cloth, cardboard, and glue, and taught her daughter to cut cloth of different colors into flower and butterfly shapes and paste them on white paper to form a picture. Yuxin's little hands were busy nonstop. In the end, the finished work was stuck on the refrigerator, and the whole family praised how beautiful it was.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan suggested taking her father out for a walk. The family slowly strolled to the small community garden, with Ma Zhiqiang supporting her father, Ma Xiulan holding her daughter’s hand, and Mingxuan and Mingzhe roughhousing ahead. They walked two laps along the path. Her father was a little short of breath but in good spirits, and he said the air smelled of flowers. Ma Xiulan remembered that she hadn’t taken a dedicated walk today, and this loop just made up for her exercise.

start_state.mood: You Ran

end_state.mood: Warm and cozy

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, evening family walk about 30 minutes (instead of morning walk)

2025-03.daily_overview: On the last Sunday of the month, Ma Xiulan prepared for the coming April: after her morning walk she found her old sports shoes, freed up storage space on her phone for the step-counting app, downloaded it, and set a goal. In the afternoon, while sorting through the family photo album, she saw photos of the children when they were little and sighed at how time flies. Afterward, she fertilized the persimmon tree with her own compost and quietly looked forward to the new month.

events.name: Morning exercise and step-counting preparation
events.description: Ma Xiulan did her usual stretching and a 15-minute walk, then decided to start using a pedometer app to keep detailed records from April 1. She took out a pair of sneakers from the shoe cabinet, put them on and walked a few steps—they still fit well—so she wiped off the dust. Then she cleared her phone's storage, deleted unused videos, downloaded a well-reviewed pedometer app, and set a daily step goal of 6,000 steps.

events.name: Organize the family photo albums.
events.description: In her spare time, Ma Xiulan imported photos taken over the past two months from her phone to the computer, created a new folder 'Spring 2025', and categorized them by themes such as her father's birthday, spring cleaning, pickled vegetables, and persimmon tree. While sorting, she marveled at how fast the children were growing, and decided to pick out a few photos each month to print and put into the family album.

events.name: Apply spring fertilizer to the persimmon tree
events.description: In the afternoon, the sun was just right. Ma Xiulan carried a small bucket and buried the composted vegetable leaves and soybean residue fertilizer around the roots of the persimmon tree, then watered it thoroughly. She touched the tender green leaves, thinking that by autumn small persimmons would form, and by then her father's health would surely be better.

start_state.mood: Planned.

end_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 15 minutes, shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, home tidying activities, and fertilizing chores

2025-03.daily_overview: On the last day of March, Ma Xiulan got up early to exercise as usual. During the day, she took time to use the ledger for a monthly review of the family finances. After working through income and expenses in detail, she fine-tuned the budget for the April market event. In the evening, she opened her new journal, wrote a monthly wrap-up about her walks, and made a small wish to keep exercising and manage life with care. During this, she had a slight quarrel with her husband about his cigarette spending going over budget, but they finally reached an agreement.

events.name: Calculate the household income for March.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan sat in the living room and opened her account book to sum up income: her husband Ma Zhiqiang's salary this month was 4,000 yuan, her own handicraft income was 300 yuan (plus 80 yuan from the end-of-month trial sales of pickled vegetables, transferred by Liu Chunmei, which she made a special note of), totaling 4,380 yuan. She checked the pay slip and WeChat transfer records one by one.

events.name: Checked the expenses for March.
events.description: Then she itemized the expenses: 800 yuan for her share of her father's hospitalization, 120 yuan for pickle ingredients, 60 yuan for glass jars, 150 yuan for education savings, and about 2,500 yuan for daily household expenses (including groceries, daily necessities, and pocket money for the children). She pulled out several receipts and mobile payment screenshots, verified them, and calculated the total expenditure as 3,630 yuan.

events.name: Calculate the balance and analyze the current situation
events.description: Ma Xiulan calculated a March surplus of 750 yuan. Beside the surplus figure, she noted: The pickled vegetables are just starting to bring in income, but the initial investment has not yet been fully recovered, and expenses such as the April market stall fee are imminent, so she must budget carefully. She also added a separate sub-item for pickled vegetable income and expenses, recording 80 yuan in income and 180 yuan in expenses, for a temporary loss of 100 yuan.

events.name: Make an April budget plan.
events.description: Based on the analysis, Ma Xiulan started a new page and drafted the April budget: first set aside 200 yuan for the market stall fee and 100 yuan for supplementary packaging materials; maintain daily expenses at 2,500 yuan; and insist on depositing 150 yuan into education savings. She hesitated at the column for her husband's cigarette money. When she mentioned it to him in the evening, he said he had already tried to control it, but he still overspent by 50 yuan this month. Ma Xiulan was a little angry, and they had a few quiet arguments. Finally, her husband promised to strictly stick to 10 yuan per day next month, and only then did she calm down.

events.name: Monthly walking summary and journal record
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dining table, took out her newly purchased journal, and wrote a summary of her March walks: she had walked for 17 days in total, her physical fitness had clearly improved, her waist and legs felt stronger, and her mood was more stable. She decided to continue her daily morning walks in April and planned to occasionally invite Wang Guilan or Liu Chunmei to join her. Closing the notebook, she felt she was gradually making her life more and more energetic.

start_state.mood: Awake

end_state.mood: In an orderly manner

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 15 minutes, shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, north wind force 2-3, temperature 5°C to 12°C

2025-11.daily_overview: On Saturday, after completing her daily exercise in the early morning, Ma Xiulan attended the Jingu Traditional Handicraft Exhibition and unexpectedly won an award. In the evening, she noticed the community computer training class announcement, and at night, after discussing signing up with her husband, she held a family meeting to reaffirm the screen-time limit rule and led the whole family out for a walk.

events.name: Morning routine exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:35, did shoulder and neck stretches in the living room for 5 minutes, then walked in the courtyard for 15 minutes, checked the autumn flowers, and removed dead leaves. Back inside, she practiced one set of Baduanjin, with smooth movements and coordinated breathing. Breakfast was low-fat oatmeal porridge with homemade pickled vegetables.

events.name: Participated in the Jingu Traditional Handicrafts Exhibition and won an award.
events.description: In the morning, she walked to the Jinghai District Cultural Center carrying homemade pickled vegetable gift boxes and embroidery works. She arranged her works at the booth, and visitors kept coming to ask about prices. At the afternoon award ceremony, she won the "Outstanding Handicraft Inheritance Encouragement Award" and received a certificate and an embroidery materials kit. After taking photos with the other artisans, she walked home.

events.name: Watch for the community computer training class announcement
events.description: In the evening, passing by the community bulletin board on Jingwen Road, I saw a newly posted enrollment notice for "Computer Basics Training Class for Middle-Aged and Older Adults." I read the time, cost, and registration method carefully and used my phone to take photos of the key information.

events.name: Discussed signing up for a computer course with her husband.
events.description: After dinner, she brought up the computer class with her husband Ma Zhiqiang in the living room and expressed her wish to learn bookkeeping and making labels. After thinking it over, her husband agreed, and she decided to sign up the next day.

events.name: Hold a family meeting and go on a screen-limited walk
events.description: Gathered the whole family and reiterated the rule that daily screen time should not exceed one hour. Then took the radio and walked slowly along Jingwen Road for about 40 minutes, listening to the news. After returning home, the children voluntarily placed their electronic devices in the designated box.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Gratified and content, filled with anticipation about the award and the class.

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, 15 minutes of walking in the courtyard, one set of Baduanjin, about 40 minutes of walking round-trip to the cultural center, and 40 minutes of evening walking.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with some clouds, light breeze, temperature 7°C to 14°C

2025-11.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan spent half a day completing the registration procedures for a computer class. In the afternoon she tidied up the house, tutored the children, and mended clothes. In the evening, after a family walk, she soaked her feet to relax.

events.name: Morning exercise and the start of housework
events.description: Woke up at 5:36, did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches in the living room, walked in the courtyard for 15 minutes enjoying the morning light, then practiced one set of Baduanjin. Started housework after breakfast.

events.name: Go to the community service center to sign up for a computer class.
events.description: At 9 a.m., she took 150 yuan in cash and her ID card, walked to the community service center, filled out a registration form, paid the fee, and received a course schedule and simple textbook. The staff member told her to come directly to class on the evening of the 5th.

events.name: Doing housework and tutoring the children.
events.description: In the afternoon she cleaned the living room and kitchen and aired out clothes for the changing season. While her two sons did homework, she checked and tutored her second son in math and also taught her daughter a few Chinese characters. In spare moments she mended the loose-thread cuffs of her husband's shirt.

events.name: Family walk and pre-bedtime relaxation
events.description: After dinner, the whole family walked along Jingwen Road for 30 minutes. Ma Xiulan held her daughter's hand and chatted with her husband about next week's plans. After returning home, she soaked her feet in hot water for 15 minutes, listened to the radio while keeping accounts, and did deep-breathing relaxation for 5 minutes before bed.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Relaxed

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Feeling settled and reassured that next week is all arranged.

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, 15 minutes of walking in the courtyard, one set of Baduanjin, about 20 minutes of walking to and from the community center, 30 minutes of evening walking, and about 2 hours of housework.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, northeast wind force 3–4, temperature 4°C to 9°C.

2025-11.daily_overview: It cooled down noticeably on Monday. Ma Xiulan got up early, took her daughter to school, then went to pay the heating fee. After returning home, she carefully cleaned the radiators. In the evening, her husband returned the advance payment. After recording it in the accounts, she insisted on doing her evening stretches.

events.name: Morning school drop-off and exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:35, did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, then walked her daughter to kindergarten (30 minutes round trip). After returning home, she walked in the courtyard for 10 minutes (shortened because of the cold), then practiced a set of Baduanjin in the living room. Breakfast was steamed sweet potatoes and soy milk.

events.name: Go to the heating business hall to pay the heating fee.
events.description: Put on a thick coat and walked to the heating service hall in Jinghai District. First paid 1,200 yuan for her own home, then took out her parents' payment bill from a cloth bag and paid 800 yuan on their behalf, totaling 2,000 yuan, and carefully kept both receipts.

events.name: Returned home and cleaned the radiator
events.description: After returning from paying the bill, she took a rag, a toothbrush, and a basin out of the storage cabinet, and cleaned the dust and grime on the surfaces and crevices of the radiators room by room, checking the valves. She was especially careful in the children's room and was busy for nearly an hour.

events.name: Her husband returned the money he had covered and recorded it in the accounts.
events.description: In the evening, when her husband came home, he took out 800 yuan and returned it to Ma Xiulan. She immediately wrote neatly in her account book, "Heating advance payment returned, income 800 yuan," and put the money into the iron box.

events.name: Evening stretching and foot soaking
events.description: Because it was cold and windy, the family did not go out for a walk. Ma Xiulan did 10 minutes of lumbar muscle rehabilitation stretches in the living room (cat stretch and wall-supported waist twists), then soaked her feet in hot mugwort water for 15 minutes, and did deep breathing to relax before bed.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Slightly anxious (due to a large expense)

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Relax, the heating fee and accounts have all been handled properly.

state.daily_exercise: 30 minutes walking for school drop-off, 10 minutes walking in the courtyard, one set of Baduanjin, about 30 minutes walking to and from the heating office, 45 minutes of physical labor cleaning radiators, 10 minutes of evening lower back stretching

2025-11.daily_overview: On Tuesday, after taking the children to school, Ma Xiulan went to the vegetable market to buy groceries for the week and chatted with Aunt Sun. In the afternoon, she cleaned the pickle jars and received a package notice from her younger sister. In the evening, she helped her second son with his homework and tried out extra calculation exercises.

events.name: Morning school drop-off and exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:36, did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, spent 30 minutes round trip taking her daughter to school, walked 10 minutes in the courtyard after returning home, and did one set of Baduanjin. Breakfast was low-fat vegetable noodles.

events.name: Went to the vegetable market to shop and met Sun Guifang.
events.description: Carrying a cloth bag, she went to the vegetable market and bought Chinese cabbage, spinach, and radishes at Aunt Sun Guifang's stall. Aunt Sun rounded off the amount and threw in some cilantro, and the two chatted about their plan to make pickled Chinese cabbage.

events.name: Wash and organize the pickle jars
events.description: In the afternoon, she carried out more than a dozen glass jars from the corner of the yard, scrubbed them clean with hot water and dishwashing liquid, dried them, and turned them upside down to air-dry. In the middle of it, she received a WeChat message from her younger sister saying a package would arrive tomorrow, and she replied with anticipation.

events.name: Evening tutoring of the second son and trying extra practice
events.description: After dinner, she tutored her second son Ma Mingzhe in math homework. Finding that he was careless in calculations, she gently agreed that he would do 5 extra calculation problems every day. That evening was the first trial; after getting them all right, he was rewarded with 15 minutes of cartoons.

events.name: Family walk and bedtime care
events.description: After dinner, the whole family walked along Jingwen Road for 30 minutes. After returning home, soaked feet in hot water, listened to the radio while keeping accounts, and did deep breathing to relax before bed.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Ordinary housekeeping rhythm, calm and peaceful.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Satisfied. Housework is done, and I've also checked on the children's studies.

state.daily_exercise: Walking 30 minutes to take the children to school, 10 minutes walking in the courtyard, one set of Baduanjin, about 30 minutes walking to and from the vegetable market, 30 minutes evening walk, and about 1.5 hours of housework.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Ma Xiulan received the fabric remnants her younger sister had sent. During the day she tried making fabric hair flowers, and in the evening she attended her first computer class to learn Word. After class, she practiced excitedly until late at night, and her neck and shoulders felt slightly sore.

events.name: Morning school drop-off and exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:36, did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches (especially adding lateral flexion movements), took 30 minutes round trip to take my daughter to school, walked 10 minutes in the yard after returning home, and did one set of Baduanjin. After breakfast, waited for the package.

events.name: Receive the package sent by younger sister and discuss the design
events.description: In the morning, she signed for a delivery. Opening the box, she found it full of floral cotton fabric, canvas, lace trim, and hand-drawn hair flower designs. She immediately took photos and sent them to her younger sister, and the two chatted excitedly on WeChat.

events.name: First attempt at making fabric hair flowers.
events.description: In the afternoon, she spread out her tools on the living room coffee table, cutting, sewing, and gluing beads. By evening she had completed six samples in different styles, photographed each one, and sent the photos to her younger sister, who praised them as "even more exquisite than the factory samples."

events.name: Attend the first lesson of the computer training class for middle-aged and elderly people
events.description: Arrived at the community activity room on time at 7 PM to learn Word basics: creating documents, text input, and making simple labels. Stared at the screen and filled a page of notes, then asked the teacher after class how to save files.

events.name: Post-class consolidation exercises and neck and shoulder discomfort
events.description: It was already 9:30 when she got home. She used her son's old exercise book to write down the operation steps from memory and simulated clicking until late at night. Because she had kept her head down for a long time, her neck and shoulders became stiff. After a simple stretch, she went to sleep.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Expecting a package, a little excited.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled. Made progress in both the new skill and the new handicraft. Neck and shoulders are a bit stiff.

state.daily_exercise: Walking 30 minutes to take the kids to school, 10 minutes of walking in the yard, one set of Baduanjin, about 3 hours of housework and handicrafts, 20 minutes of walking to and from the activity room in the evening, and simple neck and shoulder stretches after class

2025-11.daily_overview: On Thursday, Ma Xiulan continued making hair flowers to finish several samples, practiced computer skills in her spare time, chatted with Zhang Shufen while buying thread at the supermarket in the afternoon, and in the evening took a family walk and strengthened neck and shoulder care.

events.name: Morning school drop-off and exercise
events.description: Woke up at 5:37, focused on lateral neck and shoulder stretches with a hot compress for a while, took her daughter to school, walked in the courtyard for 10 minutes, and did a set of Baduanjin. After breakfast, she immediately started making hair flowers.

events.name: Continue making fabric hair flowers and complete several samples.
events.description: Based on my younger sister's suggestion, I adjusted the flower sizes, used dark fabric for a more subdued style, and tried patchwork with contrasting colors. By the afternoon, I finished twelve different designs, arranged them on plates, took photos, and sent them to my sister and my childhood friend Liu Chunmei.

events.name: Practiced Word and Excel operations in spare time
events.description: After the noon break, she opened her workbook, copied down the Word tab steps, and previewed the Excel interface, using drawn grids to simulate data entry.

events.name: Go shopping at the community supermarket and chat with Zhang Shufen
events.description: In the afternoon, went to the supermarket diagonally across the street to buy white thread, showed Zhang Shufen a photo of the hair flower, and the two exchanged microwave cake recipes.

events.name: Evening walk and neck and shoulder care
events.description: The whole family walked for 30 minutes. Ma Xiulan rotated her neck while walking. After returning home, she stretched her lower back muscles for 10 minutes, applied a hot towel to her neck while soaking her feet, and did deep-breathing relaxation before bed.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: With a goal, fully motivated.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Satisfied. The results are obvious, and the neck and shoulder discomfort has been relieved.

state.daily_exercise: 30-minute walk to school; 10-minute courtyard walk; one set of Baduanjin; 15-minute walk to the supermarket; 30-minute evening walk; 10-minute lower back stretch; neck and shoulder hot compress and stretch.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast with light rain, temperature 6°C to 9°C

2025-11.daily_overview: Friday was overcast and rainy. Ma Xiulan entertained a neighbor at home and sold a hair flower for 20 yuan. In the evening, she braved the rain to attend the computer class for advanced content. While reviewing after class, she felt discomfort in her neck and shoulders again, so she did extra stretching before bed.

events.name: Morning school drop-off and exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:37, stretched shoulders and neck, walked daughter to school in the light rain (walking with an umbrella), canceled the courtyard walk, and completed Baduanjin in the living room. Breakfast was multigrain pancakes.

events.name: Neighbor Visit and Sale of Fabric Hair Flowers
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Lihua and Zhao Xiaohong came to visit despite the rain. While drinking tea, they saw the hair flowers and loved them so much they couldn't put them down. Each chose two and paid 20 yuan. Ma Xiulan happily recorded: "First order of hair flowers: 4 pieces for 20 yuan."

events.name: Attend the second lesson of the computer training class
events.description: At 7 p.m., I braved the rain to the activity room, learned Word font color, center alignment, and image insertion, and got an introduction to the Excel interface and a sum demonstration. Because I kept my head down taking notes for a long time, the stiffness in my neck and shoulders worsened.

events.name: After-School Review at Home and Neck and Shoulder Stretches
events.description: After coming home, she recited from memory the steps for Word formatting and Excel summation and simulated the operations until 11 p.m. Before bed, she specifically did a combined neck-and-shoulder stretch for 10 minutes, applied a hot compress, and then went to sleep.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: A bit lazy; the rainy, overcast weather makes one not want to move.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Joyful and fulfilled, the hair flower business opened, but with obvious neck and shoulder discomfort

state.daily_exercise: 30-minute walk for school drop-off, one set of Baduanjin, about 1 hour of housework, 20 minutes walking round trip to the activity room, and 10 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching in the evening

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, north wind force 3, temperature 3°C to 10°C.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Saturday, the day before Start of Winter, Ma Xiulan spent the morning in the courtyard pruning roses for winter and caring for potted plants. Her second son helped and they agreed to plant sunflowers. In the afternoon she rehearsed Baduanjin, and in the evening she had the final rehearsal for the community party.

events.name: Morning exercise
events.description: Woke up at 5:38, stretched shoulders and neck, walked in the yard for 10 minutes (wore a cotton-padded jacket because it was cold), did one set of Baduanjin. After breakfast, prepared garden tools.

events.name: Winter pruning and root protection for the roses in the courtyard
events.description: Pruned the dead and diseased branches of the roses, asked her second son to help pile straw around the roots to keep them warm, and explained the reasoning while they worked.

events.name: The second son expressed his wish to plant sunflowers and got permission
events.description: During the break, her second son pointed at the empty plot and wanted to plant sunflowers. Ma Xiulan readily agreed, marked out a boundary, and they agreed to sow the seeds together at the start of spring.

events.name: Winter care for potted plants.
events.description: Dealt with several pots of frost-sensitive fuchsias and begonias, pruning, wiping leaves, laying moss, and moved them into the enclosed balcony together with her husband.

events.name: Review computer lesson and have a midday rest
events.description: After lunch, review Word labels and Excel summation; draw a mock income-expense table on paper.

events.name: Group Baduanjin practice and evening party rehearsal.
events.description: In the afternoon, she changed into her practice clothes and practiced twice on her own, then went to the activity center to rehearse with the exercise leader and correct the formation. In the evening, she had a full rehearsal in the activity room to familiarize herself with the process and fix details.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Slightly nervous; there is a rehearsal task today.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Relaxed, rehearsal went smoothly, and the second son was well-behaved.

state.daily_exercise: Yard work for 1.5 hours, Baduanjin practice and joint rehearsal for about 1 hour, 30 minutes of rehearsal, shoulder and neck stretching

2025-11.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan tidied the guest room and bought ingredients to welcome Aunt Wu. In the evening, she treated the whole family to roast duck. The family movie night was heartwarming, and she found time to practice computer bookkeeping spreadsheets.

events.name: Weekend morning exercise
events.description: Woke up a bit late at 7:00, went straight to the courtyard for a 10-minute walk, then did one set of Baduanjin. Breakfast was milk and eggs.

events.name: Tidy the guest room and buy ingredients
events.description: Converted the storage room into a guest room and put on new bedding. Rode a bike to the vegetable market to buy red chili peppers, pork belly, and other ingredients, then went to the supermarket to buy additional rock sugar.

events.name: Help second son with craft homework
events.description: At noon, the second son needed to complete a leaf collage. Ma Xiulan accompanied him to the yard to pick up fallen leaves and paste them together.

events.name: Prepare family dinner: roast duck with pancakes
events.description: Her husband brought back a hot roast duck. Ma Xiulan sliced the duck, cut cucumber into shreds, baked thin pancakes, and cooked egg drop soup. The whole family wrapped the duck in pancakes and ate with great gusto.

events.name: Family movie night: watching 'Liu Sanjie'.
events.description: After dinner, the whole family watched the old movie Liu Sanjie. Ma Xiulan explained the plot, the children were amused by the folk songs, and the atmosphere was warm.

events.name: Practice computer bookkeeping and bedtime milk
events.description: After the movie, each person had a cup of hot milk. While the children washed up, Ma Xiulan designed an income and expense sheet in her exercise book and simulated the sums. Before bed, she did her usual foot soak and deep breathing.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Relaxed; looking forward to meeting Aunt Wu

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Happy and content, sweet family time

state.daily_exercise: 10 minutes of courtyard walking, one set of Baduanjin, about 30 minutes cycling to and from the vegetable market, and 2 hours of housework

2025-11.daily_overview: On Monday morning, Ma Xiulan helped her husband prepare for his winter driving trip and then took the children to school. In the morning, she picked up Aunt Wu to come and stay with them. In the afternoon, they worked together on a trial batch of Hebei-style chili sauce. In the evening, she received a notice about her second son's open day and decided to attend it in person.

events.name: Assisting her husband with preparing for his route, morning exercise, and taking the children to school
events.description: Got up at 5:35, prepared a thermos and a fleece blanket for her husband, and checked his documents. After her husband left, she did shoulder and neck stretches, took her daughter to school, walked in the courtyard for 10 minutes, and practiced Baduanjin.

events.name: Welcoming Aunt Wu, a fellow handicraft enthusiast
events.description: In the morning, walked to the coach station to pick up Aunt Wu, introducing local life along the way. At home, prepared the guest room, served tea and chatted, and made noodles with gravy for lunch.

events.name: First trial making Hebei chili sauce with Aunt Wu
events.description: After the midday break, the two put on aprons and went into the kitchen. Following Aunt Wu's family recipe, they steamed the peppers, minced them into a paste, heated oil to sauté the aromatics, and simmered over low heat. The aroma filled the air, and they filled two small bottles.

events.name: Received the notice for the second son's parents' open day and made preparations.
events.description: In the evening, the second son brought back a notice saying that tomorrow morning would be an open day. Ma Xiulan decided to go in person, took out her dark red coat and hung it up, and discussed with her husband about picking up their daughter the next day.

events.name: Evening walk with Aunt Wu
events.description: After dinner, the whole family took a 30-minute walk with Aunt Wu along Jingwen Road. Ma Xiulan introduced the neighborhood, and Aunt Wu talked about the customs and scenery of Cangzhou. Back home, they soaked their feet and chatted.

start_state.location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Busy but organized

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Looking forward to tomorrow, happy about the new friendship and the results of the chili sauce

state.daily_exercise: Walked 30 minutes to take children to school, strolled in the courtyard for 10 minutes, did one set of Baduanjin, walked 40 minutes round trip to the bus terminal, stood in the kitchen for 2 hours, and took an evening walk for 30 minutes

2025-11.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Ma Xiulan attended her second son's school open day, sat in on the math class, and talked with the teacher. She found that the child was careless, so after returning home she gently agreed with him on extra daily practice and started it. In the afternoon, she continued adjusting the chili sauce with Aunt Wu.

events.name: Morning exercise, school drop-off, and preparations
events.description: Got up at 5:38, stretched shoulders and neck, sent daughter to school. Walked in the courtyard and sped up because it was cloudy, then did a set of Baduanjin. After breakfast, told Aunt Wu to rest at home.

events.name: Went to Yucai Primary School to attend the Parent Open Day.
events.description: Walked to the school, found the classroom for Class 2, Grade 4, sat in on the math class, saw her second son raise his hand twice and answer correctly, and noted down “actively raises hand, quick reaction”.

events.name: Communicated with homeroom teacher Yang Jianguo.
events.description: After class, in the office, Teacher Yang pointed out that the child was clever but careless and suggested daily extra practice. Ma Xiulan listened carefully and thanked her.

events.name: Go home, have a heart-to-heart talk with the second son, and make a plan together.
events.description: Brought back her son's water bottle. After he came home from school, she gently conveyed the teacher's feedback and suggested doing 5 extra calculation problems every day; if he got them all right, he could watch cartoons. The child agreed and started that evening.

events.name: In the afternoon, tried making chili sauce again with Aunt Wu.
events.description: After the lunch break, added sesame seeds and adjusted the heat based on a new idea; the second version of the chili sauce was more fragrant.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: With Aunt Wu around, the walking group was livelier. Ma Xiulan and Aunt Wu chatted about handicrafts as they walked. After returning home, while soaking her feet, she shared the open day situation with her husband.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Earnest yet slightly nervous, values communication with the school

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Relaxed, the parent-child agreement went smoothly, and full of hope.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Wednesday morning, after practicing Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao, Ma Xiulan gave a thumbs-up for her father's health. In the morning, the three of them went to the market; in the afternoon, they tasted and improved the chili sauce; in the evening, the computer class covered layout design, and her neck and shoulders flared up again from sitting too long, so she applied a hot compress after class.

events.name: Morning exercise, taking children to school, and practicing Baduanjin together
events.description: Woke up at 5:39, stretched my shoulders and neck, took my daughter to school, met Aunt Zhao in the courtyard on the way back, and did a set of Baduanjin together (a weekly Wednesday and Sunday appointment).

events.name: Like and interact with Dad's morning exercise video.
events.description: During breakfast, she watched a video her father sent in the family group chat of himself walking, saying his blood pressure was stable. Ma Xiulan liked it and replied with encouragement, and her mother also joined the interaction.

events.name: Went to the local market with Aunt Wu and Zhou Xiuqin.
events.description: In the morning, the three strolled through the market on Shengli Street, buying chili peppers, sesame seeds, and lace; at noon they had mutton soup and baked flatbread.

events.name: Taste-test the first version of the chili sauce and improve the recipe.
events.description: Back home in the afternoon, she tasted the first version of the chili sauce. Zhou Xiuqin suggested increasing the numbing flavor, so she added fried Sichuan peppercorns and sesame seeds to make a second version, and recorded the recipe.

events.name: Computer training class, Lesson 3: Word layout.
events.description: At 7 pm, studied heading styles, paragraph spacing, and headers and footers. Multi-level lists were somewhat difficult; raised hand twice to ask questions, and took full notes.

events.name: Neck and shoulder discomfort after class and hot compress
events.description: Went home and copied down the operating procedures. My neck and shoulders felt sore and swollen; I applied a hot water bottle for heat therapy, did a set of stretches, soaked my feet, and went to bed.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Cheered by updates on my father's health, in a good mood

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Studying with great motivation, but feeling a bit tired with neck and shoulder discomfort.

state.daily_exercise: Walked 30 minutes for school drop-off; practiced one round of Baduanjin in the courtyard; walked 1.5 hours at the market; walked 20 minutes round-trip to the activity room in the evening; neck and shoulder stretches and hot compress.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Thursday, Ma Xiulan recorded the growth of the potted plants, reviewed her computer class, trial-made the final version of chili sauce with Aunt Wu and Zhou Xiuqin, and took photos together. In the afternoon, she saw Aunt Wu off, and in the evening, the family went for a walk. Her neck and shoulders were improving.

events.name: Morning exercise, taking the children to school, and recording potted plants
events.description: Got up at 5:39, stretched, took daughter to school, walked in the courtyard for 10 minutes, and did Baduanjin. Before breakfast, took photos of the fuchsia on the balcony for the record.

events.name: Review Word formatting and preview Excel.
events.description: In the morning, she reviewed the Word formatting steps, previewed the SUM and AVERAGE functions in Excel, and watched videos on her phone to better understand them.

events.name: Make a trial batch of the final version of Hebei chili sauce and record the recipe.
events.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan made final adjustments with Aunt Wu and Zhou Xiuqin, adding five-spice powder and sugar to enhance the flavor. Aunt Wu demonstrated the sealed fermentation method, and they divided the mixture into jars as keepsakes, with the three of them holding up the jars for a group photo.

events.name: Seeing off Aunt Wu
events.description: In the afternoon, she helped pack the luggage, gave them pickled vegetables and hair flowers, walked with them to the passenger station, and after seeing them onto the bus, went home feeling a little wistful.

events.name: Evening walk and neck and shoulder care
events.description: After dinner, the whole family took a 30-minute walk. Ma Xiulan shared tips on making chili sauce. After returning home, she soaked her feet, continued to apply a hot compress to her neck, and did stretching. She felt better.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Calm and focused, moving forward according to plan.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Reluctant to part, but gained a precious recipe and friendship

2025-11.daily_overview: Friday was cold. After tidying up the guest room, Ma Xiulan studied computer skills, made new hair flowers in the afternoon, learned Excel formulas in the evening computer class, sorted out notes after class, and her neck and shoulders remained stable.

events.name: Morning exercise and school drop-off
events.description: Got up at 5:40, stretched shoulders and neck, took daughter to school. Because of strong wind, courtyard walk only 5 minutes; did Baduanjin in the living room. After breakfast, washed the sheets used by Aunt Wu.

events.name: Tidy up the house and practice computer skills
events.description: In the morning, thoroughly clean the guest room and scrub the kitchen. After the noon break, write out the Excel steps from memory in an exercise book, and try simulating the operations in WPS on the phone.

events.name: Make new fabric hair flowers
events.description: In the afternoon, I used leftover fabric to design two new hair flowers, adding tassel elements, and prepared to send them to Aunt Wu.

events.name: Attend Computer Training Course Lesson 4: Excel Formulas
events.description: At 7 p.m., learned SUM, AVERAGE, and conditional formatting, followed along, asked the woman sitting next to me, and mastered the fill handle. Circled the key points in the notes.

events.name: After-class tidying and routine care.
events.description: Go home to organize notes, listen to the radio while soaking feet, do deep breathing to relax before bed, and keep the neck and shoulders warm.

2025-11.daily_overview: Saturday was cold. After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan made dumplings to send to Aunt Wu, tidied up and did mending, started the second son's daily extra practice exercises, took a family walk in the evening, and successfully led Baduanjin at the community cultural evening party.

events.name: Morning exercise and starting a new habit.
events.description: Got up at 5:40, stretched neck and shoulders (adding lateral flexion), walked in the courtyard for 10 minutes (wearing a cotton-padded jacket), did one round of Baduanjin. After breakfast, started making dumplings.

events.name: Making dumplings and sending gifts
events.description: Chopped cabbage and pork filling and made more than sixty dumplings. Boiled some and froze them, then packed them together with two pairs of embroidered shoe insoles and a hair flower, and asked her husband to send them to Aunt Wu in the afternoon.

events.name: Do household chores and mend the children's clothes
events.description: In the afternoon the sunshine was nice. She mended the cuffs of the school uniform and sewed on shirt buttons, wiped the furniture, and watered the potted plants on the balcony.

events.name: Tutor the second son on extra multiple-choice questions.
events.description: After the lunch break, she officially started the daily extra practice. She prepared 5 multiple-choice questions for her second son. After he got them all right, she rewarded him with watching cartoons, and the child took it well.

events.name: Leading Baduanjin exercises at the community autumn cultural evening.
events.description: At 7 p.m., she took the stage as the lead and led the team in a Baduanjin performance. The whole routine went smoothly and drew warm applause. After coming offstage, her neighbor Zhang Shufen handed her hot tea and praised her, and Ma Xiulan took a commemorative photo with her.

events.name: After the party, the whole family took a walk and shared their joy.
events.description: After the performance, she walked along Jingwen Road with her family. The children excitedly talked about the show. Ma Xiulan held her daughter's hand and felt proud. After returning home, she did her usual foot soak and deep breathing, but went to bed a little later because she was excited.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Mild, preparing for the weekend routine

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Content and proud, the party performance was a success, and the family atmosphere was harmonious.

state.daily_exercise: Walked in the courtyard for 10 minutes, performed and practiced Baduanjin for about 30 minutes, stood for 1 hour making dumplings, took an evening walk for 30 minutes, and did lumbar muscle stretches for 10 minutes.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, after getting up early and completing her daily exercise, Ma Xiulan prepared a farewell breakfast for her craft friend Aunt Wu, who was about to leave, and packed chili sauce. After seeing her off, she organized her recipe notes. In the afternoon she handled housework and tutored her second son in math. In the evening the family went for a walk. At night she kept up her foot soaking and pre-sleep deep breathing. The day ended in calm and reflection.

events.name: Routine exercise in the morning.
events.description: Got up at 5:40, did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching in the living room, then walked in the courtyard for 10 minutes and tended to the autumn flowers. Then she went back inside to practice a full set of Baduanjin, followed by 10 minutes each of lumbar rehabilitation stretches (cat stretch and wall-supported waist twists).

events.name: Prepare a farewell breakfast and gifts for Aunt Wu.
events.description: At 6:30 she went to the kitchen, steamed Tianjin buns, cooked millet porridge, and sliced pickled vegetables. After the meal, she helped Aunt Wu pack her luggage, wrapped the chili sauce they had made together in bubble wrap, and put it in a cloth bag as a farewell gift.

events.name: Take Aunt Wu to Jinghai District passenger station and say goodbye
events.description: At 8:30, I rode an electric bike to take Aunt Wu to the bus station. While waiting, we agreed to visit Cangzhou next spring. At 10:00, the bus pulled into the station. I helped carry her luggage onto the bus, hugged her goodbye, and watched the bus drive away.

events.name: Organize the chili sauce recipe notes left by Aunt Wu.
events.description: After returning home, she carefully copied Aunt Wu's handwritten chili sauce recipe into the family recipe notebook, noting points for improvement such as 'the Sichuan pepper should be Hebei Dahongpao.'

events.name: Take a 45-minute lunch break
events.description: 12:30-13:15 Napped in the bedroom to recharge.

events.name: Tackle the backlog of housework and make fabric hair flowers
events.description: In the afternoon, after doing laundry and mopping the floor, she sat by the window making fabric hair flowers. She tried two new styles with checkered fabric and got up every 20 minutes to stretch her neck.

events.name: Help her second son with extra math problems.
events.description: At 5:00 at the living room dining table, as planned, tutored her second son Ma Mingzhe in five commonly mistaken math problems, explaining patiently and encouraging him.

events.name: Evening walk for the whole family on Jingwen Road.
events.description: At 18:40, the whole family walked along the sidewalk of Jingwen Road for 30 minutes, chatting about amusing things at the children's school as they walked.

events.name: Half an hour of family reading
events.description: At 19:30, each family member read; Ma Xiulan read a book on everyday health care.

events.name: Stretching the back and soaking feet in hot water.
events.description: At 20:30 did waist and back stretches for 10 minutes; at 21:00 soaked feet in hot water with mugwort and ginger slices for 15 minutes, and kept accounts while soaking.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: At 21:30, she sat quietly in the bedroom, did deep abdominal breathing, and pressed the Hegu acupoint for 5 minutes, reviewing the small blessings of the day.

start_state.mood: Woke up, feeling a bit reluctant because Aunt Wu is leaving today.

end_state.mood: Calm and content, savoring the warmth of friendship.

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, courtyard walk for 10 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, lower back stretches for 20 minutes, family walk for 30 minutes, deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, temperature 6-10°C, northeast wind force 3.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Monday, Ma Xiulan got up early and took her daughter to school, then did her routine exercise. In the morning she practiced Excel on the computer. At noon she picked up the children. In the afternoon she went grocery shopping and chatted with the stall owner, Aunt Sun. In the evening she received the news that her eldest son had failed history, and immediately felt anxious, mulling it over at home. After dinner she took a walk alone to soothe her mood. At night she decided to go to the school for a face-to-face talk the next day. Before bed, she still insisted on stretching and soaking her feet.

events.name: Morning walk for school drop-off.
events.description: Got up at 5:45, stretched her neck and shoulders, then at 6:10 walked with her younger daughter Yuxin to the primary school, teaching her the names of roadside trees on the way, a 30-minute round trip. After returning home, she did a 10-minute courtyard walk, Baduanjin exercises, and lower back stretches.

events.name: Lunch break and picking up the second son.
events.description: At 11:30, she walked to pick up her second son and daughter and brought them home. After heating the food, she took a 45-minute nap.

events.name: Practiced Excel on the computer in the morning.
events.description: From 9:00 to 10:00, using an old exercise book, she practiced making Excel spreadsheets alongside her class notes, repeatedly practicing merging cells and setting borders.

events.name: Go to the vegetable market in the afternoon to shop and chat.
Received the midterm grades notice for her eldest son and felt anxious.
events.description: At 17:30, she received a WeChat message on her phone from homeroom teacher Han Mei, informing her that Ma Mingxuan failed history and had not turned in several assignments. Ma Xiulan's heart sank; she looked at the report card repeatedly and muttered to herself, 'What should I do?'

events.name: Taking a solo walk in the evening to relieve anxiety
events.description: After dinner at 19:00, told her husband she was going out for a walk, strolled slowly along Jingwen Road for about 30 minutes, thinking about how to communicate with the children as she walked.

events.name: Tutoring the second son in math and instructing the eldest son to review
events.description: After returning home at 20:00, tutored the second son on five commonly missed problems, then found Mingxuan and gently said they should find time to talk about his studies, and told him to make up his homework first.

events.name: Soak feet and practice deep breathing before bed.
events.description: Soaked feet in hot water at 21:00 for 15 minutes; at 21:30 did deep breathing to relax before bed. Thoughts were still a bit scattered but gradually calmed.

start_state.mood: Calm and ready to begin the new week of household chores.

end_state.mood: Anxiety hasn't subsided; decided to talk to the teacher tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: 30-minute walk to school, 5-minute neck and shoulder stretch, 10-minute courtyard walk, one set of Baduanjin, 20-minute lower back and waist stretch, 30-minute solo evening walk, 5-minute deep breathing before bed

2025-11.daily_overview: On Tuesday, after morning exercise, Ma Xiulan received a call from the homeroom teacher to arrange an afternoon meeting. In the morning she was not in the mood for handicrafts and barely managed the housework. At noon she asked her neighbor Wang Guilan to help pick up the children. In the afternoon she went to the middle school and had a detailed talk with Teacher Han Mei, learning the details of her son's missing homework assignments, and sincerely asked for advice. In the evening she returned home feeling heavy-hearted. After dinner she took a walk alone and ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen in the neighborhood, poured out her worries, and felt a little better after being comforted. At night she discussed with her husband and decided to make a plan together with her son.

events.name: Routine morning exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:50, walked her daughter to school, then shortened the courtyard walk to 5 minutes because of the overcast sky; went indoors to do shoulder and neck stretches, Baduanjin, and lower back stretches.

events.name: In the morning, received a call from homeroom teacher Han Mei and agreed to meet in the afternoon.
events.description: At 9:00 she received a call from Teacher Han, who explained in detail that Mingxuan had failed to turn in homework and asked the parents to come to school for a face-to-face meeting. Ma Xiulan's voice trembled, but she immediately agreed to arrive at school at 2 p.m.

events.name: At noon, ask neighbor Wang Guilan to help pick up the children
events.description: At 11:00, she called Wang Guilan from across the hall to ask her to keep an eye on Mingzhe and Yuxin after school. Wang Guilan readily agreed. Ma Xiulan hastily ate lunch and changed into clean clothes.

events.name: In the afternoon, she went to the middle school for a face-to-face meeting with Teacher Han Mei.
events.description: At 13:50 she arrived at the office of Jinghai District Middle School. Teacher Han showed the report card and homework records. Ma Xiulan listened and jotted down key points in her notebook, sincerely saying she would strengthen supervision. The face-to-face conversation lasted half an hour.

events.name: Met neighbor Zhang Shufen during an evening walk and listened to her confide
events.description: After returning home at 17:30, she still felt heavy-hearted and barely ate dinner. At 19:00 she went out alone along Jingwen Road and met Zhang Shufen in the open area of the neighborhood. Zhang Shufen saw that she looked unwell and took the initiative to ask. Ma Xiulan poured out the matter of her son's grades. Zhang Shufen comforted her, 'It's normal for children to have ups and downs, don't be too anxious.' After chatting for more than ten minutes, Ma Xiulan felt much better.

events.name: In the evening, discuss with her husband and formulate an education plan
events.description: After returning home at 20:00, she discussed with her husband Ma Zhiqiang and decided not to scold their son, but instead to work out an academic balance plan with him. The two of them listed the key points on paper: submit all missing homework within a week, do experiments only after finishing homework every day, and keep experiment time to no more than 1 hour.

events.name: Talk with the eldest son and sign the plan.
events.description: At 20:30, she called Mingxuan into the study and calmly told him his grades. She first acknowledged his passion for science, then seriously pointed out the importance of homework. Mingxuan lowered his head and agreed. The three of them signed the plan together and posted it next to the desk. Ma Xiulan then heated some milk for him and told him to rest well.

start_state.mood: Calm but still concerned

end_state.mood: Though it was heavy, having a plan made her feel somewhat relieved.

state.daily_exercise: 30 minutes walking to take the children to school, 5 minutes walking in the yard, 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, one set of Baduanjin, 20 minutes of waist and back stretches, and 30 minutes of evening walking

2025-11.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Ma Xiulan got up early and felt an itchy throat and a slight runny nose, thinking she might have caught a cold. In the morning, she went to the vegetable market and the clinic to pick up medicine for her father. In the afternoon, she supervised her eldest son as he caught up on his homework, and felt a little relieved when she saw that he had completed an outline. In the evening, her cold symptoms got worse, but she still insisted on going to her computer training. After class, her husband helped the second son with homework in her place. After returning home, she soaked her feet early and went to bed early to rest.

events.name: Exercised in the early morning but cut back the amount because of feeling unwell.
events.description: Got up at 5:45. My throat felt dry and itchy, but I still did 5 minutes of brisk walking in the yard, indoor shoulder and neck stretches, and Baduanjin. However, I only did 5 minutes of back and waist stretches.

events.name: Morning trip to the vegetable market and community clinic.
events.description: At 8:30, she rode an electric bike to the vegetable market to buy tofu and greens. On the way, she stopped at the community clinic to pick up blood pressure medication for her father Ma Jianguo. Doctor Wang said his blood pressure was well controlled. After returning home, she took the medication and marked the next date on the medication calendar.

events.name: In the afternoon, supervise the eldest son in submitting his overdue history homework.
events.description: At 16:00 Mingxuan got out of school. Ma Xiulan had him sit at the desk, watched him complete the outline for the first missing assignment, and sent it via WeChat to the history teacher for advice. Although Mingxuan was a bit resistant, after he finished, Ma Xiulan patted his head to encourage him.

events.name: In the evening, cold symptoms appeared.
events.description: At 17:00 I started having a runny nose and sneezing, and felt weak, but I still prepared dinner for the whole family.

events.name: In the evening, her husband took over tutoring their second son.
events.description: After dinner at 18:00, because Ma Xiulan was feeling unwell, her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped Mingzhe with five error-prone math problems.

events.name: Keep attending computer training to learn Excel spreadsheets
events.description: At 19:00 sharp, arrived at the community activity room, put on reading glasses, and listened carefully to the class, learning to create Excel bookkeeping tables. Although dizzy, she took full notes.

events.name: After class, soak feet and go to bed early.
events.description: I got home at 21:00, soaked my feet in hot water with mugwort and ginger slices for 15 minutes, and drank a cup of hot ginger soup. I went to bed at 21:30 and did not do deep breathing before bed (due to nasal congestion).

start_state.mood: Throat feels uncomfortable; I have a feeling I'm catching a cold.

end_state.mood: Tired, but the learning was rewarding. Hope the cold gets better soon.

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of brisk walking in the courtyard, 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, one set of Baduanjin, 5 minutes of lower back stretching.

2025-11.daily_overview: Thursday, her cold persisted. Ma Xiulan had a runny nose and cough, but was still in decent spirits. In the morning she forced herself to gather straw to protect the persimmon tree from the cold, settled the year's pickled vegetable income of 1,680 yuan with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, transferred most of it into the education fund, and used the rest to supplement household expenses. In the afternoon, during her Excel review, she was interrupted several times by coughing. At dinner, the family celebrated, and her husband took the initiative to do the dishes so she could rest early.

events.name: Light exercise on the balcony in the early morning replaced a walk in the courtyard.
events.description: Because of a cold and feeling chilly, I got up at 5:50, did 5 minutes of heel-raise stretches on the balcony, and still kept up indoor Baduanjin and neck-shoulder stretches, plus 10 minutes of back stretches.

events.name: In the morning, protected the persimmon tree from the cold.
events.description: At 8:30 she carried straw and cloth strips out of the storeroom, cleaned the tree trunk in the yard, wrapped the main trunk and root collar with cloth strips, and piled straw around the base and pressed it down.
