She coughed while working but persisted until it was done, then took a photo and sent it to the family group chat: 'The persimmon tree is wearing its winter coat.'

events.name: At noon, settle the annual accounts for pickled vegetables with childhood friend Liu Chunmei.
events.description: At 11:00, Liu Chunmei rode over to pick up the last batch of pickled vegetables. The two counted the jars in the living room. A total of 56 jars were sold for the year, with total revenue of 1,680 yuan. Liu Chunmei made a WeChat transfer on the spot, and Ma Xiulan recorded the final entry in her ledger.

events.name: In the afternoon, transfer part of the income to the education reserve fund.
events.description: At 12:30, she used mobile banking to transfer 900 yuan from a balance of 1680 yuan to the education savings account. The total reached 3500 yuan, one step closer to the 5000-yuan goal, and she smiled. Then she took 200 yuan from the remaining balance to buy pork ribs and fruit.

events.name: Reviewed Excel during breaks between housework but was affected by coughing.
events.description: At 16:00, while the ribs were simmering, she took out an exercise book to simulate Excel bookkeeping, but frequent coughing forced her to pause several times. She still marked the error-prone points in red.

events.name: In the evening, the whole family celebrated the increase in income.
events.description: At 18:30 she served braised pork ribs. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, said earnestly, 'You've worked hard.' The children cheered. After the meal, her husband volunteered to do the dishes and urged Ma Xiulan to soak her feet and rest.

events.name: Soak feet and take medicine before bed
events.description: At 20:30, she drank cold medicine granules, soaked her feet in hot water with mugwort, and her stuffy nose eased a little. She went to bed early at 21:30.

start_state.mood: Cold worsened, but she continued to handle necessary tasks.

end_state.mood: Satisfied but physically tired, looking forward to recovery.

state.daily_exercise: Balcony calf-raise stretches for 5 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, and lower back stretches for 10 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to light rain, 5-9°C, east wind level 2

2025-11.daily_overview: On Friday, her cold symptoms had eased a little, but she still coughed. In the morning she braved the rain to buy groceries and checked the eldest son's homework progress; seeing that he had finished another section, she felt relieved. In the afternoon her younger sister Ma Xiufen called to ask about the fabric hair flowers, and the sisters chatted happily. In the evening she insisted on going to computer class despite being ill, learning data entry. After class she went home and practiced until she was sleepy, and her husband took over tutoring the second son.

events.name: Early morning indoor exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:55, still felt tired while doing shoulder and neck stretches in the living room, but completed the Baduanjin routine and back and waist stretches; did not go to the courtyard.

events.name: In the morning, went out in the rain to shop and checked the eldest son's homework
events.description: At 8:30, she took an umbrella to the wet market to buy potatoes and eggs. When she got back, she found that Mingxuan had finished another history assignment. She praised him, 'Keep it up,' and promised to make sweet-and-sour pork in the evening as a reward (in the end, because of a cold, her husband did the cooking).

events.name: In the afternoon, video-chatted with her younger sister about fabric hair flowers
events.description: At 15:00, Ma Xiufen made a WeChat video call to ask about the hair flower sales. Ma Xiulan showed her the dozen or so hair flowers on the table. Her sister said she would bring new fabric scraps next time, and the two chatted about family matters for half an hour.

events.name: Husband tutors the second son in her place
events.description: At 18:00, because Ma Xiulan was still coughing, her husband Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to tutor Mingzhe in math problems.

events.name: Attend computer training in the evening to learn data entry.
events.description: At 19:00 she arrived at the activity room. Today she learned quick-fill sequences and data validation. Ma Xiulan was suppressing a cough and got stuck during the operation, but the teacher taught her step by step.

events.name: Go home after class to practice and record any difficulties.
events.description: Arrived home at 21:00. After drinking some hot water, she took out her workbook and did a mock practice. She found that the date field was garbled and noted the problem. She practiced for an hour until her fingers were sore.

start_state.mood: Her cold improved, but she still felt tired.

end_state.mood: Encountered challenges while studying but persisted to completion; the sense of achievement dispelled the pain

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching, one set of Baduanjin, 10 minutes of waist and back stretching.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Saturday, her cold was in its final stage, and Ma Xiulan had recovered much of her energy. In the morning, she worked with her husband to clean the year's pickle jars; her husband's suggestion to expand production next year delighted her. In the afternoon, she adjusted her eldest son's experiment schedule and checked her second son's homework. In the evening, she exchanged pickled vegetables with neighbor Wang Guilan and chatted, and the warmth of neighborhood friendship dispelled the last of her discomfort. At night, she systematically reviewed the computer course and successfully created a mock bookkeeping spreadsheet, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Resuming Morning Brisk Walking in the Courtyard
events.description: Woke up at 6:00, felt light and refreshed. After stretching my neck and shoulders, I walked briskly in the courtyard for 10 minutes. Breathing the cold air felt invigorating, then I practiced Baduanjin and did back and waist stretches.

events.name: In the morning, cleaned the pickle jars with her husband and tidied the courtyard
events.description: After breakfast, wearing gloves, she scrubbed more than a dozen clay jars with her husband. As they washed, Ma Xiulan chatted, and Ma Zhiqiang said, 'We can expand a bit next year.' She smiled and agreed. After washing and drying, they stacked the jars in the corner and covered them with plastic sheeting.

events.name: In the afternoon, adjusted the after-school experiment time with the eldest son.
events.description: At 14:00, checked Mingxuan's homework catch-up progress; one item remained. Took out the schedule and discussed doing focused experiments for 2 hours on the weekend and 30 minutes on weekdays. Mingxuan agreed, and the new schedule was posted on the refrigerator. Then helped the second son redo the wrong problems and copied five similar problems for him.

events.name: Exchanging pickled vegetables and chatting with neighbor Wang Guilan in the evening
events.description: At 17:00, Wang Guilan brought over newly pickled crispy radishes, and Ma Xiulan gave her a small jar of pickled vegetables in return. The two talked about children’s education at the door; Wang Guilan comforted her that children all have ups and downs, and Ma Xiulan nodded repeatedly.

events.name: In the evening, systematically reviewed the computer course and created a simulated bookkeeping sheet.
events.description: 19:00: Reviewed this week's Excel material as a whole, then independently drew a draft of a bookkeeping table in my workbook containing 5 rows of data and a complete header. I practiced repeatedly until it went smoothly and smiled with satisfaction.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and reviewing cold recovery
events.description: 21:00 Soaked feet in hot water, and with relief that the cold had finally passed, decided to wear more clothes when the weather turns cold.

start_state.mood: Recovered from a cold, feeling refreshed and clear-headed.

end_state.mood: Fell asleep with a sense of accomplishment and the warmth of the neighborhood.

state.daily_exercise: Fast walking in the courtyard for 10 minutes, neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, and lower back stretches for 20 minutes.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan put on a newly made top with braided buttons and took her three children on her own to the wedding of her nephew from her natal family. At the wedding banquet, she met many relatives, had a great time chatting with her female cousins, and proactively helped serve dishes, earning praise from the elders. After returning home in the afternoon, she recorded the gift-money ledger; in the evening, she reviewed the third week of the computer course, and the notebook had grown a bit thicker. The happy day completely dispelled the lingering gloom of her cold.

events.name: Morning ritual exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:50, practiced Baduanjin in the living room; because she needed to get ready to go out, the other stretching was simplified to 3 minutes each.

events.name: Tidy up clothes and prepare a red envelope for the wedding
events.description: At 6:30, put on the blue-green top with frog buttons, helped the children change into clean clothes, took 600 yuan in cash from the piggy bank and put it into red envelopes, and reminded the children to be polite at the wedding.

events.name: Attending a wedding alone with three children
events.description: Took a taxi to the restaurant on Shengli Street at 8:30; her husband could not take leave because he was out driving. Arrived at 10:00, took the children to hand out red envelopes at the door and greet relatives.

events.name: Attending the wedding ceremony and reuniting with cousins
events.description: During the ceremony, she clapped in blessing and her eyes grew slightly moist. After the banquet began, she sat with her female cousins. The elder cousin praised the exquisite button knots, and the younger cousin shared parenting tips. Ma Xiulan opened up and talked about pickled vegetables and embroidery, and her cousins placed orders one after another.

events.name: Took the initiative to help set the table and serve dishes, earning praise from the elders.
events.description: After a few rounds of drinks, seeing the servers too busy to cope, she stood up to help pass dishes and arrange plates. Several elders praised her, saying 'Still as diligent and considerate as ever.' Ma Xiulan felt sweet at heart.

events.name: Returning home after the wedding and recording the gift money ledger
events.description: At 15:00 the event ended. She said goodbye to relatives and created a WeChat group called "Jinghai Sisters". She took a taxi home, settled the children, and jotted down in her notebook: "Gift money 600 yuan, return gift one box of wedding candy."

events.name: In the evening, she summarized the content of the third week's computer course.
events.description: At 19:00, she took out her class notes, went through the full Excel process, and practiced by simulating today's expenses. She found that sorting would be disrupted after merging cells and wrote down the problem. When she closed the notebook, it was already 21:30.

events.name: Soak feet before bed to relieve fatigue
events.description: At 21:30, soaked her feet in hot water, recalled the warmth of the wedding, and smiled.

start_state.mood: Excited and full of anticipation for the wedding

end_state.mood: Tired but happy, immersed in family affection

state.daily_exercise: One set of Baduanjin, 3 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching, 3 minutes of back stretching; helped serve dishes at a wedding, so walked around quite a bit

2025-11.daily_overview: On Monday, Ma Xiulan received an invitation from the community handicraft salon to display embroidery and cloth hair flowers next month. She gladly agreed and then spent the whole afternoon carefully selecting display materials. In the evening, she had her daughter act as the audience while she practiced her presentation over and over, her earnestness as if she had returned to her student days. In between, she found time to tutor her second son and completed her regular exercise.

events.name: Morning school drop-off and exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:45, took her daughter to school, brisk-walked in the courtyard for 10 minutes, then went home and did the full set of Baduanjin and stretching.

events.name: In the morning, answered the community invitation call and confirmed the details.
events.description: At 10:00, Xiao Liu from the neighborhood committee called to invite her to attend the handicraft salon on December 5. Ma Xiulan readily agreed, asked about the time, place, and materials, noted it on the calendar, and could not hide her excitement.

events.name: Search through and organize display materials in the afternoon
events.description: At 13:00, she took the handicraft materials box out of the cabinet, selected embroidery pieces, fabric scraps, beads, and so on, sorted them by process into transparent boxes, and backed several satisfactory embroidered pieces with cardboard.

events.name: Tutoring the second son in math
events.description: At 16:00, while the children were out of school, she tutored Ma Mingzhe at the dining table on five commonly missed problems, patiently explaining the area calculation they had just learned.

events.name: In the evening, she rehearsed the explanation with her daughter as the audience.
events.description: At 19:00, in the living room, she set up a small table and laid out the materials. She had Ma Yuxin sit on a small stool as the audience, and Ma Xiulan did a practice demonstration of folding fabric flowers, explaining as she went. Her daughter said, 'Mom, you explain so clearly.' She practiced twice more and wrote down the steps where she got stuck on a piece of paper.

events.name: Family walk (led by husband)
events.description: At 20:00, because Ma Xiulan was busy with rehearsal, her husband took the three children for a 20-minute walk along Jingwen Road.

events.name: Evening stretching and foot soaking before bed
events.description: 21:00 back and waist stretching and foot soaking; thought about what else could be prepared for the salon.

start_state.mood: Calm, occupied by household chores

end_state.mood: Nervous but expectant, full of motivation

state.daily_exercise: 30 minutes walking the child to school, 10 minutes of brisk walking in the courtyard, one set of Baduanjin, 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, 20 minutes of lower back stretching

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to a cold wave with strong winds; the temperature suddenly dropped to -2–3°C, north wind force 5.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Tuesday, an unexpected cold wave hit, but Ma Xiulan felt especially warm inside. In the morning, she took part in the community's “Most Beautiful Family” selection and won a nomination award, holding the certificate with great excitement. In the afternoon, she hurriedly set up a warm shelter for the fuchsia on the balcony to protect it from freezing. In the evening, her husband brought home roast duck to celebrate his perfect attendance award. The family of five sat together to celebrate, shared their good news, and the family atmosphere reached its peak. In the cold wind, she temporarily set aside her stall because she was busy, but her son understood.

events.name: Light activity on the balcony instead of courtyard exercise.
events.description: Got up at 5:50 a.m. Because of the strong wind and severe cold, I only did 5 minutes of heel raises and stretches on the balcony, then did Baduanjin and stretching indoors.

events.name: In the morning, attended the community's Most Beautiful Family selection meeting and received a nomination award
events.description: At 8:30, she walked into the community meeting room against the wind. Asked to share her experience in helping the elderly, she sincerely talked about visiting Grandma Zhao regularly and other things. The selection panel announced the nomination award and presented her with a certificate. Ma Xiulan held the certificate in her hands, trembling slightly.

events.name: In the afternoon, set up a cold-protection greenhouse for the balcony flowers.
events.description: At 14:00, set up thin bamboo strips around the fuchsia flowerpot, covered it with an old quilt and plastic sheeting, tied it tightly and left an air vent, and marked on the desk calendar to water it once every 10 days.

events.name: In the evening, the husband won the perfect attendance award and brought home roast duck
events.description: At 17:00, her husband Ma Zhiqiang called to say he had received a 300-yuan perfect attendance bonus and bought a roast duck to celebrate. Ma Xiulan was even more delighted, so she quickly steamed rice and stir-fried cabbage with vinegar. At 18:30, her husband came in carrying the roast duck, and the children cheered.

events.name: Family celebration dinner; husband promises to smoke less and share more responsibilities
events.description: At the dinner table, Ma Zhiqiang raised his glass to thank his wife and promised to smoke less and help more with housework. Ma Xiulan's eyes grew slightly moist as she shared that she had received a nomination award; her husband gave her a thumbs-up and the children clapped. The roast duck was completely finished.

events.name: Her husband handled tutoring the second son.
events.description: At 19:30, Ma Xiulan was busy tidying up, while her husband took the initiative to tutor Mingzhe in math.

events.name: Soak your feet before bed and review the happy day.
events.description: At 21:00, soaked her feet in hot water. Recalling today's double happy events, she felt that no matter how tired she was, it was worth it.

start_state.mood: Daily calm, did not expect today's surprise.

end_state.mood: Overflowing with happiness, family honor and warmth interwoven.

state.daily_exercise: Balcony calf-raise stretches for 5 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, and lower back stretches for 10 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Clear and cold, temperature -4~2°C, north wind force 4.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Wednesday, the cold spell continued. Ma Xiulan wore a thick cotton-padded jacket, stocked up on winter vegetables, and made fabric hair flowers. When she saw her eldest son's history homework praised by the teacher, she broke into a smile she hadn't shown in a long time. In the afternoon, after tutoring her second son, she prepared dinner. In the evening, she braved the cold wind to attend computer training and learned comprehensive applications of Word and Excel. Although it was difficult, she gritted her teeth and kept going. When she got home, her hands were so cold that she kept rubbing them together, and her husband had already helped tutor her second son and prepared hot water.

events.name: Balcony activities and Baduanjin.
events.description: Woke up at 5:45, stretched on tiptoes on the balcony for 5 minutes, practiced Baduanjin and stretched indoors; didn't go out because it was too cold.

events.name: In the morning, stock up on winter vegetables and make handmade hair flowers.
events.description: At 8:30, she went to the vegetable market and bought back a large bundle of Chinese cabbage and radishes, covering them with a quilt. Then she sat on the sofa making fabric hair flowers and made 5 new styles in the morning, sending photos to her younger sister.

events.name: In the afternoon, checked eldest son's homework and received positive feedback from the teacher
events.description: At 16:00, after Mingxuan came home from school, he proactively showed the screenshot of the history teacher's reply 'Great progress, keep it up.' Ma Xiulan looked at it several times and made an exception to allow him to watch 15 more minutes of the science program.

events.name: Tutoring the second son in math
events.description: At 17:00, she tutored Mingzhe at the dining table on five commonly missed problems. His accuracy improved today, so she praised him a few times.

events.name: Attend computer training in the evening to learn complex applications
events.description: At 18:50, she wrapped her down jacket tightly and went out. In class, she learned the mail merge function that links Word labels with Excel. Ma Xiulan was flustered, but the teacher patiently guided her, and she completed a sales receipt template for pickled vegetables.

events.name: Walked home against the wind after class and briefly reviewed lessons
events.description: Arrived home at 21:10, face red from the cold; her husband handed her hot water. She had wanted to practice but was too tired, saved the files from the USB drive to the computer, wrote "remember to match the target format" in her notes, and went to bed early.

start_state.mood: Cold weather made her a bit lazy, but she kept doing things.

end_state.mood: Tired but insisted on finishing the lesson; felt a little gratified by the child's progress.

state.daily_exercise: Balcony calf-raise stretches for 5 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, and lower back stretches for 10 minutes

2025-11.daily_overview: On Thursday, Ma Xiulan reviewed Word and Excel on the home computer in the morning and successfully printed price tags. In the afternoon, she invited her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin over to exchange new patterns. The two had tea and snacks, chatting about crafts and life. Zhou Xiuqin left in the evening. At night, she continued to enrich her computer notes and, looking at half a notebook of notes, marveled at her progress. After tutoring her second son in math, she relaxed by soaking her feet before bed.

events.name: Morning routine exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:50, did heel raises on the balcony for 5 minutes, practiced indoor Baduanjin and stretching. Seeing it was sunny, went to the courtyard for a 5-minute brisk walk to feel the air.

events.name: In the morning, reviewed Word and Excel on the home computer.
events.description: At 8:00, she turned on the old desktop computer and repeated the label-making process learned the day before. She created a new Word document, inserted a table, copied data from Excel, adjusted the formatting, and successfully printed out labels reading 'Xiulan's Handmade Pickled Vegetables' and pasted them into her journal.

events.name: In the afternoon, I invited Zhou Xiuqin over to exchange craft patterns.
events.description: At 13:00 sent a WeChat message inviting Zhou Xiuqin. At 14:00 she brought an embroidery pattern book and a new embroidered tablecloth. The two put their heads together to discuss stitching techniques, and Zhou Xiuqin suggested the salon display emphasize live demonstrations.

events.name: Evening tea and chat with Zhou Xiuqin, sharing life updates.
events.description: At 16:00 she brewed jasmine tea and brought out the Chinese yam cakes steamed that morning. When they talked about their children, Zhou Xiuqin said her son was busy with work, and Ma Xiulan comforted her. They agreed to go to the Jizhou market together in the spring. At 17:00 she walked Zhou Xiuqin to the end of the alley.

events.name: Tutoring the second son in math
events.description: At 17:30, tutored Mingzhe on five problems and encouraged him to keep up the good work.

events.name: In the evening, organized computer notes and reviewed progress.
events.description: At 19:00, arranged all the scattered notes in course order, used transparent tape to stick down the parts that were coming loose, and found that half of the notebook was already full. Wrote on the title page: 'Keep going! The course ends on December 4.'

events.name: Family evening walk (changed to indoor activities due to cold weather)
events.description: 20:00 It's too cold outside, so the whole family did stretching exercises in the living room instead of going for a walk.

events.name: Soak feet and practice deep breathing before bed.
events.description: At 21:00, soaked her feet in hot water, sat quietly, and took deep breaths for 5 minutes.

start_state.mood: Calm, planning to use Thursday for organizing and studying.

end_state.mood: Relaxed after gathering with friends, and felt motivated by reviewing her studies.

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of brisk walking in the courtyard, 5 minutes of heel raises on the balcony, one set of Baduanjin, 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, 20 minutes of lower back stretching, and indoor stretching exercises

2025-11.daily_overview: On Friday, Ma Xiulan was thrown into a fluster by the social security subsidy eligibility confirmation. In the morning, after receiving a call from Zheng Xiuying, she rummaged through boxes and cabinets for income records but found them incomplete, and broke out in a sweat. She contacted Zheng Xiuying for help and asked Liu Chunmei to make up the pickle sales accounts, finally getting things sorted out. In the evening, she pulled herself together to attend the computer class. After class, she went home to organize the materials and secretly vowed to keep clear records from then on.

events.name: Morning balcony activities and Baduanjin
events.description: Woke up at 5:40. Because it was cold and overcast, I only stretched on the balcony for 5 minutes, then completed Baduanjin and stretching indoors.

events.name: In the morning, received a call from Zheng Xiuying and learned the confirmation deadline for the social security subsidy.
events.description: At 9:30, while mopping the floor, she received a phone call. Zheng Xiuying reminded her that she needed to complete the annual qualification confirmation for the flexible employment subsidy before the beginning of next month and needed to bring income proof. Ma Xiulan scratched her head and said, "Will those scattered notes do?" Zheng Xiuying urged her to bring all the relevant materials she could.

events.name: Rummaged through the income records for pickled vegetables and embroidery and found them incomplete.
events.description: At 10:00, she hurriedly opened the drawer and rummaged for receipts, only to find that the sales records for the last three months were messy, with only the first few embroidery transactions recorded. She was so anxious that she paced in circles in the living room.

events.name: Calling Zheng Xiuying for help and getting advice.
events.description: At 10:30 she called Zheng Xiuying to explain the situation. The other party reassured her, 'Don't worry, first contact the buyer to get a supplementary certificate; if that really doesn't work, the community can issue a flexible-employment certificate.' Ma Xiulan breathed a slight sigh of relief and noted down the key points.

events.name: Contacted her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to fill in the missing pickle sales records.
events.description: At 12:00, she sent Liu Chunmei a WeChat message. The two compared their memories and pieced together the sales records of 23 jars over the past three months. Ma Xiulan thanked her repeatedly and added them to her notebook.

events.name: Husband tutors the second son in her place
events.description: At 18:00, because Ma Xiulan was busy sorting materials, her husband tutored Mingzhe in math.

events.name: Attend computer training in the evening to learn the integration of Word and Excel
events.description: At 19:00 she arrived at the activity room. The course covered data merging and layout optimization. Ma Xiulan forced herself to concentrate, followed along, and made a template for pickled vegetable sales receipts.

events.name: After class, went home to organize materials and prepare for tomorrow's procedures.
events.description: Arrived home at 21:30, put the notebook with supplementary entries, receipts, and certificates into a document folder, and left a sticky note on the table saying 'Go to the service station at 8:30 tomorrow morning.' After washing up, I reflected that I must keep accounts in a standardized way from now on.

start_state.mood: Daily life is calm; preparing to tidy up the house

end_state.mood: After being anxious, felt somewhat relieved and resolved to improve bookkeeping.

state.daily_exercise: Balcony calf-raise stretches for 5 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, and lower back stretches for 10 minutes

2025-11.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ma Xiulan went to the community service station early in the morning to complete the social security subsidy eligibility confirmation. With Zheng Xiuying's help, she got it done smoothly and felt relieved. After returning home, she locked up the documents and reflected that she should develop the good habit of keeping accounts. In the afternoon, she mobilized the whole family for a big cleaning, practiced on the computer, and independently created an accounting spreadsheet. In the evening, after tutoring her second son, the whole family watched TV together. The weekend was calm and fulfilling.

events.name: Morning balcony activities and Baduanjin
events.description: Woke up at 5:50, did calf raises on the balcony for 5 minutes, then did Baduanjin and stretching indoors.

events.name: In the morning, went to the community service station to confirm eligibility for the social security subsidy.
events.description: At 8:30 she walked to the service station. Zheng Xiuying checked the materials. Although they were scattered, the total matched the application, so she stamped it as approved and the subsidy was issued as usual. Ma Xiulan let out a long sigh of relief and thanked her repeatedly.

events.name: After returning home, lock up the materials and do bookkeeping reflection.
events.description: At 10:00 I went home, put the receipt and materials into a manila envelope, and locked it in a drawer. I sat in a chair to reflect, took out a new notebook, marked out the month columns, and wrote '2026 Flexible Employment Income Details'. I resolved to organize it in the middle of each month.

events.name: In the afternoon, the whole family did a thorough cleaning and washed winter clothes.
events.description: At 13:00 mobilized the whole family to wash the bed sheets and duvet covers, clean the windows, and tidy up the toys. Wiped down the down jackets and hung them on the balcony to dry. Rewarded everyone with a piece of milk candy.

events.name: In the afternoon, practice computer operation and independently create a bookkeeping spreadsheet.
events.description: At 15:00, she turned on the computer, built a monthly income and expenditure table from scratch in Excel, set up the headers, entered the data, and used SUM to add it up. It worked. Then she used Word to design labels. Looking at the results, she felt that the training course had been worth it.

events.name: Tutoring the second son in math
events.description: At 17:00, tutored Mingzhe on five commonly missed problems. He got them all right today, so I praised him.

events.name: In the evening, the whole family watched TV and chatted together
events.description: After the 19:00 dinner of noodles with gravy, the family watched local news. Ma Mingzhe wanted to watch cartoons, so Ma Xiulan compromised by watching half an hour of news first. The family talked about Ma Zhiqiang inspecting the roof tiles tomorrow.

events.name: Evening family walk (weather was relatively warm)
events.description: At 20:00, the temperature rose to 2°C, and the whole family walked along Jingwen Road for 20 minutes.

events.name: Evening stretching and foot soaking before bed
events.description: After waist and back stretching at 21:00, I soaked my feet in hot water, reflected on the day, and felt satisfied.

start_state.mood: A little nervous, worried the procedure might not go smoothly.

end_state.mood: Relief after setting down burdens, warmth in everyday family matters.

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of toe raises on the balcony, one set of Baduanjin, 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, 20 minutes of waist and back stretches, and a 20-minute family walk.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, temperature 0–7°C, south wind level 2.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Sunday, the last day of November, Ma Xiulan ended the month with a fulfilling review and planning session. In the morning she practiced Baduanjin and took care of chores; in the afternoon she systematically reviewed her computer course and organized her notes; in the evening she went over the monthly income and expenses with her husband and deposited 1,000 yuan into the education fund. With only 500 yuan short of the 5,000-yuan goal, the two agreed to make a final push to cut spending next month. At night she checked the children's teeth and helped her second son practice. Before bed, after soaking her feet, she sat quietly and took deep breaths, welcoming December with hope.

events.name: Morning balcony light exercise and Baduanjin
events.description: Got up at 5:45, did calf-raise stretches on the balcony for 5 minutes (it was cold), then did a full set of Baduanjin indoors, plus 10 minutes each of shoulder and neck stretches (including the "mi" character exercise) and lower back stretches.

events.name: Morning: dealing with weekend chores and tutoring the second son's review
events.description: 8:00 Sort and wash laundry, wipe the kitchen tiles, and think about making mushrooms and bok choy for lunch. 10:00 Tutor Mingzhe with extra practice problems, check and explain the wrong answers.

events.name: Systematically reviewing the computer course and organizing notes in the afternoon
events.description: At 13:00, classify all notes by Word and Excel, highlight key points in different colors, and fill in missing steps. Turn on the computer and operate comprehensively; everything from generating the accounting sheet to print preview succeeds.

events.name: In the evening, reviewed November family income and expenses with her husband
events.description: At 17:00, I took out the family ledger and calculator and read off each item: income 7,000 yuan, expenses 5,650 yuan, balance 1,350 yuan. Both of us thought the heating and training costs were worth it, and we could still save on daily expenses.

events.name: Deposit into education fund and plan next month's budget
events.description: After the accounting, Ma Xiulan took out 1,000 yuan and put it into the education savings envelope, then wrote down 'November cumulative: 4,500 yuan' in the account book. Ma Zhiqiang suggested bringing lunch in December to reduce eating out, saving about 300 yuan a month. The two wrote down the budget points on the last page of the account book.

events.name: In the evening, do the monthly dental check for the whole family
events.description: At 20:00, she used a small flashlight in the bathroom to check the children's teeth, corrected Mingxuan's dental plaque, and praised Mingzhe and Yuxin. Ma Mingzhe joked, 'Mom is stricter than a dentist,' and Ma Xiulan laughed, 'It's for your own good.'

events.name: Whole family: indoor activities to replace a walk
events.description: At 20:30, it was completely dark and cold. The whole family did simple stretching exercises in the living room, and the children joined in.

events.name: Soaking feet and deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: At 21:00, soak feet in hot water with mugwort and ginger slices for 15 minutes, listening to the radio while soaking. At 21:30, sit quietly in the bedroom, breathe deeply from the abdomen, press the Hegu acupoint, and review the month's small moments.

events.name: Read for half an hour before bed.
events.description: 21:00-21:30 family reading, Ma Xiulan reading a lifestyle magazine, the children reading extracurricular books.

start_state.mood: Lazy weekend, but planning to finish the monthly summary.

end_state.mood: Satisfied and full of hope, the goal is within close reach.

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of calf raises and stretching on the balcony, one set of Baduanjin, 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches (mi-character exercise), 20 minutes of lower back stretches, indoor stretching routine

2025-10.daily_overview: National Day was also their 20th wedding anniversary. Ma Xiulan's family spent a memorable day in Beijing: in the early morning, she received an anniversary gift from her husband, then they visited Tiananmen and the Forbidden City, and climbed Jingshan to enjoy the view. Although they got stuck in traffic, the day was still perfect.

events.name: A gift for the 20th wedding anniversary
events.description: At 6 a.m., her husband Ma Zhiqiang gave Ma Xiulan a keychain ground from an old key, engraved with ‘05.10.01’, to commemorate their wedding anniversary. Ma Xiulan was moved to tears. The children were woken up and gathered around to offer their blessings. This keychain became a treasured keepsake.

events.name: Visit to Tiananmen Square
events.description: After breakfast at the elder sister's house, the whole family set out from their place and took the subway to Tiananmen Square. Although they missed the flag-raising ceremony, the festive flower beds and the National Day atmosphere on the square still excited the whole family. They took group photos on the square, then queued up to enter the Palace Museum for a visit.

events.name: Forbidden City tour
events.description: After entering the Forbidden City, they visited the main sights along the central axis, including the Hall of Supreme Harmony and the Palace of Heavenly Purity. Ma Xiulan's husband Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to carry the backpack and hold their daughter Xinxin. The family listened attentively to the tour guide. In front of the Hall of Supreme Harmony, they asked a passerby to take a family photo, and Ma Xiulan deliberately showed the keychain.

events.name: Overlooking Jingshan Park
events.description: In the afternoon, the whole family walked to Jingshan Park, climbed to the Wanchun Pavilion at the top, and looked down at the full view of the Forbidden City. Although her husband was tired, he kept taking care of the children, and the family enjoyed the palace complex in the autumn sunset.

events.name: Evening return trip
events.description: After coming down from Jingshan, because of heavy traffic, they chose to walk for a while and then take the bus back to the sister's home. Although her husband was a little irritated, he didn't lose his temper. Ma Xiulan comforted the children, and the family returned smoothly. In the evening they had dinner at the sister's home and shared what they had seen and heard.

start_state.location: At elder sister Li Xiuyun's home in Beijing
start_state.mood: Moved and joyful

end_state.location: At elder sister Li Xiuyun's home in Beijing
end_state.mood: Tired but satisfied.

state.daily_exercise: A lot of walking at the Forbidden City and Jingshan

2025-10.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan's family spent a relaxed family day at her older sister's home, shopping for groceries, cooking, doing handicrafts, and chatting, enjoying a rare time together.

events.name: Morning shopping and cooking
events.description: Ma Xiulan and her elder sister Li Xiuyun went together to the nearby vegetable market to buy groceries, choosing seasonal vegetables and meat. After returning, they were busy in the kitchen and prepared a table full of hearty home-style dishes. Her husband and brother-in-law chatted in the living room, while the children played in the neighborhood.

events.name: Afternoon crafting and relaxation
events.description: After lunch, everyone watched TV and rested at home. Ma Xiulan took out the embroidery materials she had brought from Tianjin and taught her daughter Yuxin and her elder sister to embroider simple patterns. They did handicrafts together and spent a leisurely afternoon.

events.name: Evening Family Dinner
events.description: Her elder sister had prepared a hearty dinner. The whole family sat around, eating and chatting. Ma Xiulan shared amusing stories about making pickled vegetables, and everyone kept laughing.

start_state.location: At elder sister Li Xiuyun's home in Beijing
start_state.mood: Relaxed and leisurely

end_state.location: At elder sister Li Xiuyun's home in Beijing
end_state.mood: Warm and peaceful

state.daily_exercise: A light stroll

2025-10.daily_overview: On the last day of the National Day trip, Ma Xiulan’s family said goodbye to her sister and took the high-speed rail back to Tianjin. After returning home, they tidied up the house and returned to their daily routine.

events.name: Farewell and seeing off at the station
events.description: In the morning, the whole family packed their luggage. Ma Xiulan carefully wrapped the keychain. Her elder sister Li Xiuyun drove them to Beijing South Railway Station. They bade a reluctant farewell and agreed to meet again next time.

events.name: Return by high-speed rail
events.description: They took the G8919 high-speed train from Beijing South Station and arrived at Tianjin South Station in just 45 minutes. The children excitedly watched the scenery outside the window.

events.name: Arrive home and tidy up
events.description: After arriving home in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan immediately started doing laundry and organizing travel items, while the children did their homework or rested. She also took a short walk in the courtyard, pruned the faded roses, and gradually readjusted to the home environment.

start_state.location: At elder sister Li Xiuyun's home in Beijing
start_state.mood: Slightly reluctant

end_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Moving luggage, tidying up the house, trimming the yard

2025-10.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan began dealing with the household chores that had piled up during the trip, made healthy dried fruit, and discovered that the pickle order was delayed, so she decided to find a solution.

events.name: Morning courtyard walk and neck-shoulder stretches
events.description: After the trip, she resumed morning exercise for the first time. She walked slowly for 15 minutes in her own courtyard and did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, enjoying the quiet morning and feeling her body gradually recover its vitality.

events.name: Buy oral care products and fruit.
events.description: Following the advice of Dr. Wang at the community clinic, Ma Xiulan went to the supermarket in Jinghai District. She spent 60 yuan on 3 tubes of children's fluoride toothpaste, and spent 40 yuan on fresh apples and pears to prepare ingredients for making dried fruit.

events.name: Making healthy dried fruit
events.description: After returning home, she washed and sliced the fruit, baked it at low temperature in the oven, and made about 1 kg of homemade dried fruit. She filled glass jars with it and placed them in the living room snack cabinet, replacing candy and sugary drinks. It took about 3 hours.

events.name: Pickled vegetable order check and anxiety
events.description: After traveling for several days, Ma Xiulan discovered while checking autumn pickle orders that, because she had failed to purchase ingredients in time, the pickles originally planned to launch in early October were delayed by about two weeks, and some customer pre-orders might be lost. She felt anxious and decided to find her childhood friend Liu Chunmei the next day to discuss countermeasures.

events.name: Family daily routine
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan urged the children to brush their teeth carefully and showed them the new toothpaste, emphasizing the importance of oral hygiene. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was resting at home and helped repair a loose outlet in the kitchen.

start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.mood: Slightly anxious but already has a plan

state.daily_exercise: Courtyard walk for 15 minutes, neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, housework

2025-10.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan turned the leftover travel money into preserved fruit to share with her neighbors, and worked with her childhood friend to come up with an innovative marketing plan for pickled vegetables, injecting new inspiration into her side business.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin, trying to resume it
events.description: In the morning, she tried a set of Baduanjin in the living room, but because she had taken a few days off, her movements were a bit unfamiliar. She slowed down, her breathing coordination was acceptable, and she resolved to continue tomorrow.

events.name: Buy preserved fruit
events.description: Ma Xiulan used the 200 yuan she had saved from the trip to buy several boxes of Beijing preserved fruit at a nearby specialty supermarket, planning to give them to neighbors to share the joy of the trip.

events.name: Gift to neighbors.
events.description: She went to the home of Wang Guilan across the hall and the home of Zhang Shufen diagonally opposite, delivered the preserved fruit, and shared stories from her Beijing trip with them, thanking them for their usual help. The neighborly warmth deepened through the conversation.

events.name: Discuss strategies with Liu Chunmei.
events.description: Afterwards, Ma Xiulan went to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei's home. The two discussed the losses from the delayed pickled vegetable orders. Ma Xiulan proposed making a limited-edition 'Beijing Travel Souvenir Pack' of small jars of pickled vegetables, with handwritten travel cards, limited to 30 jars. Liu Chunmei agreed and suggested promoting it through Moments and community groups. The two finalized the plan and decided to start preparing the next day. They also had a simple lunch together, and Ma Xiulan brought some homemade dried fruit for Chunmei to taste.

start_state.mood: Positive expectation

end_state.mood: Clear direction for solving the problem

state.daily_exercise: Did one set of Baduanjin and walked to visit neighbors and childhood friends.

2025-10.daily_overview: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, Ma Xiulan carefully prepared a reunion dinner. The family enjoyed the moon and gathered together, sharing family happiness, and also made preparations for the pickled vegetable commemorative pack.

events.name: Purchase ingredients for making pickled vegetables.
events.description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan went to the local grocery store and vegetable market to buy seasonal vegetables, seasonings, and small glass jars, red-patterned label paper, and packing twine specially for commemorative packaging, preparing for the next day's pickling.

events.name: Buying groceries and preparing the reunion dinner
events.description: Afterwards, she went to Xingwang Vegetable Market and at the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang bought pork tenderloin, choy sum, carrots, and also replenished seasonings and fruit, preparing ingredients for the evening's Mid-Autumn reunion dinner.

events.name: Cooking festive reunion dishes
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan was busy in the kitchen, carefully cooking a low-salt version of sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin and garlic stir-fried seasonal vegetables. At the same time, she arranged the preserved fruit and mooncakes brought back from Beijing on plates, preparing a sumptuous dinner.

events.name: Family reunion
events.description: In the evening, her parents Ma Jianguo and Li Xiuying, and her younger sister Ma Xiufen's family arrived one after another. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang also came home from work on time. The whole family sat around the round dining table, enjoying the dishes Ma Xiulan had cooked herself. The meal was filled with laughter and a warm, harmonious atmosphere.

events.name: Admiring the moon in the courtyard.
events.description: After dinner, the family moved to the courtyard to enjoy the moon. Ma Xiulan sat on stone stools with her parents and younger sister chatting, while the children played with lanterns and her husband joined the children in setting off small sparklers. Under the bright moon of late autumn, the whole family was immersed in a warm, reunion-filled atmosphere until late at night. Excited from moon viewing, the whole family went to bed late.

start_state.mood: Busy and expectant

end_state.mood: Happy and content

state.daily_exercise: Shopping and cooking, with a relatively high level of activity.

2025-10.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan put her travel inspiration into practice. With her family's help, she completed 30 jars of commemorative pickled vegetables, and her side-business idea was officially launched.

events.name: Simplified morning exercise
events.description: Because she needed to rush the pickled vegetables, she shortened her morning exercise, doing only 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches and 10 minutes of brisk walking in the yard. She did not do Baduanjin, but she made up for it with lower back stretches in the evening.

events.name: Making commemorative-edition pickled vegetables.
events.description: Following a traditional recipe, Ma Xiulan began making 30 jars of limited-edition pickled vegetables in the kitchen. She washed and cut cucumbers, green beans, and other vegetables, prepared the secret sauce, let them marinate, and then packed them into small glass jars. Her daughter Yuxin helped pass the jars, and her eldest son Mingxuan wiped the jars after finishing his homework. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was resting at home, helped carry the purchased vegetables and jars, and took the children out for a short walk so Xiulan could focus on making the pickles. By evening, all 30 jars were finished and sealed.

events.name: Evening family relaxation.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan placed the pickled vegetables on the kitchen shelf to rest, and then the whole family watched TV in the living room for a while, enjoying the relaxation after work. Before going to bed, she seriously did 10 minutes of back and waist stretches to relieve the fatigue from standing for a long time.

start_state.mood: Full of drive

end_state.mood: A great sense of accomplishment

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, brisk walking in the courtyard for 10 minutes, and long periods of standing while making pickled vegetables

2025-10.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan extended the joy of the trip by sharing videos with her younger sister, and carefully attached handwritten cards to the commemorative jars of pickled vegetables, putting her feelings into the product.

events.name: Resume full morning exercise routine.
events.description: Today resumed normal morning exercise: in the early morning, walked in the courtyard for 20 minutes and watered flowers, then did a set of Baduanjin and 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, feeling comfortable in the body.

events.name: Write travel cards
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan reviewed her travel experiences and personally wrote short travel notes and blessings on 30 small cards, such as "The taste of autumn brought back from Beijing." In the afternoon, she tied the cards around the jar mouths and attached labels reading "Beijing Travel Commemorative Edition," completing the pickled vegetable packaging.

events.name: Preparing to organize travel photos.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan selected photos taken during the Beijing trip from her phone at home, organized them into groups in the order of the tour, and practiced telling the stories behind the photos, preparing for the video call with her younger sister Ma Xiufen in the evening.

events.name: Sharing with her younger sister via video
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan had a video call via WeChat with her younger sister Ma Xiufen, who lives in the Binhai New Area. She showed the travel photos one by one, describing the grandeur of Tiananmen Square and the exquisite beauty of the Long Corridor at the Summer Palace. Her sister was full of envy. The two agreed to travel together with both families next summer vacation. They also talked about the work at the sister's clothing store, and Ma Xiulan reminded her to take care of her health. The call lasted nearly an hour.

events.name: Record the outing plan
events.description: After the phone call with her younger sister, Ma Xiulan took out a small notebook and briefly wrote down her idea for a trip during next summer vacation, including the destination and time, planning to discuss it with her husband Ma Zhiqiang later.

start_state.mood: Peaceful and tranquil

end_state.mood: Warm and full of anticipation

state.daily_exercise: 20-minute courtyard walk, one round of Baduanjin, 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch, light housework

2025-10.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan began preparing for the Double Ninth Festival event to respect the elderly. She used her own money to buy ingredients to make low-salt pickles and organized visiting supplies as gifts. Her sense of community responsibility was growing day by day.

events.name: Signing up for senior care volunteer service
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan went to the community service center to sign up for the Double Ninth Festival elderly-care volunteer activity on October 11. She confirmed the service details and the information about the households to visit, and learned that she would be visiting two elderly people living alone.

events.name: Prepared pickled vegetables for the visit and organized the supplies.
events.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan tied on an apron, harvested cucumbers, radishes, and chili peppers from her small vegetable garden, and carefully made 10 jars of pickled vegetables according to a low-salt recipe (with the amount of salt reduced by one-third), which took about two hours. When finished, she tied a red string and a small card to each jar, writing 'Double Ninth Festival blessings · respectfully presented by Ma Xiulan.' At the same time, she sorted out cleaning supplies such as rags and garbage bags for her visits and put them in a cloth bag for later use.

events.name: Short afternoon nap
events.description: At noon she took a 45-minute nap and felt refreshed after waking up.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, the whole family took a 30-minute walk along Jingwen Road, chatting about what happened during the day while the children excitedly talked about school.

start_state.mood: Warm-hearted and proactive

end_state.mood: Content and at peace.

state.daily_exercise: Walking to and from the community center, harvesting vegetables in the yard, and taking a 30-minute family walk

2025-10.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan's small business idea got off to a successful start, with the pickled vegetables selling out instantly. Meanwhile, she methodically prepared for the Double Ninth Festival respect-the-elderly service, full of energy.

events.name: Commemorative pack of pickled vegetables went on sale and was snapped up in seconds.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan posted the launch of the 'Beijing Travel Commemorative Edition' pickled vegetables on WeChat Moments, with beautiful images and a description of a limited run of 30 jars. Liu Chunmei helped forward it in the community group, and in less than two hours orders poured in and all 30 jars sold out. After two days of settling and quality inspection, the quality of the pickled vegetables remained stable, and Ma Xiulan officially listed them in the morning. When she calculated the profit, she found it was 30 percent higher than regular pickled vegetables, which not only made up for the loss from the earlier delay but also brought in extra income.

events.name: Printed travel photos.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan took a USB drive containing 60 selected travel photos to a digital printing shop near Jingwen Road, ordered 6-inch prints, paid the fee, and waited to pick up the photos, preparing to make a family album.

events.name: Confirm visit details.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan went to the community service center to meet the grid worker Zheng Xiuying for a final confirmation before the Double Ninth Festival visit. The two checked the addresses, health conditions, and needs of two elderly people living alone. Zheng Xiuying handed her the visit checklist and reminded her of things to keep in mind.

events.name: Inviting a neighbor to come along
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan knocked on her neighbor Wang Guilan's door and officially invited her to visit the elderly together for the Double Ninth Festival. The two agreed on a division of labor: Wang Guilan would be in charge of cleaning, and Ma Xiulan would take blood pressure and deliver pickled vegetables. Wang Guilan gladly agreed, and they arranged to meet the next morning.

events.name: Evening waist and back stretching.
events.description: Before going to sleep at night, she did her usual 10 minutes of cat stretch and wall-supported waist twists to prevent lower back strain.

start_state.mood: Excited and expectant

end_state.mood: Substantial and powerful.

state.daily_exercise: Went out and was on my feet a lot; stretched neck and shoulders for 5 minutes and lower back for 10 minutes.

2025-10.daily_overview: On the Double Ninth Festival, Ma Xiulan passed on warmth to the community through her actions: she visited elderly people living alone, took care of her father, accumulated volunteer points, and felt fulfilled.

events.name: Export family photos
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan turned on her phone and old computer and exported all family photos from this year and previous years (children's growth, gatherings, etc.) to a portable hard drive in preparation for making an annual photo album.

events.name: Double Ninth Festival visit to the elderly
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan and Wang Guilan brought their homemade low-salt pickled vegetables to visit two elderly people living alone in the community (86-year-old Grandma Zhao and an old man, Grandpa Li). They cleaned the old people's homes, measured their blood pressure, and chatted with them. Grandma Zhao was so touched that she took Ma Xiulan's hand and said, 'She's dearer to me than my own daughter.' Both women felt deeply warmed.

events.name: Taking care of her father.
events.description: After the visit, Ma Xiulan hurried back to her father Ma Jianguo's home and used the midday time to make soft, easy-to-digest meals for him, taking care of the elderly man's dietary health.

events.name: Points registration
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan went to the community service center and completed the points registration for the Double Ninth Festival elderly care service. The staff recorded her service hours, and at the end of the year she can exchange points for items.

events.name: Short afternoon rest in the courtyard
events.description: After returning home, she sat in the courtyard for a while, drank a cup of tea, and enjoyed a moment of quiet.

start_state.mood: Enthusiastic service

end_state.mood: Gratified and moved

state.daily_exercise: Visiting elderly residents, walking outside, and doing housework

2025-10.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan spent the time sorting through memories and making home improvements. The community's recognition made her more determined to give back, so she began creating a family reading corner.

events.name: Organized printed photos
events.description: Ma Xiulan took out old photo albums from past years from the cabinet, removed the printed photos from the albums, spread them flat on the living room table, dusted them, and did a preliminary sorting to organize materials for making an annual photo album.

events.name: Saw the commendation on the bulletin board
events.description: When passing the community bulletin board in the morning, Ma Xiulan saw the posted Double Ninth Festival event photos and thank-you list, and her name was among them. She felt happy and proud.

events.name: Talked with Zheng Xiuying.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan met her part-time job referral contact Zheng Xiuying in the community. Sister Zheng told her that service points could be redeemed for rice, flour, cooking oil and other staples at the end of the year, and also mentioned that the elderly they served had jointly written a thank-you letter. Ma Xiulan suddenly felt more motivated to continue volunteering.

events.name: Set up the reading corner (clear the bookshelf)
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan and her three children emptied the old bookshelf in the corner of the living room and wiped it clean together. The eldest son Mingxuan carried the books, the second son Mingzhe and daughter Yuxin wiped the shelves with damp cloths, and Ma Xiulan cleaned the dust from the top. The whole family worked together happily, making space to set up a reading corner.

events.name: Indoor stretching on a rainy day
events.description: Because it was raining and she could not go for a walk, she did 10 minutes of waist and back stretches and one set of Baduanjin in the living room instead of the evening walk.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and pleasant

end_state.mood: Positive and motivated.

state.daily_exercise: Tidying and moving things around to get the body moving, one set of Baduanjin, 10 minutes of lower back stretching

2025-10.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan continued to work on the annual photo album and setting up the family reading corner, but carrying pickle jars and sitting for long periods caused mild soreness in her lower back, which eased after she stretched in time.

events.name: Photos categorized by season
events.description: Ma Xiulan divided all the collected photos (digital prints and paper photos) into four piles by spring, summer, autumn, and winter. She clipped each pile with a clip, labeled it, and removed the blurry and duplicate photos.

events.name: Arranging the bookshelf and decorations
events.description: Afterwards, she arranged the 20 books she had bought from second-hand bookstores on the cleared bookshelf by genre, and decorated the top shelf with souvenirs from the Beijing trip (Forbidden City bookmarks, Summer Palace postcards, etc.). Her eldest son, Mingxuan, took the initiative to help sort and arrange the books, while her second son and daughter passed them over from the side. The whole family joined in, making the bookshelf full of life.

events.name: Record the growth of the potted plant.
events.description: Ma Xiulan took out her phone, took a photo of the fuchsia potted plant in the courtyard to record its autumn growth changes, saved the photo to her phone album, and continued her habit of recording it every month.

events.name: Lower back discomfort and stretching
events.description: In the afternoon, after sitting for a long time while organizing photo albums and then moving several jars of low-salt pickled vegetables prepared for processing, Ma Xiulan felt slight soreness and swelling in her right lower back. She stopped her work and immediately did 10 minutes of cat stretch and wall-assisted waist twists, and applied a hot water bottle for heat therapy; the symptoms eased. In the evening, she continued with 10 minutes of lower back and back stretches.

start_state.mood: Be fully focused

end_state.mood: Slightly uncomfortable but handled it in time.

state.daily_exercise: Light housework, 20 minutes of waist and back stretching (including morning and evening).

2025-10.daily_overview: While gaining the community's gratitude, Ma Xiulan improved the details of the family reading corner and drew up a set of rules, and also arranged a warm get-together with her childhood friend. The soreness in her lower back has markedly eased.

events.name: Selected photos
events.description: From the sorted photos, Ma Xiulan carefully selected about 100 of the most memorable photos, put them in a dedicated storage box, and marked them, establishing the scope for making the photo album.

events.name: Received a thank-you letter
events.description: Community staff gave Ma Xiulan a copy of the elderly residents' joint thank-you letter, in which they thanked her for her pickled vegetables and blood pressure measurement service. Deeply moved, she treasured the letter.

events.name: Set up the photo wall and family rules
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan and the children put up Beijing trip photos (a group photo at Tiananmen and zoo pictures) on the wall next to the bookshelf, creating a photo wall. Her second son, Mingzhe, and daughter, Yuxin, used colored pens to draw a 'Family Reading Agreement' with items such as 'Read quietly,' 'Take care of books,' and 'Take turns sharing.' Ma Xiulan helped paste it on the side of the bookshelf. The children were full of enthusiasm.

events.name: Invite Liu Chunmei.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan contacted her childhood friend Liu Chunmei via WeChat, inviting her to come over tomorrow afternoon for tea and to exchange embroidery skills. Liu Chunmei happily agreed, promising to bring homemade osmanthus cake.

events.name: Waist maintenance stretching
events.description: Even though her waist no longer hurt, she still did 5 minutes of back stretches every morning and evening as a precaution.

start_state.mood: Moved and delighted

end_state.mood: Looking forward to tomorrow's gathering

state.daily_exercise: Light housework, 10 minutes of waist and back stretching

2025-10.daily_overview: The autumn roses in full bloom added poetic charm to the home. A childhood friend came to visit and exchanged craft skills. The family reading corner was officially launched, and a healthy eating plan was started; life is steadily improving in quality.

events.name: Morning school drop-off and full morning exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:50, did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, then walked to take the youngest daughter to school, a 30-minute round trip. After returning home, walked 20 minutes in the courtyard, watered flowers, pruned the roses, and then did a set of Baduanjin. After morning exercise, enjoyed a low-fat breakfast.

events.name: Arranging autumn roses and sharing them with family.
events.description: In the early morning, Ma Xiulan cut blooming autumn roses from the courtyard, pruned them, and arranged them in a vase on the dining table. Her husband and children gathered around to admire them. Her husband praised, “They look better than store-bought ones.” Her daughter sprayed water on the flowers with her little hands, and the family enjoyed the warm moment.

events.name: Finishing up sorting photos
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan put 100 selected photos into storage boxes and labeled them, discarded the unusable shots, and finished sorting and collecting the photos for the annual album.

events.name: Preparing for an afternoon tea gathering
events.description: Then Ma Xiulan swept the courtyard, moved out the stone table and chairs, picked fresh autumn roses to brew flower tea, and put out Beijing preserved fruit and homemade low-salt pickled vegetables as tea snacks. She organized the new embroidery patterns she had recently learned while waiting for her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to arrive.

events.name: A courtyard tea chat with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei
events.description: In the afternoon, Liu Chunmei arrived at Ma Xiulan's courtyard as promised, bringing homemade osmanthus cake. The two sat by the stone table, sipped flower tea and ate osmanthus cake, swapped the embroidery stitches they had each recently learned, showed their works, talked about how their children were doing, and discussed plans to sign up together for the community handicraft market next month. The gathering was warm and pleasant. When they parted, Ma Xiulan gave Chunmei a small jar of low-salt pickled vegetables.

events.name: First Family Reading Night
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan, her husband, and their three children had their first group reading session in the newly arranged reading corner. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, picked a popular science book; the second son and daughter chose picture books; Ma Xiulan read stories to her daughter; and her husband also picked up a reference book to browse. The whole family was immersed in the quiet of reading.

events.name: Make a weekly family health meal plan and start tracking oil and salt intake
events.description: While the children were reading, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang, drawing on dietary inspiration from their trip and investigation, jointly drew up a healthy meal plan for the coming week (October 17 to 21). They decided to reduce fried dishes, add more steamed and cold-tossed dishes, and use homegrown vegetables. Ma Xiulan also took out an oil-and-salt record sheet and stuck it on the refrigerator, announcing that from then on the family would track daily oil and salt usage. Her husband nodded in support.

events.name: Bedtime relaxation ritual
events.description: In the evening, she soaked her feet for 15 minutes in hot water with mugwort, listening to the radio while soaking. Then she did 5 minutes of pre-sleep deep breathing and acupressure, reviewed the day's small joys, and went to bed at 23:50.

start_state.mood: Peaceful and tranquil

end_state.mood: Warm and fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: 30-minute walk to take children to school, 20-minute courtyard walk, a set of Baduanjin, 5-minute shoulder and neck stretches, courtyard activities and housework, 10-minute waist and back stretches

2025-10.daily_overview: On a fine late-autumn day, Ma Xiulan continued making the family photo album after her morning exercise, took time to go to her mother's house to learn low-fat cooking, and in the evening the whole family went for a walk—a fulfilling and healthy day.

events.name: Morning exercise and school drop-off.
events.description: After getting up at 5:50, Ma Xiulan first did 5 minutes of shoulder-and-neck stretches and cat-cow back stretches, then walked 30 minutes with her younger daughter Ma Yuxin to the primary school, exchanging a few words with neighbor Wang Guilan along the way. After seeing her daughter off, she walked for 20 minutes in the courtyard, checked the condition of the roses and chrysanthemums, removed dead leaves, and watered them. Then she returned to the living room and completed a set of Baduanjin, with smooth movements and even breathing.

events.name: Autumn-themed photo album layout (Day 1)
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan spread out a blank album and the printed photos from the Beijing trip in her study. Under the autumn category, she carefully selected eight scenes that best represented autumn, such as the red leaves of Fragrant Hills and the ginkgo trees of the Forbidden City. She carefully arranged and fixed them on pages 1–2, and below wrote captions and dates with a gel pen, such as “Autumn 2025 · Red Leaves of Fragrant Hills,” completing the day's eight-page layout. During the process, she got up every 20 minutes to stretch her neck, paying attention to balancing work and rest.

events.name: Ask mother for advice on low-fat home-cooked dishes
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to her mother Li Xiuying's home at 45 Shengli Street. She asked her mother in detail how to make several low-fat home-style dishes. Her mother personally cooked to demonstrate the heat for steamed sea bass, the blanching time for garlic broccoli, and the seasoning ratio for wood ear salad, and especially taught her the technique of using a little oil and salt to enhance the umami flavor. Ma Xiulan took careful notes, and the mother and daughter savored the healthy lunch together, exchanging insights on dietary improvement. Before leaving, her mother gave her a small bag of sun-dried radish she had made at home.

events.name: Evening walk for the whole family on Jingwen Road.
events.description: After dinner at about 19:00, Ma Xiulan called the whole family to take a walk along Jingwen Road. The autumn night was slightly cool, so her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children all put on light jackets. The family chatted while walking; Ma Mingzhe chattered about funny things at school, and Ma Yuxin hopped along holding her mother's hand. The walk lasted 30 minutes and became the most pleasant time of the day.

events.name: Pre-sleep relaxation and foot soaking.
events.description: At 21:00, Ma Xiulan prepared hot water with mugwort, poured it into a wooden basin and soaked her feet for 15 minutes while applying pressure to the Hegu acupoint and doing deep-breathing relaxation. Then she did another round of lower back stretches and fell asleep peacefully at 23:50.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, looking forward to the new day.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and content, physically active, and slept soundly.

state.daily_exercise: Neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, a 30-minute walk to take the child to school, a courtyard stroll for 20 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, waist and back stretches for 10 minutes each in the morning and evening, and a 30-minute evening walk.

2025-10.daily_overview: The photo album smoothly completed the second day's layout; the morning exercise habit is firmly established. Although the children complained about the low-fat dinner, her husband approved. After a family walk, they enjoyed a movie night together, warm and harmonious.

events.name: Morning exercise and school drop-off.
events.description: Got up at 5:48, did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, then took her daughter to school, walking 30 minutes round trip. After returning home, she walked in the courtyard for 20 minutes. Because the cloud cover was increasing, she deliberately sped up watering the flowers. Then she practiced a full set of Baduanjin in the living room. Today she added a new variation for stretching the lumbar muscles and felt her lower back muscles more relaxed.

events.name: Album autumn-themed layout (Day 2)
events.description: Ma Xiulan continued organizing the autumn photos. She chose 7 from the remaining Beijing trip photos and pasted them onto pages 3-4 of the album, writing captions by hand such as 2025 Autumn · Corner Tower of the Forbidden City. When arranging the layout, she deliberately placed photos from the same location at staggered, varied intervals. After finishing, she rubbed her neck, remembered the care precautions, and stood up to do a set of neck stretches.

events.name: Following the first week's healthy eating meal plan
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market. At Sun Guifang's stall she chose tofu, fresh fish, lean meat, eggs, and low-sodium seasonings, and then picked seasonal greens from her own vegetable garden. In the afternoon she prepared dinner: steamed fish, dressed spinach, garlic broccoli, and a pot of multigrain porridge. Using an oil-control pitcher and a salt-limiting spoon, she carefully recorded about 20 ml of oil and about 4 g of salt. During dinner, her second son Ma Mingzhe complained that it was "tasteless," and her daughter pouted. Ma Xiulan explained patiently, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang approved of the refreshing flavor after tasting it, which encouraged her.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After a short rest following the meal, the whole family put on their coats and took a 30-minute walk along Jingwen Road. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to ask the children what they really thought of the evening's dishes. Ma Mingxuan said they were okay, and Ma Mingzhe said they were acceptable, which put her mind at ease. After the walk, they went home, rested a bit, and prepared to watch a movie.

events.name: Family movie night
events.description: Ma Xiulan made popcorn at home in a pressure cooker, then put a disc borrowed from the community cultural station into the DVD player, and the whole family watched Havoc in Heaven. The second son imitated Sun Wukong's movements and made everyone laugh, and her husband even put down his phone, which was rare, and became fully absorbed. After the movie, Ma Xiulan asked everyone who they liked the most. Ma Mingxuan said he liked Sun Wukong's cleverness, Ma Mingzhe exaggeratedly imitated the Monkey King, and Ma Yuxin said the fairies were pretty. The living room filled with laughter. Afterwards, she arranged for the children to wash up, did her own pre-bedtime relaxation and foot soak, and fell asleep at 23:48.

start_state.mood: The plan is clear; looking forward to advancing the photo album and meal plan.

end_state.mood: Relaxed and cheerful, with a warm and harmonious family atmosphere.

state.daily_exercise: Neck and shoulder stretches, 30-minute walk to take the children to school, 20-minute courtyard stroll, Baduanjin, back and waist stretches, 30-minute evening walk.

2025-10.daily_overview: The weekend was leisurely. After morning exercise, I switched the album to the winter theme, and the dietary adjustments showed some results. In the afternoon I tended the chrysanthemums, and in the WeChat group there was lively interaction and we started a shared document. During the evening walk, I had a detailed chat with my husband about side-business directions, and it was a rewarding day.

events.name: Weekend morning exercise
events.description: A bit later than usual, Ma Xiulan got up at 6:00. After stretching her shoulders, neck, and back, she first took a 20-minute walk in the courtyard to check the effects of last night's wind and rain on the flowers and plants. Then she went into the living room to practice Baduanjin, and today she deliberately added an extra set of movements, feeling slightly sweaty. With plenty of time in the morning, she also took a few photos of chrysanthemums in bud with her phone, planning to send them to the sisters' group chat.

events.name: Winter-themed photo album layout (Day 1)
events.description: Ma Xiulan sorted through the photos taken at the Great Wall and the Forbidden City in winter, selected eight that best captured the winter charm, pasted them on pages 5-6 of the photo album, and handwrote "Winter 2025 · Snowy Scenes at the Great Wall" and other captions. She was immersed in memories, smiling from time to time.

events.name: Adjust dietary strategies to deal with the child's resistance
events.description: In response to the children's resistance the day before, she changed breakfast to steamed sweet potatoes, corn, boiled eggs, and milk, and the children ate very well. For lunch she made steamed egg with minced meat (lean meat) and stir-fried baby bok choy, chopping the vegetables finely and mixing them into the egg; the children ate a good amount without noticing. Ma Xiulan happily recorded in her kitchen notebook: 15 ml oil and 3 g salt, and wrote that the children accepted it well. In the afternoon she shared her experience via WeChat with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, who praised her for being resourceful.

events.name: Second pinching and shaping of potted chrysanthemums
events.description: In the afternoon, she checked the potted chrysanthemums in the courtyard. The side branches were too dense, so Ma Xiulan carefully carried out the second pinching: for each side branch, she pinched off the tip after leaving 3-4 pairs of leaves, and cut off crossing and weak branches to make the plant shape round and full. After pinching, she watered with fermented rice-washing water liquid fertilizer and adjusted the placement to ensure even light exposure. She planned to take photos as a souvenir when the flowers bloomed.

events.name: WeChat group sharing and recipe document proposal.
