events.description: At four in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan sent a group photo of the pickled vegetables and travel photos from Beijing in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Handicraft Sisters Group, introduced the characteristics of the pickles in detail, and the sisters in the group gave likes one after another. Aunt Wu then suggested creating a shared recipe document. Ma Xiulan immediately responded and took on the responsibility of organizing the pickled vegetable and embroidery content. The two agreed to use Tencent Docs and divide the work, which inspired a new model of online collaboration in the community. After organizing the records, she felt excited.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, the whole family took a 30-minute walk along Jingwen Road. Ma Xiulan and her husband walked side by side at the back, chatting about the shared document in the group and Aunt Wu's suggestion. Ma Zhiqiang suggested she could use this opportunity to learn crochet from Aunt Wu and maybe use it for pickle packaging. Ma Xiulan thought it was feasible and decided to ask Aunt Wu in person when she invited her over next time. After the walk, she soaked her feet and did deep breathing as usual, and fell asleep at 23:45.

start_state.mood: Leisurely and relaxed, getting ready to enjoy the weekend

end_state.mood: Content and excited, full of anticipation for the new plan.

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder, neck, waist and back stretches; 20-minute walk in the courtyard; Baduanjin; 30-minute evening walk.

2025-10.daily_overview: On a cloudy Sunday, Ma Xiulan finished the layout of the winter photo album, exercised in the morning, tidied the house, and planned the next week's meals. In the evening she chatted with Wang Guilan, and then the whole family went for a walk. The day was calm and orderly.

events.name: Sunday morning exercise
events.description: Woke up at 6:30. Because it was cloudy, the courtyard walk was shortened to 15 minutes, with only a quick watering. Back indoors, she finished shoulder and neck stretches and Baduanjin, deliberately extending the back and waist stretches to counteract yesterday's long sitting. After breakfast, she rested a bit and began working on the photo album.

events.name: Winter-themed photo album layout (day 2)
events.description: She selected 7 photos from the remaining winter photos, including a family photo in front of the ice, and pasted them onto pages 7–8 of the album, with handwritten dates and captions. She looked through the completed pages with satisfaction, thinking that the whole album was more than half done.

events.name: Tidying up the house and preparing food ingredients for next week.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan cleaned the living room and kitchen and organized the seasonal clothes. Then she opened the refrigerator to check the stock, made a shopping list for next week, and went to the vegetable garden to pick a handful of scallions and a few leafy greens. She decided to go to the vegetable market early the next morning to replenish tofu and coarse grains.

events.name: Visit neighbor Wang Guilan for a chat.
events.description: While taking out the trash in the evening, she ran into Wang Guilan from across the hallway, and the two chatted at the door for half an hour. Wang Guilan shared her newly learned recipe for pickled radish, and Ma Xiulan mentioned her low-fat diet. They agreed to make pickled vegetables together another day. Ma Xiulan also gave Wang Guilan a small embroidered sachet she had just made, and Wang Guilan happily accepted it.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, the whole family took a 30-minute walk along Jingwen Road. Ma Xiulan held her daughter's hand and listened to her sing nursery rhymes learned in kindergarten. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the two sons discussed next week's lessons. The cloudy night was a bit chilly, but the family's silhouettes were stretched by the streetlights, making it feel especially warm. After returning home, they soaked their feet and did deep breathing, then fell asleep at 23:40.

start_state.mood: Calm and relaxed, enjoying the slow pace of the weekend

end_state.mood: Peaceful and fulfilling, with plans already in place for the coming week.

state.daily_exercise: Neck and shoulder stretching, 15 minutes of walking in the courtyard, Baduanjin, back and waist stretching, and 30 minutes of evening walking

2025-10.daily_overview: A highly productive new week: after morning exercise and taking the kids to school, the pickled vegetable payment arrived, the emergency fund hit its target, the spring photo album got started, the second son's eye recheck showed no worsening, and family walks have become a natural habit.

events.name: Morning exercise and school drop-off.
Deposited the income from pickled vegetable sales into the emergency fund.
events.description: In the morning, she used mobile banking to confirm that the 680 yuan from the sale of commemorative-pack pickled vegetables had arrived. She walked to the bank and deposited 500 yuan into the dedicated emergency fund account, bringing the balance to 2,000 yuan, and kept the remaining 180 yuan as pocket money. After returning home, she carefully recorded it in the ledger, with the note "Emergency fund advancing toward the 5,000-yuan goal." The financial progress reassured her.

events.name: Spring-themed photo album layout (Day 1)
events.description: After her lunch break, Ma Xiulan selected 8 photos of cherry blossoms at Beijing's Yuyuantan Park and a spring outing to the Summer Palace, pasted them onto pages 9-10 of the photo album, and wrote by hand "Spring 2025 · Yuyuantan Cherry Blossoms." The breath of spring seemed to leap off the page, and she couldn't help looking forward to going flower viewing again next year.

events.name: Vision recheck for the second son, Ma Mingzhe
events.description: At 3 p.m., she took her second son to the community health service center. After the examination, Dr. Wang Jianguo confirmed that his myopia had not worsened. Dr. Wang affirmed the effectiveness of the family's walking and screen-time limiting routine. Ma Xiulan was pleased, and Ma Mingzhe promised to continue following the rules. She immediately sent the good news to her husband via WeChat.

events.name: Family walk and check-in
events.description: During dinner, Ma Xiulan once again emphasized the benefits of walking for the eyes. After dinner, the whole family went out without hesitation and walked along Jingwen Road for 30 minutes. On the way, Ma Mingzhe took the initiative to share fun stories about school. After returning home, Ma Xiulan drew a walking marker on the October 20 square of the family calendar and wrote, "Keep walking, the whole family stays healthy." Her husband nodded and said that this habit was indeed good. Before bed, as usual, they stretched and soaked their feet, and turned off the lights at 23:00.

start_state.mood: Stay focused; there are multiple tasks to complete today.

end_state.mood: Gratified and pleased, with progress in both finances and health

state.daily_exercise: Neck, shoulder, waist and back stretching; 30 minutes of walking to take kids to school; 15 minutes of walking in the courtyard; Baduanjin; 30 minutes of evening walking.

2025-10.daily_overview: The spring album continues. After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan reviewed the week's diet. The drop in the data and her family's positive feedback boosted her confidence. During the evening walk she announced next week's menu, and the whole family clapped in support.

events.name: Morning exercise and school drop-off.
events.description: Woke up at 5:42, stretched, then accompanied her daughter to school and walked back. The morning dew had not dried in the courtyard; she carefully avoided the slippery spots, loosened the soil around the chrysanthemums, and then took a 15-minute walk (shortened a bit because time was tight). She practiced Baduanjin in the living room, and her movements were gradually improving.

events.name: Photo album spring theme layout (day two)
events.description: From the remaining spring photos, she chose 7, including a group photo of the children on the grass, and pasted them onto pages 11-12 of the album. Thinking about how the children climbed the rockery at the Summer Palace that day, she felt warm in her heart.

events.name: Weekly healthy eating summary and next week's plan
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan looked through the kitchen record book and calculated that the total oil used was about 140 ml and salt 35 g, far lower than before. She showed it to her family and praised the children for cooperating. Ma Zhiqiang said his body felt lighter, and Ma Mingzhe also said he liked steamed dishes. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to plan next week's menu and shared her experience with her mother by phone; her mother supported her persistence. In the afternoon she took her daughter to the vegetable market and showed the oil and salt records to Sun Guifang, who praised her for being thoughtful. Dinner was light steamed dishes, bringing the first week to a successful end. She stuck the new menu on the refrigerator and noted the oil and salt usage targets.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After the meal, the whole family took a 30-minute walk. As they walked, Ma Xiulan announced the new dishes for next week. When the children heard there would be corn and pork rib soup, they all cheered. After returning home, while soaking her feet she thought about how to combine her pickled vegetable side business with healthy eating and planned to share tips on low-salt pickles in the group chat. She fell asleep at 23:42.

start_state.mood: Highly motivated, looking forward to summarizing the dietary results.

end_state.mood: Her confidence doubled, and her family's support filled her with strength.

state.daily_exercise: Neck, shoulder, waist and back stretching; 30 minutes of walking to take kids to school; 15 minutes of walking in the courtyard; Baduanjin; 30 minutes of evening walking.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Wednesday morning, Ma Xiulan practiced Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao during exercise and exchanged health tips; the photo album turned to summer memories; in the evening, she and her husband carefully finalized the meal plan for the second week; life went on as usual.

events.name: Practicing Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao
events.description: Got up at 5:40. After stretching her neck and shoulders, she took her daughter to school. At 6:20 she met Aunt Zhao in the courtyard, and the two practiced Baduanjin together in the morning light. Aunt Zhao praised Ma Xiulan for her movements being more standard. After practice, as usual Ma Xiulan took a 15-minute walk in the courtyard, while Aunt Zhao did the patting exercise. They agreed to practice together again on Sunday. Later in the morning, Ma Xiulan felt her lower back was supple, a result of consistent stretching.

events.name: Summer-themed photo album layout (Day 1)
events.description: Ma Xiulan took out the family photos from the lotus pond at the Summer Palace and from the Old Summer Palace, selected 8 photos with a strong summer atmosphere, and pasted them onto pages 13–14 of the photo album, writing by hand “Summer 2025 · Lotus at the Summer Palace.” The lush green photos added a touch of warmth to the cool autumn day.

events.name: Plan the second week's healthy meal plan.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan and her husband sat at the dining table and, based on the first week's feedback, made the second week's menu for October 23-31, adding dishes the children liked such as steamed egg and corn and pork rib soup, while sticking to low oil and salt. Ma Zhiqiang suggested adding a moderate amount of vinegar and ginger to enhance the flavor, and Ma Xiulan adopted the idea. The two reached a consensus, and she copied the menu out neatly and stuck it on the refrigerator.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, the whole family went for a 30-minute walk. Ma Xiulan and her husband walked behind, discussing the recipe contents and how much to set aside for next month's heating bill. The children ran ahead, and the streetlights cast long shadows. After returning home, she soaked her feet for 15 minutes, did deep breathing to relax, and fell asleep at 23:40.

start_state.mood: Calm; had an appointment with Aunt Zhao.

end_state.mood: With thorough planning, I feel at ease.

state.daily_exercise: Neck and shoulder stretches, 30-minute walk to take the children to school, 15-minute courtyard stroll, Baduanjin (practiced with Aunt Zhao), 30-minute evening walk

2025-10.daily_overview: A drizzling autumn rain forced the morning exercise indoors; the summer section of the photo album was finished. In the afternoon she embroidered in the rain, her stitching gradually becoming more skillful. In the evening, since walking was impossible, Ma Xiulan led the family in simple stretching exercises in the living room to stay active.

events.name: Indoor morning exercise
events.description: She got up at 5:38. It was gloomy outside, and a fine drizzle started while she was taking her daughter to school. Since the courtyard was unusable after returning from drop-off, Ma Xiulan did neck, shoulder, waist, and back stretches in the living room, then closed the windows and practiced Baduanjin. The air was stale, but she persisted through the full set and did an extra round of 'Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner' to stretch out her body. As the rain grew heavier in the morning, she moved the potted plants under the eaves to keep them from being waterlogged.

events.name: Photo album summer theme layout (day two)
events.description: Pasted the remaining 7 summer photos (the children playing in water and eating watermelon) onto pages 15-16 of the album, and handwrote date captions. Looking at these vivid images, she seemed to smell the fresh watermelon aroma of summer again. At this point, 32 pages of the album had been completed.

events.name: Embroidery and handcrafts on a rainy day
events.description: It kept drizzling in the afternoon, so Ma Xiulan took out her sewing basket and sat by the window to continue the peony pillowcase embroidery she had started at the end of last year. She carefully compared the pattern and worked stitch by stitch, while paying attention to her neck posture and getting up to move around every 20 minutes. After more than two hours of focused work, she finished a half-open peony, with the embroidery surface smooth and detailed. She figured the finished piece could be given to her mother as a birthday gift.

events.name: Indoor evening activities.
events.description: Because the roads were slippery and they couldn't go out for a walk, after dinner Ma Xiulan suggested that the whole family do 15 minutes of simple stretching in the living room. She taught her husband and children the cat stretch and neck rotations. Ma Mingzhe's funny movements made everyone laugh. After that, it was still family reading time: the children read, while she browsed embroidery pattern books. Before bed, as usual, she soaked her feet and took deep breaths, and fell asleep at 23:38.

start_state.mood: Take things as they come and act according to plan.

end_state.mood: Tranquil, enjoying time spent on handicrafts

state.daily_exercise: Neck, shoulder, waist, and back stretches; Baduanjin (indoor); 15 minutes of family indoor stretching exercises.

2025-10.daily_overview: On a fine Friday, after morning exercise and taking the children to school, Ma Xiulan saw a medical insurance payment notice while out. She went home and finished the final check of the photo album; she quickly reached an agreement with her husband about paying, and discussed the budget arrangement during the evening walk.

events.name: Morning exercise and school drop-off.
events.description: Got up at 5:35, did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, and walked to take her daughter to school and back. In the courtyard, the chrysanthemums were in full bloom; she walked for 20 minutes and took a few close-up photos. After Baduanjin, she felt light, possibly the result of dietary adjustments and consistent exercise.

events.name: Found medical insurance payment notice
events.description: After breakfast, she went to the community bulletin board to see if there were any new activity notices. She immediately saw the 2026 urban and rural residents' medical insurance payment notice, quickly took a photo of the details with her phone, and marked medical insurance reserve in her portable ledger. Last year's payment experience taught her that she needed to plan ahead.

events.name: Complete the year's photo album and final inspection.
events.description: Returning to the study, she carefully pasted the last remaining 8 photos (including fill-ins for the four seasons) onto pages 17-18 of the album, completing all the captions. She checked the firmness, appearance, and text from beginning to end, and smiled after confirming everything was correct. The 60-page annual family album was complete. She laid it flat on the desk, took a photo of the cover, and sent it to the family group chat.

events.name: Couple discusses paying medical insurance premiums.
events.description: She sent the medical insurance notice photo to her husband via WeChat, with a voice message explaining the amount. After her husband got off work in the evening, the two discussed it. Ma Zhiqiang said clearly, "Don't skimp on what should be paid." Ma Xiulan decided to go handle it tomorrow. She wrote a memo in her ledger and mentally planned to withdraw the money from her pickled vegetable income.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, the whole family went for a 30-minute walk. Ma Xiulan and her husband walked behind, calculating the impact of the 532 yuan medical insurance payment on this month's expenses. On the way, they ran into neighbor Zhang Shufen and chatted briefly about the weather and vegetable prices. After returning home, everything went on as usual, and they went to bed at 23:35.

start_state.mood: Awake, ready to process the last batch of album photos.

end_state.mood: A sense of achievement from completing the photo album, and a clear plan for paying the fees.

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, 30-minute walk to take the child to school, 20-minute walk in the courtyard, Baduanjin, 30-minute evening walk

2025-10.daily_overview: A packed Saturday: early in the morning her husband did the grocery shopping for her. After her morning exercise, Ma Xiulan smoothly handled the whole family's medical insurance payment and adjusted the budget; in the afternoon she finished the final message for the photo album, and during an evening walk she confirmed Aunt Wu's visit next month. It was a full and reassuring day.

events.name: Weekend morning exercise
events.description: Woke up at 6:30. Because her husband took the initiative to buy groceries, she had an extra half hour of free time. She walked in the courtyard for 20 minutes, applied a light top dressing to the chrysanthemums, and then practiced Baduanjin. Today she deliberately slowed down her movements to focus on coordinating her breathing, and after finishing, she felt relaxed all over. At breakfast, her husband brought back the ingredients; she checked them and put them in the refrigerator by category.

events.name: Pay the family's health insurance.
events.description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan counted out 532 yuan in cash from the pickled vegetable income (380 yuan for her own family of five and 152 yuan for her parents) and walked to the community service station. She first paid for her own family of five, then paid on behalf of her parents. She received two receipts, checked them carefully, and put them away safely. With this done, she felt reassured and said to herself, 'Only when the whole family has protection can I feel at ease.'

events.name: Adjust the family budget
events.description: Back home, she recorded the medical insurance expenses in her accounting book and planned to make up the amount first with next month's pickled vegetable income. At dinner, she explained it to her husband. Ma Zhiqiang offered to smoke one less carton of cigarettes next month (saving about 100 yuan) to share the burden. Ma Xiulan smiled and wrote down this to-do item, feeling that the couple was of one mind.

events.name: Final polishing and message for the annual photo album
events.description: In the afternoon, she took out the completed 60-page photo album, re-fastened a few loose photos, and made sure every page was flat. Then she wrote "2025, we are on the road" on the title page as the annual message, closed the album, and put it into the living room bookshelf, completing this family project that had lasted several months. When the children saw it, they rushed to look through it.

events.name: Invited Aunt Wu to visit next month
events.description: In the evening, seeing the recipe document in the WeChat group gradually becoming more substantial, Ma Xiulan privately messaged Aunt Wu, formally inviting her to come stay at her home for a few days in mid-November, wanting to ask her about crochet in person and let her taste local snacks. Aunt Wu readily agreed, and the two decided to set the exact date later. This invitation made Ma Xiulan look forward to it greatly.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, they took a 30-minute walk. Ma Xiulan told her husband that the photo album was finished. Ma Zhiqiang scrolled through the photos on his phone and praised her for being thoughtful. The children were playing around ahead of them, and the evening was warm and cozy. After returning home, they soaked their feet and did deep breathing, then went to sleep at 23:30.

start_state.mood: Calm and organized; there are important matters to take care of today.

end_state.mood: At ease and reassured, important matters properly resolved

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of courtyard walking, Baduanjin, 30 minutes of evening walking

2025-10.daily_overview: Sunday Family Day: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan organized the whole family to jump rope and kick shuttlecock in the yard, with constant laughter; in the evening, tooth checks reinforced oral hygiene habits; while taking a walk, the children were still excitedly discussing the day's games.

events.name: Simple morning exercise.
events.description: Got up at 6:40. After a simple shoulder and neck stretch, since she planned outdoor yard activities in the morning, she only did 15 minutes of walking in the yard and watering flowers, leaving Baduanjin for the afternoon. Waist and back stretches as usual.

events.name: Fun family exercise in the courtyard
events.description: In the warm morning sunshine, Ma Xiulan suggested the whole family go to the courtyard for activities. Her husband brought out chairs, and the children got out jump ropes and a shuttlecock. Ma Xiulan organized a small jump-rope contest. Ma Mingxuan jumped the most; Ma Mingzhe kept tripping but was full of enthusiasm, and her daughter also bounced around counting. Ma Zhiqiang performed shuttlecock kicking and won cheers. The whole family exercised for about an hour, and their faces were rosy. Ma Xiulan felt it was much more beneficial than watching TV.

events.name: Month-end family dental checkup
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ma Xiulan gathered her three children in the bathroom and, using a small flashlight, checked each child's teeth one by one, focusing on whether there was any food residue. Ma Mingzhe had some residue on his molars and was asked to brush again and use dental floss. She praised the good habit of persisting for a month and reminded Ma Mingzhe to brush carefully in circles. After the check, she recorded the results in her health notebook, planning to show them to the dentist at the next follow-up visit.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, they went for a 30-minute walk. The children were still talking about the jump rope competition. Ma Mingxuan said he could increase his count by 100 in a week, and Ma Mingzhe was unconvinced. Ma Xiulan held her daughter's hand, feeling grateful for this ordinary happiness. After returning home, she soaked her feet and took deep breaths, then fell asleep at 23:32.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, looking forward to spending Sunday with the family

end_state.mood: Joyful, the family activity brought everyone closer together.

state.daily_exercise: Courtyard walk for 15 minutes, family jump rope and shuttlecock kicking for 1 hour, evening walk for 30 minutes.

2025-10.daily_overview: To catch the Jizhou inspection tour, Ma Xiulan got up before dawn, did a quick stretch, and set off. She made a round trip that day. Although the journey was tiring, it was very productive: she learned the methods for making fruit jam and the consignment sales model, and returned fully loaded.

events.name: Get up early and go to Jizhou
events.description: As soon as the 5:30 alarm went off, I got up and did five minutes of shoulder, neck and lower back stretches. Due to lack of time, I skipped the walk and Baduanjin. I brought some dry food, gathered with neighbors including Wang Guilan at the community gate, and took the coach departing on time at 6:00 a.m. for Jizhou. I caught up on sleep for half an hour on the bus.

events.name: Farm stay inspection in Jizhou
events.description: Traveling there and back in one day, though tiring, was very rewarding. She set out at 6 a.m. and returned at 6 p.m. In the morning, she arrived at the demonstration village in Xiaying Town. Ma Xiulan focused on observing orchard picking and jam making, asking in detail about the sugar-to-fruit ratio and preservation techniques for hawthorn jam, and taking notes on her phone. At noon, she tasted braised fish with savory sauce at a farmhouse restaurant and asked the chef about the sauce recipe. In the afternoon, while visiting a homestay, she discovered a consignment model for handicrafts. She discussed the possibility of consigning her pickled vegetables with the owner and asked for contact information. Before heading back, she bought two bottles of farmhouse chili sauce at her own expense for reference.

events.name: Evening recovery stretching
events.description: Returning by car to Jinghai in the evening, having walked a lot during the day, she felt slight soreness in her lower back. After dinner she deliberately did an extra 15 minutes of cat stretch and wall-supported waist twists, and also had her husband press on her waist a few times, which relieved the discomfort. Since she had not gone out for a walk, she soaked her feet early and went to bed at 21:30.

start_state.mood: Excited and expectant, full of curiosity about the field trip

end_state.mood: Returned with a full load, and the side-hustle idea is becoming clearer.

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, lower back stretches (intensified in the evening), farm stay walking tour (about 8,000 steps).

2025-10.daily_overview: Back to daily routine. After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan brought inspiration from Jizhou into the kitchen, creating steamed carrot shreds with rice flour and green beans with sesame sauce, which were a big hit with the family and added new dishes to their healthy diet. Before the evening walk, she received a heating fee payment notice and discussed the payment with her family.

events.name: Morning exercise and school drop-off.
events.description: Got up at 5:35, stretched shoulders, neck, waist, and back for 5 minutes, and took my daughter to school. Walked in the courtyard for 15 minutes; because the strong wind last night had blown down some leaves, I swept them up as I went. Did Baduanjin in the living room; today my waist felt more relaxed than yesterday.

events.name: Trying new dishes
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan looked up recipes for steamed vegetable dishes online. She mixed shredded carrots with cornmeal and lightly steamed them, and also made green beans dressed with sesame paste. While cooking, she carefully recorded the oil and salt, and used only a few drops of sesame oil for the steamed dish. At dinner, her husband praised the shredded carrots as soft and tender, her two sons each ate an extra bowl of rice, and her daughter especially liked the green beans with sesame paste. Ma Xiulan wrote down the recipes and feedback in detail in her kitchen notebook and decided to add these two dishes to her regular menu. She also took photos of the finished dishes and shared them in the sisters' group chat.

events.name: Discussed consignment sales of pickled vegetables with her husband
events.description: During dinner, Ma Xiulan mentioned the homestay consignment model she had seen in Jizhou and thought her own pickles could also be tried that way. Ma Zhiqiang supported her in contacting them to try, but reminded her to test the waters with a small batch first. Ma Xiulan decided to organize the pickle product list tomorrow and contact the owner of that homestay.

events.name: Received the heating fee payment notice and discussed it.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan found a heating fee payment reminder in the mailbox at the door, and the amount was quite large. She immediately discussed payment with her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the children in the living room. After discussion, they decided to first verify the charge details, pay before the end of the month if correct, and consider adjusting the heating method next year to save money. Ma Xiulan put the reminder away and planned to go to the property management office to ask the next day.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan took a 30-minute walk and was in a cheerful mood. Watching the children play ahead, she felt she was steadily achieving her goals of family health and a side business. After returning home, she soaked her feet, did some deep breathing before bed, and fell asleep at 23:35.

start_state.mood: Eager and ready to try new things

end_state.mood: Very satisfied, the family diet has gained something new, but slightly feeling financial pressure.

state.daily_exercise: Neck, shoulder, waist and back stretching; 30 minutes of walking to take kids to school; 15 minutes of walking in the courtyard; Baduanjin; 30 minutes of evening walking.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Wednesday, I practiced Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao and exchanged health-preserving tips; afterward, I tried making two new chili sauces, and the sisters in the WeChat group gave me advice; during the evening walk, the air was humid, so I brought an umbrella in case of rain.

events.name: Practicing Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao
events.description: Woke up at 5:33, stretched, then took her daughter to school. At 6:20, Aunt Zhao came to the courtyard as promised, and the two practiced Baduanjin together. Aunt Zhao pointed out that during the “Shake the Head and Wag the Tail to Dispel Heart Fire” movement, her waist needed to be more relaxed and sinking. After Ma Xiulan adjusted, she immediately felt more comfortable. After practice, she walked in the courtyard for 15 minutes. The chrysanthemums were already about a third open, so she cut two branches and placed them in a vase.

events.name: Trial production of new chili sauce
events.description: In the morning, inspired by Jizhou chili sauce and Aunt Wu's online sharing, Ma Xiulan used a stone mortar to pound dried red peppers, garlic, and Sichuan peppercorns, stir-fried them in a very small amount of oil, then poured in the fermented sauce base and simmered it. She adjusted the spiciness in two batches, making one bottle of mild and one bottle of medium-spicy, using only 10 ml of oil per batch. After bottling and labeling, she prepared dinner for the family to taste.

events.name: Ask for advice in a WeChat community group
events.description: In the afternoon, she sent photos of the new chili sauce to the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Handicraft Sisters Group and privately messaged Aunt Wu to ask for the secret to keeping the color bright red. Aunt Wu replied that adding a little sugar and vinegar would brighten and enhance the flavor. Ma Xiulan quickly noted it down and made an appointment for Aunt Wu to teach her in person when she came. Other sisters in the group also offered suggestions, and the interaction was lively.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: For dinner, a jar of medium-spicy sauce was opened. Her husband praised its flavor but said the mildly spicy one was more suitable for the children. After dinner, they went for a 30-minute walk. Ma Xiulan had brought an umbrella, but it did not rain, and the family enjoyed walking in the damp, fresh air. She and her husband discussed the possibility of making the spicy sauce in larger quantities and decided to bring some to next month's handicraft market to try selling them. After returning home, she soaked her feet, did some deep breathing before bed, and fell asleep at 23:33.

start_state.mood: Calm, planning to try making a new chili sauce.

end_state.mood: A slight sense of accomplishment; the community's support brought warmth.

state.daily_exercise: Neck and shoulder stretches, 30-minute walk to take children to school, 15-minute courtyard walk, Baduanjin (practiced together), 30-minute evening walk

2025-10.daily_overview: On the second-to-last day of the month, after morning exercise, Ma Xiulan rushed to finish an embroidered hanging ornament to give to a neighbor. The afternoon financial pre-check gave her a clear picture of family income and expenses, and the evening walk became the day's moment of relaxation.

events.name: Morning exercise and school drop-off.
events.description: Got up at 5:30. The weather is getting colder, so the courtyard walk was reduced to 15 minutes, but she checked the roses and they need winter pruning. She did Baduanjin in the living room, paying attention to the 'seven jolts behind' movement. At breakfast, the children all wore slightly thicker coats.

events.name: Complete the embroidered pendant
events.description: In the morning, she used leftover scraps to design and embroider a palm-sized "Ruyi" hanging ornament, using blue and cyan silk thread and filling it with dried lavender flowers. She planned to give it to her neighbor Wang Guilan as a birthday surprise. After finishing it, she smelled the faint floral fragrance and wrapped it up with satisfaction.

events.name: Month-end preliminary review of household expenses
events.description: In the afternoon, she pulled out the account book and mobile payment records to do a preliminary review of income and expenses for the first 30 days of October. Food expenses had dropped by nearly 10% due to low-budget purchasing, but medical insurance pushed total spending up. She calculated that she still needed to set aside 1,200 yuan for heating fees and decided to pay formally tomorrow. After the review, she had a clear picture and made an initial plan for next month's budget.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, they walked for 30 minutes. Ma Xiulan told her husband that the heating fee reminder had not arrived yet, but the budget had already been set. Ma Zhiqiang said he would cut his cigarette spending by another half carton next month. During the walk, their daughter said she wanted to learn Grandma's pancake-making method, and Ma Xiulan promised to teach her on Saturday. After returning home, she soaked her feet and took deep breaths, then turned off the lights at 23:30.

start_state.mood: Stick to the routine; focus on indoor activities today.

end_state.mood: Finances are clear, and she feels secure.

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, 30-minute walk to take the children to school, 15-minute courtyard stroll, Baduanjin, 30-minute evening walk

2025-10.daily_overview: On the last day of the month, she kept up her morning exercise as usual and added an end-of-month health indicators review; her BMI was in line with expectations. The second week of healthy eating came to a perfect close. At the family wrap-up meeting, everyone agreed to continue the new habits over the long term. In the afternoon, she proactively paid the heating fee, and all of the month's financial matters were settled, drawing a perfect end to a busy and fulfilling October.

events.name: End-of-month morning exercise
events.description: Woke up at 5:30, did shoulder and neck stretches, then took her daughter to school. She walked in the courtyard for 15 minutes; the chrysanthemums were in full bloom, so she cut a few stems to arrange in a vase. She practiced Baduanjin with light, flowing movements and felt no discomfort in her lower back. Breakfast was multigrain porridge and boiled eggs; the habit has become second nature.

events.name: Month-end health metrics review
events.description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan stood on the scale and weighed 53.0 kg, then took out a tape measure to measure her waistline. She pulled out the records from the beginning of the month and calculated that her BMI had dropped steadily from 19.7 at the start of the month to 19.5, and her waist had also decreased slightly. She carefully wrote down the data in her health log and, comparing it with the diet and exercise plan set at the beginning of the month, happily found that all indicators were improving.

events.name: Comprehensive summary of the second week of healthy eating
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan completed a two-week diet summary in her kitchen notebook: average daily oil usage dropped from 30 grams to 18 grams, salt usage decreased by one-third, and family feedback was good—her husband's stomach acid reduced, the children liked vegetables, and she no longer felt drowsy in the afternoon. She decided to stick with light cooking long-term and planned to report to her mother on the weekend. After summarizing, she put the notebook away.

events.name: Go to the heating company in the afternoon to pay the bill.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan went to the heating company and used 1200 yuan squeezed out of this month's pickled vegetable income to pay this season's heating fee. She felt relieved, recorded it as done in her account book, and told her husband.

events.name: Family meeting on family-wide screen-time limits and the walking summary
events.description: After returning from an evening walk after dinner, Ma Xiulan gathered the family for a brief review meeting in the living room. She praised everyone for their persistence over the past month or so: the daily walks had never been interrupted, screen time was effectively controlled, and the family atmosphere was harmonious. Ma Zhiqiang also praised the children's self-discipline. The whole family agreed to keep the new habits permanently. Ma Xiulan also recorded the progress: the eldest son's grades improved, the second son became more lively, and the daughter learned three embroidery stitches. The meeting ended warmly, marking the success of October's various plans.

events.name: Relaxing before bed
events.description: Soaked her feet for 15 minutes, reviewed the day, all financial matters were completed, and the family worked together to handle things. She pressed the Hegu acupoint, took deep breaths, felt her lower back relaxed, and thought she should keep it up in November. She fell asleep peacefully at 23:30.

start_state.mood: Take stock of her mindset and prepare to wrap up the month’s plans.

end_state.mood: All of this month's financial matters are complete. I can welcome November with peace of mind. Although there is financial pressure, we are full of hope and will face it together as a family.

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, a 30-minute walk to take the child to school, a 15-minute stroll in the yard, Baduanjin, a 30-minute evening walk, and deep breathing before bed

2025-01.daily_overview: On New Year's Day family dinner day, Ma Xiulan went back to her parents' home early to cook, warming the whole family with sweet-and-sour pork and noodles with gravy. In the afternoon, she watched the children play in the yard and recorded the warm scenes with her phone, feeling fulfilled in body and mind.

events.name: Walking to her parents' home on New Year's Day
events.description: On the morning of New Year's Day, Ma Xiulan walked from her own home to her parents' home, carrying the sweet and sour pork tenderloin, hand-rolled noodle ingredients, and other items she had bought in advance. After arriving, she exchanged a few words with her mother, Li Xiuying, and began preparations such as washing vegetables, thawing the meat, and kneading dough.

events.name: Cooking a specialty dish
events.description: In the kitchen at her parents' home, Ma Xiulan and her mother worked together to cook sweet-and-sour pork and hand-rolled noodles with gravy. The kitchen was filled with the rich aroma of home-style cooking, and it took about two hours.

events.name: Family New Year's Day gathering
events.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan brought the cooked dishes to the table. Her father Ma Jianguo, her mother Li Xiuying, Ma Xiulan's three children, and Ma Xiulan herself sat together for the meal. After tasting it, her father happily praised that the taste of home was truly different, and Ma Xiulan felt warm at heart.

events.name: After-dinner mother-daughter heart-to-heart chat
events.description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan took the initiative to clear the dishes, wash the utensils, and wipe the table. Her mother Li Xiuying helped on the side, and the two chatted while they worked. Ma Xiulan told her mother about her small plans for the new year, such as wanting to take on more handicraft odd jobs to supplement the family income. Her mother told her not to overwork herself and to take care of her health.

events.name: Children's playful time in the courtyard.
events.description: In the afternoon, the three children ran and played in the yard at the parents' home. Ma Mingzhe played hide-and-seek with his younger sister Ma Yuxin, while Ma Mingxuan quietly read comics. Ma Xiulan moved a chair under the eaves and watched the children play, feeling full of happiness and contentment. She took out her phone and took a few photos to record this warm moment.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Looking forward to it, with the happy mood of the festival

end_state.location: Living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.
end_state.mood: Happy and content, savoring the warmth of the family being together

state.daily_exercise: Walking round trip to her parents' home, about 30 minutes.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning sunny, temperature -3 to 4°C, light breeze.

2025-01.daily_overview: After seeing the children off to school, Ma Xiulan buried herself in reviewing last year's family accounts. In the evening, she and her husband agreed to set aside 200 yuan each month as an education fund, taking the first step in family financial management.

events.name: Reconciled last year's family accounts
events.description: In the morning, after dropping the children off at school, Ma Xiulan took out a notebook and pen in the living room at home. She carefully went through last year's shopping receipts and scattered records, checking household income and expenses item by item, calculating the annual total income and each expenditure category, paying special attention to the share of food and daily necessities, to prepare for careful budgeting in the new year. Halfway through, she found a few receipts with blurred handwriting and specifically made notes next to them in pencil.

events.name: Discuss and agree on education savings with her husband.
events.description: In the evening, after her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from work, Ma Xiulan took out the accounts she had sorted during the day and discussed with him setting aside a fixed 200 yuan each month as a reserve fund for the children's education. Ma Zhiqiang hesitated at first because of limited income, but after Ma Xiulan patiently explained its importance, he finally said he was willing to smoke less to squeeze out the money. Hearing this, Ma Xiulan felt both grateful and a little financial pressure, but her determination to carry it out was strengthened. The two discussed until nearly 10:30 before finishing.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Clear-headed, determined to get finances in order

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Gratified and settled after reaching a consensus with her husband

state.daily_exercise: Housework for about 1 hour

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, temperature -4 to 3°C, northwest wind force 3.

2025-01.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan started keeping accounts with a dual-track system using a mobile app and a notebook. Even when her husband teased her, she persisted, managing family finances down to the smallest detail.

events.name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
events.description: After dropping off the children in the morning, Ma Xiulan walked to the vegetable market near Jingwen Road and bought the day's vegetables and pork at Sun Guifang's stall, chatting briefly about prices and the weather. Aunt Sun took the initiative to give her a bunch of scallions, which warmed her heart.

events.name: Learning to use a budgeting tool
events.description: In the afternoon, as agreed with her husband the day before, Ma Xiulan downloaded a bookkeeping app on her phone and started learning the basics and recording the day's expenses. At the same time, she used the old home computer to search online for family bookkeeping methods. The computer froze and restarted once, and after waiting patiently, she continued copying the important bookkeeping tips into her pocket notebook. When her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from work and saw how earnest she looked, he laughed and teased her, but she ignored him and kept carrying out the plan.

events.name: Evening tutoring and keeping up with bookkeeping
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan checked the homework of her eldest and second sons, then took out the account book and entered today's grocery shopping and miscellaneous expenses into the app and the notebook, insisting on dual-track record keeping.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Feeling refreshed, she became more determined to keep track of expenses.

end_state.location: Living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.
end_state.mood: Relaxed, satisfied with carrying out the plan

state.daily_exercise: About 20 minutes round trip on foot to buy groceries

2025-01.daily_overview: Over the weekend, Ma Xiulan protected the roses from the cold in the courtyard. In the afternoon, she had tea and chatted with her neighbor Wang Guilan. In the evening, she continued her embroidery practice and also briefly helped watch a neighbor's child.

events.name: Courtyard winterization maintenance
events.description: In the morning, taking advantage of the fine weather, Ma Xiulan inspected her small courtyard and found that the roots of several rose bushes were exposed. She fetched straw and old cloth, carefully covered the roses to keep them warm, and cleared away dead leaves to ensure the plants survived the winter safely.

events.name: Help Wang Guilan look after her grandson.
events.description: Around noon, the neighbor Wang Guilan knocked urgently on the door, saying she had to go to the community to take care of some urgent business and asked Ma Xiulan to help watch her little grandson for a while. Ma Xiulan readily agreed, brought the child into her home, gave him some snacks, and played with him with building blocks for half an hour.

events.name: Chat with neighbor Wang Guilan.
events.description: In the afternoon, after Wang Guilan picked up her grandson, she stayed to visit. Ma Xiulan brewed a pot of tea, and the two sat in the living room chatting, sharing recent family anecdotes and community news. Wang Guilan also gave her a handful of homemade pickled radish strips.

events.name: Evening embroidery practice.
events.description: In the evening, while the children watched cartoons, Ma Xiulan took out her embroidery hoop and practiced stitching by following a newly found peony pattern, honing her skills for possible small sewing orders. She kept at it until after nine o'clock before resting.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Relaxing, ready to enjoy the weekend

end_state.location: Living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.
end_state.mood: Leisurely; handcrafts and socializing bring satisfaction.

state.daily_exercise: About 40 minutes of courtyard work

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan sorted out seasonal clothes, took the kids to the community supermarket, and in the evening the whole family watched a TV drama together, immersed in the warmth of ordinary family life.

events.name: Organize winter clothes
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan sorted through the family's winter clothes for the change of season, packed up the cotton-padded coats the children had outgrown, and planned to give them to relatives' children another day. She also sewed up the loose threads on the thick coat her husband wore for work.

events.name: Take the child to the community supermarket.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan took her three children to the convenience supermarket run by Zhang Shufen, which was diagonally across the street. She bought daily necessities such as salt and soy sauce, and also bought a lollipop for each child. In the store, she chatted with Zhang Shufen about family matters and exchanged views on children's education and prices. Zhang Shufen mentioned that soy sauce was about to go up in price and suggested she buy an extra bottle to stock up.

events.name: The whole family watching TV
events.description: In the evening, after dinner, the family sat around in the living room watching TV. Ma Xiulan switched to the family drama she liked, and everyone watched and commented. The children later played chess nearby until bedtime.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Lazy, savoring the slow Sunday.

end_state.location: Living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.
end_state.mood: Content, spending a leisurely day with family

state.daily_exercise: Walk to shop for about 15 minutes

2025-01.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan officially took the first step toward education savings. In the morning, she went to the bank for detailed consultation. In the afternoon, she bought some snacks while picking up her daughter. In the evening, she and her husband finalized the date to open the account.

events.name: Bank inquiry about education savings
events.description: In the morning, after sending the children to school, Ma Xiulan walked to the Tianjin Jinghai District Rural Credit Cooperative and asked at the counter about the rules for education savings accounts. She carefully asked about the interest rate for installment deposits, the minimum monthly deposit amount, and withdrawal conditions, wrote down the key information in her notebook, and took a brochure. On the way, she ran into her old neighbor Aunt Zhao, and the two stood and chatted for a few minutes.

events.name: Picking up daughter and buying snacks
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan left a little early to pick up her younger daughter Ma Yuxin from kindergarten. Passing a pastry shop, she bought some jujube cake, planning to use it as the children's afternoon snack and her husband's late-night snack.

events.name: Evening conversation between husband and wife.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan told her husband Ma Zhiqiang about the education savings information she had asked about during the day. After discussing it, they decided to open an account on the 10th and deposit 500 yuan that day. Her husband also confirmed again that he would keep his cigarette spending under control.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Full of hope, actively working on the education fund.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Confident, the plan is about to be implemented

state.daily_exercise: About 30 minutes walking round trip to the bank.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to light snow, temperature -6 to 0°C, east wind force 2.

2025-01.daily_overview: While waiting for odd-job opportunities, Ma Xiulan quietly designed new embroidery patterns. After sitting with her head lowered for a long time, she felt slight soreness in her neck, but she persisted and finished the draft. In the evening, when checking the children's homework, she encouraged her second son for his small progress.

events.name: Contacting the part-time job referral person
events.description: In the morning, after finishing basic housework, Ma Xiulan called Zheng Xiuying, her part-time job referrer, to ask whether there were any handicraft odd jobs or short-term work opportunities recently. Sister Zheng said there was nothing suitable at the moment, but she would keep an eye out for her, and suggested she embroider a few more samples in case they were needed. Before hanging up, Sister Zheng also reminded her to be careful on the icy roads.

events.name: Designing new embroidery patterns
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan found some floral patterns online and, combining them with her own ideas, sketched on the embroidery cloth and began embroidering a handkerchief with a new pattern. She planned to take a photo and send it to Sister Zheng and her childhood friend once it was finished. After lowering her head for more than two hours straight, she felt a bit of soreness in her neck, rubbed it with her hand, moved around a little, and continued.

events.name: Check the children's homework
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan checked the homework of her eldest and second sons, specifically praised her second son Ma Mingzhe for writing more neatly than before, which made him very happy. Afterward, she recorded the day's small expenses in the app. Before bed, her neck was still a bit stiff, so she applied a hot towel for a while.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Ordinary, beginning a busy day as usual

end_state.location: Living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.
end_state.mood: Slightly tired, and neck discomfort is beginning to appear.

state.daily_exercise: About 1 hour of housework, including long periods of lowering her head to embroider.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning sunny, temperature -3 to 3°C, light breeze

2025-01.daily_overview: The faucet at home suddenly leaked, and Ma Xiulan didn't know what to do. After work, her husband skillfully fixed it. At dinner, the whole family praised him. A small incident brought the family closer.

events.name: Discovered a leaking faucet
events.description: In the morning, while Ma Xiulan was preparing breakfast in the kitchen, she noticed water continuously dripping from the faucet joint. She tried using a rag to tighten it, but it still dripped. She had to put a basin underneath and thought about contacting Master Liu from the community or waiting for her husband to take a look in the evening.

events.name: My husband skillfully fixed the faucet.
events.description: In the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from work and, after learning about the leak, decided to fix it himself. He took a wrench and a screwdriver from the toolbox, disassembled the faucet valve core, tightened the internal screw, and carefully cleaned the limescale from the filter screen. Ma Xiulan helped by handing him tools and holding a flashlight, admiring her husband's skilled hands.

events.name: Family praise at dinner
events.description: At dinner, the family sat together. Ma Xiulan smiled and said to the children, Look how amazing Dad is. He's so handy and saved the family 50 yuan in repair costs. The eldest son Ma Mingxuan, the second son Ma Mingzhe, and the daughter Ma Yuxin all praised Dad for being great. Ma Zhiqiang wore a proud smile, and the family ate and chatted in a relaxed, happy atmosphere.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Calm, starting a new day as usual.

end_state.location: Living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.
end_state.mood: Happy, delighted by her husband's craftsmanship and family interaction.

state.daily_exercise: About 1.5 hours of housework

2025-01.daily_overview: On an ordinary Thursday, Ma Xiulan enjoyed a parent-child reading time with her younger daughter in the community reading room. After her daughter accidentally fell, she comforted her gently, and in the evening she carefully checked the family accounts for the week.

events.name: Parent-child reading in the community reading room.
events.description: In the afternoon, after picking up her kindergarten daughter Ma Yuxin, Ma Xiulan took her to the reading room of the Jingwen Road Community Service Center. She let her daughter read picture books while she herself browsed a family life magazine nearby. During that time, her daughter slipped off the chair and scraped her knee a bit, and started crying. Ma Xiulan quickly found a Band-Aid in the reading room's first-aid kit, put it on her, and gently comforted her. Her daughter soon smiled through her tears.

events.name: Evening bookkeeping and budget review
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan opened the bookkeeping app on her phone and checked this week's expenses against her notebook. She found that the main expenses were on food and the children's stationery. Looking at the accounts, she thought it over and decided to reduce snack purchases starting next week, and jotted down some money-saving tips.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Energetic, preparing to complete daily household chores

end_state.location: Living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.
end_state.mood: Relaxation: reading and organizing accounts bring peace of mind

state.daily_exercise: Walking to take and pick up my daughter takes about 20 minutes.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, temperature -5 to 3°C, light breeze.

2025-01.daily_overview: Today Ma Xiulan completed a key step in her family financial planning: she successfully opened an education savings account and deposited the first 500 yuan. In the evening, she and her husband established the principle of only depositing and not withdrawing, and she felt at ease.

events.name: Set out to process education savings
events.description: In the morning, after taking the children to school, Ma Xiulan took the family account book, her ID card, and 500 yuan in cash prepared in advance, and walked to the nearby Jinghai Sub-branch of the Tianjin Jinghai District Rural Credit Cooperative.

events.name: Successfully opened an account and made the first deposit
events.description: In the business hall, Ma Xiulan queued up and told the teller that she wanted to open an education savings account with monthly deposits and lump-sum withdrawal. She reconfirmed the interest rate and rules, carefully filled out the account opening application form, handed 500 yuan in cash through the window, and successfully completed the process, receiving a brand-new passbook.

events.name: Return home and keep the bankbook safe
events.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan walked home after finishing her business, carefully locked the education savings passbook in the drawer of the desk in the bedroom, and decided to deposit money into it regularly in the future.

events.name: Informing her husband and establishing rules
events.description: In the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home. Ma Xiulan showed him the bankbook and explained that this account was dedicated to the children's future education, with deposits only and no withdrawals. Her husband nodded in approval and said he would also try to cooperate by reducing unnecessary expenses.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Clear plan and full of drive.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Reassuring, the education fund now has a dedicated home.

state.daily_exercise: Walked round trip to the credit union, about 30 minutes.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ma Xiulan exchanged embroidery skills with a childhood friend online. In the afternoon, she focused on embroidering for two hours; the soreness and stiffness in her neck worsened, but she insisted on finishing. In the evening, the family relaxed and watched TV, and she seized the opportunity to share daily life in the group chat.

events.name: Exchanging embroidery patterns with a childhood friend on WeChat.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan sent photos of her recently embroidered handkerchiefs to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei via WeChat. The two discussed stitching techniques and color matching for quite a while. Liu Chunmei praised her for making rapid progress and encouraged her to embroider more, saying she might receive orders.

events.name: Focused on the half-finished embroidery.
events.description: In the afternoon, while the children were playing by themselves, Ma Xiulan continued embroidering the handkerchief she had started sketching yesterday in the living room. It took her two hours to finish embroidering the main petals. As she bent over the embroidery, the soreness in her neck became increasingly obvious. She stopped several times, rubbed it, and then kept working, determined to finish.

events.name: Family TV time
events.description: In the evening, the whole family watched a variety show for a while. As she watched, Ma Xiulan browsed life hacks on her phone and shared the day's good mood in the family WeChat group with her younger sister.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Relaxed, ready to create

end_state.location: Living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.
end_state.mood: Both satisfied with completing the embroidery and a bit irritable due to a sore neck

state.daily_exercise: Housework for about 30 minutes; sat embroidering for 2 hours.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan organized the whole family to make a family photo album together. Halfway through, they ran out of glue, so she went out to buy more. In the end, they used photos, cutting, and writing to capture last year's wonderful memories, and the family atmosphere was warm and joyful.

events.name: Preparing photo album materials
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan rummaged through the drawer and found old photos, colored paper, scissors, glue, and other items. She spread newspapers on the living room coffee table and called the children over to make things together, but found that only half a bottle of glue was left and worried it wouldn't be enough.

events.name: Go out to buy glue.
events.description: Ma Xiulan asked her husband to organize the photos with the children first, while she hurried to the community supermarket to buy glue and also bought a pack of sticker decorations. The round trip took about 15 minutes.

events.name: The whole family divided up the work to make a photo album
events.description: In the afternoon, the family officially started making it. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was in charge of cutting photos and colored paper; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, pasted the photos onto the inner pages; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, drew decorative borders with colored pens. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, also joined in on his own, writing the shooting date and a short note next to each photo. The family divided the work and chatted about funny stories from last year's outings and holidays while working. Although Ma Xiulan's neck was sore, she smiled happily.

events.name: Present the results and tidy up
events.description: In the evening, the photo album was completed, and the whole family looked through the final result together. Ma Xiulan said that from now on she wanted to make one every year, and placed the album on the TV cabinet in the living room for display. Afterward, she put away the remaining materials and restored the tabletop to its tidy state.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Excited and preparing to launch a family activity

end_state.location: Living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.
end_state.mood: Warm, full of family memories.

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 15 minutes to buy glue; the rest of the day was mainly indoor activities.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, temperature -4 to 2°C, north wind force 3.

2025-01.daily_overview: The continuous head-down embroidery and housework left Ma Xiulan with an unbearable sore neck. She started hot compresses on her own and searched online for ways to ease it. She decided to visit the community clinic the next day, feeling a little low.

events.name: Neck soreness worsened
events.description: After getting up in the morning, Ma Xiulan felt that the stiffness and pain in her neck were worse than in the past few days, and it was even difficult to turn her head. She barely managed to make breakfast and take the children to school. After returning home, she felt she could no longer tough it out.

events.name: Applied hot compresses on her own and studied online.
events.description: She applied a hot towel to her neck while searching online on her phone for ways to relieve neck soreness at home. She tried a few simple slow rotation movements, but the effect was not obvious. She called Dr. Wang at the community clinic and described the symptoms. Dr. Wang advised her to come in for an examination tomorrow.

events.name: Reduce chores that require looking down
events.description: That day, she deliberately spent less time doing housework with her head down, trying to keep her neck straight while washing dishes and vegetables. In the afternoon, instead of doing embroidery, she sat and flipped through her previous embroidery pieces, feeling a bit restless, worried that her health might affect future odd jobs.

events.name: Evening heart-to-heart with her husband.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan told her husband about her neck pain. Ma Zhiqiang rubbed her shoulders and reassured her that she would feel better after seeing a doctor tomorrow. Ma Xiulan felt comforted but still somewhat worried.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Neck pain and discomfort, slightly irritable.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Awaiting the appointment, pain brings anxiety.

state.daily_exercise: About 40 minutes of housework (reduce looking down), simple neck exercises.

2025-01.daily_overview: In the morning Ma Xiulan tried the stretches she learned online, but with little effect. Later in the morning she asked her childhood friend for advice, then went to the pharmacy and bought a box of medicated patches to apply herself. In the evening, while keeping accounts, she decided she must go to the clinic tomorrow.

events.name: Morning stretching attempt
events.description: After getting up in the morning, Ma Xiulan, despite her neck pain, did a set of shoulder and neck stretches learned from the internet, but the stiffness did not improve noticeably. She was somewhat disappointed.

events.name: Call a childhood friend and buy medicated patches
events.description: After finishing simple housework in the morning, she called her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to vent. Liu Chunmei recommended a pain-relieving plaster for promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis, saying her own mother-in-law had used it with good results. Ma Xiulan then walked to a nearby pharmacy and bought a box. After returning home, she applied it to the sore spots according to the instructions.

events.name: Evening bookkeeping and determination.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan opened the bookkeeping app to record the day's expenses. The medicated patch cost 25 yuan, and she put it under the medical budget in her notebook. Thinking that she must go to the community clinic tomorrow for a proper check-up and not delay, she looked at her sleeping children before bed and hoped she would get better soon.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Beware of neck pain and take rehabilitation seriously.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Improvement was limited, so she decided to see a doctor, feeling a bit heavy-hearted.

state.daily_exercise: Walk about 15 minutes to the pharmacy and do 5 minutes of morning stretching.

2025-01.daily_overview: In the morning, Ma Xiulan went to the community clinic for a formal consultation and was diagnosed with shoulder and neck muscle strain; she was prescribed topical medicine and systematic stretching guidance. In the afternoon, she carefully prepared a reward for her eldest son's academic progress, publicly praised him at dinner, and gently reassured her second son. The bedtime story made both brothers feel their mother's love.

events.name: Go to the community clinic to see a doctor
events.description: After dropping off her children in the morning, Ma Xiulan walked to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center and registered to see Dr. Wang Jianguo. Dr. Wang asked in detail about when the symptoms started and her daily habits. After palpating her neck, he formally diagnosed shoulder and neck muscle strain, prescribed a box of topical plasters for promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis, and on the spot taught her a set of targeted shoulder and neck stretching exercises, telling her to do them once every morning and evening, to pay attention to her sitting posture, and to avoid keeping her head down for long periods. Ma Xiulan carefully noted all the instructions.

events.name: Pick up the medicine and go home to apply it.
events.description: She picked up the medicine at the pharmacy and walked home. Once home, she immediately applied a new medicated patch to the sore area as directed by the doctor, and then carefully did a full round of stretching.

events.name: Choosing reward stationery
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan, enduring the lingering soreness in her neck, went to the stationery store near Jingwen Road and picked out a new set of stationery for her eldest son, including pens, notebooks, and a pencil case, as a reward for his improvement in the final exam scores. She spent about 30 yuan.

events.name: Praise and comfort at dinner.
events.description: In the evening, the family of five had dinner together. Ma Xiulan handed the new pencil case to her eldest son and praised him in front of the family for his improvement in grades. Noticing the envious look on her second son Ma Mingzhe's face, she deliberately called him aside after the meal, gently affirmed his efforts, and promised that as long as he improved, he would get a reward too.

events.name: Bedtime stories and stretching
events.description: Before going to sleep, Ma Xiulan went to her second son's bedroom, told a story about a little animal working hard to improve, and encouraged him again. Returning to her own room, she followed Dr. Wang's advice and did another set of bedtime shoulder and neck stretches, feeling her muscles relax somewhat.

start_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: With neck pain, but determined to see a doctor to solve the problem.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Gratified; the parent-child relationship has grown closer, and she is confident about the recovery

state.daily_exercise: Walk to and from the clinic takes about 15 minutes; do shoulder and neck stretches for 10 minutes each morning and evening.

date_attribute.weather: Clear and cold, northwest wind level 3, high of 4°C, low of -6°C

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first day of winter vacation, Ma Xiulan focused on her children's learning feedback and health management. In the morning, after receiving her eldest son's final exam results, she promptly communicated with the homeroom teacher, noted the suggestions, and made a holiday plan; in the evening, she had a warm interaction with her eldest son, encouraging his academic progress. At the same time, following the doctor's advice, she began daily shoulder and neck stretches, bringing health awareness to her busy winter vacation life. At noon, absorbed in bookkeeping, she ate lunch in a hurry and felt a slight stomach discomfort.

events.name: Check the eldest son's final grades and prepare to talk with the homeroom teacher.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa in her living room and used her phone to check the parent group notifications and text messages sent by the school, learning about her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's final exam results. She carefully looked at each subject's score and noticed that math had improved from 78 in the midterm to 89, while Chinese and English remained stable. She felt both gratified and aware that she still needed to communicate in depth with the homeroom teacher, so she went over in her mind the questions she planned to ask: class participation, how he got along with classmates, and holiday study suggestions.

events.name: Called homeroom teacher Han Mei to get detailed information about the child's performance at school.
events.description: At 9:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan called her homeroom teacher, Han Mei. She first thanked Teacher Han for her hard work over the semester, then asked in an organized way about Mingxuan's overall performance at school. Teacher Han said Mingxuan had made obvious progress in math and raised his hand to answer questions more often in class, but his Chinese reading accumulation was still insufficient, and she suggested he read more extracurricular books and write simple notes during the vacation. The two talked for about 15 minutes, and Ma Xiulan listened attentively and took it to heart.

events.name: Record the teacher's suggestions and plan holiday supervision measures.
events.description: After the call, Ma Xiulan took a notebook with a plastic cover from the drawer, sat down at the dining table, and neatly wrote down: Teacher Han praised her child's progress in math and suggested reading extracurricular books for half an hour every day, also noting the types of books suitable for middle school students. Then she also wrote down how she planned to supervise her children during the vacation: check their reading every day, have them write a short weekly journal, and limit time on their phones. She thought about specific ways to implement this as she wrote, spending about 10 minutes. At noon, because she was absorbed in bookkeeping, she ate lunch in a hurry and felt a bit bloated. She rubbed her stomach and rested for half an hour before feeling better.

events.name: Talk to the eldest son about his grades and work together on a winter vacation reading plan.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Mingxuan came back from playing outside (on the first day of winter break, he had gone to a nearby bookstore with classmates). Ma Xiulan called him over and said gently, 'Xuanxuan, Teacher Han called today and praised you for making great progress in math, saying you are more confident in class now.' Mingxuan smiled shyly. Then Ma Xiulan passed on the teacher's suggestion to read more extracurricular books, and discussed with Mingxuan, agreeing together on a daily reading time of half an hour. Mingxuan nodded in agreement, and mother and son also drew a simple check-in chart in the notebook, agreeing to start from tomorrow. Mingxuan's eyes shone with the light of being affirmed, and his confidence in learning clearly increased.

events.name: Start daily morning shoulder and neck stretching to relieve soreness
events.description: Following the advice of Dr. Wang at the community health service center the day before, Ma Xiulan, after getting up and washing up in the morning, laid a small thin mat in her living room and started her first five-minute shoulder and neck stretching routine. She followed a simple video she found on her phone and did several movements, including neck side stretches, shoulder rolls, and arm raises. After finishing, she felt that the previously tight areas around her shoulders and neck had loosened considerably. Although they were a bit sore, she felt much more refreshed. She decided to keep doing it every morning.

start_state.mood: Not fully awake, slightly worried about how busy the winter vacation will be

end_state.mood: Grounded, with confidence in the children's progress and my own health management.

state.daily_exercise: Morning neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, plus about 3 hours of housework.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, easterly wind force 2, high temperature 3°C, low temperature -5°C

2025-01.daily_overview: On the second day of winter vacation, daily chores and taking care of the children took up most of Ma Xiulan's time. She handled three meals and cleaning while supervising the three children's winter vacation homework. In the gaps of her busy day, she kept up her morning stretching and began to think about preparing New Year goods, with some initial ideas about pickled foods forming in her mind. In the afternoon, her childhood friend Liu Chunmei suddenly called to chat, disrupting her original plan to organize the clothes.

events.name: Morning stretching and preparing breakfast for the family
events.description: Ma Xiulan got up 10 minutes earlier than usual. At 7 o'clock, she first did her 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch in the living room, and the light feeling in her shoulders and neck lasted into the morning. Then she went into the kitchen, used the leftover leavened dough from the previous day to make several home-style flatbreads, cooked a pot of millet porridge, and served it with her own pickled vegetables, preparing a hot breakfast for the whole family. The children got up one after another and noisily gathered around the table.

events.name: Morning chores and reminding the children to finish their winter vacation homework.
events.description: After seeing her husband Ma Zhiqiang off to work, Ma Xiulan began to clear the dining table and tidy the kitchen, wiping down the stove and the surface of the range hood with a cloth. Then she went to the children's room and found that her second son, Ma Mingzhe, was playing with building blocks instead of doing his homework. In a calm, unhurried tone, she reminded him: Zhezhe, do the two pages of math problems the teacher assigned this morning first, and play this afternoon. She then checked Mingxuan's schedule, saw that he had already started reading a popular science book, nodded, and turned to deal with her daughter Ma Yuxin, who was pestering her to help braid her hair.

events.name: Childhood friend Liu Chunmei suddenly called to chat about handicrafts and family life
events.description: At a little past two in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan was about to sort out seasonal clothes when her phone rang. It was her childhood friend Liu Chunmei.
