The two chatted about embroidery patterns, their children's exam scores, and the new snack shop in town, and before they knew it, nearly half an hour had passed. After hanging up, the plan to organize the clothes had to be postponed, but Ma Xiulan felt it wasn't bad to relax and chat like that once in a while.

events.name: Afternoon shopping for some seasonings and vegetables
events.description: After chatting, Ma Xiulan took advantage of her younger daughter's nap, had Mingxuan watch the house, and went to Xingwang Vegetable Market carrying a cloth bag. At Sun Guifang's stall, where she was a regular customer, she bought white radishes, Chinese yam, and a few yuan worth of ginger and garlic, and chatted with Aunt Sun: "Aunt Sun, this year I plan to pickle some soy-sauce radishes myself, so I need to get the ingredients ready in advance." Aunt Sun warmly helped her pick out several firm radishes. On the way home, she also bought a bag of soy sauce and a bottle of mature vinegar at a grocery store.

events.name: In the evening, guided her second son through his homework and talked with her husband on the phone.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Mingzhe had a few math problems he couldn't solve. While Ma Xiulan was preparing dinner in the kitchen, she asked Mingxuan to help his younger brother first. Later, she wiped her hands, came out, and sat patiently next to Mingzhe, explaining the word problems using drawings. Around 5:30, her husband Ma Zhiqiang called, saying he would be home late from transport work and that she didn't need to wait for him for dinner. Ma Xiulan told him to be safe on the road and mentioned that she had already started preparing the New Year goods.

events.name: Relax watching TV in the evening and think about preparations for the Spring Festival.
events.description: After finishing the day's housework and getting the children into bed, Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa and turned on a family drama on Tianjin TV. She watched while mentally planning: the 24th of the twelfth lunar month for a thorough cleaning, the 25th to start pickling radishes, and she also needed to find time to buy Spring Festival couplets and new clothes for the children... She took a small notebook from the coffee table drawer, wrote down a few dates and things to do, making preliminary arrangements for the busy days ahead.

start_state.mood: Calm, ready to face the trivial chores of a new day.

end_state.mood: Slightly tired but fulfilled, with a preliminary plan for Spring Festival preparations

state.daily_exercise: Morning shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes, and about 4 hours of housework

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, light southwest wind, high 6°C, low -4°C.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday, the family atmosphere was relaxed and warm. The younger daughter used her childish paintbrush to express her love for her mother. Ma Xiulan was overjoyed when she received the drawing and put it on the refrigerator as the best decoration. In the afternoon, when neighbors came by, she shared the joy again, and the home was filled with a mother's unique happiness. In the evening, because Mingzhe had a small quarrel with a neighbor's child, Ma Xiulan patiently mediated.

events.name: Her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, drew a picture to express her love for her mother.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Yuxin took out a box of crayons brought home from kindergarten and a few sheets of A4 white paper, leaned over the coffee table in the living room, and drew a picture seriously. She outlined a woman in an apron standing in front of a pot with red and yellow crayons, with a few scribbles next to her representing steam. On the drawing she wrote wobbly, 'Mommy is cooking.' Although the lines were childish, the colors were full and rich, full of childlike innocence and attachment to her mother. After finishing, she happily ran to the kitchen to find Ma Xiulan.

events.name: Ma Xiulan put the painting on the refrigerator, took a photo, and shared it.
events.description: Ma Xiulan's eyes lit up when she received the painting, and she praised Xinxin again and again for drawing so well. She took Xinxin's hand and walked to the kitchen, opened the junk drawer, found a roll of clear tape, tore off a few pieces, and carefully stuck the painting on the most prominent spot in the middle of the refrigerator door. After sticking it up, she stepped back two steps to look at it, then reached out and gently adjusted the corners to make the picture lie flatter. Then she took a photo of the painting with her phone and sent it to the “One Family” relatives' WeChat group, adding a voice message: “Look at what Xinxin drew for me!” Her tone was full of pride.

events.name: Neighbor Wang Guilan from across the way dropped by and praised the younger daughter's painting.
events.description: At three or four in the afternoon, Wang Guilan came to Ma Xiulan's door carrying a small bag of dried sweet potatoes she had made at home. Ma Xiulan warmly welcomed her in and asked her to sit. After chatting about family matters for a while, Ma Xiulan couldn't help pulling Wang Guilan over to the refrigerator and pointing at the painting, saying, "Sister Guilan, look, this was drawn by my Xinxin. She hasn't even started primary school yet, but she can already draw like this!" Wang Guilan looked at it carefully and praised her again and again: "Oh my, this little one really can draw. Xiulan, you are truly blessed!" A contented smile spread across Ma Xiulan's face, and she talked about how serious her daughter was when drawing. The whole living room was filled with love for the child and the warmth of neighborliness.

events.name: Mediate the quarrel between the second son and a neighbor's child.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Mingzhe got into an argument with the neighbor's boy at the front door over a spinning top toy and ran home crying. Ma Xiulan squatted down to find out what had happened—it turned out the other boy had dropped the top on the ground and cracked it. She comforted Mingzhe, then took him by the hand to the neighbor's house. After communicating calmly, the other child's parent compensated him with a new top, and the two boys made up. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to teach Mingzhe to take good care of his toys and to talk things through when problems arise.

start_state.mood: A relaxing and pleasant weekend morning

end_state.mood: Surrounded by her daughter's filial devotion, with a minor hiccup resolved satisfactorily, she felt happy and sweet.

state.daily_exercise: Morning shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes; about 2.5 hours of housework and activities with the children

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy to sunny, southerly wind force 2, high temperature 7°C, low temperature -3°C.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan carefully arranged a family trip to the library. She took the three children to get library cards and choose books, and they spent a quiet morning reading in the reading room to nurture the children's reading habits. In the evening, a childhood friend brought news of an embroidery order, opening up her first handicraft side job opportunity after the New Year. When she did the accounts at night, she found that this month's education savings had not yet been deposited.

events.name: In the morning, preparing to take the children to the library.
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan checked that all three children were dressed warmly enough, gave each of them a stainless steel bottle of warm water, and put the household registration booklet and her own ID card into her cloth bag, because they might be needed for applying for library cards. She also packed a few small buns as snacks. Before going out, she checked each window to see that it was tightly closed, reminded Ma Mingxuan not to forget his heavy coat, and then the family of four locked the door and set off.

events.name: Walk to Jinghai District Library.
events.description: From 156 Jingwen Road to the library is about a 15-minute walk. Ma Xiulan walked in front holding her little daughter Ma Yuxin's hand, with her two sons following on either side. The sunlight was warm on the way, and the children chattered about what books they would read. Mingzhe said he wanted to read about dinosaurs, and Mingxuan wanted to read stories about inventors. Ma Xiulan smiled and reminded them to keep their voices down and watch for cars when crossing the street. She also enjoyed this walking time with her children.

events.name: At the library, obtained a library card and guided her in choosing books.
events.description: After arriving at the library, Ma Xiulan went straight to the service desk and politely explained what she needed. She took out her ID, filled out three simple application forms, and the staff quickly issued three children's library cards, each with a number and expiration date. She walked into the borrowing area, first led Ma Yuxin to the brightly colored children's picture book section and helped her pick out The Very Hungry Caterpillar; then let Ma Mingzhe choose in the comic section on his own, and he happily picked up Dinosaur Adventure; then took Mingxuan to the science bookshelf, where Mingxuan carefully chose Fun Science Experiments. Ma Xiulan offered timely suggestions nearby, but didn't force anything, letting the children decide for themselves.

events.name: The whole family reads quietly in the reading area.
events.description: After choosing the books, they found a four-seat reading table by the window and sat down. Ma Xiulan herself took a copy of "Family Life Encyclopedia" from the magazine rack and flipped through it. She looked up and saw Mingxuan already buried in his popular science book, occasionally pointing at the illustrations; Mingzhe was quietly laughing behind his hand at the comic story; Yuxin was pointing at the caterpillar in her picture book and mumbling to herself. The late-morning sunlight slanted into the reading room, and Ma Xiulan felt a solid sense of contentment—the sight of her children loving books made everything worthwhile.

events.name: After completing the borrowing procedures, she walked back home.
events.description: About an hour later, Ma Xiulan saw that it was about time, so she took the children to the service desk to complete the borrowing procedures. She showed her library cards one by one, the staff scanned and registered the books, and she put away the three borrowed books. On the way back, the children excitedly shared the interesting things they had each read. Ma Xiulan smiled and praised them: 'You all did very well today. From now on, let's come every month. During the winter break, you should set aside time each day to read, and Mom will join you.' The children cheered and jumped. The house key turned the lock, and a familiar scent greeted them at the door.

events.name: Childhood friend Liu Chunmei came by to tell her about a handmade order opportunity.
events.description: Just after one in the afternoon, childhood friend Liu Chunmei rode an electric bike to Ma Xiulan's door, carrying a bag of steamed bean buns she had made at home. The two sat down in the living room, and Liu Chunmei told her that Boss Wang from a small shop in town recently needed 10 hand-embroidered handkerchiefs, at about 15 yuan each for the labor cost, 150 yuan in total. The pattern should be a simple and elegant plum blossom design, and the goods were to be delivered within a week. Ma Xiulan felt this was exactly what she was good at and agreed immediately. She and Chunmei arranged to go to the shop together tomorrow morning to look at the patterns and pick up the materials. After sending Chunmei off, Ma Xiulan calculated that this income could help support the family, and the corners of her mouth lifted slightly without her noticing.

events.name: Add the forgotten education savings to the accounts in the evening
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan took out her mobile bookkeeping app and remembered that this month's regular education savings (200 yuan per month) had not yet been transferred to the dedicated account. She quickly used mobile banking to transfer 200 yuan from her change balance and made a record in her notebook. After saving, she breathed a sigh of relief and felt that she should set a reminder in the future to avoid forgetting again.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the planned trip to the library.

end_state.mood: Satisfied, and delighted by the children's interest in reading and the new part-time job opportunity

state.daily_exercise: Morning shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes, walking about 3 kilometers round trip to the library, and household chores.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast, temperature slightly dropped, high 2°C, low -7°C, northeast wind force 3-4

2025-01.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan officially started the first production day for her embroidery order. In the morning, she went with her childhood friend to the small shop to confirm the patterns and pick up materials; in the afternoon, she focused on embroidering at home. In the evening, her husband announced his decision to cut down on smoking, bringing a breath of fresh air to both the family's health and finances. During embroidery breaks, her shoulders and neck became stiff and sore, so she stopped midway and did a set of stretches.

events.name: Go with Liu Chunmei to the small shop to pick up embroidery materials and clarify the requirements
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ma Xiulan met Liu Chunmei and they went together to a small shop in town. The shop owner, Boss Wang, was in his forties. He courteously took out several white pure cotton handkerchiefs and several bundles of embroidery thread, then spread the pattern samples on the counter. Pointing to a plain plum blossom pattern, he said, “Just this one. It doesn't need to be too complicated, but it must be fine.” Ma Xiulan looked at the pattern carefully and nodded to indicate it was no problem. She selected all the materials. Boss Wang told her to deliver within a week. Ma Xiulan carefully put the materials into her cloth bag, said goodbye to Chunmei, and went home alone.

events.name: In the afternoon, I started embroidering the first handkerchief at home.
events.description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan cleaned off the dining table and carried a chair with a backrest over to the window with the best light in the living room. She opened her sewing box and took out an embroidery hoop, embroidery needles, and a thimble. First she lightly traced the outline of a plum blossom in pencil on one corner of the first handkerchief, then threaded a needle with pink silk thread and began to embroider stitch by stitch. She was used to the satin stitch and the coiling stitch. Although she had practiced a lot at home, this was her first formal order, and she unconsciously pulled the stitches somewhat tight. After embroidering for nearly an hour, her right shoulder began to feel sore. She put down her needle and thread, stood up, did several sets of shoulder circles and chest-expansion exercises, drank some warm water, and then sat down to continue. She rested once more after another hour.

events.name: In the evening, her husband took the initiative to cut down on smoking.
events.description: In the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home a bit earlier than usual. After dinner, he sat on the sofa and said to Ma Xiulan, a little awkwardly, "Xiulan, I've done the math: a pack and a half of cigarettes a day costs over ten yuan, three or four hundred a month. From now on I'll try cutting down to ten a day, and the money we save can go to the kids." Ma Xiulan felt a warmth in her heart and said "good" over and over, encouraging him that he could definitely do it. She took the opportunity to add, "Let's put the cigarette money in the ledger as our family's health savings." The two of them checked the cigarette receipts together, and the atmosphere at home that night was especially understanding and open.

start_state.mood: Full of enthusiasm for the embroidery order

end_state.mood: Satisfied. The handmade orders have gotten off to a good start, and her husband's decision to cut down on smoking has made the family more united.

state.daily_exercise: Morning neck and shoulder stretch for 5 minutes, housework, and actively moving neck and shoulders during embroidery.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to clear, northwest wind level 2, high 3°C, low -5°C

2025-01.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan had a full and industrious day. Besides preparing three meals for the family and supervising the children's schoolwork, she invested almost all her spare time in embroidery. Through continuous work, she finished most of the orders and carefully inspected the stitching of every handkerchief, demonstrating her dedication to her craft. In the evening, because her throat was dry and itchy, she drank homemade pear water and went to bed early.

events.name: Continued embroidering the handkerchief in the morning; more than halfway done.
events.description: After finishing her morning stretches and breakfast, Ma Xiulan cleaned off the table and sat down again to embroider. With yesterday's experience in mind, she consciously loosened the pressure in her fingers to make the stitches more even. She embroidered while softly humming a tune she had learned from TV. By lunchtime, she had finished embroidering the fourth, fifth, and sixth handkerchiefs. The three plum blossom pieces were laid side by side on the table. Though still slightly wrinkled, the overall effect was already smoother and more natural than yesterday.

events.name: In the afternoon, she squeezed in embroidery between household chores.
events.description: In the afternoon, her younger daughter Ma Yuxin wanted her mother to watch cartoons with her. Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa with her embroidery hoop, accompanying her to watch Peppa Pig while her hands kept embroidering petals. In the middle, Mingzhe ran over to ask a math question. She put down her needle and thread, explained patiently, then went back to continue. In this way of squeezing out time, by 4 pm she had finished three more, leaving only the last one. She moved her stiff shoulders a bit, felt some fatigue in her neck and shoulders, then stood up and did a few stretching movements to relieve it.

events.name: Finished all the handkerchiefs in the evening and inspected each one.
events.description: In the evening her husband called to say he was coming home for dinner, so Ma Xiulan quickly stir-fried two dishes. After dinner she turned on the living room light and sat down to embroider the last handkerchief. Around eight o'clock, all 10 handkerchiefs were finished. She put away the needles and thread one by one, spread the 10 handkerchiefs flat on the sofa, and examined them carefully under the light: she found that two had embroidered edges that were too tight, causing the handkerchiefs to pucker slightly, so she lightly steamed them with a steam iron to try to improve them; on another, the blue flowers were not full enough in color, so she added a few stitches. Although there were still some small flaws, the overall effect was elegant and tasteful, and she decided to deliver them early the next morning.

events.name: Had a sore throat, boiled pear water, and went to bed early
events.description: Probably because she talked a lot during the day and didn't drink water in time, Ma Xiulan felt a dry, itchy throat. She cut two pears and boiled a pot of pear water with a few rock sugar lumps, and each family member had a bowl. Feeling fatigue set in, she sent the children to bed a little earlier than usual, and she herself lay down before ten o'clock.

start_state.mood: Eager to complete the order, slightly nervous

end_state.mood: Relaxed; the sense of accomplishment from completing the order offset the day's fatigue.

state.daily_exercise: Morning neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, intermittent stretching during afternoon embroidery, and household chores.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, light west breeze, high temperature 4°C, low temperature -4°C

2025-01.daily_overview: In the morning, Ma Xiulan completed the delivery of the embroidery order and received the payment, which greatly boosted her confidence. In the afternoon, while buying groceries, she happened to meet Zheng Xiuying, who had introduced her to part-time jobs, and proactively asked about casual work opportunities. She then carefully wrote down the information and began to think about a stall plan for a future handicraft market. That day made her see more possibilities for increasing her income through a side business. On the way home, she bought sugar-roasted chestnuts at a street corner to treat her family.

events.name: Delivered embroidered handkerchief and received payment
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan took a plastic bag with 10 handkerchiefs and left the house. After a 20-minute bus ride, she arrived at the small shop in town. Boss Wang saw her coming, took the handkerchiefs, and spread them one by one on the glass counter to examine closely. He nodded and said, 'The embroidery is good, though a few edges are a little tight, but overall they can be sold.' Then he counted out fifteen 10-yuan bills from the cash box and handed them to her. Ma Xiulan took them with both hands and said with a smile, 'Thank you, Boss Wang. If there's more work next time, find me again — I'll embroider even better.' She carefully folded the money and put it in her inner pocket. When she walked out of the shop, she felt the sunshine was warmer than usual.

events.name: After returning home, she recorded the income and customer feedback in detail.
events.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan took out the family ledger with the green cover from the cabinet. She turned to a new page and neatly wrote: January 22, 2025, embroidery order income 150 yuan. Then on a new line she added a note: "Boss Wang commented: the embroidered edge is a bit tight, but the pattern is clear, and you can take more orders." She then jotted down Boss Wang's phone number and store address. Closing the ledger, she put the 150 yuan into an iron box in the bedroom drawer—the place where the family kept temporary reserve funds.

events.name: Went to Xingwang Vegetable Market in the afternoon to buy groceries
events.description: Around three in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan carried her vegetable basket to Xingwang Vegetable Market. She first went to Sun Guifang's stall and bought cabbage, potatoes, and some green peppers. Aunt Sun, as usual, rounded down the change and also tucked a small bunch of cilantro into her basket. Ma Xiulan thanked her and was about to leave when she heard someone call her.

events.name: Ran into part-time job introducer Zheng Xiuying and proactively asked about gig work opportunities
events.description: The person calling her was none other than Zheng Xiuying. The two stood by the vegetable stall and chatted. Ma Xiulan remembered that she had just delivered her goods that morning, so she felt a bit more confident, and took the initiative to say, "Sister Zheng, I've taken on an embroidery job lately, and it's going all right. If you hear of any odd jobs, please keep me in mind." Zheng Xiuying's eyes lit up and she nodded again and again. "You really are something, sister! I heard that a few shops in town may need people for sewing and mending during New Year. I'll ask around for you. I'll call you as soon as I hear anything."

events.name: Zheng Xiuying gave the specific store information, and Ma Xiulan carefully noted it down.
events.description: Zheng Xiuying thought for a moment and added, "That fabric shop at the entrance of the old street ahead, and the tailor shop next to the post office — they often take in alteration work. If you can do mending, you'll definitely have a chance. I'll tell you the shop owners' surnames..." Ma Xiulan quickly took out the small notebook she carried with her from her bag and jotted down the shop names, locations, and possible needs that Zheng Xiuying mentioned. The two chatted a bit more about their children before waving goodbye.

events.name: After returning home, sort through potential opportunities and browse market photos.
events.description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan put away the groceries in the kitchen, then sat at the dining table and recopied the information she had just noted into her notebook, underlining key items such as "Laojie Fabric Workshop - Sister Wang" and "Tailor Shop - Master Zhou". Then, as if remembering something, she took out her phone and looked through photos taken last autumn at the local handicraft market: the stalls were lined with exquisite embroideries and weavings, with people coming and going. Staring at the photos, an idea grew clearer and clearer—when spring comes, she and Xiuqin could set up a stall together to sell their own embroidered and hand-knitted goods. This thought brightened her mood.

events.name: Buy sugar-roasted chestnuts as a small surprise for the family.
events.description: On the way home, she passed a nut stall and the aroma of hot sugar-roasted chestnuts drifted over. Ma Xiulan remembered that the children loved them, so she weighed out ten yuan's worth of chestnuts. When she got home, the children gathered around to shell them, and the house was filled with a sweet fragrance.

start_state.mood: Full of confidence, looking forward to a smooth order handover.

end_state.mood: Filled with hope and a clearer vision for future side-business paths

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of morning shoulder and neck stretching, about 1 hour of walking outdoors, and household chores.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and cold, northwest wind force 4, high 2°C, low -8°C.

2025-01.daily_overview: The 24th day of the twelfth lunar month is the traditional Dust-Sweeping Day. Ma Xiulan led the whole family in a thorough house cleaning, from high lamp fixtures to the dead corners under beds, from washing windows to removing and washing the bedding. The family divided the work and cooperated, busy yet orderly, sweeping away the dust of the old year to welcome the new year. After the heavy labor, her back pain flared up, but seeing the home looking brand new, she still felt deeply gratified.

events.name: The whole family mobilized to start the year-end clean-up.
events.description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up earlier than usual. After a quick breakfast, she called her husband and three children into the living room and announced with a smile, "Today is house-cleaning day! Let's all work together and make the house bright and spotless!" She assigned tasks to everyone: her husband Ma Zhiqiang was responsible for climbing the ladder to remove light fixtures and clean the ceiling; she herself was responsible for washing windows, sweeping cobwebs in the corners, and washing all the washable bedding; her eldest son Mingxuan tidied up the desk and bookshelf; her second son Mingzhe cleaned up his toy box that was scattered everywhere; and her little daughter Yuxin was asked to put small items such as cloth dolls and puzzles into storage bins. Everyone rolled up their sleeves and got to work.

events.name: Morning: focus on difficult and high-up cleaning
events.description: Ma Zhiqiang put on a hat, brought over an aluminum alloy ladder, and carefully removed the lampshades in the living room and bedroom one by one, placing them on old newspaper to wipe them, while gently cleaning the bulbs with a dry cloth. Ma Xiulan tied the mop to a long bamboo pole, reached up to clean the dust from the corners of the ceiling, and stood on a stool to wipe the inside and outside of every window until they were spotless. Cold wind blew in through the gaps in the window frames, turning her hands red from the cold, but watching the glass gradually become clear made her feel at ease. The children were busy too: Mingxuan arranged the books neatly by size, while under his mother's urging, Mingzhe sorted through his broken toys and decided which to keep and which to discard.

events.name: Had a simple lunch and rested briefly
events.description: They were busy until noon, and everyone had dust on their faces. Ma Xiulan cooked a pot of hot tomato and egg noodles. They ate quickly, then drank some hot water. Ma Xiulan patted her lower back, reminded the children to finish up the remaining work in the afternoon, and urged her husband to go to the kitchen to remove the range hood filter and soak it.

events.name: In the afternoon, I took apart and washed the bedding and completed basic cleaning.
events.description: In the afternoon the sun was a little better. Ma Xiulan took the duvet covers off the family's four cotton quilts, carried them to the yard, and stuffed them one by one into the washing machine. While the machine was running, she used a damp cloth to wipe all the door frames and windowsills in the house. Ma Zhiqiang crouched in front of the range hood, laboriously scrubbing off six months of accumulated grease. In the evening, the duvet covers were washed, spun dry, and hung on the clothesline in the yard. Though her hands got cold, they smelled clean and fresh. The house looked much brighter, and the first phase of the big cleaning was a success.

events.name: Lumbar muscle strain, with a dull pain in the old injury area
events.description: When she sat down in the evening, Ma Xiulan felt some soreness and swelling in her lower back. Remembering that she had pulled it a few years ago, she realized it had started protesting after several hours of bending over. Her husband helped her apply a medicinal patch, and she sighed that time waits for no one, deciding to take it easy when finishing up tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, ready for a big effort

end_state.mood: Although my back ached, seeing the clean and tidy home made me feel light and clear inside.

state.daily_exercise: Morning neck and shoulder stretching for 5 minutes, plus about 8 hours of high-intensity housework throughout the day.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, temperature slowly rising, high 5°C, low -3°C

2025-01.daily_overview: On the second day of the big cleaning, Ma Xiulan led the whole family to finish the remaining work, leaving the house spotless. In the afternoon, she invited her childhood friend Liu Chunmei over for tea and embroidery appreciation. The two friends sat together, chatting and exchanging handicraft skills, adding a leisurely moment of friendship as the Spring Festival approached. Chunmei brought word cards once used by her granddaughter and gave them to Yuxin.

events.name: Finished the final cleaning and tidying of the thorough housecleaning in the morning.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan brought in the quilt covers that had been hung in the room the night before. They had already dried completely thanks to the heat of the radiator, so she put the quilt cores back into the covers and folded them neatly. Then she picked up the mop, dipped it in warm water mixed with cleaning detergent, and carefully mopped the floors of the living room, bedrooms, and hallway, even wiping the baseboards. Under her direction, the children put the odds and ends back in their places, and Mingxuan wiped the water marks off the glass he had cleaned yesterday with a dry cloth. By noon, the whole house radiated a fresh, clean feeling, and the sunlight streamed in brightly. Ma Xiulan looked around with satisfaction, feeling that this was what it meant to prepare for the New Year.

events.name: Invite her childhood friend Liu Chunmei via WeChat to come over in the afternoon for tea and to admire the embroidery.
events.description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan remembered that she still had a few of the handkerchiefs she had embroidered the previous couple of days at home as samples, so she wanted to invite Chunmei over to enjoy them together. She took out her phone, opened WeChat, and sent Liu Chunmei a voice message: “Chunmei, are you free this afternoon? Come to my place for tea. I'll show you the plum blossom handkerchiefs I just embroidered, and we sisters can chat for a while.” Chunmei quickly replied, “Sure, I'll be over around three.”

events.name: Preparing refreshments and showing handmade patterns
events.description: While the children were having their afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan wiped down the coffee table, put some melon seeds and peanuts on a white porcelain plate, boiled a pot of water, and brewed the jasmine tea she had bought earlier this year. From her sewing box, she took out the sample handkerchief embroidered with plum blossoms and the pattern drawings for several new designs she had learned from an online community previously — orchids, bamboo leaves, and daisies — and spread them all out on the coffee table, waiting to share them with her good friends.

events.name: Tea and chat with a childhood friend, sharing embroidery work and New Year outlook
events.description: Just after three o'clock, Liu Chunmei walked in carrying two cups of milk tea bought at the street corner and a small stack of literacy cards. The two sat down on the sofa, with warm steam curling up from the tea. Ma Xiulan handed over the handkerchief. Chunmei looked at it over and over and exclaimed with admiration that Xiulan's hands were getting more and more skillful, and that the plum blossoms were embroidered so lifelike she felt she could smell their fragrance even standing there. Ma Xiulan smiled sheepishly at the praise, then showed Chunmei the patterns one by one, and the two discussed how to match the colors with elegance. Chunmei urged her to take on more of this kind of work in the future, saying the pay was fair and it wouldn't delay taking care of the children. Ma Xiulan nodded and said she planned to try setting up a stall at the market after the New Year. The two then chatted about the children's exams and New Year preparations until the sky began to darken, and only then did Chunmei reluctantly take her leave. Ma Xiulan walked her to the door; the cold wind was blowing outside, but her heart was warm.

start_state.mood: Full of energy and looking forward to finishing the thorough cleaning

end_state.mood: Comfortable and joyful; chatting with a childhood friend gave me more confidence in my handicraft hobby.

state.daily_exercise: Morning shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, about 3 hours of housework in the morning.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with a gentle breeze, temperatures rising, high 7°C, low -2°C.

2025-01.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan began making pickled radish as a Spring Festival gift, from selecting ingredients, washing, cutting into strips, to curing, meticulously. While tidying a drawer, she unexpectedly found an old digital camera, took the first New Year photos of the children, and created a 2025 family photo folder, thus starting a warm family documentation tradition. In the evening, she video-called her mother and learned a new technique for enhancing the flavor of pickled vegetables.

events.name: In the morning, select and process radishes to prepare pickled vegetables.
events.description: On Saturday morning, Ma Xiulan brought out half a bag of white radishes from the storage room at home, checked each one carefully, and selected about 20 jin of radishes that were uniform in size, smooth-skinned, and free of black spots. She filled a large basin with clean water, scrubbed the mud off the radishes with a brush, then used a peeler to remove the root whiskers and imperfect parts. Then she placed the radishes on a cutting board, first cut them into thick slices and then into finger-thick strips; the even strips covered two large basins. She sprinkled several handfuls of coarse salt into the basins, tossed them up and down with her hands so that every strip was coated with salt, then covered the basins and set them aside to draw out water.

events.name: In the afternoon, mixed the sauce and sun-dried the radish strips
events.description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan took out all the radish strips that had released water, drained them in a bamboo basket, and carried them to the yard to dry in a place with good ventilation and light. The winter afternoon sun was thin but there was wind, and the surface of the radish strips slowly dried. While they were drying, she began to prepare the sauce: she took out light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, aged vinegar, sugar, a few star anise, and a small handful of dried chili peppers, measured and mixed them according to the proportions her mother had taught her, poured them into a small pot, and boiled. After the sugar melted, she turned off the heat and left the pot by the stove to cool naturally to room temperature. By the time the sun was setting, the radish strips were half-dried and slightly soft. She brought them in, ready to officially start pickling them the next day.

events.name: Found an old digital camera while tidying the drawer and took a few test shots.
events.description: In the evening, while tidying the living room drawer, Ma Xiulan touched something hard. She took it out and saw it was an old digital camera that her husband had bought years ago, with some scratches on the body. She tried putting in two AA batteries, and the camera screen actually lit up. She pointed the shutter at a pot of narcissus on the windowsill and pressed the button. Although the focus was slightly blurry, it could take pictures. She excitedly called the three children over: 'Come quick, Mom will take your picture!' The children ran out. In the yard, she took a group photo of Mingxuan, Mingzhe, and Yuxin standing side by side, and also took an individual photo of each. The children crowded around to see themselves on the screen, laughing helplessly.

events.name: In the evening, import the photos into the computer and create a New Year image folder.
events.description: In the evening after the children had gone to bed, Ma Xiulan found the data cable and transferred seven or eight photos from the camera to the old desktop computer at home. She created a new folder in 'My Documents', named it '[2025]', dragged the photos in, and simply renamed the files by date, such as '0125_daffodil' and '0125_three children'. Looking at the children's smiles on the screen, she felt warm inside and decided to take photos every month from now on, so that over the year she could see how the family changed.

events.name: Video call with mother to learn the secret recipe for pickled vegetables
events.description: Before bed, Ma Xiulan video-called her mother Li Xiuying to ask for tips on pickling radishes. Her mother reminded her to add a small spoonful of shrimp oil to the sauce to enhance the umami, and urged her to make sure it was tightly sealed. Ma Xiulan noted this down in her little notebook and planned to adjust the recipe tomorrow. The mother and daughter chatted about everyday things for a while before hanging up.

start_state.mood: The leisurely weekend carries the anticipation of making pickled vegetables.

end_state.mood: The novelty and joy of discovering the old camera; the family documentation plan filled her with anticipation.

state.daily_exercise: Morning shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, and about 4 hours of radish processing and household chores.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with few clouds, stable temperature, high 5°C, low -4°C

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan spent the morning putting the soy-pickled radish into jars for the initial pickling and sealing. Then she and her husband made a list of New Year goods to buy. In the afternoon, the whole family went to the market to buy candies, Spring Festival couplets, and snacks. In the evening, she kept strict accounts, and the total spending on New Year purchases was kept within the budget, reflecting her newly developed good money-management habits. At the market, she ran into an old acquaintance, Zhang Shufen, and chatted for a while.

events.name: Completed jarring and initial curing of the pickled radish
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan brought the dried radish strips from the bamboo basket back into the kitchen. She poured the pre-cooked and cooled sauce into a large porcelain jar, then put the radish strips in by handfuls. Wearing disposable gloves, she stirred the radish and sauce thoroughly until every strip was coated in a dark soy color. She put the lid on the jar, covered the gap around the lid with a clean cotton cloth, and tied it tightly with string. Then she found a writing brush and wrote “First pickling 2025.1.26” on the label stuck to the jar. After moving it to a cool corner of the kitchen, she checked the seal again.

events.name: Make a Chinese New Year shopping list and set a budget with my husband.
events.description: After finishing the pickled vegetables, Ma Xiulan went into the study and took out paper and a pen. She also called her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, over, and the two discussed what to buy for the Spring Festival this year. Thinking as she wrote, Ma Xiulan listed: candy (sunflower seeds, peanut brittle), a pair of Spring Festival couplets and a pair of fortune characters, new clothes for the children (a jacket for Mingxuan, a tracksuit for Mingzhe, and a dress for Yuxin), and condiments that needed to be replenished. She estimated the cost: 50 yuan for candy, 10 yuan for the couplets, about 300 yuan for new clothes, plus miscellaneous items, keeping the total budget within 500 yuan as much as possible. She entered the budget into a mobile expense-tracking app and set up a separate category called "New Year goods." Ma Zhiqiang nodded and said okay, and that they would go to the market together when they had time.

events.name: In the afternoon, the whole family went to the town market to buy Chinese New Year goods
events.description: At two in the afternoon, with the sun shining just right, Ma Xiulan and her family of five put on their jackets and walked to the town's Spring Festival market. The market was bustling and red lanterns hung everywhere. They first bought Spring Festival couplets and the 'Fu' character; Mingxuan helped choose a couplet reading, 'Peace and good fortune every year, and harmony in the family and success in all things.' Then at the dried goods stall, Ma Xiulan carefully picked out melon seeds, peanut candy, and crispy sweets, and after haggling spent 48 yuan. She then bought a few strings of small firecrackers for the children (though she later decided not to set them off for safety and kept them as decorations), spending 210 yuan in total. After each purchase, Ma Xiulan took out her phone and made an entry in her bookkeeping app. Mingxuan watched with curiosity and asked his mother what she was doing, and Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to tell him how important keeping accounts is for the family.

events.name: Bumped into neighbor Zhang Shufen and exchanged tips on New Year preparations
events.description: At the candy stall, Ma Xiulan ran into Zhang Shufen, a neighbor who lives diagonally across from her, who was also buying New Year goods with her grandson. The two chatted about this year's prices. Zhang Shufen recommended an inexpensive Spring Festival couplet stall and shared some of the malt candy she had bought with the children. After a brief chat, they each continued shopping.

events.name: In the evening, she summarized the accounts and confirmed that the budget had not been exceeded.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa and opened the bookkeeping app, checking today's expenses item by item: Spring Festival couplets 10 yuan, candy 48 yuan, sunflower seeds and peanuts 22 yuan, other snacks 30 yuan, small firecrackers 20 yuan, totaling 130 yuan (new clothes counted separately, not bought yet). She found that the New Year goods bought today plus the money spent on seasonings in the past few days were still within a manageable range, and she breathed a sigh of relief. She told her husband, and Ma Zhiqiang praised, "Your bookkeeping method really works; we have a much clearer picture now." Ma Xiulan smiled, gaining more confidence in her approach to running the household.

start_state.mood: Full of plans, with the new day packed with arrangements.

end_state.mood: Relaxed; finished the New Year shopping without overspending, and felt a strong sense of achievement in managing finances.

state.daily_exercise: Morning shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes, about 1 hour walking to the market, and housework

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, northerly wind, temperatures slightly lower, high 3°C, low -5°C.

2025-01.daily_overview: As Chinese New Year's Eve approached, Ma Xiulan today finished turning and seasoning the preserved radish in the jar, bottling and labeling it. In the afternoon, she and her husband took the children to the supermarket to buy new clothes. In the evening, she did the last income-and-expense check before the New Year, and total spending was strictly kept within budget. With clear accounts, she knew exactly what the New Year expenses would be. Her husband brought back two boxes of fruit from the factory as New Year goods.

events.name: Turning Over the Jar of Soy-Pickled Radishes and Fine-Tuning the Flavor
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan opened the cotton cloth seal on the pickling crock. Using clean long bamboo chopsticks, she turned the radish strips from the bottom to the top so that every strip was soaked in the sauce. She picked one up and tasted it. She thought the saltiness was enough but the sauce flavor was a bit weak, so she added two spoonfuls of dark soy sauce and a few pieces of rock sugar, then stirred again. After that, she put the lid back on and stuffed the gaps with cloth strips. Then she took out several glass jars that had been washed and dried a few days earlier, scalded them with hot water, turned them upside down to drain, and prepared to fill them the next day.

events.name: In the afternoon, went to the supermarket to choose New Year clothes for the children.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan left the youngest child, Yuxin, with her mother, Li Xiuying, to take care of (her mother had come in the morning to bring some rice cakes and stayed to help). She and her husband took the two sons by bus to a discount supermarket on the edge of the city. With a clear budget, she went straight to the point in the children's clothing section: she picked out a gray padded jacket for Mingxuan and a blue tracksuit for Mingzhe, and both fit perfectly. Then she moved to the girls' section and immediately spotted a little red wool skirt, thinking Yuxin would look like a little lucky doll wearing it. The three items came to 272 yuan in total. After paying, Ma Xiulan immediately noted in her phone app: New clothes expense 272 yuan.

events.name: Husband brought back benefits from work, making the family's festive New Year atmosphere even stronger.
events.description: In the evening, when Ma Zhiqiang came home from work, he carried in two cardboard boxes. They turned out to be New Year goods from the factory: a box of apples and a box of oranges. Ma Xiulan happily took them, picked out a few nice-looking ones, placed them in a fruit bowl on the table, and felt that the New Year atmosphere at home had become even stronger.

events.name: In the evening, tally all expenses and verify against the budget
events.description: Back home, Ma Xiulan laid out all the shopping receipts from the past two days and opened her bookkeeping app to check them item by item: New Year goods and snacks 121 yuan (the 20 yuan firecrackers were recorded as a waste because they decided not to set them off, but she did not deduct them from the budget for now), Spring Festival couplets 10 yuan, new clothes 272 yuan, plus the small scattered expenses for seasonings and fabric earlier, totaling 475 yuan. She found that 25 yuan was still left from the 500 yuan budget, and the fruit her husband brought home was not in the budget, which was like an extra bonus. She showed it to her husband: See, at first I was worried we'd overspend, but instead we saved a bit. Ma Zhiqiang was amused too. On the flyleaf of the account book she wrote a reflective note and silently resolved to live this way from now on.

start_state.mood: Methodical, with a tight pace.

end_state.mood: Pride. The practice of having a frugal New Year was successful, and she became more certain about her financial management methods.

state.daily_exercise: Morning shoulder-and-neck stretching for 5 minutes, about 40 minutes of walking while shopping at the supermarket, and household chores.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, gentle breeze, daytime high 5°C, nighttime -3°C.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Chinese New Year's Eve, Ma Xiulan put the homemade pickled radish into jars and affixed labels in the morning, then put up Spring Festival couplets and prepared the reunion dinner. In the afternoon, she gathered with her sisters at their parents' home to make dumplings and chat about family matters. In the evening, the whole family sat around watching the Spring Festival Gala, staying up to welcome the new year, with the strong flavor of the festival filled with the warmth of family affection. Because she stayed up late watching the gala, her neck and shoulders were a bit stiff.

events.name: In the morning, put the prepared pickled radish into jars as the finished product.
events.description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan brought out the pickled vegetable crock, used clean chopsticks to take out the radish strips, drained off the excess sauce, and put them one by one into glass jars prepared in advance. She pressed them down with her hands, leaving a little space, and packed 8 jars in total, each one tightly packed. Then she wiped the jar rims with a damp cloth and screwed the lids on. Next she took out small red paper pieces she had cut herself and a fine writing brush, neatly wrote the words Ma Xiulan's Handmade Soy-Pickled Radish, Spring Festival of the Yisi Year on them, and pasted them on the jars with glue. The 8 jars of soy-pickled radish were lined up neatly on the kitchen counter, red paper with black words giving a festive air. She planned to give these as gifts to her parents and her older and younger sisters.

events.name: Pasting Spring Festival couplets and hanging “fu” characters to decorate the home with a festive New Year atmosphere.
events.description: Ma Xiulan asked her husband to bring over a ladder, and the children helped hold it steady. The family pasted the Spring Festival couplets bought the day before on both sides of the front door, and stuck an upside-down 'fu' character in the center. Ma Xiulan also found a few small red lanterns left over from previous years and hung them under the corridor. Mingxuan stuck several paper window decorations on the living room window glass. Sunlight filtered through the paper cuttings, casting scattered red shadows on the floor. The small courtyard suddenly had a festive feel.

events.name: In the afternoon, took the whole family back to the parents' home, sisters gathered to make dumplings.
events.description: A little after three in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan and her family of five, carrying four jars of pickled radish and other gifts, walked to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street. Her elder sister Li Xiuyun had already come from Beijing, and her younger sister Ma Xiufen had also arrived with her family. The three sisters were especially delighted to see each other; laughing and joking, they crowded into the kitchen, mixing dough, chopping filling, wrapping dumplings, and chatting about their own families. Their mother, Li Xiuying, was also nearby preparing cold dishes and braised beef, and the kitchen was steaming hot. The children were in the living room playing games under the care of their father, Ma Jianguo, and bursts of laughter came from time to time.

events.name: Reunion dinner on Chinese New Year's Eve and watching the Spring Festival Gala.
events.description: At six in the evening, a lavish New Year's Eve dinner was set on the big round table: soy-braised beef, stewed fish, four-happiness meatballs, assorted vegetarian dishes, and steaming hot dumplings. Everyone took their seats. Ma Jianguo said some auspicious words, and the whole family raised their glasses to toast the New Year. Ma Xiulan noticed that her father's sideburns had grown grayer, and silently reminded herself to come back more often to visit. After dinner, the family gathered in front of the TV to watch the Spring Festival Gala. They applauded together during wonderful performances and laughed heartily at funny skits, until Ma Xiulan laughed so hard tears came out. Near midnight, firecrackers sounded one after another outside, and the children excitedly ran into the yard to watch fireworks. Leaning against the doorframe and looking at the fireworks filling the sky, Ma Xiulan felt that although the year had not been easy, having her loved ones around at this moment was the greatest happiness. After staying up for the New Year, she rubbed her stiff neck, but her heart was full of warmth.

start_state.mood: Excited and busy, welcoming Chinese New Year's Eve.

end_state.location: Parents' home living room (stayed overnight after New Year's Eve vigil)
end_state.mood: Happiness, gratitude, and the satisfaction of being with loved ones fill my heart.

state.daily_exercise: Morning shoulder and neck stretch for 5 minutes, housework, walk to and from parents' home.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, slightly low temperatures, with a high of 4°C and a low of -6°C.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first day of the Lunar New Year, Ma Xiulan received a red envelope that her sister had thoughtfully slipped to her early in the morning. Touched, she carefully recorded it in her accounts. In the morning she packed the pickled radish into portions; in the afternoon the family of four went to her maternal uncle's house to pay New Year's greetings and brought homemade gifts; in the evening she watched the Spring Festival special with the children at home. Because she had gone to bed late the previous night and got up a bit later this morning, she felt much better after stretching.

events.name: The elder sister privately gave money to express her care.
events.description: In the morning at her parents' home, after everyone had eaten the Lunar New Year's Day dumplings, Li Xiuyun took the chance when no one was looking to pull Ma Xiulan aside. She quietly slipped 500 yuan in cash into her hand and whispered, “Take it. Buy the children some new clothes. Don't tell Dad.” Ma Xiulan tried to refuse but had to accept, and felt a warm glow. She carefully put the money away. The first thing she did when she got home was take out her ledger and neatly write in the Other Income column: “1/29 Sister's kindness 500 yuan,” followed by a small heart. She intended this money as a supplement to the education fund and would not use it casually.

events.name: In the morning at home, I portioned out the pickled radish and prepared Chinese New Year gifts.
events.description: After returning to her own home from her parents' house, Ma Xiulan combined the remaining 4 jars of soy-pickled radish with the ones packed earlier, and picked out two jars to give to her maternal uncle's family. She found several festive red gift bags, put the soy-pickled radish in them, and placed a small bag of candy on top, making the gifts look generous and tasteful. She checked the seal and label of every jar, and only after confirming that everything was correct did she nod with satisfaction.

events.name: In the afternoon, went with the whole family to her maternal uncle's house to pay New Year calls.
events.description: At two o'clock in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan's family of five dressed neatly, carrying pickled radish and two boxes of pastries, took one stop by bus to arrive at her maternal uncle's home at the other end of Jinghai Town. The uncle and aunt warmly welcomed them inside. Mingxuan, Mingzhe, and Yuxin all said in clear, crisp voices, "Happy New Year, Uncle, and good health," making the old man grin from ear to ear. Ma Xiulan opened a jar of pickled radish for everyone to taste, and they all said it was crisp, tender, flavorful, and richly savory. The cousin's wife even asked her for the recipe. Everyone sat around chatting; the table was filled with peanuts, melon seeds, and candy. The children competed over who got the most lucky money, and they stayed until dark before leaving.

events.name: In the evening, after stretching, she watched TV with her family.
events.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan felt her shoulders and neck were a bit stiff from the day's busyness, so she did some extra stretches in the living room. In the evening, the whole family curled up on the sofa watching the Spring Festival special program—a rare moment of leisure.

start_state.mood: The first day of the new year, filled with joy and gratitude.

end_state.mood: Warmth. Receiving my sister's gift and being praised for my New Year greeting gave me a big confidence boost.

state.daily_exercise: Morning neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, additional stretching in the evening, and about 40 minutes of walking during afternoon visits.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the second day of the Chinese New Year, the traditional day for a married woman to visit her parents' home, Ma Xiulan again led the whole family back to her parents. She enjoyed her mother's abundant dishes and was moved by how much older her father had become. After returning home in the evening, she silently decided to spend more time with her parents. She also agreed with her younger sister Ma Xiufen to take the children to the park next week.

events.name: In the morning, check and wrap the gifts to bring when visiting her parents' home.
events.description: Ma Xiulan packed the jars of pickled radish she had set aside the day before into cloth bags, and also packed some candy gift boxes bought a couple of days earlier. She squatted down to check the children's clothes, buttoned them up, brushed off the dust, and asked Mingxuan to help Mingzhe cut the tag off his new tracksuit. After everything was ready, the family picked up the gifts and walked to the parents' home, greeting neighbors with New Year wishes along the way.

events.name: Arrived at her parents' home; the whole family reunited.
events.description: Father Ma Jianguo was looking out the gate early, and beamed as soon as he saw them. "Dad, Happy New Year!" The three children ran over and surrounded their grandpa. Ma Jianguo patted this one's head and that one's shoulder, saying "Good, good" repeatedly. Mother Li Xiuying came out of the kitchen, took the pickled radish from Ma Xiulan's hand, and said with a beaming face, "You brought so much again, you should keep some for yourselves." The whole family squeezed into the living room, and the atmosphere was even more relaxed than on New Year's Eve.

events.name: Mother prepared a table full of hearty dishes
events.description: At noon, Li Xiuying was busy in the kitchen, with Ma Xiulan and her younger sister Xiufen helping. Her mother specially made Tianjin baozi, noodles with gravy, and sweet and sour pork tenderloin — all dishes Ma Xiulan loved. When the food was served, the aroma was tempting, and everyone raised their glasses to toast each other. Ma Xiulan watched her mother moving between the kitchen and the dining table, feeling both grateful and sad.

events.name: After the meal, her father gave out New Year's money, and Ma Xiulan noticed his white hair.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Jianguo took out three red envelopes and lovingly handed them to his three grandchildren. The children thanked him and ran off to compare who had more. Ma Xiulan sat quietly beside her father, chatting about everyday things. She noticed that the white hair at his temples and on top of his head was much more than last year, and his back seemed more hunched. Her heart tightened as she realized that, busy with the children and housework, she didn't actually visit very often. She took her father's hand and said with more seriousness, "Dad, from now on I'll come over once or twice a week and bring some food for you and Mom." Her father smiled and patted her on the shoulder.

events.name: In the evening, she left her parents' home, and after returning home, privately planned to spend more time with them.
events.description: As it got dark, Ma Xiulan's family said goodbye to her parents. On the way back, her younger sister Ma Xiufen walked alongside her, and the two agreed to take the children to Jinghai Park next week when they had time. When they got home, the children chattered as they counted their lucky money. Ma Xiulan sat at the desk and added a few lines to the 'Family Plan' page of her notebook: “Visit Mom and Dad at least once a week; buy Dad a box of good tea every month; check whether Mom and Dad still have their regular medications.” Closing the notebook, she felt a little more at ease.

start_state.mood: Calm, looking forward to going back to her parents' home for a family reunion.

end_state.mood: Gratitude tinged with slight sadness, and a determination to spend more time with aging parents.

2025-01.daily_overview: As the Spring Festival holiday drew to a close, Ma Xiulan shared healthy stretching methods with her husband in the morning, tidied up the household in the afternoon, and in the evening completed her first monthly financial review for January, checking the accounts and setting a new budget for February, while also reinforcing her side-job and bookkeeping habits, laying a solid foundation for the new year's finances. Her husband's cigarette spending control has begun to show results, giving her more confidence in the future.

events.name: After morning stretching, share health tips with her husband
events.description: In the morning, after finishing her stretching in the living room, Ma Xiulan felt especially relaxed in her shoulders and neck. Ma Zhiqiang happened to come by to get some water, so she called him over and said, “Zhiqiang, come do these exercises with me. Your neck must be stiff too from driving every day.” She slowed down and taught him a few side neck stretches and shoulder rolls. Ma Zhiqiang followed along twice and said he did feel a bit better. Ma Xiulan told him to do a little stretching every morning before setting out to drive, to prevent neck problems, and he nodded in agreement.

events.name: In the morning, the whole family tidied up the house after the holiday.
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan saw that sunflower seed shells and candy wrappers were still scattered around the living room, so she mobilized the whole family to do a short cleaning. Mingxuan was in charge of sweeping the floor, Mingzhe helped put the chairs back in place, and Yuxin wiped the coffee table with a small cloth. Ma Xiulan bagged up the kitchen waste that had accumulated over the past few days and had her husband take it out when he left. In less than half an hour, the house was restored to clean and tidy.

events.name: After a short afternoon nap, began the financial review.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, the children were playing quietly in their own rooms. Ma Xiulan sat down at the dining table, spread open her account book, and opened the bookkeeping app on her phone. She reviewed all income and expense entries since she started keeping accounts on January 2, then took out a calculator and began to tally them item by item. On a blank sheet of paper she wrote: income — embroidery 150 yuan, sister's gift 500 yuan, husband's salary (settled before New Year) 2,800 yuan; expenses — New Year goods and new clothes 482 yuan, daily miscellaneous expenses (food and daily necessities) about 600 yuan, husband's cigarette money about 200 yuan, education savings deposit 500 yuan (January 10), other odds and ends about 68 yuan. After offsetting income against expenses, the month had a slight surplus.

events.name: In the evening, discussed with her husband and set the February budget
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan told Ma Zhiqiang the results of the budget review. She pointed out: “Everyday snacks and your cigarette money take up a considerable portion, especially the cigarette money. I estimate we spent over 200 yuan this month. Didn't you say you'd cut down from the 20th? Next month let's set a hard limit: at most 10 yuan a day for cigarettes, okay?” Ma Zhiqiang calculated that 10 yuan could buy seven or eight cigarettes, a little less than now, and agreed. Ma Xiulan also suggested that, as winter odd-job income was unstable, the monthly education fixed savings be temporarily adjusted from the original planned 200 yuan to 150 yuan, to ensure it was saved. The two reached an agreement. Ma Xiulan wrote on the flyleaf of the account book: “February budget: fixed savings 150 yuan, cigarette limit 10 yuan/day, living expenses controlled within 600 yuan.” Closing the book, she felt the family finances were gradually getting on track. At this point, the family's monthly education savings were officially fixed at 150 yuan, the final consensus reached through the couple's continuous adjustment.

start_state.mood: Relax and enjoy the last leisurely moments of the vacation.

end_state.location: Living room at home (preparing to rest after the review)
end_state.mood: Firm and down-to-earth, full of hope for future financial planning and side hustles.

state.daily_exercise: Morning neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, light housework, and several sets of stretches with her husband in the evening

2025-05.daily_overview: On Labor Day, Ma Xiulan completed her stretching and morning walk, then carefully cared for the garden flowers and plants, shared a warm lunch with her family, and made preliminary preparations for the market in the afternoon. The whole day was leisurely.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretches and an early walk.
events.description: She got up at 6:35 in the morning, did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch in the living room, then put on light shoes and briskly walked along Jingwen Road to the neighborhood park, taking 25 minutes at a steady pace. She walked part of the way with her neighbor Zhang Shufen, cheering each other on.

events.name: Morning courtyard care and sharing
events.description: After returning from her walk, she carried a bucket of water and watered the newly sprouted flower seeds and the budding rose seedlings in the courtyard, carefully controlling the flow. Then she used her phone to take pictures of the tender shoots and flower buds and sent them to the family WeChat group, adding, “It makes me so happy to watch them grow day by day.” Her husband replied with a thumbs-up, and the children gave likes.

events.name: Labor Day family lunch.
events.description: At noon, she made noodles with gravy and sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin for the whole family. The three children sat around the table; her husband was rarely home all day. As they ate and chatted, she mentioned amusing stories from the trade fair she attended in April, and her husband encouraged her to keep developing her pickled vegetables.

events.name: Neighborly chats and pre-market preparations
events.description: A little past 3 p.m., she chatted with her neighbor Wang Guilan at the doorway, sharing how the flowers and plants in the courtyard were growing. Then she went back inside, counted the existing embroidered sachets and crochet ornaments, noted the quantities, and made preliminary plans for the market, but was in no hurry to pack.

start_state.mood: Calm, with a slight sense of anticipation.

end_state.mood: Joyful and grounded

In the morning she focused on finishing handmade crafts; in the afternoon she watched TV, rested, and took care of housework; in the evening she briefly talked with her husband after he got off work.

events.name: Morning stretching and walking
events.description: At 6:40, she got up and stretched for 5 minutes, then walked briskly alone along Jingwen Road. She met Zhang Shufen and finished the walk with her, counted her steps at about 2,000, and felt refreshed.

events.name: Rushing to finish handmade crafts for the market.
events.description: After breakfast, she took out the embroidery cloth and silk thread, sat by the living room window, and sewed peace sachets, embroidering flowers and plants with emerald green and pink silk thread. She finished three in the morning. At noon, she crocheted two small coasters, carefully checked the stitches, and, satisfied, put them into the storage box.

events.name: Afternoon rest and WeChat contact.
events.description: In the afternoon she watched a TV lifestyle program for a while, then washed a few pieces of clothing and cleaned the living room. A little after 4 p.m., her childhood friend Liu Chunmei sent her a WeChat message, and they agreed on a time to meet at the market the day after tomorrow. Their tone was light and relaxed.

end_state.mood: Satisfied

2025-05.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ma Xiulan focused on the final preparations for the market, checking and packing all the items, busying herself for nearly three hours, and spent the evening simply with her family.

events.name: Morning stretching and early morning walk.
events.description: Got up at 6:30, did the usual 5-minute stretching, then went out for a walk. The wind was a bit strong today, so she quickened her pace and finished the route in 20 minutes, breaking into a light sweat.

events.name: Packing and checking market supplies.
events.description: After breakfast, she busied herself in the kitchen and living room. She wiped each bottle of homemade pickles clean and checked the seals; picked out the embroidered sachets and crocheted ornaments with the most delicate patterns and wrapped them in clean cloth; and prepared small change, a payment QR code, a small tablecloth, and a hand-written 'Xiulan Handmade' sign. While taking stock, she found one jar of pickles with a slightly loose lid, so she tightened it again and affixed a label to ensure everything was secure.

events.name: Evening family time
events.description: In the evening, her husband watched TV with the children for a while. Ma Xiulan also sat down, and her youngest daughter Yuxin leaned against her. She gently stroked her daughter's hair, and the strain of a busy day eased.

start_state.mood: Focused, slightly nervous.

end_state.mood: Full of anticipation

2025-05.daily_overview: On Sunday market day, Ma Xiulan and her childhood friend Liu Chunmei set up a stall to sell pickled vegetables and handmade crafts, earning 85 yuan. The successful debut boosted her confidence.

events.name: Rushed but consistent morning stretching
events.description: Because she had to leave early for the market, she got up at 6:20, spent only 3 minutes doing a simplified neck and shoulder stretch, and then hurried out the door.

events.name: Meet up with her childhood friend and head to the market
events.description: At 8 a.m., she met Liu Chunmei at the intersection of Jingwen Road. Each carrying large bags, they walked 20 minutes to the community square. After finding their stall, Ma Xiulan quickly spread out a plain floral tablecloth, neatly arranged the pickled vegetables, sachets, and coasters by category, and hung up the sign. The two had rarely been alone together since the April exhibition fair; at first they were a bit reserved, but their tacit coordination in setting up the stall together soon dispelled the awkwardness.

events.name: Market selling and interaction.
events.description: From 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., she stayed at the stall, enthusiastically introducing passersby to the pickling method for pickled vegetables and the symbolism of the sachets. An elderly woman tasted the pickled vegetables and bought two jars; a young mother bought a sachet embroidered with twin lotus flowers for her daughter. During the day, Chunmei helped mind the stall, and the two took turns eating. In the end, they sold two jars of pickled vegetables and three sachets, earning a total of 85 yuan. A woman also left her phone number to order custom embroidered pillowcases.

events.name: Packing up the stall, returning home, and recording insights.
events.description: At 4:30 in the afternoon the market ended. She and Chunmei packed up the stall and returned the stall sign. On the way home, she showed Chunmei the money, and Chunmei was happy for her. When she got home, she gave her husband 85 yuan and told the children interesting stories. In the evening, she opened her notebook, recorded the sales and customer feedback, and came up with the idea of participating in exhibitions regularly and selling online. She solemnly wrote in her account book: income 85 yuan, with the note "successful market debut."

start_state.mood: Somewhat nervous.

end_state.mood: Excited and satisfied

She found her saved floral fabric scraps and silk threads in the storage room and thought about the design: a twin lotus flower on one side and a cartoon bunny on the other. She cut the fabric pieces in the morning and started embroidering the first lotus petal in the afternoon.

start_state.mood: Calm

She found a pack of mung beans stored from last year and planned to make soup with them when the weather turned hot.

Before bed, her husband Ma Zhiqiang called to say he would be on the road for another two days and told her to keep an eye on the house. Listening to his familiar voice, she felt at ease.

2025-05.daily_overview: As the temperature rose, the pickled vegetables for sale developed a white film. Ma Xiulan urgently went online to learn and successfully saved most of them using a water bath method, and deeply summarized the experience.

events.name: Morning stretching and shortened walk due to the hot weather
events.description: Woke up at 6:45, stretched for 5 minutes, went out for a walk but it felt hot and muggy; walked only 18 minutes before going home, still a bit sweaty.

events.name: Checked and found white film on the pickles
events.description: At 10 a.m., she opened the storage cabinet and found a white film floating on the surface of two jars of pickled vegetables. When she leaned closer, there was a slight sour, rancid smell. She immediately judged it was contamination by miscellaneous bacteria caused by the temperature, and her heart tightened.

events.name: Learn rescue methods online.
events.description: She quickly used her phone to search for ways to deal with the white film on pickled vegetables. After browsing several food forums and videos, she learned that the water bath heating method can kill unwanted bacteria without damaging the flavor. Once she confirmed it was suitable, she immediately got to work.

events.name: Rescue by water bath heating and subsequent inspection.
events.description: She picked out the two jars that were most affected, added water to a pot and heated it to about 70 degrees, then placed the pickled vegetable jars in the pot and heated them in a water bath for 15 minutes. After they cooled, the surface film disappeared and the smell was normal. Then she checked all the jars in stock one by one and confirmed the rest were uncontaminated. She lost two jars this time, but saved most of them. She silently noted the process, sighed that there is knowledge everywhere, and resolved to pay attention to storage temperature and learn scientific sterilization in the future.

start_state.mood: As usual

end_state.mood: Feeling fortunate and reflecting

events.name: Morning stretching and walking

events.name: Discovered rosebuds and shared them.

Her husband replied with a thumbs-up, and her mother Li Xiuying sent a voice message praising Xiulan for her skilled hands.

Then she went inside and continued embroidering the little rabbit on the schoolbag; today she began embroidering the pink part inside its ears.
