2025-05.daily_overview: In the morning, attended a community free clinic and all indicators were good; went home to learn low-salt pickled vegetable recipes, bought ingredients in the afternoon, and successfully pickled spicy cabbage and sweet garlic in the evening. Fulfilling and rewarding.

events.name: Morning stretching and walking
events.description: Woke up at 6:40, stretched for 5 minutes, walked alone for 23 minutes, and thought about today's plan to make new pickled vegetables.

events.name: Participating in the community health consultation.
events.description: At 8 a.m., she and Wang Guilan walked to the community square to attend a free clinic. Dr. Wang Jianguo measured her blood pressure at 118/76 mmHg and random blood sugar at 5.6 mmol/L, and the results were ideal. She asked about the benefits of homemade yogurt. Dr. Wang affirmed them and suggested pairing it with whole grains. Wang Guilan's blood pressure was also normal, and the two exchanged smiles.

events.name: Look up low-salt pickled vegetable recipes online.
events.description: After getting home at 10, she wanted to enrich the flavors and lower the salt content. She searched for low-salt fermented pickle recipes on her phone, chose spicy cabbage and sweet garlic, and carefully wrote down the ingredient ratios, steps, and fermentation temperature.

events.name: Buying ingredients and pickling vegetables
events.description: At 2 p.m., she rode her electric bike to the vegetable market, bought Chinese cabbage, garlic, chili peppers, etc. according to the list, chatted about vegetable prices at Aunt Sun Guifang's stall, and Aunt Sun reminded her that sweet garlic should be made with new garlic to stay crispy. In the evening, she went home, first soaked the Chinese cabbage in salted water, then prepared the spicy sauce (chili powder, mashed garlic, glutinous rice paste, etc.), spread it layer by layer, and sealed it in jars. Next she handled the sweet garlic: peeled it, soaked it in light salted water to remove the spiciness, prepared a sweet and sour sauce to cover the garlic cloves, and sealed it. She labeled the two small jars with the date and the source of the recipe, looking forward to the flavor after a week.

start_state.mood: Positive

end_state.mood: Satisfied and tired

state.daily_exercise: Stretched for 5 minutes, took a 23-minute morning walk, walked to and from the square, cycled to buy groceries, and stood while pickling.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Mother's Day, Ma Xiulan took her three children to her parents' home. She gave her mother a peace sachet embroidered by her own hands, made dumplings with her, and chatted about family matters, returning home full of family affection.

events.name: Morning stretching and a short walk.
events.description: Got up at 6:35, stretched for 5 minutes. Because she needed to leave early, she only walked for 15 minutes and briefly met with Zhang Shufen.

events.name: Going with her children to her parents' home.
events.description: At a little past 9 in the morning, she changed the children into clean clothes, put the embroidered peace sachets into small cloth bags, and walked to her mother Li Xiuying's home (No. 45 Shengli Street). On the way, the boys discussed what delicious food Grandma would make, while the youngest daughter Xinxin skipped along and said she would help Grandma pick vegetables.

events.name: Gave sachets and made dumplings for Mother's Day.
events.description: As soon as she entered, she personally hung the peace sachet at the head of her mother's bed. Li Xiuying looked closely at the fine stitching and said in surprise that it was more exquisite than the ones sold outside. Xiulan smiled and said it was all learned from her. Then the mother and daughter trimmed chives, kneaded dough, and mixed filling in the kitchen, exchanging tips on bun filling while wrapping dumplings. The two sons watched TV in the living room, and Xinxin also came over to shape a plump dumpling, making everyone laugh.

events.name: Warm lunch and return home
events.description: At noon, three generations sat together eating chive and egg dumplings. Her mother praised her cooking as even better than her own, and she felt a warmth in her heart. At 3 p.m., Li Xiuying went to the vegetable garden, pulled up a big bunch of spinach, and pressed it into her hands. The mother and daughter agreed to make pickled vegetables together next week. She walked home contentedly with her children and vegetables.

start_state.mood: Warm anticipation.

end_state.mood: Happy and moved

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of stretching, 15 minutes of morning walking, and walking to and from parents' home.

2025-05.daily_overview: The good news came that the social security subsidy had been approved, and Ma Xiulan put it into the education fund. In the morning she cared for the roses and removed pests; at dinner she discussed family finances with her husband, keeping everything steady.

events.name: Morning stretching and walking
events.description: Got up at 6:30, stretched for 5 minutes, and walked with Zhang Shufen for 24 minutes, chatting about social security issues along the way.

events.name: Receive the social security subsidy notice and record it in the ledger
events.description: At 9 a.m., she went to the community service center and received from grid worker Zheng Xiuying the notice that her flexible-employment social security subsidy application had been approved, confirming that 200 yuan per month would be paid into her social security-linked account starting in June. After returning home, she took out her account book, wrote education fund in the day's income and expense column, and set this money aside exclusively for that purpose.

events.name: Morning rose care and pest removal.
events.description: While watering at 6:50, she found a few aphids on the backs of the rose leaves. She gently wiped them off with her hand and sprayed diluted soapy water. She photographed the treatment method and sent it to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. Chunmei replied suggesting that spraying with water used to soak cigarette butts would be more effective.

events.name: Discussed with her husband during dinner.
events.description: In the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home after finishing his run. During dinner, she told him that she had put the social security subsidy into the education fund. He nodded and said, “Okay. Save what should be saved; put aside what should be put aside.” Looking at his dust-covered face, she felt a shared responsibility.

start_state.mood: Feel a little relaxed.

end_state.mood: Grounded

In the evening, as the children bent over their homework, she quietly pressed the shutter and captured their quiet, focused backs.

A health program was explaining the benefits of probiotics for the gut and mentioned that homemade yogurt contains a high amount of live bacteria. She thought of her younger daughter Yuxin, who was occasionally constipated, and decided to try making yogurt herself. She planned to use the money earned at the last market to buy a simple yogurt maker and starter culture, and intended to start on the weekend.

Yuxin was so happy she spun around in circles, and her older brother Mingzhe also clamored that he wanted one. She smiled and said she would make one for him when he reached fifth grade, and privately thought that she might also take custom backpack orders.

events.description: Left at 6:40 and walked briskly along Jingwen Road to the street-corner park for 20 minutes, keeping a steady pace, alone, and recorded 3,200 steps with a pedometer.

events.name: Early morning courtyard garden diary.
events.description: At 7:20, Ma Xiulan came to her courtyard, observed the newly sown flower seedlings and the roses transplanted last month, watered the seedbed thoroughly with a watering can, removed new weeds, and checked the undersides of leaves for signs of aphids and powdery mildew. Then she took photos of the seedlings and new rose branches from multiple angles with her phone and sent the photos and a message to the family WeChat group: Today I officially start taking care of the little garden, and the seeds have all sprouted! Family members replied with encouraging emojis, and she started the day in a good mood.

events.name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
events.description: Around 8 a.m., Ma Xiulan walked to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District. At the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang, she picked out tomatoes, greens, and eggs, and also bought half a jin of pork. After paying at about 9:40, she carried her vegetable basket and returned to her home at 156 Jingwen Road.

events.name: Discovered that the home had been burglarized.
events.description: Around 10 o'clock, she arrived at the door of her home and found the door ajar with pry marks on the lock. Ma Xiulan's heart tightened. She pushed the door open and entered to find the bedroom wardrobe thoroughly ransacked. The 300 yuan cash in the drawer and the silver necklace her mother had given her at her wedding were gone. Her eyes instantly reddened. She hurriedly called her husband Ma Zhiqiang to inform him of the situation, then dialed 110 to report it to the police.

events.name: Police officers arrived at the scene to investigate
events.description: At around 10:30, two police officers from the Jinghai District police station arrived. Officer Wang photographed and documented the scene and asked in detail about the time of the theft, the missing items, and any suspicious people. Ma Xiulan, feeling low, cooperated in giving a statement. The officers told her that the neighborhood had no surveillance cameras and the chances of recovery were very small, advised her to strengthen anti-theft measures, and left a case filing receipt.

events.name: Tidy up the wardrobe that had been turned upside down.
events.description: After the police left, Ma Xiulan, with red-rimmed eyes, folded and put away the clothes in the wardrobe and drawers. She checked and confirmed that only cash and a necklace were lost, and was relieved that the children's school supplies and family photo album were intact. She wiped the cabinet surface with a cloth, sat on the bedside and grieved silently for a while, then pulled herself together and began cleaning.

events.name: Contact to change the lock and order a security door.
events.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan called Liu Jianguo, the community handyman, to explain that her home had been burglarized and the lock needed to be changed urgently. At 1 p.m., Master Liu arrived with tools and a B-grade anti-theft lock cylinder. He removed the broken lock, installed the new lock, and finished adjusting it, charging 150 yuan. At 2 p.m., on Master Liu's recommendation, she contacted a hardware and building materials store to order a simple security door (500 yuan including installation), paid a 300 yuan deposit via WeChat, and agreed on installation the next morning.

events.name: Husband's return home and nighttime safety inspection
events.description: In the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home early from work, carefully inspected the new lock, and comforted his wife. The two discussed storing valuables in separate places. After dinner, the whole family recalled whether any strangers had come by, and the children proactively helped check the windows. Before bed, Ma Xiulan and her husband did 5 minutes of deep-breathing relaxation, placing their hands gently on their knees, reviewing the small blessings of the day—though upsetting, the family was safe. Then they repeatedly checked all doors and windows and decided that from now on, her husband would be responsible for the safety check every night before bed. Although she still felt heavy-hearted, the support of her family made Ma Xiulan feel somewhat reassured.

start_state.mood: Calm and content, looking forward to tending the small garden.

end_state.mood: Exhausted and anxious, but slightly reassured by her family's comfort.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 20 minutes, courtyard watering and weeding for 30 minutes, walking to and from the vegetable market for 40 minutes, tidying the ransacked room and wiping furniture for about 1 hour, and doing daily housework for 2 hours.

2025-05.daily_overview: The installation of the security door finally restored the family's sense of safety, and the trial production of pickled vegetables also brought good news: the spicy cabbage and sweet garlic were unanimously loved by the family. In the afternoon, she exchanged anti-theft tips with neighbors and posted safety notices. The mutual help from the community warmed Ma Xiulan's heart.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Got up at 6:30, did the usual 5-minute stretch, felt the neck slightly stiff, and relaxed after finishing.

events.name: Early morning walk
events.description: At 6:45, walk briskly with neighbor Zhang Shufen along Jingwen Road for 25 minutes, exchanging anti-theft tips, and the two discuss reminding the neighbors together.

events.name: Final inspection and tasting of the finished pickled vegetables.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Ma Xiulan did a final check on the kimchi and sweet garlic that had been fermenting for a week: the kimchi leaves were translucent red with a rich sour and spicy flavor; the sweet garlic had lost its spiciness and turned amber and translucent, with a pleasant sweet-and-sour taste. She invited her husband and three children to taste them together, and everyone said they liked both new flavors. She put the finished products into small jars, took photos to record their appearance, and wrote a summary note on the successful trial production.

events.name: Washing the pickle-making utensils
events.description: After the trial production was completed, Ma Xiulan washed all the used knives, cutting boards, basins, sealing jars, and other utensils repeatedly with dish detergent, scalded them with boiling water to disinfect, dried them, and put them back in place. She also cleaned up the vegetable leaves and sauce left on the countertop.

events.name: Security door installation completed
events.description: At 9 a.m., two installation workers from the building materials store arrived with the security door, removed the old wooden door, installed the new door, and adjusted the door frame and locks. Ma Xiulan supervised the whole process. The installation took about 1.5 hours. After it was done, she paid the remaining 200 yuan on the spot and asked the workers to test the security of the door lock. Only after confirming everything was fine did she finally relax.

events.name: Putting up safety reminders for the neighborhood.
events.description: In the afternoon, while taking out the trash, Ma Xiulan ran into her neighbor across the landing, Wang Guilan, and told her about the burglary and the upgraded security measures. Wang Guilan was shocked and said she would warn the neighbors around. The two then posted handwritten safety reminders on the community bulletin board and several conspicuous spots, reminding everyone to close doors and windows when going out. Zhang Shufen, who lived diagonally opposite, also came over to ask. The three stood at the doorway chatting about community safety for half an hour.

events.name: The whole family tries the new key
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan distributed the new security door keys to her husband and eldest son Ma Mingxuan, and personally taught her second son Ma Mingzhe and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin how to unlock the door correctly, urging them to lock the door immediately after returning home from school. The whole family gathered at the door and practiced repeatedly; from that day on, the safety habit was formally established.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: At 22:30, Ma Xiulan and her husband sat on the edge of the bed, did 5 minutes of deep breathing, reviewed the smooth installation and neighborly help today, and felt relieved.

start_state.mood: Still shaken, but looking forward to the installation of the security door.

end_state.mood: Felt much relieved by the security upgrade and mutual help among neighbors

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 25 minutes, checking pickled vegetables and cleaning utensils for about 1.5 hours, supervising the installation of the security door and cleaning the entrance hall for 1 hour, walking 20 minutes to post safety notices, and daily housework for about 1.5 hours

2025-05.daily_overview: When her husband returned from a driving trip, Ma Xiulan carefully prepared noodles with gravy and stewed pork ribs, but pulled a muscle in her right shoulder while lifting the stew pot. The children presented handmade greeting cards. The dinner was warm and touching, and the shadow of the theft was washed away by the warmth of home.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Got up at 6:40, did the usual 5 minutes of stretching, and got ready for a busy day.

events.name: Early morning walk
events.description: Because her husband was returning today, Ma Xiulan briskly walked alone on Jingwen Road for 20 minutes at 7:00, and on the way went to the vegetable market to buy fresh pork ribs and vegetables.

events.name: Buying fresh ingredients at the vegetable market
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan went to Xingwang Vegetable Market and bought fresh pork ribs, flour, and vegetables at Sun Guifang's stall, planning to prepare a hearty dinner for her husband Ma Zhiqiang when he returned from driving. She specially picked the best ribs, thinking about how hard he worked outside.

events.name: Carefully cooking dinner and right shoulder strain
events.description: Starting in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan was busy in the kitchen, hand-kneading hand-rolled noodles and preparing the sauce broth. When she lifted the heavy pot of stewed ribs from the small stove, her right shoulder suddenly strained and sent a sharp pain through her, and she realized she had pulled a muscle. She endured the pain and continued simmering the ribs over low heat, but she didn't dare move her right arm much. Later, she applied a cold compress with a wet towel and had her second son go to Wang Guilan's house to borrow a medicated plaster to put on.

events.name: The children made hand-painted greeting cards
events.description: After lunch, the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, the second son, Ma Mingzhe, and the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, sat by the living room table making a card for their dad with colored paper, markers, and stickers. Ma Mingzhe specially drew a big truck and wrote "Dad, drive safely" beside it in crooked handwriting. Watching the children so serious and focused, Ma Xiulan quietly filmed the process with her camera.

events.name: Warm family dinner
events.description: In the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang returned from a driving trip. Ma Xiulan carried the noodles with gravy and braised pork ribs to the table with her left hand. During the meal, the children presented greeting cards. Ma Zhiqiang did not say much, but drank a couple more glasses of wine and, unusually, did not smoke. Ma Xiulan noticed her husband looking again and again at the truck his son had drawn, with slightly moist eyes. The whole dinner atmosphere was warm and harmonious.

events.name: Treasured greeting cards and courtyard records
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan carefully smoothed out three greeting cards, placed them in the “Love and Support” section of the family album, and wrote the date. Then she went to the courtyard, watered the flower seedlings and roses while it was still light, took a photo of the new leaves in the evening light with her phone, and shared it in the family group: “Today the little garden grew a little taller.”

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed (simplified due to shoulder injury).
events.description: At 22:45, due to discomfort in her right shoulder, Ma Xiulan sat on the edge of the bed and did simple deep breathing exercises by herself, recalling the warmth of the family reunion and praying that her shoulder injury would recover soon.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired but looking forward to her husband's return

end_state.mood: Content and happy, but with a nagging worry about the pain in the right shoulder.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk 20 minutes; kitchen work such as kneading dough and simmering about 2.5 hours (right shoulder strain); watering the courtyard 20 minutes; daily chores 1 hour

2025-05.daily_overview: The pain in her right shoulder persisted; she applied a medicated patch and reduced activity on the right side. She carefully filed away yesterday's greeting cards, and her husband silently fixed the faucet, their mutual understanding flowing in silence. Routine housework and courtyard care gradually brought life back to normal.

events.name: Morning neck and shoulder stretches (left side only)
events.description: Got up at 6:40. Due to right shoulder pain, Ma Xiulan only did left-side shoulder and neck stretches and neck movements, gently rotating her shoulders.

events.name: Short walk
events.description: At 6:50, Ma Xiulan, due to right shoulder discomfort, only walked slowly in the residential compound for 15 minutes and did not walk briskly.

events.name: Archive the greeting card records
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan reorganized the three greeting cards in the living room, smoothing each one out before placing them into the 'Love and Support' section of the family album, and noting the date beside them with a ballpoint pen. She gently touched the photos, recalled yesterday's dinner scene, and felt warm inside.

events.name: Daily housework and yard care (reduce right-side exertion).
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan did a simple cleaning of the whole house mainly with her left hand, used the washing machine to wash clothes, and, unable to wring out the heavy bed sheets, called her husband to help hang them in the yard. Then she went to the courtyard, watered plants with her left hand, checked whether the anti-theft door frame was tightly sealed, and checked whether the newly sown seeds in several pots of impatiens had sprouted.

events.name: Husband fixed the loose faucet
events.description: In the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang saw the newly added greeting card in the family photo album. Without saying anything, he turned around, took a wrench from the toolbox, and fixed the kitchen faucet that had been loose for days. Ma Xiulan handed him a cloth from the side, and the two smiled at each other, their unspoken understanding complete.

events.name: Routine pre-sleep safety check and deep breathing
events.description: Before bed, Ma Zhiqiang checked all the doors and windows as usual, while Ma Xiulan checked the gas and outlets. The two sat on the edge of the bed and did 5 minutes of deep breathing. Ma Xiulan deliberately placed her left hand lightly on her knee, reviewing the day as order gradually returned and her shoulder pain eased a little.

start_state.mood: Right shoulder still hurts, but her mood is stable.

end_state.mood: Grounded; family relationships grow stronger in the details; mild ache in the right shoulder but tolerable.

state.daily_exercise: In the early morning, walk slowly for 15 minutes; do a simple cleaning of the whole house for about 1.5 hours (reduce right-side activity); water and weed the courtyard for 20 minutes; do daily housework for 1 hour

2025-05.daily_overview: Her right shoulder improved. In the evening, she fully reconciled with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, with whom she had been on bad terms for weeks; the rift over the pickled vegetable return vanished with the wind. At night, she also bought a yogurt maker online, starting a new attempt for her family's health.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretch (light)
events.description: Woke up at 6:30. The pain in her right shoulder had lessened. Ma Xiulan tried doing stretching movements gently with both arms, still being careful when bending her neck to the side.

events.name: Early morning walk
events.description: At 6:40, she brisk-walked for 20 minutes along the tree-lined avenue on Jingwen Road. She slowed her pace because of a shoulder injury but still finished the walk.

events.name: Early Morning Courtyard and Garden Diary
events.description: At 7:20, Ma Xiulan went to the courtyard and watered with her left hand, discovering that the flower seedlings had grown several pairs of true leaves and the rose had put out new branches. She took photos from various angles and wrote in the family group: "The seedlings look different every day; our little garden is getting more and more flourishing." Her husband and children all liked the posts.

events.name: Chunmei called with an invitation.
events.description: In the morning, Liu Chunmei, Ma Xiulan's childhood friend who had been on bad terms with her for several weeks, took the initiative to call. In a sincere tone, she invited Xiulan to her home for dinner in the evening, saying she wanted to talk about something face to face. Ma Xiulan hesitated briefly, then happily agreed, and the two agreed to meet at six in the evening.

events.name: Preparing the favor gifts and freshening up to go out
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan picked a basket of fresh spinach and spring onions from her small vegetable garden, and also found a jar of sweet garlic pickled last year to bring as a gift. She changed into a clean plain top, washed up briefly, and walked to Chunmei's home with the heartfelt gift.

events.name: Reconciliation dinner
events.description: At 6 p.m., Ma Xiulan arrived at Chunmei's home, where Chunmei had already prepared a table of home-style dishes: noodles with gravy, sweet and sour ribs, cucumber salad, and more. The two sat across from each other. The atmosphere was a bit restrained at first, and they chatted about recent family matters while eating. In the middle of the meal, Chunmei put down her chopsticks and apologized earnestly: “About the pickled vegetables, I was too blunt back then. Don’t take it to heart.” Ma Xiulan felt a lump in her throat, raised her glass, and replied, “Without you, I wouldn’t be where I am today. Sis, let’s not talk about the past.” They clinked glasses and drank it all down. The estrangement of the past few weeks completely melted away.

events.name: Helped tidy up and said goodbye.
events.description: At about 8:30 in the evening, the two of them talked about many intimate things. Ma Xiulan helped clean up the dishes and then said goodbye. When parting, Chunmei told her to take it easy on the way home, and they agreed to go to the temple fair together next weekend. Ma Xiulan walked home feeling relaxed and at ease.

events.name: Bought a yogurt maker online
events.description: Back home, Ma Xiulan remembered a yogurt health program she had seen on TV, so she used the pocket money saved from selling pickles to place an order on the mobile Taobao app for a household yogurt maker and several packs of yogurt starter powder, planning to make homemade yogurt to improve her family's health, especially her youngest daughter's constipation problem.

events.name: Deep breathing before sleep.
events.description: At 23:00, Ma Xiulan was in a good mood. She sat on the bedside with her husband for 5 minutes of deep breathing, recalled the warmth of making up, and fell asleep peacefully.

start_state.mood: Slightly uneasy, not knowing how to face Chunmei, but the improvement in her right shoulder brought relief.

end_state.mood: Completely relaxed, and the mended friendship pleased her greatly.

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of morning walking, 20 minutes of watering the courtyard, 20 minutes walking to and from Chunmei's house, and 1.5 hours of housework.

2025-05.daily_overview: Her right shoulder had basically recovered, and the passing rain brought a coolness. Ma Xiulan stayed home and focused on preparing a sample of spicy pickled cabbage for the upcoming consignment negotiation with the supermarket. She also did embroidery stitch by stitch. Her life's focus shifted to a side-business breakthrough.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching (full)
events.description: Got up at 6:40. Her right shoulder was almost pain-free. Ma Xiulan completed the full stretching routine and felt her shoulder and neck flexibility returning.

events.name: Short indoor exercise
events.description: Because it was raining and she couldn't go out, Ma Xiulan marched in place in the living room for 10 minutes while swinging her arms.

events.name: Prepare a consignment sample of spicy pickled cabbage.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan carefully made a new flavor sample of spicy pickled cabbage in her home kitchen using Chinese cabbage, chili powder, garlic, ginger, and other ingredients. She controlled the pickling time and seasoning ratio, deliberately reducing the saltiness to fit the health trend.

events.name: Progress on embroidering the twin-lotus pillowcase
events.description: In the afternoon, to the sound of dripping rain, Ma Xiulan sat by the living room window and continued embroidering the twin-lotus pillowcase custom-ordered by regular client Liu Fang. The silver needle moved through the silk as she sewed and thought about the consignment business, and her handiwork became increasingly skilled. Every 30 minutes she got up and looked into the distance outside the window to rest her eyes.

events.name: Discussing the consignment plan with her husband
events.description: During dinner, Ma Xiulan told her husband about her idea of going to neighbor Zhang Shufen's supermarket to discuss consignment. Ma Zhiqiang expressed support and told her to go ahead without worrying about the family. The two also discussed that if the consignment went well, they could make a few more kinds of pickled vegetables in the future.

events.name: Deep breathing before sleep.
events.description: At 22:45, the couple did their usual five minutes of deep breathing, reviewed that today's sample preparation went smoothly, and felt somewhat expectant about tomorrow's consignment negotiation.

start_state.mood: Right shoulder is recovering, mood is stable, and she is ready to focus on the side business.

end_state.mood: Both hopeful and somewhat anxious about the consignment prospects.

state.daily_exercise: Walking in place indoors for 10 minutes, making pickled vegetables for about 1.5 hours, doing embroidery for 2 hours (interspersed with looking into the distance), and doing daily housework for 1 hour.

2025-05.daily_overview: The first bud in the morning garden made the whole family excited. The consignment agreement for pickled vegetables was signed smoothly, and the first batch going on the shelves marked an important step toward commercialization. Although the first attempt at yogurt failed, it accumulated experience for success.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Got up at 6:35, stretched for 5 minutes, and felt my shoulders and neck were limber.

events.name: Early morning walk
events.description: At 6:45, she walked briskly alone along Jingwen Road for 20 minutes, feeling happy.

events.name: Found flower buds in the early morning
events.description: At 7:20, Ma Xiulan pushed the door open into the courtyard. While watering as usual, she was delighted to find a mung-bean-sized light green bud at the top of a flower seedling. She squatted down, took a close-up and a panoramic shot with her phone's macro mode, and immediately sent the photos to the family group chat: "Quick, look! Our little flower is about to bloom — its first bud!" Her husband and children responded enthusiastically, and Ma Xiulan was in a great mood.

events.name: Sign for the yogurt maker and make yogurt for the first time.
events.description: At 10 a.m., the delivery man delivered a package containing a yogurt maker and yogurt starter powder to the home. After signing for it, Ma Xiulan opened it to inspect it, confirmed that the accessories were all there and the starter powder package was intact. She mixed pure milk with the starter powder according to the instructions and put it into the yogurt maker to ferment, full of anticipation.

events.name: Negotiating and signing a consignment agreement for pickled vegetables
events.description: At 2 p.m., Ma Xiulan walked to Shufen Convenience Supermarket, run by her neighbor Zhang Shufen, carrying the sample bottle of spicy cabbage. After tasting it, Zhang Shufen approved of the flavor, and after discussion the two settled the consignment details: selling price 28 yuan per bottle, commission at 15% of the selling price, settled monthly. The two signed a simple written agreement and each kept a copy.

events.name: The first batch of pickled vegetables is now on the shelves
events.description: After signing the contract, Ma Xiulan immediately went home, picked out five jars of spicy cabbage with intact packaging and newer dates from her inventory, packed them in a clean cloth bag, and delivered them to the supermarket again. Zhang Shufen placed the pickled vegetables in a prominent spot on the shelf beside the snacks. Ma Xiulan told her to let her know promptly if any customers gave feedback.

events.name: First Yogurt Failure and Adjustment Plan
events.description: At 5 p.m., after about 8 hours of fermentation, Ma Xiulan took out the yogurt and found it too sour. The three kids each took a taste and shook their heads. She did not get discouraged. In the evening, in the living room, she used her phone to search online for ways to improve it and found that adjusting the ratio of milk to starter powder and adding honey and fruit pieces could improve the taste. She decided to ask Chunmei for advice the next day.

events.name: Deep breathing before sleep.
events.description: At 22:50, Ma Xiulan sat on the edge of the bed and took a deep breath. She reviewed the successful launch of the consignment and the pleasant surprise of the flower buds, and she was able to take the small yogurt failure in stride.

start_state.mood: The good mood from last night continues; looking forward to the changes in the garden.

end_state.mood: The consignment deal going through made her relieved, but the yogurt failure was a slight regret; nonetheless, she remained full of drive.

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of morning walk, 20 minutes of watering and weeding the courtyard, 1 hour of making yogurt and cleaning, 30 minutes total for two round trips on foot to the supermarket, and 1.5 hours of daily housework.

2025-05.daily_overview: After learning the yogurt technique from Chunmei, her second try was a big success, and the children couldn't stop eating it. The embroidery order also came to a successful conclusion, and preparations for the next day's wedding brought a festive touch to life.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Got up at 6:40 and stretched for 5 minutes.

events.name: Early morning walk
events.description: At 6:50, walked briskly for 20 minutes with Zhang Shufen along the tree-lined avenue of Jingwen Road, chatting about consignment yogurt and other matters.

events.name: Learn yogurt-making tips from Chunmei
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan walked to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei's home to ask in detail how to make homemade yogurt. Chunmei shared her experience of using pure milk and a small amount of starter culture for long, low-temperature fermentation, and also taught her tips for adding fruit pieces and honey. Ma Xiulan carefully wrote down the steps and brought back a small bottle of the yogurt Chunmei had made for comparison.

events.name: The second batch of yogurt was made successfully
events.description: When she got home at noon, Ma Xiulan adjusted the ratio of milk to yogurt starter, increasing the amount of milk, based on an online method and Chunmei's experience, and made a new batch of yogurt. After fermentation, she added some honey and chopped fresh strawberry pieces, stirred them in evenly, and put it in the refrigerator to chill. After dinner, she took it out for the family to taste. The finished yogurt was silky with a moderate sweetness and acidity. The children kept praising it, and her younger daughter Ma Yuxin drank more than half a cup in one go.

events.name: Finished and organized the embroidered pillowcases.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan did the final needlework finishing on the custom double lotus embroidered pillowcase in her study, carefully trimming loose threads. After confirming the pattern was complete and flawless, she ironed the pillowcase smooth, folded it, and placed it in a clean cloth bag, ready for delivery the next day.

events.name: Preparing for tomorrow's wedding.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan dug out a floral dress from the bottom of the wardrobe and tried it on, finding it a bit tight (she had lost a little weight from recent hard work), so she changed into another plain knee-length skirt. She also ironed shirts and pants in advance for her husband and two sons, checked the amount in the red envelopes, packed the needed items into her backpack, and only rested after everything was in order.

events.name: Deep breathing before sleep.
events.description: At 22:50, Ma Xiulan and her husband did deep breathing together, reviewed the success of the yogurt and the completion of the embroidery, and looked forward to tomorrow's wedding.

start_state.mood: In good spirits, determined to conquer the yogurt challenge

end_state.mood: The double success gave her a strong sense of achievement, and she also felt excited about tomorrow's wedding.

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of early-morning walking; 20 minutes of walking to Chunmei's house and back; 1 hour finishing embroidery; 1.5 hours of yogurt making and kitchen cleaning; 1.5 hours of daily housework.

2025-05.daily_overview: In the early morning, the homemade yogurt served with breakfast was a big hit. The family of four then took a taxi to Hedong District for a wedding. At the wedding banquet, they interacted with relatives and observed urban life. After returning home, when she tallied up the gift money for the wedding, although it pained her, she cherished the family bond even more.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Woke up at 6:30 and stretched for 5 minutes.

events.name: Short walk
events.description: At 6:40, I walked briskly in the neighborhood for 15 minutes; a little shorter because I had to rush to a wedding today.

events.name: Breakfast yogurt won praise
events.description: At 7 a.m., Ma Xiulan took out the yogurt she had made the night before from the fridge. The three children ate it with steamed buns, savoring every bite, and finished it quickly. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang tasted a few spoonfuls and nodded, saying it was good. Ma Xiulan happily decided to make yogurt twice a week from now on.

events.name: Change clothes and take a taxi to the wedding banquet
events.description: At 8:30, Ma Xiulan changed into a simple elegant skirt, helped her two sons straighten their clean shirts, and after a simple makeup, made an exception and ordered a taxi with her mobile phone. Before leaving, she deliberately put the cloth bag with the custom pillowcases she had put away yesterday in a prominent place, and instructed her eldest son Mingxuan: if Aunt Liu Fang calls, she can be asked to come pick it up in the afternoon. The family of four set out from 156 Jingwen Road to Hedong District, Tianjin, to attend a wedding of her husband's distant cousin. In the car, she checked the red envelopes again and reminded her husband to drink less.

events.name: Wedding banquet socializing and observation
events.description: After arriving at the hotel, they checked in, handed in the red envelope, and the family of four sat down as directed. Ma Xiulan sat at the same table as several sisters-in-law, chatting about the children's studies and family news. She quietly compared the dishes on the table and felt that the sweet-and-sour pork was not as good as her own. During the meal, she secretly noticed the embroidered napkins on the table and studied the stitching, thinking of using it for a new order. Her husband was pulled over to help drink toasts, and when he came back with a red face, she immediately handed him hangover tea and reminded him in a low voice that he still had to drive out the next day. The two sons ate quietly, occasionally playing with unfamiliar children. The wedding banquet lasted about two hours, with a pleasant atmosphere. After the banquet, Ma Xiulan took her family for a 10-minute walk near the hotel and took several group photos.

events.name: Return trip and settling favor accounts
events.description: After the wedding banquet ended and saying goodbye to the newlyweds, Ma Xiulan called a taxi again to return to Jinghai. It was already afternoon when she got home. She changed back into her loungewear and sat with her husband in the living room, carefully calculating in the account book: a 300 yuan red envelope and about 80 yuan for round-trip taxi fare, nearly 400 yuan in total. She sighed that they would need to save a bit next month, but visits to relatives could not be reduced. The two recorded the expense in the account book and planned to cut back on unnecessary spending in the near future.

events.name: Evening courtyard and safety check
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan went to the courtyard to water the flowers. Finding that the flower buds had grown a bit larger than yesterday, she took photos to record it. Before going to bed, she and her husband checked the doors and windows as usual, and retrieved the spare key from Wang Guilan's home (it had been entrusted to her before they went out). Everything was in order.

events.name: Deep breathing before sleep.

end_state.mood: A bit distressed about the expense, but felt the warmth of relatives and family harmony; overall satisfied.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Sunday, she specially made yogurt to share with the neighbors; the spinach in the courtyard was also ripe and was given away, and the eggs Wang Guilan gave in return made the friendship flow. Stocking up on milk and yogurt starter powder laid the foundation for a long-term health plan.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Got up at 6:50 and stretched for 5 minutes.

events.name: Early morning walk

events.name: Making yogurt and packaging it

events.name: Pick vegetables from the courtyard garden.

events.name: Distribute yogurt and vegetables.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan first walked to her neighbor Wang Guilan's home across the hall, giving her a bottle of yogurt and a small bunch of spinach. Wang Guilan happily gave back five fresh eggs from her own hens. Then she carried another bottle of yogurt and vegetables to visit her parents at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District. Her mother Li Xiuying tasted the yogurt and praised it repeatedly, while her father Ma Jianguo asked with concern how the installation of the security door had gone.

events.name: Purchased ingredients for making yogurt

At the supermarket, she also checked the shelf of her homemade pickles at Shufen Supermarket and felt a little relieved to see the five jars still there.

2025-05.daily_overview: The embroidery order was delivered smoothly and won the client's praise, and unexpectedly brought a recommendation for new clients. The reputation of the handicraft side business began to take root; the flowers in the courtyard looked even more spirited in the sunlight.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching

events.name: Early morning walk

events.name: Deliver embroidered pillowcases
events.description: At 10 a.m., Ma Xiulan walked to the home of her regular customer Liu Fang on Shengli Street in Jinghai District, carrying a neatly ironed embroidered pillowcase with twin lotus flowers. She showed the embroidery to Liu Fang in person. Liu Fang was very satisfied with the needlework and pattern, and immediately transferred 120 yuan via WeChat. Ma Xiulan thanked the customer for her recognition and proactively asked if she had any other needs.

events.name: Received new customer referral

She immediately called Wang Juan, and after a brief introduction, Ma Xiulan and Wang Juan added each other on WeChat and agreed to discuss the requirements in detail later.

events.name: Courtyard flower and plant care.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan went to the courtyard to water the plants as usual and noticed that the flower bud had swelled a bit more, and another plant next to it had also put out a tiny bud the size of a millet grain. She took a photo and updated the garden diary in the family group chat: "The second bud is here too!" She also applied diluted cake fertilizer to several rose bushes, hoping they would bloom soon.

events.name: Deep breathing before sleep.
events.description: At 22:40, did deep breathing with her husband, reviewed the smooth delivery, and felt more confident about the side business.

2025-05.daily_overview: The first flower blooming in the early morning brought a huge surprise, and the whole family was immersed in joy; communication with a new client went smoothly, and the handmade business is steadily expanding.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Woke up at 6:30, stretched for 5 minutes, feel refreshed.

events.name: Early morning walk
events.description: At 6:40, walked briskly along Jingwen Road for 20 minutes, thinking the flower buds would soon open.

events.name: The first flower of the morning bloomed
events.description: At 7:10, Ma Xiulan had just pushed open the courtyard gate when she caught a whiff of a sweet fragrance. She hurried to the flower bed and saw that the bud had fully bloomed into a pinkish-white flower, about three centimeters in diameter, covered with dew. Excitedly, she took dozens of photos and a video around it, then posted in the family group: "It's blooming! The first flower has bloomed! Our little garden has flowers!" Family members liked it one after another. Her husband sent a red envelope to congratulate her, her eldest and second sons ran out to look, and her daughter hugged her leg and shouted, "So pretty!" Ma Xiulan deliberately picked that flower and put it in a glass in the living room for the whole family to enjoy.

events.name: Voice communication with a new client
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ma Xiulan had a voice call with a new client, Wang Juan, on WeChat to learn the details of the custom order: a mandarin ducks playing in water embroidery of moderate size, intended as a wedding gift. Ma Xiulan showed Wang Juan pictures of similar works she had made before, and they discussed an initial quote and delivery time. Wang Juan expressed great interest and hoped to discuss further at their next meeting.

events.name: Prepare materials for the Dragon Boat Festival.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan walked to the vegetable market. At Sun Guifang's stall she bought glutinous rice, candied dates, and red bean paste filling, and then went to the grocery store to buy cotton string for tying zongzi, preparing for the Dragon Boat Festival. She deliberately bought an extra portion, planning to make zongzi together with her mother and neighbors.

events.name: Deep breathing before sleep.
events.description: At 22:45, the couple did deep breathing for 5 minutes. Ma Xiulan excitedly talked about the flowers blooming, and her husband listened with a smile.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to seeing the changes in the flower buds

end_state.mood: Filled with joy, the success of the garden and the new orders made her feel enthusiastic about life.

2025-05.daily_overview: Little gains in the daily routine: went to the supermarket to ask about the sales feedback on the pickled vegetables, received good reviews and restocked; at dusk, noticed the courtyard roses had quietly grown two buds. In the evening, the family started a new habit of walking together.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Got up at 6:30, stretched for 5 minutes, and added shoulder rotation exercises.

events.name: Early morning walk
events.description: At 6:40, walked briskly alone for 20 minutes; it was hot but bearable.

events.name: Check on the consignment status of the pickled vegetables.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan walked to Shufen Convenience Store. Zhang Shufen told her that two of the five jars of spicy cabbage on the shelf had been sold, and the buyer said the taste was authentic. Ma Xiulan was delighted to hear this, and gave her a jar of newly made sweet pickled garlic as a sample for Zhang Shufen to try selling, promising to supply it weekly if it sold well. The two chatted for a while in front of the shelf, and Ma Xiulan also bought a bottle of soy sauce while she was there.

events.name: Housework and yogurt making
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan made another pot of yogurt according to the new recipe and put it in the refrigerator to chill. Then she took out the summer quilts and clothes to air, cleaned the corners of every room, and also removed and washed the kitchen range hood filter. While busy, she turned on the radio to listen to a local lifestyle program and worked until dusk without realizing it.

events.name: The garden rose has sprouted buds
events.description: While watering before dinner, Ma Xiulan noticed two flower buds smaller than rice grains sprouting at the tips of the rose branches transplanted last month. She quickly took photos to record it and wrote in the family group chat: 'The roses also have double happiness!' The children ran out to see. Her daughter Ma Yuxin asked when they could pick them. Ma Xiulan smiled and said she would ask her to be a little assistant once they bloomed.

events.name: First evening walk
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan suggested taking the children for a 20-minute walk in the neighborhood, and her husband joined in. The family of five walked and chatted along the community path, while the children chased each other and played. Ma Xiulan felt very relaxed. She decided to do this every evening from now on.

events.name: Deep breathing before sleep.
events.description: At 22:50, Ma Xiulan sat on the edge of the bed, took a deep breath, reviewed the fulfilling day, and fell asleep with satisfaction.

start_state.mood: Calm, with no particular expectations or worries.

end_state.mood: Content, with home and garden advancing side by side, everything in order.

2025-05.daily_overview: As the weather got hotter, Ma Xiulan moved her walk to 6:40, then prepared Dragon Boat Festival zongzi leaves and fillings. She also sorted out the family accounts for the month and found a decent surplus; the first draft of a new embroidery order was approved by the customer.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Got up at 6:30 and stretched for 5 minutes to take a walk while it was still cool.

events.name: Early morning walk (moved earlier to avoid the heat)
events.description: At 6:40, she briskly walked along the tree-lined avenue on Jingwen Road for 25 minutes, alone, with a slightly slower pace, coordinating with deep breathing.

events.name: Preparing zongzi leaves and fillings for the Dragon Boat Festival
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan took out the dried bamboo leaves saved from last year, soaked them in warm water until soft, washed dozens of them, and covered them with a damp cloth. Then she pitted the candied dates, divided the red bean paste into small balls, and put them in a basin for later use. She also soaked a basin of glutinous rice, planning to cook it until half done tomorrow before making zongzi so the zongzi would be stickier and softer. In addition, she washed the fresh reed leaves she had picked by the river during her morning walk and set them aside, preparing enough materials for the Dragon Boat Festival.

events.name: Calculate household spending so far this month.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan sat at the dining table and opened the account book, checking the household expenses from May 1 to 28 page by page. She found that apart from the one-time security expense, daily spending had been well controlled, and there was still a surplus. She specifically listed the security door and lock replacement costs as a special security item, and noted that starting next month, she would set aside 50 yuan each month as a safety fund.

events.name: Design communication for a new embroidery order.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan sent a hand-drawn sketch of mandarin ducks playing in water to her new client Wang Juan via WeChat. The size and color scheme were both approved. Wang Juan wanted to add a few lotus flowers as embellishment, and Ma Xiulan agreed to revise it. They arranged to meet next Monday to confirm and pay a deposit. After putting down her phone, she took out her needle and thread and first embroidered a few small lotus flowers on scrap fabric to practice.

events.name: Evening stroll
events.description: After dinner, as usual, she took the children for a 20-minute slow walk around the neighborhood. Her husband had not returned yet, so the mother and her three children identified stars as they walked.

events.name: Deep breathing before sleep.
events.description: At 22:45, Ma Xiulan took a deep breath alone, reviewed the accounts and designs, and felt everything was in good order.

end_state.mood: Looking forward to both the holiday preparations and the handicraft work

2025-05.daily_overview: At the community's Dragon Boat Festival parent-child sachet sewing activity, the youngest daughter won the Cutest Award, and the whole family was immersed in the pre-festival joy; purchasing coarse grains and yogurt ingredients paved the way for a healthy diet in June.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Got up at 5:50, stretched for 5 minutes, and performed the movements fluently.

events.name: Early morning walk
events.description: At 5:55, power-walked for 25 minutes along the street-side central park, alone; it was hot, but I persisted.

events.name: Attend the community Dragon Boat Festival parent-child activity.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ma Xiulan walked with her three children to the community activity center near Jingwen Road to attend a parent-child sachet-sewing competition. After receiving the materials, her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin's hands were weak, so Ma Xiulan taught her hand over hand how to thread the needle, sew the edges, and fill the sachet with mugwort. The competition lasted about 40 minutes. With help, Ma Yuxin completed a sachet with crooked stitches but stuffed nice and plump.

events.name: Youngest daughter wins the Cutest Award
events.description: The judges commented that Ma Yuxin's sachet, though not neat, was full of childlike charm, and they unanimously awarded it the Most Adorable Award. When the host announced the result, Ma Yuxin ran onto the stage excitedly to receive the prize - a bag of colorful embroidery thread. She jumped about in the crowd. Seeing her daughter so happy, Ma Xiulan felt very gratified and captured the moment with her camera.

events.name: Activity ending and sharing joy
events.description: After the event, Ma Xiulan returned home with the children. On the way, Ma Yuxin kept holding up her prize and showing off, and her two older brothers also praised her. Once home, Ma Xiulan told her husband and parents the news of winning via WeChat, and put away the colorful embroidery threads, planning to use them in later handicraft projects.

events.name: Purchase whole grains and yogurt ingredients.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan went to the vegetable market and the supermarket. According to her healthy eating plan, she bought millet, oats, red beans and other ingredients for making mixed-grain porridge, and also bought pure milk and yogurt starter powder, to stock up for continuing her healthy diet in June. She also took a look at the pickled vegetables at Zhang Shufen Supermarket on the way; seeing that only one bottle was left, she made a mental note to restock in time after the holiday.

events.name: Soaking glutinous rice in preparation for the Dragon Boat Festival
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan changed the water for the dried zongzi leaves that had been soaked soft yesterday, and soaked a large basin of fresh glutinous rice, adding a little edible alkali to make the zongzi more yellow and shiny. She hummed a tune while working, looking forward to tomorrow's Dragon Boat Festival reunion.

events.name: Evening stroll
events.description: After dinner, took the children for a 20-minute slow walk around the neighborhood. My daughter showed off her prize, and we laughed and chatted all the way.

events.name: Deep breathing before sleep.
events.description: At 22:50, the couple took deep breaths together, recalled their daughter's award, and fell asleep contentedly.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and happy; her daughter participated in a community competition for the first time

end_state.mood: Proud of her daughter, festival preparations ready, looking forward to the Dragon Boat Festival

2025-05.daily_overview: During the Dragon Boat Festival, Ma Xiulan used the bamboo leaves she had prepared in advance to wrap zongzi with her mother and neighbors, and distributed them to the neighborhood. They hung mugwort to pray for peace, and she and her children launched paper boats. Traditional customs intertwined with family warmth. In the evening, she tallied May's side-job income and set June goals, bringing May to a fulfilling close with a summary and new goals.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Got up at 6:40, stretched for 5 minutes, shoulder circles went smoothly, and the right shoulder is completely fine now.

events.name: Brief morning walk
events.description: At 6:50, did a 15-minute brisk walk in the neighborhood; slightly shorter because today was busy.

events.name: Making zongzi with mother and neighbors
events.description: At 8 a.m., her mother Li Xiuying and neighbor Wang Guilan from across the street came to the courtyard as invited. The three used pre-soaked dried bamboo leaves and fresh reed leaves, rinsed glutinous rice, and prepared candied jujube and sweet bean paste fillings. Then they sat around the stone table in the courtyard and began wrapping zongzi. Ma Xiulan skillfully folded and tied the leaves, her mother filled the rice and stuffing, and Wang Guilan handed over materials. In less than an hour, they wrapped more than forty candied jujube and sweet bean paste zongzi.

events.name: Boiling zongzi and hanging mugwort
events.description: She put the wrapped zongzi into the large wok on the stove. Ma Xiulan lit a fire in the wood-burning stove in the yard. After bringing it to a boil over high heat, she turned down to low heat and simmered for nearly two hours, filling the whole yard with the fragrance of zongzi. While the zongzi were simmering, she and her husband Ma Zhiqiang hung the prepared mugwort and peach branches on the lintel of the front door to ward off evil and pray for blessings for the family.

events.name: Distributing rice dumplings to spread neighborly warmth
events.description: After the zongzi were cooked and drained, Ma Xiulan, while still hot, put more than ten on a plate and first delivered them to the entrance of Zhang Shufen's supermarket diagonally opposite, wishing her a healthy Dragon Boat Festival. Zhang Shufen thanked her repeatedly. Then she packed another bag and walked to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei's home. Chunmei happily took them and invited her inside to sit, but Ma Xiulan declined politely because she still needed to go home. On her way back, Wang Guilan brought a bag of fresh eggs as a return gift.

events.name: Folding paper boats with the kids and setting them afloat on the canal.
events.description: At 11 a.m., Ma Xiulan and her second son, Ma Mingzhe, folded several paper boats from colored paper in the living room. At 2 p.m., her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, took Ma Mingzhe to the nearby canal to set the paper boats adrift. Ma Xiulan followed with her daughter and took photos of the father and son standing side by side watching the paper boats float away.

events.name: Dragon Boat Festival Family Dinner
events.description: At 6 p.m., Ma Xiulan prepared a Dragon Boat Festival dinner: honey-date zongzi, red bean paste zongzi, noodles with gravy, cucumber salad, and the braised meat from last night. The family of five sat around the table, eating and chatting. The second son told funny stories about setting paper boats adrift, the younger daughter showed off her prize embroidery thread, and her husband, unusually, drank half a glass of realgar wine.

events.name: Calculate May's side income
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ma Xiulan sat at the dining table and took out her ledger. She sorted out the May records: consignment through Shufen Supermarket (settled two bottles at 28*2=56 yuan, after deducting 15% commission it was 47.6 yuan, though the actual settlement per the agreement may be rounded), the stall at the handicraft market (the data was mentioned but not calculated in detail, keeping the original meaning), and an embroidery order of 120 yuan. She calculated a total income of 285 yuan. After deducting costs of 70 yuan for pickled vegetable ingredients and handicraft materials, the net income was 215 yuan. She wrote the details neatly in the ledger, with a note: net income of 215 yuan to be transferred into the education fund, plus the monthly social security subsidy of 200 yuan, making a total deposit of 415 yuan. The education reserve fund thus exceeded 10,000 yuan.

events.name: Goal setting and June planning
events.description: After checking the accounts, Ma Xiulan wrote on a blank page of the ledger: May handicraft opening, keep it up! She also solemnly noted the June goals: increase pickled vegetable production, strive to have monthly net income exceed 300 yuan; complete the mandarin ducks playing in water embroidery order; continue advancing the garden project. Then she checked the pickled vegetable inventory and planned to restock immediately after the holiday.

events.name: Organizing family photos and taking an evening walk.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan as usual took the children and her husband for a 20-minute slow walk around the neighborhood, discussing June plans while walking. Before going to bed, she imported the May photos from the memory card into her computer, created a new “May 2025” folder, and archived them.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: At 23:15, Ma Xiulan and her husband sat on the edge of the bed in the bedroom, hands resting lightly on their knees, doing five minutes of deep breathing. They reviewed the fulfilling day and the entire month of May, felt physically and mentally satisfied, and fell asleep looking forward to June.

start_state.mood: Dragon Boat Festival morning, feeling refreshed and energetic

end_state.mood: After a busy and fulfilling day, I feel tired but satisfied in both body and mind, and deeply gratified by the May side-business breakthrough and family warmth.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of morning walking, 2 hours making zongzi, about 40 minutes walking to deliver zongzi several times, 20 minutes of evening walking, and about 1.5 hours of housework and evening bookkeeping

2025-09.daily_overview: It was the first day of school, and the three children started school at the same time. Ma Xiulan got up at 05:35 in the morning, completed her usual neck-and-shoulder stretches, courtyard walk, and Baduanjin exercises, then prepared breakfast for the family and took the children to school. Afterwards, she went to the library to borrow books, launched Family Reading Consolidation Month, and mobilized her mother and craft friend Zhou Xiuqin to come help at home, starting the initial dehydration process for the autumn pickles. Because of continued financial pressure, after discussing with her husband, she decided to reduce the monthly savings to 50 yuan starting this month.

events.name: Taking the children to school for the start of term.
events.description: After getting up at 05:35 in the early morning, Ma Xiulan first spent 20 minutes doing morning shoulder and neck stretches, Baduanjin, and a courtyard walk to take care of her roses. Then she prepared breakfast (heated congee, boiled eggs, and homemade pickled vegetables). At 07:10, she first took her younger daughter Ma Yuxin to Jinghai District Experimental Primary School. Because it was the first day of school and the school gate was crowded, she comforted her a little longer. She hurried home to urge her eldest son Ma Mingxuan and second son Ma Mingzhe to leave. The start of school for the three children suddenly made the family's pace much more hectic.

events.name: Launched Family Reading Consolidation Month
events.description: After taking the children to school, she walked to the community library and borrowed Jinghai Folk Tales and Basic Embroidery Tutorial. When she got home, she put the new books in the reading corner of the living room and announced that from this month, every evening from 20:00 to 20:30 would be fixed reading time, to strengthen the reading habit established during the summer vacation.

events.name: Started making pickled vegetables together with her mother and craft friends
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan rallied her mother Li Xiuying and her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin to come to her home to rush out autumn pickled vegetables. The three divided the tasks: Ma Xiulan washed and cut radishes, cucumbers, and other vegetables; her mother prepared the brine and did the first salting; Zhou Xiuqin drained the vegetables and layered them one by one. After an afternoon of work, they completed the initial pickling and dehydration of all the vegetables.

events.name: Adjust the family savings plan
events.description: After dinner, because her husband Ma Zhiqiang's income had dropped last month, Ma Xiulan discussed it with him and decided to lower the monthly savings amount to 50 yuan to prioritize daily expenses. She recorded the new amount and the reason in the family finance notebook and reviewed the plan to cut non-essential spending, such as pausing purchases of new fabric.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous but orderly

end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled.

state.daily_exercise: In the early morning: 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, one set of Baduanjin, 20 minutes of walking in the courtyard; plus household chores and walking to and from the library.

2025-09.daily_overview: On the second day of school, Ma Xiulan got up at 05:35 in the morning. After finishing shoulder and neck stretches and Baduanjin, she worked with her mother and craft friends to mix the vegetables dehydrated the day before with sauce, then sealed them in jars, completing about 40 jars in the day. Between household chores, she supervised her second son's homework and maintained family reading time.

events.name: Continue packing the pickled vegetables into jars.
events.description: Ma Xiulan, her mother Li Xiuying, and Zhou Xiuqin continued rushing to make pickled vegetables. Ma Xiulan thoroughly mixed the cooked sauce (soy sauce, star anise, ginger slices, etc.) with the dehydrated vegetables. Her mother filled clean glass jars one by one, pressing the mixture down and pouring in the liquid. Zhou Xiuqin was responsible for screwing the lids on tightly to seal them. They completed about 40 jars that day, and the remaining 20 jars were planned for the next day.

start_state.mood: Busy but organized.

end_state.mood: Satisfied, feeling gratified by the progress on the pickled vegetables.

state.daily_exercise: Morning shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, and long periods of standing and walking while making pickled vegetables

2025-09.daily_overview: The final stage of rush-producing the pickled vegetables. In the morning, Ma Xiulan first practiced Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao in the courtyard, then, together with her mother and Zhou Xiuqin, finished filling the remaining 20 jars, uniformly wiped the jar surfaces, and pasted handwritten labels. A total of 60 jars of pickled vegetables were neatly arranged. During family reading time in the evening, her second son Ma Mingzhe still had trouble sitting still, and Ma Xiulan guided him patiently.

events.name: Practicing Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao
events.description: In the early morning, neighbor Aunt Zhao arrived at the courtyard as promised. The two practiced Baduanjin together, correcting each other's movements, and Aunt Zhao also shared a little trick for relieving lower back tension.

events.name: Finish jarring the pickled vegetables and applying labels
events.description: The three of them jarred and sealed the remaining 20 jars, then wiped the jars clean with a clean cloth. Ma Xiulan hand-wrote the label "Xiulan's Homemade Pickles" with a marker and affixed it to each jar. All 60 jars were neatly placed on the storage shelf by the stove. They counted the jars and checked that the labels were firmly attached.

start_state.mood: Full of energy

end_state.mood: Tired but looking forward to sales

state.daily_exercise: Practiced one set of Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao, did shoulder and neck stretches, stood for long periods doing manual labor, and carried jars

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, light early autumn breeze

2025-09.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan brought her handmade pickled vegetables to market for the first time. Early in the morning, she carried 60 jars of pickled vegetables on a tricycle to the entrance of Jingwen Road Vegetable Market and set up a stall. With uniform labels and enthusiastic introductions, she sold 25 jars on the first day, earning 200 yuan, and recorded the contact information of repeat customers. After packing up in the afternoon, she went home to tidy up, and in the evening continued the family reading.

events.name: First time setting up a stall to sell pickled vegetables.
events.description: Got up at 05:30 in the morning. After completing shoulder and neck stretches and a short session of Baduanjin, Ma Xiulan transported 60 jars of pickled vegetables to the entrance of the food market by tricycle at 06:30. She set up the stall, put up labels (priced at 8 yuan per jar), actively promoted the products to customers, and invited them to taste. That day she sold 25 jars and earned 200 yuan, and she noted down the contact information of several repeat customers in a small notebook.

start_state.mood: Nervous and expectant

end_state.mood: Satisfied and encouraged by the start of sales.

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of morning shoulder and neck stretching, a short version of Baduanjin, riding a tricycle, and standing for long periods at the market stall.

2025-09.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan continued to sell the remaining pickled vegetables at the stall. That day she sold 17 jars and earned 136 yuan. After packing up in the afternoon, she stored the remaining 18 jars at home, bringing the two-day total sales to 336 yuan. In the evening she contacted her neighbor Wang Guilan to discuss a home delivery plan, and they initially set the weekend delivery schedule. At night she supervised the children's homework.

events.name: Continue selling at the stall and plan delivery of the remaining pickled vegetables
events.description: In the morning, she transported the remaining 35 jars of pickled vegetables to the stall and continued selling. That day she sold 17 jars and earned 136 yuan. In the afternoon, she closed the stall and went home, temporarily storing the remaining 18 jars in a cool place. She counted the total sales over the two days as 336 yuan and recorded it in the account book. In the evening, she proactively contacted Wang Guilan to get the list and addresses of the interested households introduced earlier and discussed the delivery order and time for the weekend.

start_state.mood: Energetic

end_state.mood: Gratified but slightly fatigued
