2025-09.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ma Xiulan carried out door-to-door delivery of the remaining pickled vegetables. Carrying 18 jars of pickled vegetables and handwritten delivery notes, she visited households one by one in the neighborhood. That day she delivered and sold 10 jars, earning 80 yuan, and gave 2 jars to warm-hearted neighbors. In the afternoon, she tidied the courtyard and tended the small vegetable garden at home, and made preliminary preparations for next week's handicraft salon. In the evening, after family reading, she watched TV with her husband for a while.

events.name: Door-to-door delivery of the remaining pickled vegetables
events.description: At 9 a.m., following the list she had prepared with Wang Guilan, Ma Xiulan packed 18 jars of pickled vegetables into a cloth bag, took a handwritten delivery note, and delivered them door-to-door to residents near Jingwen Road. She first visited the prospective households introduced by Wang Guilan. Thanks to the referral from an acquaintance, sales went smoothly. She sold 10 jars on the spot (earning 80 yuan), gave 2 jars to particularly warm-hearted neighbors, and brought the remaining 6 jars back.

events.name: Yard care and weekend chores
events.description: After the delivery, she went home and had a simple lunch. In the afternoon, she went to the courtyard to pull weeds from the vegetable plot, tie up the tomato vines, and check the germination of the autumn vegetables. Then she cleaned the house and washed and hung out the clothes. In the evening, she organized her embroidery tools and pattern papers to make preliminary preparations for the community salon.

start_state.mood: Energetic, with a relatively relaxed weekend.

end_state.mood: Satisfied, with the pickled vegetable stock almost cleared out

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretching, walking deliveries, and courtyard work

2025-09.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan took the children to visit her parents, bringing homemade pickled vegetables and fresh vegetables. She helped make lunch and they spent a warm time together. In the afternoon, they returned home, and she supervised her eldest son's weekend homework. In the evening during family reading time, her second son Ma Mingzhe listened to a complete story attentively for the first time and voluntarily asked to extend the time, which made Ma Xiulan feel very gratified.

events.name: Take the children to visit her parents
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan prepared her homemade pickled vegetables and scallions and eggplants picked from the courtyard, and took the three children by bus to her parents' home. She helped her mother Li Xiuying prepare lunch, while her father Ma Jianguo played with the grandchildren. At the dinner table she shared how the pickled vegetable stall was going, and her parents praised her craftsmanship. She returned at 3 p.m. and stopped by the supermarket on the way to buy daily necessities.

events.name: The second son showed notable progress in family reading time.
events.description: At 8 p.m. during family reading time, Ma Xiulan told Jinghai Folk Tales to her second son Ma Mingzhe and her youngest daughter. For the first time, Mingzhe quietly listened to the whole story and even actively begged, "Mom, tell another one." Pleasantly surprised, Ma Xiulan told another short story, hugged Mingzhe to encourage him, and recorded this progress in her diary.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and pleasant

end_state.mood: Gratified and moved

state.daily_exercise: Walking to and from the bus stop and doing household chores

2025-09.daily_overview: A new week begins. Ma Xiulan got up at 05:35, did stretching and Baduanjin, then took her child to school. During the day she washed clothes and mopped the floor. In the afternoon, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home excited and told her he had been chosen as physics class representative. Ma Xiulan was happy for him and encouraged him to study hard. In the evening, after family reading, she checked homework.

events.name: Eldest son Ma Mingxuan was selected as physics class representative
events.description: A little after 4 p.m., Ma Mingxuan came home from school and excitedly told Ma Xiulan that he had been chosen as the physics class representative because of his interest in science experiments, and he showed her his physics book. Ma Xiulan hugged him, encouraged him to study physics hard, and also reminded him not to neglect other subjects. At dinner, the whole family had a small celebration at the table.

events.name: Daily housework and homework supervision
events.description: In the daytime, I finished chores such as laundry and mopping, cleaned out the refrigerator, and made a shopping list of ingredients for next week. In the evening, after reading time, I checked Mingxuan's and Mingzhe's homework, urged Mingxuan to preview history, and prepared for next week's parent-teacher meeting.

start_state.mood: Regular and simple.

end_state.mood: Proud of her eldest son

state.daily_exercise: Neck and shoulder stretches, one set of Baduanjin, household chores.

2025-09.daily_overview: On Tuesday, the weather turned cloudy with light rain in the afternoon. In the morning, Ma Xiulan delivered 4 of the remaining 6 jars of pickled vegetables to neighbor Zhang Shufen's supermarket to sell on consignment, then braved the drizzle to go to the vegetable market to shop and chatted with stall owner Sun Guifang. In the afternoon, she did embroidery at home and exchanged new patterns with Zhou Xiuqin via WeChat. In the evening, she continued family reading and urged the children to keep warm.

events.name: Handle remaining pickled vegetables and do grocery shopping.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan took 4 of the remaining 6 jars of pickled vegetables to her neighbor Zhang Shufen's convenience store and asked her to sell them on consignment, priced at 7 yuan per jar. Then she went to the vegetable market to buy groceries. While chatting with Sun Guifang, the vegetable stall owner she usually visited, she learned that egg prices had risen slightly. She bought greens and tofu to prepare dinner.

events.name: Embroidering at home and chatting with craft friends
events.description: In the afternoon, a light rain fell. Ma Xiulan sat by the living room window and continued embroidering a sample baby bellyband (in preparation for the community salon display). She sent progress photos to Zhou Xiuqin via WeChat and discussed a new overlock stitch. Zhou Xiuqin also shared a peony embroidery pattern and suggested she try it.

start_state.mood: Peaceful and plain.

end_state.mood: Tranquil and content

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, Baduanjin, walking to the vegetable market, and household chores

2025-09.daily_overview: On Wednesday afternoon, the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was absorbed in a physics experiment at home. He focused sunlight with a magnifying glass to start a fire and nearly burned the curtain. Ma Xiulan discovered it in time and stopped him, calmly gave him safety education, and placed an additional fire extinguisher. In the evening, she called her parents to confirm the free autumn health checkup arrangements. During family reading time in the evening, the whole family discussed fire safety.

events.name: Eldest son's physics experiment nearly caused a fire; safety education provided
events.description: After school in the afternoon, Ma Mingxuan, while his mother was busy in the kitchen, used a magnifying glass on the balcony to focus sunlight and do a fire-starting experiment, accidentally igniting a corner of the curtain. Ma Xiulan smelled the burning smell and rushed over to put it out. She seriously sat Mingxuan down to learn fire safety knowledge together and made him write a handwritten safety guarantee. Afterwards, she checked the expiration date of the household fire extinguisher and placed it in an accessible spot in the kitchen.

events.name: Contact parents about health check-up
events.description: After dinner in the evening, Ma Xiulan called her parents to confirm they were free on September 15 to attend the free autumn health checkup organized by the community. She reminded her father to bring his hypertension medical records and recent blood pressure readings, and urged her mother to get checked as well. She noted the date and time on the calendar and found the family's health insurance cards, putting them in a fixed place.

start_state.mood: Normal

end_state.mood: Scared in hindsight but handled it properly, looking a bit serious

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, Baduanjin, housework.

2025-09.daily_overview: Worried about her second son Ma Mingzhe's eyesight, Ma Xiulan reminded him early in the morning to bring his vision check records and walk to the community health service center. Dr. Wang examined him and confirmed his myopia had deepened to 150 degrees, recommending an immediate change of glasses and limiting screen time. Ma Xiulan had new glasses fitted on the spot. After returning home, she worked with Mingzhe to work out eye-care measures, adjusted the desk lamp and screen time, and agreed on half an hour of outdoor activity every evening.

events.name: Took my second son for a vision checkup and lens replacement
events.description: At 8 a.m., Ma Xiulan reminded Ma Mingzhe to bring his summer vacation vision check form, and the two walked to the community health service center. After a detailed examination, Dr. Wang Jianguo confirmed that his myopia had deepened from 100 to 150 degrees and that his glasses needed to be replaced. Ma Xiulan blamed herself for not supervising enough, listened carefully to eye care tips, then chose new lenses (150 degrees) for Mingzhe at the center's glasses counter, had his eyesight tested on the spot, paid 240 yuan, and picked up the glasses.

events.name: Create a family eye care plan
events.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan and Mingzhe wrote down the doctor's key instructions (daily screen time no more than 1 hour, reading distance of one chi, blink more often, etc.) on sticky notes and posted them by the desk. She adjusted the position of the desk lamp to avoid glare and agreed with Mingzhe: watch TV for only half an hour a day, use the phone only to look up study materials, and spend half an hour in the community open space in the evening.

start_state.mood: Worried about her second son's vision.

end_state.mood: Slightly self-reproachful but already taken action

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, Baduanjin, walking to and from the community center, and an evening stroll.

2025-09.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan's 41st birthday. In the morning she was busy with housework as usual. In the afternoon, her husband ended his shift early and brought home a potted fuchsia as a gift, and the three children presented handmade pop-up cards. After dinner, she prepared the plan to print the birthday photos and called a family meeting to formally sign the screen-time limit and walking agreement as a new family health commitment.

events.name: Household chores routine on the birthday
events.description: Ma Xiulan got up at 05:35 as usual. After her morning exercise, she prepared breakfast and took the children to school. Then she cleaned the house, tidied the yard, and watered the small vegetable garden. She deliberately picked some extra seasonal vegetables to prepare a slightly more elaborate birthday dinner in the evening.

events.name: Family giving birthday gifts and celebrating
events.description: At 5 p.m., her husband Ma Zhiqiang finished work early and brought home a potted fuchsia from the flower shop, giving it to Ma Xiulan and saying the flower was as simple and resilient as she was. The three children also presented handmade pop-up cards: Ma Mingzhe folded three paper roses, Ma Mingxuan drew the background and wrote a blessing, and the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin helped color it. Ma Xiulan was deeply moved and held the potted plant in the yard to take a photo as a memento. The family sat around the dinner table, celebrating simply and warmly.

events.name: Post birthday Moments and prepare for archiving.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan selected close-up photos of potted plants, a family portrait, and greeting card photos, and posted them on WeChat Moments with the caption, “At 41, there are flowers in the yard, food in the bowl, and you by my side.” Afterward, she planned to print the paper photos the next day and put them into the family album.

events.name: Eldest son shares reading progress.
events.description: Around 7 PM, Ma Xiulan's eldest son Ma Mingxuan told her on his own initiative that his Chinese teacher had recently praised him for having richer essay material, inspired by his extracurricular reading of The Grass House. Ma Xiulan, pleased, recorded this progress in the reading growth notebook in the living room.

events.name: Family meeting to set a screen-time limit and walking pact
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ma Xiulan called the whole family together for a family meeting in the living room. Given the deepening myopia of her second son, the family reached an agreement: watch no more than one hour of TV per day, use phones only for studying, and after dinner the whole family would take a half-hour walk on Jingwen Road together. Ma Xiulan led by example and decided to change her daily TV drama habit to listening to the radio. The content of the pact was written on a large piece of paper and posted on the refrigerator door, and the whole family signed to pledge their commitment.

start_state.mood: Peacefully welcoming the new day

end_state.mood: Happy and touched, full of hope for the future

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, Baduanjin, courtyard work, evening walk

2025-09.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ma Xiulan attended the community "Handy Moms" salon in the morning, demonstrated her embroidery skills and guided young mothers, and received two orders for baby belly bands. In the afternoon, she printed birthday photos on the way and went home to care for her potted fuchsia. After dinner, the whole family took their first group walk along Jingwen Road for half an hour, officially launching the family health pact.

events.name: Preparing for and attending the community handicraft salon
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan packed embroidery tools, samples, and teaching materials into a tote bag and walked to the community activity center. At the salon, she embroidered a peony flower on the spot, earning admiration, and then patiently taught three young mothers the basic flat stitch technique. At the end of the activity, Sister Liu, a community worker, gave her a set of exquisite embroidery tools as a souvenir. The two mothers, Mother Zhang and Mother Li, immediately said they wanted to order baby belly bands for their babies.

events.name: Developing, printing, and sorting birthday photos
events.description: After the gathering ended, Ma Xiulan took the memory card to the photo studio in the town center, had three 6-inch paper photos printed from the birthday potted plant close-ups, family blessing photos, and greeting card photos, and paid 20 yuan. After returning home, she found the family album, inserted the three photos into the reserved “Golden Autumn Memories” page, and wrote down the date and notes.

events.name: Learn about and care for fuchsia potted plants
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan searched for fuchsia care tips on her phone, learning key points such as it prefers partial shade, should not be exposed to direct sun, and needs to be watered only when the soil is dry but then thoroughly. She wrote these down in her notebook. She then moved the potted plant to a spot beside the rose bushes in the courtyard, touched the soil with her hand to judge the moisture, watered it thoroughly, removed dead leaves, and placed it in a ventilated, partially shaded area.

events.name: First implementation of the family screen-time limit and walking pact.
events.description: At 7:30 after dinner, Ma Xiulan gathered the family and reaffirmed the screen-time limit and walking agreement made on the 12th. Then she led the family out of the house along Jingwen Road for a half-hour stroll. On the way, she reminded the children to put down their phones and observe the roadside flowers and pedestrians. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang, rarely relaxed, chatted about amusing work stories. After returning home, everyone put their phones in the charging spot in the living room according to the agreement.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to joining social activities

end_state.mood: Content and fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, walking to and from the community center, and an evening walk

2025-09.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan took the requirements for the belly wrap orders and went to the home of her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin. The two designed the embroidery pattern together, exchanged new stitching techniques, and collaborated to complete the first sample embroidery. After returning home in the evening, she received formal orders from two salon mothers via WeChat at 25 yuan per piece, and immediately replied and recorded the measurements. During family reading time in the evening, the father and son had a lively discussion around an automobile mechanics book, and the atmosphere was warm.

events.name: Collaborate with Zhou Xiuqin to design the doudou embroidery pattern
events.description: At 10 a.m., Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Zhou Xiuqin's home with the order requirements. The two discussed the order's size and color needs. Zhou Xiuqin designed two auspicious patterns — Carp Playing in Lotus and Rich and Noble Peony — for her to choose from. After Ma Xiulan chose the Carp Playing in Lotus pattern, Zhou Xiuqin also taught her a practical new overlock stitching technique, which she quickly picked up. The two chatted about everyday things while embroidering samples, and had a simple lunch at Xiuqin's home at noon.

events.name: Father-son interaction over car topics promotes reading
events.description: At 8 p.m. during family reading time, the eldest son Ma Mingxuan pulled out an old book about automobile mechanics and took the initiative to discuss car repair basics with his father Ma Zhiqiang. Ma Zhiqiang usually spoke little, but when it came to car parts he became interested and used gestures to explain to his son how the engine works. Ma Xiulan, off to the side, captured the warm moment with her phone and sent it to the family group chat.

events.name: Received bellyband orders from two mothers.
events.description: At 8:30 pm, Ma Xiulan received two messages on WeChat. Mother Zhang and Mother Li from yesterday's salon each ordered a baby bib at 25 yuan each, providing the baby's gender and size. She made detailed notes, promised to finish within two weeks, and agreed to embroider the baby's nickname for free.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and looking forward to cooperation.

end_state.mood: Pleasant and fulfilling, with a sense of achievement

state.daily_exercise: Neck and shoulder stretches, round trips by electric bike, and a little housework

2025-09.daily_overview: On Monday morning, Ma Xiulan first went to Zhou Xiuqin's home to continue working together on the finishing touches of the belly band embroidery. Each kept one sample as a memento of their collaboration. At 10 a.m., she picked up her parents and accompanied them to the community autumn health check-up: her father's blood pressure was stable, and her mother's blood lipids were slightly high. Ma Xiulan carefully noted the doctor's advice. After returning home in the afternoon, she immediately adjusted the meal plan for the coming week and made a health reminder card that she stuck on the refrigerator door to remind the whole family to watch their diet.

events.name: Completed the cooperative bellyband sample with Zhou Xiuqin.
events.description: After taking her child to school at 7:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan brought her embroidery materials to Zhou Xiuqin's home. The two of them finished embroidering the bellyband sample they had started yesterday, and each kept one finished piece as a memento of their cooperation. Zhou Xiuqin demonstrated the new edge-stitching technique completely, and Ma Xiulan recorded a video with her phone for review. At around 9:30 she took her leave and went to her parents' home.

events.name: Accompanying parents to their autumn health check-up.
events.description: At 10 o'clock, Ma Xiulan arrived at her parents' house to pick up her parents, and the three of them walked to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center. Her father's blood pressure and electrocardiogram results were stable; her mother's tests for blood lipids, blood sugar, and other items showed high blood lipids. Doctor Wang Jianguo explained the results and reminded her mother to reduce greasy foods and eat more vegetables and whole grains. Ma Xiulan recorded the doctor's advice item by item in her notebook.

events.name: Adjust the family menu and make healthy reminder cards
events.description: After returning home in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan revised the menu for the coming week according to the doctor's advice: changed braised pork to steamed fish, replaced fried snacks with blanched vegetables, and increased the proportion of mixed-grain rice. Using sturdy cardstock, she made a parents' health reminder card with her father's blood pressure readings, her mother's blood lipid values, and the doctor's recommendations, attached it to the refrigerator door with a magnet, and took a photo to send to the sisters' group chat to remind her younger sister Ma Xiufen.

start_state.mood: Worried about her family's health and feeling a bit tense.

end_state.mood: Reassured and resolute, determined to stick to a low-fat diet

state.daily_exercise: Neck and shoulder stretches, one set of Baduanjin, walking to escort parents to and from, and housework.

2025-09.daily_overview: Got up at 5:30 in the morning, did shoulder and neck stretches, walked in the courtyard, practiced Baduanjin, then took her daughter to school. In the morning, tidied up the house and drafted a packing list for the National Day trip. In the afternoon, went to the supermarket to buy travel snacks and disposable items, and on the way stopped by her parents' home to remind her mother to watch her diet. In the evening, checked the high-speed rail ticket information again with her husband and confirmed the luggage division of labor.

events.name: Morning exercise and school drop-off routine
events.description: Get up at 5:30, do 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, prepare breakfast (boiled eggs, multigrain porridge), wake the children, have family breakfast at 6:30, walk daughter to primary school at 7:00, on return take a 20-minute walk in the courtyard and water the flowers, then complete one set of Baduanjin.

events.name: Draft a list of items for the National Day trip.
events.description: In the morning at home, she used a notebook to list clothing, medicine, chargers, snacks, and other items, and adjusted it against the travel guide she had saved earlier.

events.name: Purchase travel supplies
events.description: In the afternoon, I rode an e-bike to the supermarket and, according to the list, bought low-fat snacks such as cookies and dried fruit, plus disposable wipes, band-aids, and so on; I especially picked out a few portable picture books for the children to read on the road.

events.name: Discussing travel details with her husband
events.description: In the evening, after Ma Zhiqiang came back from his shift, the two of them checked the high-speed rail ticket times and divided the luggage responsibilities. The husband was in charge of the large items, and she was in charge of the children's supplies and documents to carry with them. She also reminded her husband to check the car in advance, because tomorrow he would drive them to the South Station.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Calm, preparing for the trip as planned

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Looking forward to the trip

2025-09.daily_overview: After persisting with morning exercise, she received a call from the homeroom teacher in the morning telling her about her eldest son's uneven grades in different subjects. In the afternoon, she consulted Dr. Wang to draw up a low-fat meal plan. In the evening, she worked with her husband to set ground rules with their son. Under the double pressure, she acted decisively.

events.name: Received a call from the eldest son's homeroom teacher and learned that his history grades had slipped
events.description: At 10 a.m., she received a call from Han Mei, her eldest son's homeroom teacher, who told her that Ma Mingxuan had repeatedly failed to complete his history homework because he was so absorbed in physics experiments, and his grade in that subject had declined. After hanging up, she felt anxious and decided to work with her husband to resolve it that evening.

events.name: Consulted the community health service center about a low-fat diet plan.
events.description: At 2 p.m., she brought her parents' blood lipid test reports to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center and saw Wang Jianguo, the general practitioner. Dr. Wang explained in detail the risks of high cholesterol and handwrote a low-fat diet guide: focus on steaming and boiling, eat more whole grains and vegetables, reduce red meat, and he provided sample recipes. She took photos with her phone to record the information and scheduled a follow-up appointment for her mother in two weeks.

events.name: Create a two-week low-fat diet plan.
events.description: After returning home from the consultation, she immediately planned a three-meal daily menu in her kitchen notebook, replacing white rice with mixed grain rice and braised pork with steamed fish, and drafted a shopping list, deciding to do a big shopping trip early tomorrow morning.

events.name: Couple agrees on three rules with eldest son
events.description: That evening, she discussed things with her husband while washing dishes in the kitchen. They decided not to discourage Mingxuan's interest in physics but to maintain a balance among all subjects. Afterwards, they called Mingxuan into the living room and clearly set three rules: physics experiments were limited to one hour a day and could only be done after finishing homework; Ma Xiulan would check his homework every night. Mingxuan lowered his head and agreed.

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: As the previous day, worried about mother's health

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Slightly fatigued by the dual pressures of her son's education and her mother's health, but a clear plan has been made.

state.daily_exercise: 20-minute morning walk in the courtyard, one set of Baduanjin, 30-minute walk to send my daughter to school, 10 minutes of waist and back stretching, about 3,000 steps walking round trip to the community health service center, and a 20-minute family walk in the evening.

2025-09.daily_overview: In the morning she officially launched the family's low-fat diet during her shopping trip. Full of energy, she put up health reminders and announced the new rule to the whole family. In the evening, her second son took the initiative to tell stories, and her younger sister called to discuss a trip, making her feel the warmth of family.

events.name: Purchased a full range of low-fat ingredients.
events.description: At 9 a.m., she went to Xingwang Vegetable Market with a shopping list and bought brown rice, oats, millet, spinach, broccoli, tomatoes, apples, sea bass, and live shrimp. At Sun Guifang's stall, she also bought crown daisy and cucumbers. Afterwards, she selected olive oil and low-sodium soy sauce at the supermarket.

events.name: Clever placement of kitchen health reminders
events.description: After organizing the ingredients, she wrote 'Less oil, less salt, more vegetables, steam and boil instead of frying' on a sticky note with a red marker, posted it in prominent places on the refrigerator and wall, and pressed Dr. Wang's recipe onto the refrigerator with a magnet.

events.name: Announcing new dietary rules to the whole family
events.description: In the evening, after her husband came home, she officially announced the low-fat diet plan at the dinner table, explained her mother's blood lipid problem, and stated that it would benefit the whole family's health. Ma Zhiqiang expressed support. The eldest son asked curiously whether they could still eat fried chicken in the future. She smiled and said occasionally. The little daughter cheered and said she wanted to eat dried fruit.

events.name: The second son took the initiative to tell his younger sister a story.
events.description: Family reading time. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, took the initiative to pick up Grimm's Fairy Tales and tell his little sister the story of Little Red Riding Hood. Although he could not recognize some characters, he was full of enthusiasm. She secretly recorded a video on her phone and sent it to the family group chat, and noted his progress in the reading growth journal.

events.name: Video-called younger sister Ma Xiufen to discuss the National Day trip.
events.description: At 8:30 pm, her younger sister made a video call and asked with concern about her elder sister's family's National Day trip to Beijing, reminded her to bring extra coats as it was cool in the morning and evening, and recommended cheap and delicious snack shops. The two chatted for half an hour. After hanging up, she wrote the reminders into her travel notebook.

start_state.mood: Planned last night, full of determination this morning

2025-09.daily_overview: In the morning, she pickled vegetables and tended the courtyard; in the afternoon, she sat in the courtyard with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, drinking tea and doing handicrafts while exchanging skills, nourishing their friendship. The roses in the courtyard were in full bloom, and laughter rang out frequently.

events.name: In the morning, prepare for the gathering and pickle new autumn-winter flavor pickled vegetables.
events.description: In the morning, she wiped down the tables and chairs in the courtyard, set out the tea set and snack plates, and placed the recently finished peony embroidery pieces and a few jars of homemade pickles on the display shelf. Before the gathering, she made the most of her time and pickled a batch of low-salt vegetables with cucumbers and radishes, planning to let Chunmei taste them and give feedback.

events.name: Courtyard craft gathering with childhood friend Liu Chunmei
events.description: At 2 p.m., Liu Chunmei arrived as promised. The two sat on rattan chairs beside the rose bushes. Chunmei had brought recently crocheted coasters and a phone pouch, while she showed off the peony embroidery technique she learned at the community salon. They drank jasmine tea, chatted about family anecdotes and neighborhood gossip, and worked on new patterns. Chunmei suggested putting a QR code on the pickle jars to make it easy for customers to reorder, and she kept that in mind. The gathering lasted more than three hours.

events.name: Giving away pickled vegetables and tidying the courtyard
events.description: When parting in the evening, she gave Liu Chunmei two jars of new pickles and a jar of sweet garlic, and walked her to the entrance of the alley. After returning, she carefully put away the tea set, snack plates, and sewing basket, moved the tables and chairs back into place, and swept up the fallen leaves.

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Relaxed and happy, looking forward to getting together with good friends.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: After spending the afternoon with friends, she felt happy and relaxed in body and mind.

2025-09.daily_overview: Saturday was a busy whirlwind: early in the morning, she helped her husband check the car for rainy weather; at noon, she organized photos and posted them on WeChat Moments; in the afternoon, she took her eldest son to enroll in an advanced history class. Although spending the money hurt, she felt it was worth it.

events.name: Assist husband with pre-trip safety checks on a rainy day
events.description: In the morning, because the roads were slippery from days of rain, she took the initiative to help her husband inspect the truck: Ma Zhiqiang tested the windshield wipers and fog lights, while she checked the tire tread depth and used a flashlight to inspect the undercarriage. Only after confirming the vehicle was in good condition did she feel at ease and watch her husband leave.

events.name: Organized photos on her phone and posted them on Moments to record the reading time.
events.description: During a break from tidying up the house in the afternoon, she browsed the photo album on her phone, selected photos of the children reading over the past week, and edited a WeChat Moments post: “Our family's ever-improving reading time.” It received many likes and encouraging comments.

events.name: Fill in the reading growth journal and communicate with her husband.
events.description: After posting on Moments, she neatly copied the details of the children's reading progress she had observed these days into the reading growth notebook, and wrote on the title page, "Keep family reading for half an hour every day." During dinner, she discussed with her husband how to maintain the habit for the long term, and her husband said he would also join the parent-child reading on weekends.

events.name: Took her eldest son to enroll in a history enrichment class
events.description: At 3 p.m., she took out 500 yuan her husband had given her earlier and 100 yuan she had saved by hand, 600 yuan in total, from her wallet, and called her eldest son to walk to the tutoring institution in town. On the way, she patiently counseled Mingxuan, pointing out the importance of history for the high school entrance examination. After arriving, she asked about the courses in detail. Mingxuan flipped through the textbook and showed interest upon seeing the comic chapter on the Battle of Red Cliffs. She decisively signed and paid, took the receipt and course schedule, went home to inform her husband, and urged her son to cherish the opportunity.

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Slightly somber due to the weather and the son's education issues.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Though it cost money, it put her at ease, and she regained confidence in her child's history studies.

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk for 15 minutes (shortened due to rain), Baduanjin practice at home, 10 minutes of back and waist stretching, about 2 kilometers of walking round trip to the tutoring center, and simple indoor stretching instead of the evening walk.

2025-09.daily_overview: The autumn weather was clear and crisp. On a whim, she took the whole family to the park for a picnic and spent a rare moment of leisure. She took many photos with her phone to make up for the regret of the damaged card last time. The family's laughter helped her temporarily forget the financial pressure.

events.name: Borrow books from a neighbor to update the reading corner.
events.description: In the morning, thinking that the children's books in the reading corner at home needed updating, she went to visit Wang Guilan, who lived across the way. Wang Guilan warmly found a few picture books that her granddaughter had read and a craft magazine, and gave them to her. After thanking her, Ma Xiulan returned home and placed the books on the small bookshelf.

events.name: Making picnic food and preparing for the outing
events.description: Seeing the weather was clear and fine, she made a spur-of-the-moment decision to take the whole family to the park for a picnic. She quickly tossed a large bowl of zhajiang noodles, cut cucumber sticks, washed apples and oranges and packed them into an insulated container, and also checked that her phone had enough storage space.

events.name: The whole family walked to the Cultural Park.
events.description: At 9 a.m., she called her husband and three children and brought along a picnic mat and food. The family walked for 20 minutes from Jingwen Road to the Cultural Park in Jinghai District. The children hopped and skipped along the way, and she kept reminding them to watch out for e-bikes.

events.name: Picnic and play on the park lawn
events.description: They spread a mat on the grassy slope by the lake and sat in a circle sharing homemade zhajiang noodles, cucumbers, and fruit. After lunch, the three children chased each other and flew kites on the grass while she and her husband sat in the shade chatting about the next week's travel plans and division of household chores.

events.name: Lakeside walk and autumn scenery photography
events.description: Around two in the afternoon, the family cleaned up the garbage and walked along the lake. She used her phone to take multiple photos of the lake reflections, yellowing phoenix tree leaves, and family group photos, and was grateful that this time she could take pictures to her heart's content, making up for the distress caused by the damaged memory card in August.

events.name: After returning home, organize and back up photos
events.description: Returning home in the evening, she sat in the living room, selected the most satisfactory photos, shared them with her mother and older sister via WeChat, and decided to buy a portable hard drive as soon as possible to back up all the photos.

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Relaxed, wanting to take the family out to enjoy the sunshine.

end_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: Feeling happy and fulfilled, she was delighted by the travel photos.

state.daily_exercise: Morning: 10 minutes of simplified Baduanjin; family walk in the park, about 8,000 steps; 10 minutes of back and waist stretching before bed (courtyard walk not done because she went out).

2025-09.daily_overview: A new week begins, mainly handling pickled vegetable deliveries and finishing up handicraft orders at home. Successfully delivered two baby bibs and received 50 yuan in craft fees; also went to the community supermarket to settle last month's consignment payment for pickled vegetables, one step closer to the savings goal.

events.name: Completed and delivered an order for two infant belly bands
events.description: In the morning, she finished the last few stitches at home and ironed two infant belly wraps smooth (25 yuan each). She called the customers to let them know; they came to pick them up in the afternoon and paid 50 yuan in cash. She carefully gave washing advice.

events.name: Go to Shufen Supermarket to settle the consignment payment for pickled vegetables.
events.description: At 3 pm, she took her account book and walked to Shufen Convenience Store, where she found her neighbor Zhang Shufen to settle the consignment payment for pickled vegetables for August: 14 bottles sold, 112 yuan receivable, minus a 5% handling fee, actual receipt 106.4 yuan. Shufen encouraged her to continue supplying new autumn and winter products, and she gladly agreed.

events.name: Supervise the children's screen time and go for a family walk.
events.description: After dinner, she strictly enforced the screen-time rule: after the children finished one episode of a cartoon, she turned off the TV. Then she led the whole family out for a half-hour walk, and on the way discussed details of the National Day trip with her husband.

events.name: Learning to use electronic backup for the family ledger
events.description: Before bed, she opened her computer in the study and tried to enter this month's income and expense records in Excel, manually inputting several large expenditures to prepare for the end-of-month financial review.

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Energetic, ready to handle the backlog of matters.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Seeing the income from the side business come in, I felt secure.

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk for 20 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, a 30-minute walk to take her daughter to school, 10 minutes of back and waist stretching, about 2 km walking to and from the supermarket, and a half-hour family walk in the evening.

2025-09.daily_overview: The most important thing today was that her husband bought the National Day high-speed rail tickets, and the travel plan was officially finalized. She also searched online for guides and printed out the route. The family atmosphere grew more and more expectant with the upcoming trip.

events.name: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang buys high-speed rail tickets for National Day
events.description: In the evening, after her husband got off work, he used the 12306 app on his phone to buy 5 high-speed train tickets for G8922 from Tianjin South to Beijing South for September 30, totaling about 500 yuan. He sent a screenshot to Ma Xiulan, and she forwarded it to the family group and informed her sister Li Xiuyun of the pickup time at the station.

events.name: Ma Xiulan searched online for tips and printed out the route.
events.description: In the afternoon, she used the computer at home to search online for Beijing travel guides, focusing on visiting tips and weather for Tiananmen and the Forbidden City. She saved them as bookmarks, printed out the subway route map, and marked the approximate location of her elder sister's home.

events.name: Continue with the low-fat dinner and record how I feel
events.description: For dinner she made steamed sea bass and cold spinach salad. The whole family has gradually accepted the light taste. She wrote in her notebook: 'Day 7. The kids no longer complain, and my husband says he feels lighter. Keep going.'

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Excited about preparing for the trip.

end_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: Looking forward to the National Day trip, feeling bright and cheerful

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk for 20 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, 30-minute walk to take her daughter to school, 10-minute waist and back stretch, evening family walk for 20 minutes, and 1 hour of housework.

2025-09.daily_overview: Noticed that the birthday potted fuchsia has grown new shoots, and took advantage of the cool morning to pinch off the growing tips. In the afternoon, went to the community library to borrow a few cookbooks and craft books to build up knowledge for the winter leisure time.

events.name: Pinch out the fuchsia to encourage branching.
events.description: At a little after 9 a.m., she observed the potted fuchsia her husband had given her for her birthday in the yard. She found that the new shoot at the top of the main branch was about 10 centimeters long. After carefully washing her hands, she gently pinched off the two tender leaves at the tip to encourage lateral buds to sprout, applied diluted carbendazim solution to the cut with a cotton ball, moved the plant to a semi-shaded, airy spot, and then cleaned her hands and tools.

events.name: Go to the community library to borrow books
events.description: In the afternoon, she walked to the Jinghai District Community Library and borrowed two low-fat home-style cookbooks and a copy of Practical Embroidery Patterns Collection, planning to try new dishes and embroidery patterns during the winter idle time and bring inspiration to her side business.

events.name: In the evening, clean the courtyard and prepare soil for autumn sowing
events.description: In the evening, as the temperature dropped slightly, she took a broom and swept up the fallen leaves in the courtyard. She cleared a small patch of ground near the wall, loosened the soil, and mixed in well-rotted organic fertilizer, planning to sow cold-hardy vegetable seeds after the National Day trip.

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Relaxed, enjoying gardening time.

end_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: Satisfied, adding new plans for the courtyard.

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of morning walking in the courtyard, one set of Baduanjin, 30 minutes of walking to take her daughter to school, 10 minutes of waist and back stretching, 1 hour of courtyard work, and about 3 kilometers walking round trip to the library

2025-09.daily_overview: While tidying up the house on Monday, she remembered the lesson of the damaged memory card in August and decided to immediately back up all photos. In the afternoon she went out to buy a portable hard drive and learned automatic backup, finally feeling relieved.

events.name: Review the lessons from August and decide to buy a portable hard drive
events.description: In the morning, she sat in the study, looking at the newly taken September photos stored on her computer. Thinking of the precious moments lost in August—close-ups of the garden roses, videos from her eldest son's birthday party, etc.—she decided to buy a hard drive today; it couldn't be put off any longer.

events.name: Husband comforts and supports
events.description: She mentioned the losses in August to Ma Zhiqiang. Her husband encouraged her: “Go buy a hard drive and back everything up, so you won’t leave any regrets later.” She nodded and resolved to act immediately.

events.name: Go to a digital store to buy a portable hard drive.
events.description: In the afternoon, she walked with cash to a digital electronics store on Dongfanghong Road in Jinghai District, and with the clerk's recommendation chose a 1TB USB3.0 portable hard drive for 120 yuan, opening it immediately after returning home.

events.name: Learn to back up and set up automatic backup
events.description: After returning home, she connected the hard drive to her computer and copied all the photo folders on the computer to the external hard drive. Then she searched online for tutorials, learned to use Windows File History, and set up automatic weekly backups of photos and documents. Watching the progress bar finish, she thought that at last all her new memories were insured.

start_state.location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Recalling the old loss, she resolved to take immediate action.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
end_state.mood: Backup completed, mind at ease

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk for 20 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, a 30-minute walk to send my daughter to school, 10 minutes of lower back stretching, and walking to and from the digital store about 2 kilometers.

2025-09.daily_overview: On the monthly financial review day, she carefully calculated September expenses with her husband and found that education spending was severely over budget. The couple urgently discussed and worked out a spending-saving plan for October, and added a monthly education emergency fund of 200 yuan, upgrading their financial management awareness once again.

events.name: Organize this month's income and expense documents.
events.description: After dinner, she took the family ledger and all of the month's shopping receipts, tutoring fee slips, and supermarket receipts out of the desk drawer in the study, spread them on the dining table, sorted them, and clipped them into separate categories: education, medical, and daily expenses. Then she waited to check them together with her husband.

events.name: Husband and wife jointly checking the accounts
events.description: After the meal, Ma Zhiqiang sat down, and she reported each expense while he checked against the receipts. When they calculated the education expenses, the two found that just the history enrichment class and book materials had already exceeded the budget. Adding the earlier cost of the second son's new lenses and other planned expenses, the pressure was considerable.

events.name: Formulated next month's budget adjustment plan.
events.description: Facing the overspending, she discussed it with her husband and decided: starting in October, greatly reduce snack purchases, cancel plant purchases on non-holidays, and set aside 200 yuan every month from her husband's salary as an education emergency fund. She wrote the new rules in red pen on the flyleaf of the account book and set a phone alarm on the 26th of each month to remind herself to take stock.

events.name: Archive the vouchers and update the travel budget
events.description: After checking the accounts, she put away the receipt folder and also wrote down the expected expenses for the Beijing trip in her travel notebook: round-trip high-speed rail 500 yuan, three days of meals and lodging 800 yuan, and reserve cash 200 yuan, reminding herself to keep tracking expenses during the trip. She added a note in the notebook: on the 28th, her daughter has a dental appointment, and this expense should be kept until the end of the month and then recorded again.

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Calm daily routine; preparing for the routine end-of-month work.

end_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: The overspending brought pressure, but the new plan brought a sense of control.

state.daily_exercise: A 20-minute courtyard walk in the morning, one set of Baduanjin, a 30-minute walk to take my daughter to school, 10 minutes of waist and back stretching, and a 20-minute family walk in the evening (mainly indoor financial work, with slightly less exercise).

2025-09.daily_overview: Today was a whole-family deep-cleaning day, busy from morning to night. It happened that grid worker Zheng Xiuying came to the door and revealed that she had recommended their family for the “Most Beautiful Family” award. Deeply encouraged, Ma Xiulan led the family in scrubbing and cleaning the house inside and out until it looked brand new.

events.name: Organize the family and assign cleaning tasks
events.description: In the morning, she gathered the whole family in the living room and announced the autumn cleaning. She assigned tasks: her husband would clean the windows and move furniture, her eldest son would tidy the bookshelf in his room, her second son would put away toys and sweep the floor, her youngest daughter would wipe the tables and chairs with a wet cloth, and she herself would handle the heavy grease in the kitchen and the courtyard.

events.name: Each family member carried out their own cleaning tasks.
events.description: Her husband brought out a ladder and wiped clean all the window glass; the eldest son sorted and put away the books and threw away waste paper; the second son put the toys scattered all over the floor into boxes and swept with a broom; the youngest daughter, with her mother's help, wiped down the coffee table and TV cabinet. She focused on tackling the kitchen: she removed the range hood filter and soaked it in degreaser, scrubbed the stove with a steel wool pad, and cleaned the top of the refrigerator and the old grease buildup.

events.name: Community grid worker Zheng Xiuying came by to share the good news
events.description: At a little past 3 p.m., community grid worker Zheng Xiuying came by for a visit. While chatting beside the rose bushes in the courtyard, she revealed that the subdistrict would be selecting the 'Most Beautiful Family' at the end of the year, and that she had already recommended Ma Xiulan's family. Ma Xiulan quickly made a modest reply, and Zheng Xiuying encouraged her: 'Your family has a harmonious couple, well-behaved children, and a well-kept yard—you have a good chance.' She was secretly pleased and decided to put more effort into keeping the home tidy.

events.name: After being inspired, she put more effort into tidying the courtyard and living room.
events.description: After seeing off Zheng Xiuying, she felt a surge of energy. She picked up a big broom and thoroughly swept the fallen leaves and weeds in the courtyard, used garden shears to trim the overgrown rose branches, put the scattered schoolbags and toys in the living room back in place, and wiped the dust off the furniture. She felt that the home was indeed warmer.

events.name: Seasonal clothing reorganization
events.description: During a break in the afternoon cleaning, she opened the wardrobe, washed and folded the family's summer lightweight clothes and put them into storage bins, and took out the autumn long-sleeved jackets and hung them in a prominent place for easy access during the National Day trip.

events.name: Final inspection to wrap up the big clean-up
events.description: In the evening, she led the whole family to inspect each room one by one: windows bright, bookshelves tidy, toys put into boxes, kitchen free of grease, courtyard fresh and clean. Her husband carried several large bags of garbage to the collection point. Though tired, the whole family looked at the renewed home and all wore satisfied smiles.

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Full of energy, planning a thorough cleaning.

end_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: Tired but full of a sense of accomplishment, happy to have been recommended

state.daily_exercise: Early morning: 10 minutes of simplified Baduanjin (time was tight because of the big cleaning), all-day high-intensity housework equivalent to substantial exercise, and 10 minutes of waist and back stretching before bed.

2025-09.daily_overview: Originally planned to pack for the trip, but the plan was disrupted by the youngest daughter's sudden toothache. Took Xinxin to the clinic for root canal treatment, feeling distressed and self-blaming. After returning home, I made up my mind to overhaul the whole family's oral hygiene and snacking habits. In the evening, I was pleasantly surprised to find that my daughter had made progress in recognizing characters.

events.name: Daughter went to the doctor urgently for a toothache
events.description: In the morning, she heard her younger daughter Ma Yuxin crying and shouting that she had a toothache. An examination revealed obvious dark cavities in the lower baby molars. Judging the situation as urgent, she immediately took Xinxin to the nearby community dental clinic. Along the way, she kept comforting her: "After the dentist, Mommy will make you a cloth doll." The doctor diagnosed severe decay in the baby teeth and said root canal treatment was needed. During the half-hour treatment, Xinxin cried and fussed. Ma Xiulan held her daughter's hand tightly and encouraged her softly. The treatment cost 200 yuan in cash. She tucked the clinic receipt into her ledger, planning to enter it later. The doctor explained what to watch out for and prescribed anti-inflammatory medicine.

events.name: Clean out the family snack cabinet and ban high-sugar foods.
events.description: At noon, after returning home and settling Xinxin down to take her medicine and rest, she opened the living room snack cabinet, packed all the high-sugar foods such as candies and sandwich cookies into bags, and sealed them in a high cabinet, leaving only a little dried fruit. She seriously explained to the three children the dangers of eating sugar, announced that from now on they could only eat a small amount of sugar on special days, and decided to buy more fruit to replace snacks in the future.

events.name: Supervised everyone to brush their teeth carefully in the evening
events.description: At 9 pm, she called the three children to the bathroom, took out an hourglass timer, and demonstrated the correct brushing method: brush up and down, inside and out, and brush every tooth surface for a full two minutes. Then she checked each child one by one, especially helping Xinxin brush hand over hand. She designated the eldest son to be responsible for daily supervision of his younger siblings' brushing. The first supervision session took nearly half an hour.

events.name: During reading time, her daughter's character recognition improved by leaps and bounds
events.description: Despite the busy day, the nightly reading time was not interrupted. Tonight she accompanied Xinxin in reading basic literacy cards and was pleasantly surprised to find that her daughter could already recognize five characters on her own, such as sky, big, and small. She happily hugged her daughter, called her older brothers over to witness it, and the whole family applauded to encourage her. She recorded this milestone in her reading notebook.

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: The leisurely weekend was disrupted by a sudden toothache

end_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: She felt sorry for her daughter and was glad to see her literacy progressing; after the toothache incident, she valued her health more.

state.daily_exercise: 10 minutes of simple courtyard stretching in the morning, short walks to and from the clinic, housework, and 10 minutes of stretching before bed.

2025-09.daily_overview: On the last day before the National Day trip, she completed several preparations in quick succession: consulting about children's fluoride toothpaste, protecting the persimmon tree for winter, packing the family's luggage, and holding a family meeting to make oral hygiene a routine. In the evening, she finished the last family reading session of the month, drawing a successful conclusion to a reading plan she had kept up for a month.

events.name: Consulted the community health service center about fluoride toothpaste.
events.description: At 9 a.m., she went to the community clinic and found Doctor Wang Jianguo, asking in detail about choosing fluoride toothpaste for children. Dr. Wang recommended two brands of low-fluoride toothpaste and reminded her to use only a pea-sized amount each time to prevent swallowing. She noted this on her phone, thanked him, and went directly to the supermarket to buy two tubes.

events.name: Completing the final annual care of the persimmon tree with her second son
events.description: In the afternoon, she took her second son Ma Mingzhe to tend to the persimmon tree in the courtyard. The two cleared fallen leaves under the tree together, Ma Mingzhe watered it thoroughly, and she wrapped the base of the trunk with straw to help it survive the winter. Looking at the sapling, now 1.5 meters tall, she encouraged her son: 'It has grown well this year; next year it can bear fruit.'

events.name: Prepare all luggage for the Beijing trip
events.description: In the afternoon, she focused on packing for the family trip: a change of clothes for each person, toiletry bags, the youngest daughter's nap blanket, and the children's puzzles and water bottles. She brought a gift box of homemade pickles as a present for her sister, and called her mother Li Xiuying to ask her to help take care of the family vegetable garden.

events.name: Hold a family meeting on oral hygiene.
events.description: At 7 p.m., she gathered the whole family in the living room and announced the official new oral hygiene rules: brush teeth for two minutes using an hourglass timer every morning and evening, and rinse the mouth after meals; at the end of each month, the whole family would check dental cleanliness together. She demonstrated the correct brushing technique again and had the children practice on the spot. She decided that snacks would mainly be changed to homemade dried fruit, and a collective check-up would be held after half a year. Although the children were a bit reluctant, they all nodded in agreement.

events.name: Complete the monthly family reading review meeting.
events.description: At 8 p.m., she led the children in the reading corner for the last family reading session of the month. She read the final story from 'Jinghai Folk Tales', then asked the children to share their favorite books. The second son said he liked the magical monkey, the eldest son said chatting with Dad about car repair was interesting, and the youngest daughter recited the new characters she had learned. She concluded, 'We did very well sticking with this this month, and we should keep it up in the future!' She then solemnly recorded in the reading growth notebook that they had read for 30 days in September with no absences.

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Busy and excited, making the final push for the trip.

end_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: Everything is ready; I'm looking forward to setting out tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: 20-minute morning stroll in the courtyard, one set of Baduanjin, 30-minute walk to take her daughter to school, 10-minute lower back stretch, about 4,000 steps walking round trip to the clinic and supermarket, and physical labor of packing luggage.

2025-09.daily_overview: The long-awaited trip to Beijing finally began! The family of five, carrying bags and bundles, arrived in Beijing by high-speed rail. Sister Li Xiuyun warmly greeted them at the station. At night, the whole family squeezed together at her home and slept on the floor. Though the conditions were simple, the children were excited and the adults were joyful; the fatigue of the journey was drowned in the warmth of family love.

events.name: Final luggage and trip check in the early morning
events.description: She got up at 5:30 a.m. and did a final check, confirming that everyone's ID documents, tickets, chargers, and emergency medicine were in order. At 7 o'clock, the family of five, carrying a large suitcase, backpacks, and a gift box of pickled vegetables, got into the reserved taxi at the door of their home and headed to Tianjin South Station. The children were very excited.

events.name: Take the high-speed rail to Beijing to meet her sister at the station.
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., the G8922 high-speed train departed on time. Along the way she watched the scenery outside the window, the two children leaned against the window, and her husband read the newspaper. They arrived at Beijing South Railway Station at 10:15. Her elder sister Li Xiuyun was already waiting at the exit, and they hugged warmly. Then they took her sister's car to her home in Daxing District.

events.name: In the afternoon, settled in and rested at my sister's home.
events.description: In the afternoon, at her older sister's home, she and her sister cleared out two rooms and laid out floor bedding. The children played in the living room while she helped her sister prepare dinner ingredients, and the two sisters chatted about everyday family matters. Her husband and brother-in-law went to a nearby supermarket to buy some milk and fruit.

events.name: Evening family dinner and travel planning.
events.description: In the evening, the two families sat together and ate the fried sauce noodles made by her elder sister. After the meal, she took out a gift box of pickled vegetables and gave it to her sister, who praised it as her favorite taste. Then everyone discussed the itinerary for the next three days: on October 1, watch the flag-raising ceremony and visit the Forbidden City; on October 2, go to the zoo; on October 3, return home. The children listened with sparkling eyes.

start_state.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
start_state.mood: Excited, nervous, worried about leaving something behind

end_state.location: At her older sister Li Xiuyun's home in Daxing District, Beijing
end_state.mood: Safe journey, reunion with family, filled with joy and relaxation

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of light stretching in the morning, carrying luggage, walking to the station and inside the station about 4,000 steps, 5 minutes of deep breathing relaxation before bed

2025-08.daily_overview: In the early morning, while walking in the courtyard, she was pleasantly surprised to find the roses in early bloom; she started a new parent-child ritual of watering flowers; in the morning, the pickled vegetables sold poorly at the stall, but she actively adjusted her attitude; in the evening, she bought an eye-protecting desk lamp online, managing the family budget carefully.

events.name: Morning courtyard walk and the first blooming of the roses
events.description: At 5:20, Ma Xiulan was walking slowly and stretching in her own courtyard when she noticed two rose bushes blooming with the first pink flowers of the summer. Excitedly, she called the three children over to enjoy them together. She guided the children to water the plants, took close-up photos of the flowers with her phone, and shared them in the photography group. From then on, she decided to take a walk in the courtyard every morning and tend to the plants and flowers.

events.name: Friend and vegetable stall owner.
events.description: After the walk, she opened the window in the living room and practiced a set of Baduanjin by herself. Her movements were smooth and coordinated with deep breathing, and she felt her muscles and bones stretch and relax.

events.name: Setting up a stall at the vegetable market, she encountered high temperatures and sluggish sales.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, she transported 30 jars of newly pickled vegetables by electric bike to the stall at Xingwang Vegetable Market. In the morning, the heat was high and there were few people. She actively hawked and invited people to taste, but by noon only 3 jars were sold. She persisted until 4 p.m. and sold 5 jars in total for the day. After returning home, she counted the inventory with a heavy heart.

events.name: Buy an eye-protecting desk lamp online to protect the children's eyesight
events.description: In the evening, thinking of how the children often bend over their desks to do homework, she compared options repeatedly on an e-commerce platform and ordered an 80-yuan LED eye-protection desk lamp, expected to arrive in 2-3 days. After paying, she chatted with her neighbor Wang Guilan on WeChat; although it hurt to spend the money, she felt it was worth it.

events.name: Soaking feet and relaxing before bed
events.description: Before bed, she soaked her feet in hot water with mugwort for 15 minutes, reviewed the day while soaking, and did deep-breathing relaxation for 5 minutes.

start_state.mood: Calm, full of anticipation for the new day

end_state.mood: Worried about poor sales, but felt fulfilled by the family's small progress.

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of morning courtyard walking, one set of Baduanjin, 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, 10 minutes of lower back stretching, and 20 minutes of evening walking.

2025-08.daily_overview: On the weekend, she was dragged by her neighbor Wang Guilan to take part in a square-dancing friendship competition. She went from panicked refusal to reluctantly joining in, and in the end it became a joke in the family and neighbor WeChat groups. The unexpected group activity brought a long-missed sense of relaxation.

events.name: Morning walk in the courtyard and watering flowers with the children
events.description: At 5:20, Ma Xiulan walked laps in the courtyard for 15 minutes, then took the children to water the roses. Ma Mingxuan carried the watering can, Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin frolicked around, and Ma Xiulan took photos of the flower buds.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin and stretching
events.description: After watering the flowers, I practiced a set of Baduanjin in the living room, then stretched my shoulders, neck, and lower back, feeling relaxed.

events.name: Was dragged by her neighbor to fill in at the square dance.
events.description: At 9 a.m., when she got back from buying groceries, Wang Guilan stopped her and said the community square-dance friendship match was short of people and insisted she participate. Ma Xiulan could not refuse, so she was dragged to the activity center and got a pink T-shirt.

events.name: The square dance friendship competition was both embarrassing and joyful.
events.description: At 2 p.m., the competition started in the community square. Ma Xiulan stood in the back row and followed along, making a few mistakes but persisting to the end. The team received a participation award — each person got a bag of laundry detergent. She stepped off the stage wiping sweat and told Wang Guilan to go easy on her next time.

events.name: Posting photos in the WeChat group drew teasing from the neighbors.
events.description: In the evening, community staff posted the competition photos to the group. Ma Xiulan's pink-clad, flailing pose drew good-natured laughter. She pretended to hit Wang Guilan, but after returning home, she secretly saved the photo, planning to put it in the family album.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, took the children for a slow 20-minute walk around the neighborhood, chatting about funny square-dance stories, and the whole family laughed.

start_state.mood: A bit sleepy, planning to have an easy weekend.

end_state.mood: Relaxed and happy; she felt that although she made a bit of a fool of herself today, she was quite glad.

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk 15 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, square dance 15 minutes, evening walk 20 minutes, stretching.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, practiced Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao. In the morning, installed an eye-protecting desk lamp. In the afternoon, set up a stall with childhood friend Liu Chunmei to clear out stock. Her friend's help and suggestions made her start thinking about new sales channels.

events.name: Practicing Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao
events.description: At 5:30, met Aunt Zhao in the community garden and practiced a set of Baduanjin together, corrected a few movements, then took a slow walk around the garden and exchanged health tips.

events.name: Courtyard stroll and watering flowers together with the kids
events.description: After the joint practice ended, they went home, walked in the courtyard for 10 minutes, and watered the roses with the children. Ma Mingxuan took the initiative to assign tasks, while Ma Xiulan continued using her phone to photograph the flowers and shared them in the photography group.

events.name: Installed an eye-care desk lamp and reminded the children
events.description: In the morning, the courier delivered an eye-protection desk lamp. Ma Xiulan unwrapped it, installed it on her eldest son's desk, adjusted the brightness, then gathered her three children and told them they must turn on the lamp when doing homework.

events.name: Liu Chunmei helped set up the stall and discussed strategies.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Ma Xiulan took the 25 jars of pickles that had not sold the day before to the vegetable market. Liu Chunmei hurried over to help, played a pickle-making video on her phone, and suggested promoting them on WeChat Moments. Ma Xiulan offered a buy-three-get-one-free deal, but by evening she had sold only 8 jars. The two had dinner at a steamed bun shop and discussed in detail a plan for online promotion.

events.name: Deep breathing and foot soaking before bed
events.description: Before bed, soak your feet in hot water with mugwort for 15 minutes, do 5 minutes of deep breathing to relax, and reflect on the day's gains.

start_state.mood: Feeling weighed down because the pickled vegetables are not selling, but hoping friends can come up with ideas

end_state.mood: Although the pickled vegetables still had not sold well, the help of friends made her feel a little warmer inside.

state.daily_exercise: Practice one set of Baduanjin, take a 10-minute walk in the courtyard, tend the market stall, and take a 20-minute evening walk.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Monday, she tidied up the house, kept up her morning exercise, took stock of the pickled vegetable inventory, and had a phone call with a childhood friend to work out a WeChat sales plan, preparing for tomorrow's proactive push.

events.name: Walk in the courtyard and loosen up the shoulders and neck
events.description: At 5:20, Ma Xiulan walked laps in the courtyard for 20 minutes, adding shoulder circles and chest expansion exercises, and felt her shoulders and back looser. She planned the day's housework and shopping list.

events.name: Baduanjin exercise
events.description: After the walk, practiced a set of Baduanjin alone in the living room, with precise movements and steady breathing.

events.name: Take the children to water the flowers and record the growth
events.description: After the walk, she took the three children to continue the morning watering ritual. Ma Mingxuan took the initiative to check leaves for pests, Ma Mingzhe loosened the soil, and Ma Yuxin sprayed water. Ma Xiulan took several close-up photos of flowers using diagonal composition and posted them in the photography group; the group members praised her improvement.

events.name: Taking inventory of pickled vegetables and consulting Liu Chunmei
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan counted the pickled vegetable jars in the kitchen again and found that, with the newly pickled ones added, another 28 jars had piled up. She called Liu Chunmei, and the two discussed the WeChat sales copy and forwarding strategy. Liu Chunmei agreed to help post it in the colleague group.

events.name: Go back to my parents' home in the afternoon
events.description: After a short midday nap, she walked the children back to her parents' home on Shengli Street. She helped her mother pick vegetables and prepare dinner, while her father played chess with his grandson. She also brought two jars of pickled cucumbers for her parents to taste; her mother praised the flavor and suggested giving some to relatives.

events.name: Stretching and deep breathing before bed
events.description: Before bed, do waist and back stretches for 10 minutes, then sit quietly and breathe deeply for 5 minutes. Decided to put off foot soaking starting tomorrow because the high temperature makes me feel a bit too hot and restless.

start_state.mood: Calm, mulling over how to handle the pickled vegetables.

end_state.mood: A new sales idea came to her, and she felt a little hopeful.

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk for 20 minutes with stretching, a set of Baduanjin, and household chores

2025-08.daily_overview: Today I tried new methods on two fronts: I increased my exercise and studied photography composition, and my pickled vegetables were sold on WeChat for the first time, receiving support from family and friends. My confidence was ignited by the small orders.

events.name: Extended the walk to 20 minutes and added stretching.
events.description: At 5:15, Ma Xiulan extended her walk time in the courtyard to 20 minutes, stopping every 5 minutes to do simple stretches such as raising her arms overhead, side stretches, and chest expansion. She felt that her body was adapting well and that she was sweating slightly.

events.name: Baduanjin and shoulder and neck stretches
events.description: After the walk, she practiced a set of Baduanjin in the living room, followed by 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, and felt refreshed.

events.name: Promoting pickled vegetables on WeChat Moments.
events.description: At 10 a.m., instead of going to the market stall, Ma Xiulan followed Liu Chunmei's advice and took several close-up photos of the pickles with her phone, then posted them on Moments with the caption

events.name: Water flowers with the child and learn diagonal composition.
events.description: In the evening, while watering the flowers, Ma Xiulan tried a diagonal composition to photograph the roses and got likes in the photography group. The children gathered around, and she took the opportunity to teach them about framing.

events.name: Evening reading and relaxing before bed.
events.description: At 8 p.m., after half an hour of family reading, she did 10 minutes of lower back stretches, then sat quietly and took deep breaths for 5 minutes. She didn't soak her feet today, but felt it didn't affect her sleep.

start_state.mood: A little nervous, not sure if selling on WeChat will work.

end_state.mood: A modest gain; I feel I still need to try more new approaches.

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk for 20 minutes plus stretching, one set of Baduanjin, shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, evening walk for 20 minutes.

2025-08.daily_overview: Fulfilled yesterday's pickled vegetable order and took samples to Liu Chunmei on the way. In the afternoon, she stayed home and did embroidery quietly, laying a foundation for future small handicraft jobs. The days move slowly forward amid the busyness.

events.name: Practicing Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao
events.description: At 5:30, as agreed, she practiced a set of Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao in the community garden. Aunt Zhao praised Ma Xiulan for her increasingly standard movements. Afterwards, the two walked a lap in the garden and chatted about health and wellness topics.

events.name: Watering flowers and taking photos in the courtyard in the early morning
events.description: After returning home from the group practice, she took the children to water the plants. Ma Mingxuan skillfully used the hose to water the west-side flower bed, while Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin had a competition. Ma Xiulan photographed the roses using diagonal composition and specifically tagged Zhou Xiuqin and Aunt Wu to ask for their advice.

events.name: To arrange delivery of the reserved pickles and thank friends
events.description: At 9 a.m., she packed the 6 jars of pickled vegetables ordered yesterday into a cloth bag and rode her electric bike to deliver them to several friends' homes, including Wang Guilan and Zhou Xiuqin. She specially brought each person an extra small bag of scallions she had grown herself. At Zhou Xiuqin's home, they chatted for a while about new embroidery patterns and agreed to visit a handicraft market together next time.

events.name: A fulfilling afternoon spent at home doing embroidery
events.description: In the afternoon, she embroidered a handkerchief with a peony pattern in the living room while watching TV news. Liu Chunmei called to ask about the pickled vegetable orders, and she happily said they had all been delivered. Liu Chunmei suggested setting up a stall together at the next market, and she agreed. After finishing embroidering a petal, she started preparing dinner.

events.name: Stretching and deep breathing before bed
events.description: Do 10 minutes of lower back stretches before bed, and sit quietly breathing deeply for 5 minutes. Still didn't soak my feet today, but I've gotten used to it.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, preparing to go make deliveries
