end_state.mood: A small sense of achievement, with the body feeling slightly tired

state.daily_exercise: Did one round of Baduanjin, strolled in the courtyard for 20 minutes, and took a 20-minute evening walk.

2025-08.daily_overview: Morning exercise added new moves; watering and taking photos became a daily routine; at the vegetable market she chatted with the stall owner while shopping, and even tried selling pickled vegetables on consignment, quietly accumulating energy for life.

events.name: Fine-tune walking and stretching exercises.
events.description: At 5:20, kept up a 20-minute walk in the courtyard, added shoulder circles, slowed down the arm raises and side stretches, and felt the shoulder and back stretch more thoroughly. Hummed a tune while going inside to prepare breakfast.

events.name: Baduanjin exercise
events.description: After the walk, she completed a set of Baduanjin in the living room. Her movements were already smooth and fluid, coordinated with deep breathing, and she felt her stamina was getting better and better.

events.name: Watering flowers and seeking photography advice in the early morning
events.description: After Baduanjin, she took the children to water the flowers. Ma Mingxuan checked the rose leaves, while Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin sprayed the vegetable seedlings with water. Ma Xiulan took close-ups of the dewy flowers from a low angle and sent them to the Tianjin Skilled Hands Sisters Group to ask Aunt Wu for advice, and received praise.

events.name: Go to the vegetable market and discuss selling goods on consignment with the stall owner.
events.description: At 9 a.m., she rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market for groceries. When buying vegetables at Aunt Sun's stall, Aunt Sun showed concern about the pickled vegetable sales and offered to put two jars at her stall to help sell them. Ma Xiulan gratefully left two jars of sweet garlic, and they agreed to split the proceeds after selling.

events.name: Evening reading and pre-bed stretching.
events.description: Family reading for half an hour at 8 p.m., then took the children for a 20-minute evening walk. Did 10 minutes of lower back and waist stretches before bed, and 5 minutes of deep breathing. Foot soaking was still on hold because the weather felt too hot.

start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.mood: Relaxation.

state.daily_exercise: 20-minute morning courtyard walk plus stretching, one set of Baduanjin, and a 20-minute evening walk

2025-08.daily_overview: Best friend Chen Yulan came to visit with her son. The joy of reunion after a long time apart eased the pickle troubles. The old friend's listening allowed her to pour out her concerns and planted the seeds of change.

events.name: Early morning walk and Baduanjin
events.description: To prepare to pick up her best friend, she got up at 5:00, took a quick 15-minute walk in the courtyard, then practiced a set of Baduanjin. The movements were a bit fast, but she made sure to finish. Shoulder and neck stretches were simplified.

events.name: Welcome close friend Chen Yulan and her son
events.description: At 10 a.m., Chen Yulan, Ma Xiulan's junior high school classmate, arrived in Jinghai by bus from Tangshan with her 8-year-old son Chen Xiaojun. Ma Xiulan was waiting early at the station, and they held hands and smiled as soon as they met. Back home, she had already tidied up the guest room and placed dried flowers. The three of them ate Tianjin baozi she had made in advance and chatted about family life. Yulan said she was busy running a clothing store in Tangshan, and Ma Xiulan talked about funny things her children had done.

events.name: Visited the vegetable market and looked at the pickled vegetable jars.
events.description: In the afternoon, she took Yulan and her son to the Xingwang Vegetable Market and bought live fish and vegetables. After going home, she showed Yulan the pickle jars in the kitchen and let her taste them. Ma Xiulan pointed at several jars of stock and said worriedly that it was so hot this summer that nobody came to the vegetable market, so the pickled vegetables were not selling and had piled up. Yulan tasted them and said the flavor was good, but the packaging was too plain, and suggested making it more refined and selling them outside.

events.name: Evening family dinner and late-night chat with close friends
events.description: That evening, Ma Xiulan cooked a table full of dishes: braised fish, stir-fried mixed vegetables, and sweet and sour pork. Her husband and the three children also sat down at the table, and Chen Xiaojun quickly started playing with the children. After dinner, the two of them sat in the living room flipping through middle school photos and talked until late. Yulan said she could help come up with ideas for the packaging, and Ma Xiulan felt warm inside.

events.name: Simplified stretching before bed
events.description: Since it got late from chatting, she only did a simple 5-minute waist and back stretch, did not soak her feet, and went to sleep after a few quick deep breaths.

start_state.mood: Excited, going to pick up my best friend.

end_state.mood: Happy, but the pressure of the pickles is still there.

state.daily_exercise: Early morning 15-minute courtyard walk, one set of Baduanjin (simplified version), housework

2025-08.daily_overview: Enjoying pickled vegetables and doing crafts with my close friend; in the afternoon, sewing a cushion and mailing a package to my older sister far away. Family affection and friendship intertwine in the threads and the aroma of the sauce.

events.name: Morning walk in the courtyard and admiring flowers.
events.description: At 5:30, she walked laps in the courtyard alone for 20 minutes, along with stretching. A few more Chinese roses had bloomed, pink and pretty. After the walk, she quietly prepared breakfast while Yulan and Xiaojun were still asleep.

events.name: Baduanjin exercise
events.description: Quietly did a set of Baduanjin in the living room, with gentle movements, without disturbing the guests.

events.name: Taste pickled vegetables and do handicrafts with Chen Yulan
events.description: In the morning, she and Yulan sampled several kinds of pickled vegetables in the kitchen, putting them into small dishes. Yulan thought the sweet garlic was the standout and suggested putting it in prettier jars to sell at a higher price. After eating, they set up embroidery hoops in the living room. Ma Xiulan taught Yulan to embroider leaf outlines, and Yulan used her phone to take photos of the pickle jars and embroidery pieces, saying she would promote them for her in her friends' group chat. The children played with building blocks nearby.

events.name: Sewed a cushion and mailed it to her older sister in Beijing
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan found a few bright floral fabric scraps and, on Yulan's suggestion, pieced them into a sturdy small cushion to send to her elder sister Li Xiuyun in Beijing. After sewing it, she also packed a bottle of chili sauce and wrote a note: Elder Sister, the cushion is warm to sit on in winter, and the chili sauce is a recipe even Mom praises. She walked with Yulan and her child to the Jinghai Post Office to mail it. Yulan teased her: With skills like yours, you could sell these someday.

events.name: Evening family walk
events.description: After dinner, the whole family took Yulan and her son for a 20-minute slow walk in the community. The children chased and played, while Ma Xiulan and Yulan chatted about old times.

events.name: Stretching and deep breathing before bed
events.description: Before bed, I did 10 minutes of back and waist stretches and 5 minutes of deep breathing. I'm in a good mood today; having friends around makes life not so hard.

start_state.mood: Relaxed; with my bestie here, I feel at ease.

end_state.mood: Heartwarming, a warm surge of sisterly affection.

state.daily_exercise: A 20-minute morning walk plus stretching, one set of Baduanjin, and a 20-minute evening walk

2025-08.daily_overview: The whole family did a thorough cleaning, making the house shine, and also rushed out a batch of simple pickled vegetable gift boxes, opening up a small market among relatives and friends. It was busy, but they were full of energy.

events.name: Sticking to morning walks and stretching
events.description: At 5:30, completed a 20-minute walk and accompanying stretches in the courtyard, with smooth movements. She stood and took deep breaths, saw that the vegetables in the yard had grown a bit taller, and felt that being active every day was truly comfortable. After going inside, she woke the children to get ready for the big cleaning.

events.name: Baduanjin exercise
events.description: After the walk, I practiced a set of Baduanjin alone in the living room. Since I had many things to do today, my movements were a bit quick, but I completed the full set.

events.name: The whole family pitched in for a thorough cleaning
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan divided up tasks: her husband cleaned the windows, the eldest son tidied the desk and bundled up old books, the second son swept and mopped the floor, the youngest daughter put away toys, and she took down and washed all the curtains and bedsheets. The family worked for two hours, and the house was completely transformed. She took a photo of the tidy living room as a keepsake. The clutter in the corner of the living room was also cleared out, making space for a reading corner.

events.name: Making simple gift boxes of pickled vegetables and promoting them
events.description: During a break in the thorough cleaning, Ma Xiulan found a stack of clean paper boxes and red string, repacked the pickled vegetables into 10 simple gift boxes, and tied them with bows. She took photos and sent them to her younger sister Ma Xiufen, who agreed to recommend them in her WeChat Moments from her clothing store in Binhai New Area. She also contacted Liu Chunmei and Zhou Xiuqin to ask them to promote the products in the community. By evening, she had received 3 gift-box orders from Binhai and 5 bulk orders locally, which slightly relieved the inventory pressure.

events.name: Stretching and deep breathing before bed
events.description: Before bed, as usual, she did 10 minutes of waist and back stretches and 5 minutes of deep breathing. Though tired, she felt content.

start_state.mood: Planned to make a big push

end_state.mood: Tired but satisfied, feeling that life has hope and direction

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 20 minutes plus stretching, one set of Baduanjin, and a big cleaning — fairly high activity.

2025-08.daily_overview: She resolved to shut down the pickle stall, giving away the remaining stock to relatives and friends and having some sold on consignment. Although she lost a bit, a weight was lifted from her heart and she began to think about what to do next.

events.name: Early morning walk and courtyard work
events.description: At 5:15, after walking laps and stretching in the courtyard, she also pulled weeds in the vegetable plots and picked a handful of green beans. Yulan got up early today, so she walked and chatted with her.

events.name: Baduanjin exercise
events.description: Practiced Baduanjin with Yulan in the living room. Ma Xiulan led her through the movements; Yulan learned earnestly and found it quite relaxing.

events.name: Full inventory check and decision-making on pickled vegetables
events.description: At 8 a.m., Ma Xiulan moved all the pickle jars to the kitchen floor and counted them: 28 jars in total. She realized that if she delayed any longer, the flavor would deteriorate. She called her husband to discuss and decided not to set up a stall herself anymore. She gave some pickles to neighbors and her parents, and wholesaled the rest to Aunt Sun at the market at cost price to sell on commission. In the morning she contacted Wang Guilan, Zhang Shufen, and Aunt Sun. Wang Guilan and Zhang Shufen gladly accepted the gifted pickles, and Aunt Sun agreed to sell them on commission. After sending the pickles away, Ma Xiulan decided to stop making new batches for now and first work through the existing stock. Although she lost some money, she felt much calmer.

events.name: Take Yulan to her parents' home
events.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan took Yulan and the child to her parents' home on Shengli Street for lunch. Her mother Li Xiuying was delighted to see Yulan and made noodles with gravy. After lunch, Ma Xiulan helped her mother pick vegetables, and her father talked with Yulan about the changes in Tangshan.

events.name: Stretching and deep breathing before bed
events.description: Completed stretching and deep breathing before bed. Today I didn't soak my feet, but I'm completely used to days without foot soaking.

start_state.mood: Anxious about the pickled vegetables.

end_state.mood: Relieved, planning to look ahead

state.daily_exercise: Early morning: 20-minute walk plus stretching and one set of Baduanjin

2025-08.daily_overview: Chen Yulan helped design hand-drawn labels for the pickled vegetables, giving the product an immediate look; took the kids back to her parents' home, and in the afternoon started clearing space for a family reading corner, with new ideas stirring in her mind.

events.name: Morning walk and watering flowers.
events.description: At 5:20, out of habit, she walked in the courtyard for 20 minutes, then took the children to water the plants. Some rose petals had fallen today, so she taught the children to pick them up and bury them in the soil as fertilizer. After taking a photo and sending it to the group, she checked the weather forecast. It was going to be another hot day.

events.name: Baduanjin exercise
events.description: After the walk, I practiced a set of Baduanjin. Today my lower back feels especially relaxed.

events.name: Chen Yulan designed the pickled vegetable labels and proposed gift boxes.
events.description: In the morning, Yulan tasted the pickled vegetables again and felt that both the taste and quality were good; the problem was the packaging. She took out a paintbrush and blank paper and drew a new hand-painted label for Ma Xiulan, featuring a pickled vegetable jar and the Tianjin Eye, with the words “Xiulan Handmade” written by hand. Yulan suggested, “You could try making gift boxes for presents, which would be more elegant.” Ma Xiulan saw the light and decided to adopt the suggestion. The two went to a nearby print shop and printed ten labels.

events.name: Take the children to her parents' home and discuss the reading corner.
events.description: In the afternoon, she took the children to her parents' home. Her mother made date cakes for the grandchildren to eat, and her father played chess with them. Ma Xiulan talked with her mother about wanting to set up a reading corner for the children at home. Her mother was very supportive and said there was an old bookshelf she was not using that they could take. Ma Xiulan said she had already cleared out the space and would come back later to move it. In the evening, she returned with the children.

events.name: Stretching and deep breathing before bed
events.description: Stretch for 10 minutes before bed, then take deep breaths for 5 minutes. Thinking about the label matter, she felt that even a small cost could bring a big change.

start_state.mood: Inspired by her best friend, full of motivation.

end_state.mood: Full of anticipation for the new plan.

state.daily_exercise: A 20-minute morning walk plus stretching, one set of Baduanjin, and a 20-minute evening walk

2025-08.daily_overview: Turned Yulan's design into reality and carefully produced the first batch of gift-boxed pickled vegetables. The community neighbors were very supportive. The income was not much, but it opened up new ideas.

events.name: Morning walk and watering flowers with the children.
events.description: At 5:15, after a walk, she took the children to water the plants. Ma Mingxuan took the initiative to report that a few weeds growing beside the roses had been pulled out, and Ma Xiulan praised him for being careful. She took close-ups of the flowers and sent them to the photography group; group members said she was getting more and more professional.

events.name: Baduanjin exercise
events.description: Today I practiced a set of Baduanjin alone because Yulan was still asleep. The movements were gentle and slow, and I felt my waist flexibility improve further.

events.name: Prepare the first batch of pickled vegetable gift boxes.
events.description: In the morning, she put the dried pickled cucumbers, pickled radishes, and sweet garlic into transparent glass jars, pressed them down, stuck on hand-drawn labels with magnolia designs, and tied them tightly with red string. She made six gift boxes in total, each containing one jar of each of the three kinds of pickled vegetables, priced at 38 yuan. She used her phone to take photos of the gift boxes from different angles and also recorded a short video, feeling that they were much higher in quality than the previous paper boxes.

events.name: Promoted gift boxes and obtained initial orders
events.description: At noon, she sent photos of the gift boxes to the community WeChat group with a promotional message. She also privately messaged familiar neighbors and relatives. In the afternoon, she took samples to Wang Guilan's house across the hall. Guilan liked them as soon as she saw them and bought one on the spot. She then went to Zhang Shufen's supermarket diagonally opposite, and Zhang Shufen also bought one. Next, she went to her mother's and a distant aunt's homes, and each reserved one. That day, cash income was 76 yuan and reservations were 76 yuan. Ma Xiulan felt she had found a way.

events.name: Accompany Yulan to the local handicraft exhibition.
events.description: In the afternoon, after delivering the gift boxes, she took Yulan to a small handicraft exhibition in the district, where they met craft friend Zhou Xiuqin. The three of them exchanged ideas on embroidery and pickle packaging. Zhou Xiuqin agreed to help promote the gift boxes in the community.

events.name: Stretching and deep breathing before bed
events.description: Stretch for 10 minutes and do deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed. Today was busy but very fulfilling.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, determined to make the gift box well.

end_state.mood: Excited, having tasted the benefits of the product upgrade.

state.daily_exercise: Early morning: 20-minute walk plus stretching and one set of Baduanjin

2025-08.daily_overview: In the morning she saw off her best friend, then with her childhood friend she cleared out all the pickle stock using promotions at the vegetable market. In the evening she made full preparations for her mother's birthday. The tension that had been building for days finally eased.

events.name: Morning walk and garden work.
events.description: At 5:30, after finishing her walk and stretching in the courtyard, she picked half a basket of ripe tomatoes and green beans, planning to take some back to her mother's home tomorrow. Just as she straightened up, she heard Yulan calling her from inside to eat breakfast.

events.name: Baduanjin practice (accompanied by Yulan)
events.description: After breakfast, Yulan said she wanted to practice Baduanjin with Ma Xiulan again. The two of them slowly performed one set in the living room, and Yulan felt her body warm up, which was very comfortable.

events.name: Seeing off Chen Yulan and her son
events.description: At 8 a.m., Chen Yulan and her son finished packing their luggage. Ma Xiulan stuffed two jars of freshly made pickled cucumbers and a small bag of local specialties into Yulan's bag, and the two hugged tightly at the door. Yulan patted her back and said, 'I'll come again at Chinese New Year. Then we'll see how the gift boxes sell. Keep in touch on WeChat.' Ma Xiulan's eyes were a little red, and she watched the taxi drive away before going back inside.

events.name: Clearing out and promoting pickled vegetables with Liu Chunmei
events.description: At 9:30 in the morning, she went with Ma Xiulan to Xingwang Vegetable Market with the last batch of pickled vegetables; it was the last time they would personally run a stall. The two held up a cardboard sign reading "Buy three, get one free" and hawked their goods. Liu Chunmei also played a video of the pickled vegetable-making process on her phone. Because of the strong promotion and the large number of shoppers before the weekend, the backlog of two weeks' inventory was completely sold out by just before 3 p.m., bringing in 230 yuan in total. The two high-fived in front of the stall, and Ma Xiulan let out a long sigh of relief.

events.name: Preparing pickled cucumbers for Mother's birthday.
events.description: In the evening, in the kitchen, she carefully made a small jar of soy-pickled cucumbers from cucumbers picked in her own vegetable garden, following a traditional recipe, planning to give them to her mother as a birthday gift the next day. Smelling the soy aroma, she thought of how her mother used to teach her hand in hand, and a warmth welled up in her heart.

events.name: Called her younger sister to finalize the birthday celebration details.
events.description: At 8 p.m., she called her younger sister Ma Xiufen to confirm the arrangements for their mother's 67th birthday the next day: each would prepare gifts, work together at their mother's home to cook a table of dishes, and give their mother a surprise. The call lasted 20 minutes. After hanging up, Ma Xiulan found the patchwork cushion she had sewn a while ago as an additional gift.

events.name: Check the second son's homework and keep him on task
events.description: Before going to bed, she remembered that her second son would be starting school soon. She flipped through his summer vacation homework notebook and found that some math exercises were missing. She called Mingzhe over and told him to start catching up when he came back from grandmother's house the next day. Mingzhe pouted and agreed.

events.name: Resume soaking feet in hot water before bed.
events.description: After finishing everything today, I felt extremely tired and remembered I hadn't soaked my feet in a long time. I boiled a pot of hot water, poured it into a wooden basin, added mugwort, and soaked my feet. Slowly relaxing in the warm steam, I decided to soak every night before bed as a little reward for myself. After soaking for 15 minutes, I did some simple stretches and deep breathing.

start_state.mood: A little reluctant because she was seeing off her close friend.

end_state.mood: The pickled vegetable problem is finally resolved; I'm looking forward to an easy time at Mom's birthday.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 20 minutes plus stretching, one set of Baduanjin, and a fairly high level of activity from running the stall.

2025-08.daily_overview: Today was like a roller coaster: in the early morning I picked up a secondhand bookshelf to set up the reading corner; after my husband returned from a short trip, he helped tidy up; in the morning my sisters and I celebrated my mother's birthday, warm and happy; in the afternoon the whole family decorated the long-awaited reading corner; in the evening, the eldest son's birthday candlelight was warm; but at dinner, the news of my husband's pay cut led to a fierce argument; late at night, after checking the accounts, we decided to tighten our spending; before bed, I soaked my feet in hot water to try to relieve my fatigue.

events.name: In the early morning, hunt for and buy a secondhand bookshelf and books
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan saw someone in the community second-hand goods group selling a nearly new small bookshelf and 30 second-hand books. She immediately messaged them and closed the deal, and at 7 o'clock rode her electric bike to the seller's building on Shengli Street to inspect the items and pay 80 yuan. She wrapped the books in coarse cloth into two bundles and carried the bookshelf parts home in two trips.

events.name: Hurriedly taking a morning walk in the courtyard and watering flowers
events.description: At 7:30, I finished a 20-minute walk and stretching in the courtyard, but because time was tight, I simply walked a few laps and did arm stretches without taking photos. Then I quickly watered the flowers.

events.name: Full set of Baduanjin exercises
events.description: Before 8:00, she practiced all eight postures of Baduanjin in the living room. Although time was tight, she stuck with the whole set and felt her muscles and joints loosen up.

events.name: Husband returns from an early morning drive; wife helps him organize
events.description: At 9 a.m., her husband Ma Zhiqiang returned home after completing a short-distance delivery. Ma Xiulan patted the dust off his clothes, handed him a hot towel, and asked whether the trip had gone smoothly. He answered briefly and went to catch up on sleep.

events.name: Return to her parents' home carrying gifts and a preserved vegetable gift box.
events.description: At 10 o'clock, she packed a cloth bag with the patchwork chair cushion for her mother and the newly developed pickled cucumbers, took along the two pre-ordered pickled vegetable gift boxes, and walked with the three children to her parents' home on Shengli Street. She first delivered the gift boxes to her mother and to Aunt Li next door, collecting 76 yuan in pre-order payments.

events.name: Sisters team up to celebrate their mother's 67th birthday.
events.description: When she arrived at her parents' home, her younger sister Ma Xiufen was already there and had given their mother a stylish sun-protection jacket. The two sisters made their mother sit and rest in the living room, then went into the kitchen. One cooked and the other prepared the ingredients, making a table full of dishes: sweet and sour pork loin, noodles with gravy, stir-fried vegetables, and more. At noon the whole family sat around the table. Ma Xiulan raised her glass to wish her mother health and longevity. Her mother's eyes grew slightly moist, and she said they should do the same again next year. After the meal, Ma Xiulan chatted with her parents and cleaned up the dishes until 2 p.m.

events.name: Pick up the custom birthday cake on the way back.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Ma Xiulan said goodbye to her parents and younger sister, and on the way stopped by the bakery to pick up a Tianjin baozi-shaped cake custom-made for her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan. Looking at the unique cake, she thought her son would love it.

events.name: Setting up a family reading corner.
events.description: Back home, she called her husband, who had woken up, and together they laid an old blanket in the cleaned corner of the living room and arranged several floor cushions. The two assembled the bookshelf they had picked up in the morning and secured it against the wall. Ma Xiulan hung up a small embroidered wall hanging she had made, Light of Reading. The three children excitedly brought books from their rooms and, under Ma Xiulan's guidance, neatly arranged them on the shelves by category. For the first time, the whole family sat together in the new reading corner, each picked a book, and read quietly for a while.

events.name: Celebrating the 13th birthday of her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan.
events.description: At 6 p.m., Ma Xiulan finished making dinner. After dinner, she brought the steamed bun cake to the table, put candles in it, and the whole family sang the birthday song. Ma Mingxuan closed his eyes, wished that everyone in the family would be healthy, and blew out the candles in one breath. Ma Xiulan held up her phone to record the whole time, watching her sensible son with a bittersweet feeling. When the cake was being cut, the children were frolicking around.

events.name: Had a heated argument because her husband's salary was cut.
events.description: The joy of the birthday celebration had not yet faded when her husband Ma Zhiqiang hesitantly said at the dinner table that his logistics company had cut salaries during the off-season and that he wanted to suspend the monthly 150 yuan education savings plan. Ma Xiulan became anxious as soon as she heard this and retorted with tears in her eyes that it was a long-term safeguard and could not be stopped. Her husband felt she did not understand the real-life pressure, and their voices grew louder and louder until Ma Zhiqiang lost control and stormed out, slamming the door. Ma Xiulan sat at the table wiping her tears, and the children were too scared to make a sound.

events.name: Late at night, did the accounts and decided to cut expenses
events.description: An hour later, her husband returned. The two calmed down and opened the ledger to review August income and expenses. They found that due to the salary cut and various expenses, they had overspent by 120 yuan this month. Ma Xiulan decided to reduce non-essential spending starting next month, pause buying new fabric, and add a packaging materials category in the ledger specifically for handicraft costs. She recorded all of today's income and expenses one by one, then closed the book with a sigh.

events.name: Soaking feet in hot water for the first time before bed to relieve fatigue.
events.description: Before going to bed, Ma Xiulan felt aches and pains in her back and waist. She boiled a pot of hot water, poured it into a wooden basin, added a handful of mugwort she had gotten from her mother's house, and soaked her feet. In the rising steam, she gradually relaxed and decided to soak her feet before bed every day from now on, as a little reward for herself.

start_state.mood: Rushed, planning out the day's affairs

end_state.mood: Complex: it has the warmth of birthday celebrations, the pain of arguments, and also the tenacity of perseverance.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 10 minutes (hurried), full set of Baduanjin, lots of housework

2025-08.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ma Xiulan got up in the morning and resumed the full set of Baduanjin exercises. In the morning, she took homemade pickled cucumbers to her parents' home and was praised by her mother. In the afternoon, she and her husband discussed reducing the monthly savings to 50 yuan and postponing the Beijing trip. In the evening, they officially started family daily reading, sitting together in a warm atmosphere. Before bed, she resumed deep-breathing relaxation.

events.name: Morning: resumed the full set of Baduanjin exercises.
events.description: Got up at 5:45 in the morning and practiced the complete set of Baduanjin in the living room. The movements were a little unfamiliar, and the breathing coordination still needed adjustment. It took 20 minutes.

events.name: Return to her parents' home to deliver handmade pickled cucumbers
events.description: At nine in the morning, Ma Xiulan carried the canned pickled cucumbers she had carefully made yesterday and rode her bicycle (after noticing the tire was low, she inflated it with a pump) to her mother Li Xiuying's home at No. 45 Shengli Street. Her mother opened the door and happily took them. The mother and daughter chatted about family matters. After tasting, her mother praised that the cucumbers were crispier and told her not to work too hard. Half an hour later, Ma Xiulan took her leave.

events.name: Husband and wife negotiate adjustment to the family savings plan
events.description: At three in the afternoon, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home carrying two crucian carp and took the initiative to apologize, saying he should not have lost his temper yesterday. The two calmly discussed the salary cut. After calculating with the account book, they agreed to reduce the monthly education fund from 150 yuan to 50 yuan, postpone the Beijing trip to next summer vacation, and transfer the existing travel fund into the education fund. Ma Xiulan said, "We need to find new odd jobs as soon as possible." Her husband nodded and promised to take on more work, and the atmosphere eased.

events.name: First family daily reading time
events.description: At seven in the evening after dinner, Ma Xiulan gathered the whole family in the reading corner and announced that 19:00 to 19:30 every evening would be reading time. She took the lead and opened a cookbook; her husband read a maintenance manual; the eldest son read One Hundred Thousand Whys; the second son looked around at first, then quieted down after Ma Xiulan held him and explained a picture book; and the youngest daughter flipped through a picture book. After half an hour, she praised everyone and wrote the rule on the refrigerator memo board.

events.name: Deep-breathing relaxation before sleep
events.description: At 21:30 in the evening, Ma Xiulan sat quietly by the bedside in the bedroom, pressed the Hegu acupoint, reviewed the day's little blessings, took deep breaths for 5 minutes, and felt much more at peace.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Still a bit low from yesterday's argument, but trying to cheer up

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk for 20 minutes, full set of Baduanjin, morning shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, morning and evening waist muscle stretches for 10 minutes each, and 5 minutes of deep breathing before bed.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan received a thank-you call from her mother and felt better. In the morning, she took the children to trim the roses in the courtyard; in the afternoon, she played puzzles with them and tidied the reading corner; in the evening, she continued the family reading. Life was calm. Before bed, she soaked her feet in hot water to relax (for the first time).

events.name: Mother called to praise the soy-pickled cucumbers and give encouragement.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan was hanging clothes on the balcony when her mother called, happily saying the soy-sauce cucumbers were delicious and the sisters' cooking had improved. She told Xiulan not to work too hard and to speak up if the family had any difficulties. Xiulan felt warm inside.

events.name: Took the children to tidy the roses in the courtyard and water them.
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan took her youngest daughter and second son to water the plants and prune withered branches in the courtyard. The roses were blooming beautifully; she taught the children the names of the flowers, while her second son helped pull weeds.

events.name: In the afternoon, play puzzles with the children and tidy up the reading corner
events.description: In the afternoon, she took out an old jigsaw puzzle and assembled an undersea world with her second son and daughter, while her eldest son read nearby. After finishing the puzzle, she organized the books in the reading corner, re-categorized and labeled them, and made a few bookmarks from cloth scraps.

events.name: Asked her husband to check the washing machine because it was making a strange noise during laundry
events.description: In the afternoon, while the washing machine was washing the sheets, it made a clunking sound. Ma Xiulan asked her husband to check, and they found a small coin stuck in the drain pump. After removing it, the machine returned to normal. This little incident made her sigh that home appliances still need regular inspection.

events.name: Evening family reading time
events.description: At seven after dinner, the whole family sat in the reading corner. Ma Xiulan told Yuxin the story of The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl, her husband read a transportation safety manual, Mingxuan read historical stories, and Mingzhe looked at a dinosaur pictorial. Afterwards, Ma Xiulan noted the children's performance in her notebook.

events.name: First attempt at soaking feet in hot mugwort water
events.description: Before bed, Ma Xiulan remembered the mugwort that Wang Guilan had given her. She boiled it in water and soaked her feet for 15 minutes. It felt very refreshing, and she decided to do it regularly from then on.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Feeling slightly low

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of morning walking in the courtyard, a full set of Baduanjin, 5 minutes of morning shoulder and neck stretching, 10 minutes of lumbar muscle stretching each morning and evening, and 30 minutes of walking to the evening market for groceries.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Monday, Ma Xiulan found the faucet leaking during housework and decided with her husband to fix it themselves. In the evening, the couple worked together, bought a washer, borrowed tools, and installed it successfully, saving 30 yuan. In the evening, they continued family reading. During the day, she slightly cut her finger while making lunch and treated it herself.

events.name: Discovered a dripping kitchen faucet and decided to fix it herself
events.description: While washing vegetables in the morning, she found the faucet was dripping continuously. She initially wanted to call Master Liu, but thinking of the pay cut, she asked her husband via WeChat. Her husband replied that they should fix it themselves, and she offered to do it together.

events.name: Turn off the water valve and remove the leaking faucet
events.description: In the evening, her husband came home. The two first shut off the angle valve. Ma Xiulan handed him a wrench, and her husband unscrewed the faucet, finding that the internal washer had aged and cracked.

events.name: Going to the hardware store to buy new washers
events.description: The two rode an e-bike to Xingwang Hardware Store. The shopkeeper found the gaskets by model and charged 5 yuan. Her husband asked for two extra spares, and the shopkeeper reminded him to apply sealant.

events.name: Borrowed a suitable wrench from neighbor Wang Guilan and installed it.
events.description: Passing by Wang Guilan's house, she borrowed an adjustable wrench. After returning home, her husband cleaned the connection, applied sealant, and installed the gasket, while Ma Xiulan held a flashlight to light the way.

events.name: Reinstalled the faucet and tested it successfully
events.description: Tightened the faucet and opened the angle valve; the water flow was normal with no drips. Her husband wiped sweat, and Ma Xiulan handed him a towel, saying, "You really are good." They saved at least 30 yuan. In the ledger she wrote, "Fix faucet -5 yuan."

events.name: Cut her index finger while cooking at noon
events.description: At noon, while cutting vegetables to save time, she accidentally cut her index finger. The wound was not deep. She disinfected it with iodine and put on a Band-Aid, joking that she was “getting old and useless.”

events.name: Evening family reading
events.description: At seven in the evening, reading time went on as usual. Ma Xiulan read fairy tales to her daughter. Mingzhe was very absorbed in reading "The Dinosaur Illustrated Guide" today, and after finishing he asked questions, which Ma Xiulan answered one by one.

start_state.location: Kitchen at Ma Xiulan's home, 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Normal

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Happy

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk for 20 minutes, full set of Baduanjin, morning shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, and lumbar stretches for 10 minutes each in the morning and evening; heavy housework load

2025-08.daily_overview: On Tuesday, neighbor Wang Guilan brought mugwort and asked about Ma Xiulan's back pain. In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan dug out old fabric and planned to make a patchwork chair cushion, sparking the idea for some handicraft work. In the evening, she went shopping and encountered a small dispute over counterfeit money, but it went smoothly overall. At night, she read and soaked her feet.

events.name: Neighbor Wang Guilan brought mugwort to help relieve back soreness
events.description: In the morning, Wang Guilan came over for a visit. Seeing Ma Xiulan holding her lower back, she asked about it and went home to bring back a bundle of dried mugwort, saying that soaking her feet in it could relieve soreness and fatigue. The two chatted about their children at the door.

events.name: Sorting old fabric in preparation for making patchwork chair cushions
events.description: In the afternoon, she took out an old cloth bag from the top of the wardrobe, sorted the floral fabric scraps by color and material, picked out thick cotton cloth, cut a template from cardboard, drew a diamond patchwork sketch, and decided to start work tomorrow.

events.name: Encountered counterfeit money during evening supermarket shopping.
events.description: In the evening, she went to the community supermarket to buy laundry detergent. When paying, the cashier said a 20-yuan bill was counterfeit. Ma Xiulan was surprised and looked closely, finding that it did indeed look crude. She immediately went home to figure out who had given it to her—change from the market a few days earlier—but she did not intend to make an issue of it. She put the counterfeit bill in her account book as a lesson.

events.name: Evening family reading
events.description: After dinner during reading time, Ma Xiulan told her daughter the story of Chang'e Flying to the Moon. Mingzhe asked questions on his own, and Mingxuan, excited by what he read in Weapons Knowledge, shared a few points with his younger siblings. Half an hour passed quickly.

events.name: Soak feet in hot mugwort water.
events.description: Before bed, I soaked my feet in mugwort water for 15 minutes. The soreness in my lower back eased a lot, and I read the pickled vegetable group chat messages on my phone while soaking.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Slightly tired

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk for 15 minutes, a full set of Baduanjin, morning shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, and lower back stretches for 10 minutes each in the morning and evening

2025-08.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Ma Xiulan spent the morning making four patchwork chair cushions in a row, which made her right wrist sore. Hearing that Aunt Zhao's husband was hospitalized, she took the initiative to cook and deliver meals, going back and forth to the hospital twice that day, busy but fulfilled. In the evening, after reading, she applied a warm compress to her wrist.

events.name: Made four patchwork chair cushions from old fabric; wrists tired.
events.description: After breakfast, she worked on the old-fashioned sewing machine with diamond patchwork, working continuously for 4 hours to complete four chair cushions with dense, neat stitching. Because of the long repetitive motion, her right wrist began to ache slightly.

events.name: During morning exercise, learned that Aunt Zhao's husband was hospitalized and took the initiative to take on meal delivery.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning while practicing Baduanjin, Wang Guilan anxiously said that Aunt Zhao's husband had been hospitalized after a stroke. Ma Xiulan immediately called to ask about the situation and took the initiative to say she would bring her meals, that having hot food was better than anything else. Aunt Zhao choked up with gratitude.

events.name: Went to the vegetable market to buy ingredients.
events.description: She rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market. At Sun Guifang's stall she bought chicken, meat, eggs, greens, and apples. Aunt Sun gave her an extra bunch of scallions.

events.name: Rushing to prepare a nutritious lunch and deliver it
events.description: She went home at 10:30, put on an apron, simmered millet porridge, steamed egg custard, stir-fried vegetables, and made noodles with gravy, then packed them into an insulated lunch box. At 12:00 she rode her bicycle to the hospital. Aunt Zhao's eyes reddened as she took the lunch box. She chatted with her until 1:00 before leaving.

events.name: Rushed home to prepare dinner and deliver the meal again.
events.description: At 4 p.m. she was busy stewing old hen soup, steaming tofu with minced pork, and making scallion pancakes; at 5:30 she delivered dinner. Aunt Zhao was wiping down her husband, and she helped fetch water and set out the meal, and they agreed to continue tomorrow.

events.name: Got wet in the rain shower, went home to change clothes.
events.description: On the way back from the second food delivery, a sudden rain shower started. She wore a plastic bag, but her trouser legs were soaked, so she went home to take a bath and change clothes.

events.name: Found that wrist soreness worsened, applied heat compress.
events.description: In the evening, she noticed pain when rotating her right wrist. She applied a hot towel for 20 minutes and rubbed on safflower oil, then decided to do less sewing tomorrow.

events.name: Evening family reading and foot soaking
events.description: After dinner, she kept up reading time. When reading fairy tales to Yuxin, her wrist was uncomfortable, so she asked her husband to help turn pages. Before bed, she soaked her feet in mugwort water to relieve the day's fatigue.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Satisfied but tired.

state.daily_exercise: Full set of Baduanjin qigong in the early morning, 15 minutes of walking in the courtyard, 5 minutes of morning shoulder and neck stretches, 10 minutes of lumbar muscle stretches each morning and evening (in the evening, reduced right-hand movements due to wrist pain), and cycling to and from the hospital

2025-08.daily_overview: On Thursday, Ma Xiulan continued delivering meals to Aunt Zhao early in the morning; after returning home, her neighbor Wang Guilan came over and bought all the chair cushions, earning 60 yuan, and her first handicraft order was successful. Her wrist still ached, and she applied a hot compress during the lunch break to relieve it. In the evening, she read and soaked her feet.

events.name: Continue cooking and delivering meals for Auntie Zhao.
events.description: After breakfast, she made fish porridge, stir-fried luffa, and flower rolls, and brought them to the hospital at 9:30. Aunt Zhao said her husband's condition was stable. Ma Xiulan briefly asked the doctor and then left.

events.name: Neighbor Wang Guilan liked the chair cushions and bought them all.
events.description: In the morning, Wang Guilan came by for a visit. She took an immediate liking to the chair cushions and, after sitting on one, praised them endlessly. She took out 60 yuan on the spot and bought all of them, and suggested making more practical cloth items, saying her daughter's workplace might want them as welfare goods. Ma Xiulan accepted the money and recorded it in her handicraft income ledger.

events.name: Apply a warm compress to wrists during the lunch break
events.description: During the midday break, she applied a hot-water bottle to her right wrist for 15 minutes. The soreness eased a little, but she still did not dare to exert force.

events.name: Accidentally cracked phone screen
events.description: In the afternoon, while she was wiping the table, her phone slipped off and the upper right corner of the screen cracked a little. She was heartbroken, but it still worked, so she decided not to repair it for now and put clear tape over it to prevent any cuts.

events.name: Evening family reading and foot soaking
events.description: After dinner, reading as usual. Before bed, soaked her feet in mugwort water, and while soaking, replied to messages in the pickles group with her left hand.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Busy but positive.

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Pleasant

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk in the courtyard for 15 minutes, full set of Baduanjin (with extra attention to the wrists), 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch in the morning, 10-minute lower back stretches in the morning and evening, and cycling to and from the hospital.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Friday, Ma Xiulan took her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to the primary school to complete enrollment registration; her daughter was about to become a primary school student. In the afternoon, she washed the new school uniform and prepared school supplies. The soreness in her wrist had noticeably eased. During evening reading, her daughter excitedly described what she had seen at school.

events.name: Take youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to complete enrollment registration.
events.description: At 8 a.m., she dressed Yuxin in a new dress, braided her hair, and rode the electric bike to school with the household registration booklet and vaccination certificate. She registered as instructed and picked up textbooks and a school uniform. Yuxin put on her schoolbag, looked in the mirror, and shouted that she was starting elementary school. Ma Xiulan took photos and noted prices at the stationery store outside the school gate.

events.name: Ran into neighbor Zhang Shufen and chatted about back-to-school preparations.
events.description: At the school gate, she met Zhang Shufen, who was also registering her child. The two chatted about what was needed for the new semester. Zhang Shufen shared where to buy cheap stationery, and Ma Xiulan wrote it down in her notebook.

events.name: In the afternoon, wash the new school uniform and check and patch up the old schoolbag
events.description: After returning home, she rinsed the new school uniform in water and hung it out to dry, then found the two sons' old schoolbags to repair and reinforce them. She sewed a few stitches on the sewing machine (her wrist was no longer a problem, but she still limited her time).

events.name: Evening family reading and wrist recovery confirmation
events.description: After dinner, she read. Ma Xiulan moved her wrist and found it no longer hurt, and happily said "It's better" to her husband. Before bed, she soaked her feet and reviewed the day.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Excited

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Gratified

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk for 20 minutes, full set of Baduanjin, morning shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, and lumbar stretches for 10 minutes each in the morning and evening; heavy housework load

2025-08.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ma Xiulan took the three children alone on a long-distance bus to visit the Tianjin Museum. The children were drawn to the ancient weapons and folk custom exhibits and were excited the whole way. It was a meaningful cultural trip. They returned home in the afternoon; though tired, she insisted on a short reading session in the evening.

events.name: In the early morning, preparing to take the children to visit the city museum.
events.description: Got up at 6:00 to prepare meals, packed a water bottle, biscuits, and tissues, reminded the eldest son to bring his notebook, and left at 7:00 to walk to the long-distance bus station.

events.name: Take a long-distance bus to downtown Tianjin
events.description: Got in the car at 7:30, confirmed with the driver to get off at the museum stop, the children pressed against the window watching the scenery, arrived after an hour and a half, and walked to the museum using phone navigation.

events.name: Visited the Ancient Tianjin exhibition hall; the eldest son was fascinated by weapons.
events.description: At nine they entered the museum and got free tickets with their ID cards. They first went to the Ancient Hall, where Ma Mingxuan was drawn to the armor and swords and took out his notebook to sketch them; Ma Mingzhe was curious about the fishing gear, and Xiulan explained how old Tianjin lived off the sea; Ma Yuxin held her mother's clothes.

events.name: Visiting the folk customs exhibition area; the children had different interests
events.description: Then they visited the folk customs hall, where wax figures recreated old street scenes. Mingzhe pointed at a wax figure in a long gown and asked about it, while Yuxin stopped in front of a loom model and refused to leave. Xiulan explained, relating it to her own embroidery.

events.name: Having lunch at a fast-food restaurant near the museum
events.description: At noon, she took the children to a fast-food restaurant and ordered noodles with gravy and sweet-and-sour pork. The children ate happily. Xiulan asked what they liked most; Mingxuan said weapons, Mingzhe said wax figures, and Yuxin said a loom. She smiled and noted it down.

events.name: Buy museum souvenir postcards
events.description: After the meal, they returned to the souvenir shop and spent 20 yuan on a set of postcards. The children were each allowed to pick one: Mingxuan chose ancient architecture, Mingzhe chose a lion, Yuxin chose a painting of ladies, and Xiulan put them away.

events.name: The second son briefly wandered off, but it was a false alarm.
events.description: While visiting the folk customs hall, it was crowded. Mingzhe disappeared in a blink, and Xiulan was so anxious that she broke out in a sweat. She quickly made an announcement to find him. Three minutes later, she found him at the toy counter, looking at a small dinosaur model. Still shaken, Xiulan sternly told him he must not run off.

events.name: Returning home in the evening, the whole family shared what they had seen and heard.
events.description: At 4 p.m., they left the museum and took a bus back to Jinghai. The journey home was long, and the children talked excitedly on the bus. When they got home, the whole family sat around looking at the postcards, and Xiulan put the photos and tickets into the album.

events.name: Brief evening reading and foot soaking.
events.description: Because the day was tiring, she shortened reading to 15 minutes, mainly letting Mingxuan share his museum notes. Before bed, she soaked her feet in mugwort water to relieve sore soles.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: In the morning rush, did not do Baduanjin but did shoulder and neck stretches; walked a lot during the day (about 15,000 steps), and did 10 minutes of lower back stretches in the evening.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan sorted museum photos with the children at home to make an album. She tried making low-sugar green plum jam for her father's health. While boiling the jam, she burned her finger, but it was nothing serious. Afterwards, she took some newly made jam to Grandma Li across the hall, who praised her and agreed to make it together next time. In the afternoon, she took the children to weed the courtyard and taught them to recognize plants. In the evening, family reading continued. Before bed, she soaked her feet and discussed expenses with her husband.

events.name: Organizing museum photos and making a themed album
events.description: In the morning, go to the stationery store to buy a blank photo album, go home and select photos to develop (15 yuan at the community print shop), and paste the photos and postcards into the album with the children. Mingxuan writes the title, and they make a 'Museum Trip' page and file it away.

events.name: Tried making low-sugar green plum jam and got scalded.
events.description: In the afternoon, she bought two jin of green plums from the vegetable market and boiled them with xylitol according to the tutorial, filling the room with fruity aroma. While bottling, hot jam spilled over the edge of the pot and splashed onto the back of her hand, leaving a small red spot. She rinsed it with cold water and applied aloe vera gel.

events.name: Deliver freshly made green plum sauce to Grandma Li across the way.
events.description: Ma Xiulan took a small bottle of green plum jam to Grandma Li's house across the way. Grandma Li tasted it and praised it as neither too sweet nor too cloying, just right. She chatted with Ma Xiulan for a while, saying that she also loved making fruit jam when she was young. Ma Xiulan promised to invite her to join in next time she boiled a batch, and the neighborly relationship became even closer.

events.name: Take the children to weed the courtyard and teach them to identify plants.
events.description: Taking advantage of the sunny weather, she took the three children to pull weeds in the courtyard and taught them to recognize perilla and agastache. The daughter curiously smelled the leaves, and the second son used a magnifying glass to observe ants.

events.name: Continue family reading time in the evening
events.description: After dinner, reading went on as usual. Ma Xiulan read folk tales, and Mingxuan voluntarily read historical stories to his younger brother and sister. After half an hour, she wrote in the growth notebook.

events.name: While soaking her feet, she chatted with her husband about next month's expenses
events.description: Before bed, she soaked her feet while her husband sat beside her. They discussed the list of school supplies to buy for the upcoming semester next month, and Ma Xiulan used her account book to make a rough estimate of the budget.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Relaxed

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Morning courtyard walk for 15 minutes, a full set of Baduanjin, morning shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, and lower back stretches for 10 minutes each in the morning and evening

2025-08.daily_overview: On Monday, Ma Xiulan made a last-minute decision to accompany her husband on his truck trip to Shijiazhuang, leaving the children with her mother. After a day of bumping along in the truck, they squeezed into the cab to rest late at night. She experienced firsthand the hardships of her husband's life on the road, and their bond as a couple deepened.

events.name: Leave the children with her mother and accompany her husband on a driving run.
events.description: After receiving her husband's call at seven in the morning, she quickly packed some clothes, took the three children to her mother's house, and carefully explained about meals, homework, and bedtime; her mother readily agreed.

events.name: Met my husband at the logistics parking lot and set off.
events.description: At 8:30 she took the bus to the parking lot. Her husband had already started the truck. She climbed into the passenger seat, looked out the window at the vast cornfield, chatted about family matters, and remarked how hard it was for her husband to drive long distances alone.

events.name: Arrived at the Luquan factory area in Shijiazhuang. During unloading, Ma Xiulan kept watch and bought meals.
events.description: Arrived at 2 p.m.; her husband unloaded the goods while she watched over the cargo. Afterwards they went to a snack stall and bought Chinese hamburgers and water, sitting by the truck for a simple meal. She silently felt sorry for her husband's dirty work clothes.

events.name: Squeezed into the driver's cab to rest at night, Ma Xiulan deeply appreciated her husband's hardship.
events.description: At nine in the evening, the seats were reclined and a thin quilt spread out. The two lay down side by side in their clothes, with insects chirping outside the car. She asked softly, 'Do you usually sleep here?' Her husband answered, 'I'm used to it.' Her heart ached, and she quietly squeezed her husband's rough hand.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: In a hurry

end_state.location: Inside the cab of a truck at a factory in Luquan District, Shijiazhuang.
end_state.mood: Empathetic ache and love

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-08.daily_overview: Early Tuesday morning, the couple drove back to Jinghai. After picking up the children, Ma Xiulan was more considerate toward her husband; this shared experience brought the family closer. She caught up on sleep in the afternoon and insisted on soaking her feet in the evening.

events.name: Drove back to Jinghai from Shijiazhuang in the early morning
events.description: At four in the morning, her husband started the truck. Just before dawn, they arrived at a service area, where they washed up briefly and ate steamed buns. At nine in the morning, they drove into Jinghai. Ma Xiulan got out rubbing her waist, and her husband helped her carry her bag.

events.name: Go home to pick up the children and catch up on the afternoon nap.
events.description: After arriving home, went straight to mother's place to pick up the children; mother said the kids were very well-behaved. Went home, reheated breakfast for her husband, and was so tired that she collapsed on the sofa and slept for over an hour. She felt a bit better after waking up.

events.name: Massaged her husband's shoulders and reminded him to stay safe.
events.description: In the evening, her husband was about to go out on a short trip by car. Ma Xiulan took the initiative to massage his shoulders, told him to drive carefully, and tucked an apple into his work clothes pocket. Her husband smiled sheepishly.

events.name: Short evening reading and a hot foot soak
events.description: After dinner, because she was tired, she read for only 10 minutes and mainly let Mingxuan supervise the younger siblings. Ma Xiulan boiled mugwort water and soaked her feet for 15 minutes. While soaking, she recalled the driving trip and silently resolved to care more for her husband. This became the start of her regular foot-soaking routine.

start_state.location: Truck cab at the factory site in Luquan District, Shijiazhuang
start_state.mood: Fatigue

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Warm

state.daily_exercise: None (only active while doing housework)

2025-08.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Ma Xiulan took her second son to a follow-up eye exam, and the results were stable. In the afternoon, she checked homework and mended clothes. At noon, she burnt the braised dish and criticized herself for being careless. In the evening, she soaked her feet and read; life was orderly.

events.name: Take second son Ma Mingzhe to the eye hospital for an eyesight recheck.
events.description: In the morning, she took Mingzhe to the eye hospital by electric bike for a follow-up. After the examination, the doctor said his prescription had stabilized at 150 degrees and was well controlled, and praised the eye-protection measures. Ma Xiulan spent 30 yuan on an anti-drop glasses strap. Mingzhe chose blue and promised not to secretly take off his glasses. She took photos and posted them to the family group chat.

events.name: At noon, the bottom of the pot was scorched while stir-frying vegetables
events.description: At noon, while making braised eggplant, she went to answer the phone and forgot to turn off the stove. She only rushed back to the kitchen when she smelled something burning. The bottom of the pot was black, and the eggplants were ruined. While scrubbing the pot, she joked to herself, "Getting old really makes you forgetful," and had to cook a new dish.

events.name: In the afternoon, check holiday homework and mend husband's work uniform
events.description: After returning home, she spot-checked Mingzhe's math workbook, found several blank pages, and reminded him to catch up. She checked Yuxin's pinyin tracing and corrected her stroke order. Then she took out her husband's worn-out work pants and mended and reinforced them with the sewing machine.

events.name: Taught the second son the basic Baduanjin movements.
events.description: In the evening, while practicing Baduanjin in the courtyard, Mingzhe came over curiously, so Ma Xiulan taught him simple movements such as "Two Hands Hold Up the Sky to Regulate the Triple Burner." Mingzhe mimicked them quite well, and the mother and son were both delighted.

events.name: Evening family reading and foot soaking
events.description: During reading time after dinner, Mingzhe took the initiative to say, 'Mom, I didn't play on my phone today.' Xiulan praised him. Before bed, she soaked her feet in mugwort water for 15 minutes as usual.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Concern

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Relaxation.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk in the yard for 20 minutes, full set of Baduanjin and teaching the second son some of the movements, 5 minutes of morning shoulder and neck stretching, 10 minutes each of morning and evening lower back muscle stretching, and cycling to and from the hospital.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Thursday, Ma Xiulan discovered that her second son had left a large part of his summer homework unfinished. Instead of getting angry, she gently accompanied and urged her son to make up the work until late at night, teaching responsibility through concrete actions. In the evening, while soaking her feet, she reflected on her parenting approach.

events.name: During the day, spot-checked the second son's homework and found serious omissions
events.description: In the morning, she carefully flipped through Mingzhe's math workbook and found 10 blank pages. She asked him why they hadn't been done. Mingzhe hung his head and said he had forgotten because he was too busy playing, his eyes turning red. Ma Xiulan didn't scold him; she simply had him sit at his desk and start catching up.

events.name: In the evening, accompanied the child in making up homework until late at night.
events.description: After dinner Mingzhe continued doing the make-up work. Ma Xiulan sat beside him sewing a chair cushion to keep him company, occasionally reminding him to sit up straight and rest. It went on until 11 p.m. when it was finally finished. Mingzhe rubbed his hands and said they were sore. Ma Xiulan patted his head and said, 'From now on, get things done on time.'

events.name: Late-Night Foot Soak and Reflection on Parenting
events.description: After Mingzhe fell asleep, Ma Xiulan boiled water to soak her feet. In the scent of mugwort, she thought to herself that with children she should be more patient and scold less. She locked the phone (handed over by Mingzhe) in a drawer and planned to praise him tomorrow for taking the initiative to hand it over.

events.name: Evening reading shortened due to catching up on homework
events.description: Because there was homework to catch up on, reading lasted only 15 minutes; she mainly had Mingxuan read aloud to his younger sister while Ma Xiulan did mending beside them.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Serious.

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Tired but relieved

state.daily_exercise: A 20-minute morning walk in the courtyard, a full set of Baduanjin, 5 minutes of morning shoulder and neck stretches, and 10 minutes of lower back stretches each in the morning and evening (in the evening, focusing on stretching the lower back after sitting for a long time).

2025-08.daily_overview: On Friday, her second son voluntarily handed over his phone, which made Ma Xiulan feel very gratified. She received a thank-you call from Aunt Zhao after being discharged from the hospital, bringing several days of meal delivery to a successful close. In the afternoon, the power went out for two hours, so she cooked with the gas stove, staying calm and unhurried. In the evening, she read and soaked her feet.

events.name: The second son voluntarily handed over his phone early in the morning.
events.description: Just after getting up in the morning, Mingzhe ran into the kitchen holding his phone and said, “Mom, please keep this for me. I’ll take it back after I finish all my homework.” Ma Xiulan was surprised and touched. She took the phone, locked it in a drawer, bent down and hugged him, saying, “Good son, I trust you.”

events.name: Received a thank-you call from Aunt Zhao on her discharge from the hospital
events.description: At 10 a.m., Aunt Zhao called happily to say that her husband had recovered well and would be discharged from the hospital tomorrow. She especially thanked Xiulan for bringing meals and said she would come by to thank her in person when she had time. Xiulan kept saying it was no problem, wished her health, and marked a reminder on the calendar.

events.name: In the afternoon, the electricity went out for two hours, and I cooked with a gas stove.
events.description: In the afternoon, a sudden power outage due to line maintenance shut down the rice cooker and TV. Ma Xiulan remained calm, boiled water on the gas stove to cook noodles, and mixed in some pickled vegetables. The family ate with relish. Taking advantage of the darkened room, she taught the children to play hand-shadow games.

events.name: Evening family reading and foot soaking
events.description: After dinner, they read. Mingzhe was especially enthusiastic because he had finished his homework and turned in his phone, and he read dinosaur stories aloud. Before bed, Ma Xiulan soaked her feet, felt happy, and chatted with her husband about Mid-Autumn Festival plans.

start_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Pleasant surprise

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Gratified

state.daily_exercise: 20-minute walk in the courtyard in the early morning, a full set of Baduanjin, 5-minute morning shoulder and neck stretches, and 10 minutes of lower back stretches each morning and evening.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ma Xiulan and her husband did the monthly financial review and found they had overspent by 120 yuan, so they made a plan to cut expenses. During it, her husband's smoking craving flared up and he almost broke his resolve, but was stopped in time. The day was quite stressful, but the whole family was united. In the evening, while soaking their feet, they felt their confidence strengthen.

events.name: Prepare the family ledger and receipts.
events.description: In the morning, she took the brown leather-covered account book out of the drawer, spread all of this month's receipts, utility bills, pay stubs, and part-time income records on the dining table, and sorted them.

events.name: The couple jointly calculated this month's income and expenses.
events.description: In the afternoon, her husband sat down, and Ma Xiulan read out the expenses one by one: groceries, water and electricity, children's school supplies, faucet repair, transportation, and so on, while her husband added them up on his phone. Total income decreased by 580 yuan due to a pay cut, and total expenses were higher than last month, resulting in a deficit.

events.name: Analyze the reasons for overspending
events.description: They checked item by item and found that the overspending was mainly on the second son's new schoolbag and stationery (120 yuan), Ma Xiulan's extra embroidery fabric (80 yuan), and several takeout meals. The husband frowned, and Xiulan sighed.

events.name: Make a plan to cut non-essential expenses next month.
events.description: They agreed to stop buying new fabric from next month, reduce eating out (at most once a week), and halve the snack budget. Xiulan wrote a list of spending cuts in the ledger and planned to keep separate records of her handicraft income. Her husband promised to work more overtime.

events.name: Stopped her husband from smoking against his promise.
events.description: After the inventory, her husband became upset and secretly fished half a pack of cigarettes out of the drawer. Ma Xiulan spotted him and snatched it away, saying, “We agreed you wouldn’t smoke; the money we save can be used to buy books for the children.” Her husband looked embarrassed, and she hid the cigarettes. To reward him for holding back, she deliberately cooked an extra portion of his favorite dish to go with the rice.

events.name: Evening reading and foot soaking
events.description: After dinner, reading continued. Ma Xiulan announced to the whole family that they would reduce snacks starting next month. The children pouted but agreed. Before bed, they soaked their feet as usual, and she discussed with her husband how to save money while still ensuring nutrition.

start_state.location: At the bookkeeping desk in Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Serious

end_state.location: At the bookkeeping desk in Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Stressed but determined

state.daily_exercise: 20-minute walk in the courtyard in the early morning, a full set of Baduanjin, 5-minute morning shoulder and neck stretches, and 10 minutes of lower back stretches each morning and evening.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan bought raw materials in bulk for the autumn pickled vegetable side business, shared the last batch of vegetables from her own courtyard with neighbors, and posted reservations online. During morning exercise, she practiced Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao. Her weight dropped to 54 kg, and she felt light both in body and mind. In the evening, she soaked her feet and took stock of August, looking forward to September.

events.name: Morning exercise: practicing Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao.
events.description: In the morning, she practiced Baduanjin in the courtyard. Aunt Zhao also came out to exercise, and the two did a set together. Aunt Zhao thanked her again for the meal delivery and said her husband had been discharged from the hospital and was recuperating at home, inviting her to come over whenever she had time. Xiulan happily agreed.

events.name: A big shopping trip for making autumn pickled vegetables
events.description: In the early morning, she rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market. She bought 40 jin of radishes, 20 jin of cucumbers, and 10 jin of green beans at Sun Guifang's stall, then went to the dried goods store to buy salt, soy sauce, Sichuan peppercorns, and so on, and then went to the glass shop to pick up 30 glass jars, for a total of 215 yuan. Aunt Sun smiled and said business was getting bigger and bigger. When paying, she received a counterfeit 10-yuan bill in change. After examining it carefully, she confirmed it was fake and smiled wryly. Considering her experience last time, she did not pursue the matter; she just silently tucked the counterfeit bill into her accounting book, reminding herself to be more careful when accepting money in the future.

events.name: Picked the last batch of vegetables in the yard and gave them to neighbors.
events.description: After coming home from grocery shopping, I went to the courtyard to pick the last batch of green beans and cucumbers, and the trellis already looked sparse. I chose a bag of fresh, tender ones and gave them to Wang Guilan; she gave me two links of cured sausage in return. I also gave two cucumbers to Grandma Li across the way. The neighborly interactions were heartwarming.

events.name: Post pickled vegetable pre-order information in the community group
events.description: In the afternoon, she posted a message in the community WeChat group and her daughter’s kindergarten group: “Freshly made pickled vegetables: sweet-and-sour radish and soy-pickled cucumbers, 8 yuan per jar, available for pre-order.” Soon three parents responded to reserve six jars. She registered them one by one, and her confidence grew a little.

events.name: Take a 45-minute lunch break
events.description: After lunch, took a 45-minute nap to regain energy and rest up for the afternoon work.

events.name: Evening family reading and foot-soaking wrap-up.
events.description: After dinner, reading as usual; Ma Xiulan read an article about autumn health preservation. Before bed, while soaking her feet, she looked through her account book and photo album, feeling that August had been hard but rewarding. She said to her husband, 'Things will get better.' Tonight the mugwort water was at just the right temperature; she broke into a slight sweat and slept especially soundly.

start_state.location: At the bookkeeping desk in Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Thorough planning.

end_state.location: Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Full of anticipation

state.daily_exercise: A 20-minute morning walk in the courtyard, a full set of Baduanjin (practiced with Auntie Zhao), 5 minutes of morning shoulder and neck stretching, 10 minutes of lower-back stretching each in the morning and evening, riding an electric bike to buy groceries, and working in the courtyard.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Monday, after finishing her morning stretching and taking her daughter to school, Ma Xiulan began organizing the paperwork for her side business. She found her friend Liu Chunmei to sign and confirm the income, and in the afternoon successfully completed the annual social security subsidy verification. In the evening, she took the children for a walk and checked their screen time—everything was in good order.

events.name: Morning neck and shoulder stretches and taking the daughter to school
events.description: After getting up at 05:45, Ma Xiulan did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches in the living room, then dressed her daughter neatly and walked her to primary school, chatting briefly with neighbor Wang Guilan on the way.

events.name: Light activity on the balcony and Baduanjin.
events.description: After taking the children to school and returning, because there was a thin layer of ice in the courtyard, she did tiptoe stretches on the balcony for 5 minutes, then practiced a set of Baduanjin alone in the living room, with gentle movements and deep breathing.

events.name: Buy folders and organize side-business receipts.
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan went to the stationery store on Jingwen Road and bought a blue folder. After returning home, she sorted and organized the pickled vegetable orders, embroidery receipts, and so on, and put a label [Organize on the 1st of every month] on the first page, determined to keep standardized records.

events.name: Ask Liu Chunmei to sign to confirm the part-time income
events.description: She took her income certificate and pickle sales records, walked to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei's home, and asked her to sign as a witness. The two chatted about how the children were doing and market vegetable prices, and stayed for about half an hour.

events.name: Noon break and a simple lunch
events.description: On the way home, she bought a few baozi. After lunch, she took a 45-minute nap in the bedroom and woke up refreshed.

events.name: Go to the social security service station to complete the annual verification.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan hurried to the Jinghai District Social Security Service Station with signed documents, submitted the materials, and completed the annual confirmation procedures. After checking, the staff told her the subsidy would be paid as usual, and she felt relieved.

events.name: Evening parent-child walk and screen time check
