events.description: Her husband was away driving and had not returned. After dinner, Ma Xiulan dressed the three children and took a 30-minute walk along Jingwen Road. She brought a radio to listen to traditional opera, and the eldest son took the initiative to look after his younger siblings. After returning home, she checked the screen time records; none exceeded the limit, and she verbally praised the children.

events.name: Fixed evening routine: tutoring the second son, computer practice, waist and back stretches.
events.description: 19:30 tutored the second son on 5 easily-missed math problems, explaining patiently; 20:00 opened her husband's old laptop to practice Word formatting for 30 minutes; 20:30 did cat stretches and wall-assisted waist twists for 5 minutes each.

events.name: Bedtime ritual: soaking feet in hot water and deep breathing
events.description: At 21:00, soaked feet in hot water with mugwort and ginger slices for 15 minutes, flipping through the family ledger while soaking; at 21:30, sat quietly by the bed in the bedroom, did abdominal deep breathing for 5 minutes, and pressed Hegu acupoint; at 23:45, went to bed.

start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.mood: Relaxed and content

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, 30 minutes of walking to take the children to school, 5 minutes of stretching on the balcony, one set of Baduanjin, 30 minutes of evening walking, and a total of 20 minutes of morning and evening waist and back stretching.

2025-12.daily_overview: In the early morning, after hurriedly seeing her daughter off, Ma Xiulan rushed to the railway station and took a train alone to Renqiu, Hebei, to visit her craft friend Auntie Wu. The two met in person for the first time and chatted happily. Ma Xiulan stayed overnight at Auntie Wu's home and spent a warm day.

events.name: Morning quick stretch and taking daughter to school
events.description: Got up at 05:30, did some simple shoulder and neck stretches, helped my daughter comb her hair, then walked her to the school gate. I asked the homeroom teacher, Han Mei, to look after my daughter a bit more over the next couple of days because I would be going out.

events.name: Final preparations before departure
events.description: After returning home, she checked her backpack: pickled vegetable gift boxes, embroidery works, phone charger, and re-confirmed the train tickets. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was off work today and agreed to take care of the children. Ma Xiulan reminded him to remember to help their second son with his practice problems.

events.name: Walking to catch the train and time alone
events.description: She walked quickly to Jinghai Railway Station and boarded the K-series train to Renqiu. Sitting by the window, she looked out at the winter fields, scrolled through the praise from pickled-vegetable customers on her phone, and looked forward to meeting Aunt Wu.

events.name: Arrival in Renqiu and first meeting
events.description: Arriving at Renqiu Station at noon, Aunt Wu was already waving at the exit. The two hugged warmly, Aunt Wu took her luggage, and rode an electric bike to take her home. Ma Xiulan was attracted by the crochet works and old textile items all over the house and praised them endlessly.

events.name: Exchanging gifts and sharing craft skills
events.description: Ma Xiulan gave Aunt Wu a gift box of pickled vegetables and an embroidered round fan, and Aunt Wu gave her a handmade crocheted wool hat in return. In the afternoon, the two sat by the edge of the kang. Aunt Wu demonstrated crochet stitches, and Ma Xiulan embroidered a small peony as a demonstration.

events.name: Aunt Wu's specialty dishes and a discussion of chili sauce.
events.description: In the evening, Aunt Wu made Hebei-style braised fish with corncakes. The two chatted about the chili sauce recipe while eating. Ma Xiulan noted her suggestion to use fresh chilies instead of dried ones, and they agreed to go to the morning market the next day to choose ingredients.

events.name: Overnight stay and late-night chat.
events.description: They talked late into the night, and Aunt Wu asked her to stay over. Ma Xiulan did some simple waist and back stretches in the guest room and only turned off the light at 23:30, feeling warm inside and marveling that online friendship could be so sincere.

start_state.mood: Excited and expectant

end_state.mood: Warm and friendly

state.daily_exercise: 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching, 30 minutes of walking to take the kids to school, walking to the station, and indoor activities.

2025-12.daily_overview: In the early morning, Aunt Wu took Ma Xiulan to the morning market to buy chili peppers. After lunch, she said goodbye reluctantly and took the train back to Tianjin. In the evening, she hurried to the community activity room to attend the last computer training class and made up the hands-on practice she had previously missed.

events.name: Morning market shopping and sharing experience.
events.description: Aunt Wu led Ma Xiulan to the Renqiu morning market and personally taught her how to choose fresh chilies with thick flesh and strong flavor, as well as Sichuan peppercorns. She also gave her a bag of homemade pear syrup candy. Ma Xiulan bought two jin of samples and photographed the stall owner's contact information with her phone.

events.name: Saying goodbye and heading back
events.description: Before leaving, the two took a group photo at the door, and Ma Xiulan put away the new crocheted coasters she had learned to make. After boarding the return train, she sorted through her notes and realized she had not practiced Baduanjin or taken a nap for two days. Feeling a bit stiff in her lower back, she decided to do some stretching once she got home.

events.name: A brief rest after returning home.
events.description: Arriving home in the afternoon, the children were not out of school yet. Ma Xiulan first did 10 minutes of back and waist stretches, then washed her face and prepared dinner ingredients. Her husband had already picked up their daughter and was playing in the yard with their two sons.

events.name: Attend the last computer training class.
events.description: At 7 p.m., she arrived on time at the community activity room. The teacher led everyone through a review of Word layout and basic Excel formulas. Ma Xiulan took out her notebook and actively asked questions about problems encountered during hands-on practice. The teacher praised her notes as the most careful.

events.name: After-class practice and evening routines.
events.description: After returning home at 20:30, she practiced spreadsheet work on the computer in the living room for 30 minutes; tutored her second son on 5 problems; did lower-back stretches; and soaked her feet. Because she was tired from the trip, she went to bed earlier than usual and turned off the lights at 22:30.

start_state.mood: Gratitude

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and rewarding.

state.daily_exercise: Walk at the morning market for about 1 hour, walk to the train station, stretch lower back for 10 minutes, and stretch after the evening computer class

2025-12.daily_overview: It was the graduation day of the computer training course. Ma Xiulan attended the ceremony and received her certificate. She struck while the iron was hot, using Excel to complete the year's pickled vegetable accounts, and also designed bottle labels herself. In the afternoon she systematically organized all the training materials, and in the evening she continued her extra Baduanjin practice.

events.name: Resume the complete morning routine.
events.description: Got up at 05:50; after shoulder and neck stretches, took my daughter to school. Because the weather was sunny and nice, I walked briskly in the courtyard for 10 minutes, and after returning home I did one set of Baduanjin. After breakfast I had a bowl of multigrain porridge.

events.name: Completion ceremony and certificate collection
events.description: At 9 o'clock, she hurried to the community classroom and attended the graduation ceremony of the middle-aged and elderly computer training course with 30 other trainees. The subdistrict director issued the completion certificates. Ma Xiulan spoke as a representative of outstanding trainees and shared her progress in using Excel for bookkeeping.

events.name: Making an annual cost and profit statement for pickled vegetables in Excel.
events.description: After the ceremony, she borrowed the classroom computer, entered the ingredient costs and sales revenue of each batch of pickles based on handwritten records, used SUM and subtraction formulas to calculate a net profit of 1,680 yuan, which matched the reconciliation result with Liu Chunmei. Delighted, she took a screenshot and saved it.

events.name: Design and print new bottle labels
events.description: Then she opened Word, inserted the chili pepper and ruyi pattern she had drawn, and designed a [Xiulan Pickles] label with red background and black text, including the production date and shelf life. She printed 20 labels.

events.name: Organizing training materials after the lunch break
events.description: At home in the afternoon, after a 45-minute nap, she recopied the past five weeks' handouts and notes into a new notebook, categorizing them with colored sticky labels: Basic Operations, Word, Excel. Her husband saw how serious she was and joked that she looked like she was preparing for college entrance exams.

events.name: Evening: extra Baduanjin practice and family reading.
events.description: In preparation for the community New Year's Day performance, from today she added an extra evening practice session of Baduanjin. She asked her husband to record her and found that the [Shake Head and Wag Tail] posture was slightly unsteady. After dinner, the whole family read for half an hour; the children read quietly while Ma Xiulan looked at computer teaching materials.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

end_state.mood: Content and proud

state.daily_exercise: Walked 30 minutes to take the children to school, brisk-walked 10 minutes in the courtyard, did two sets of Baduanjin (morning and evening), neck and shoulder stretches, and back stretches.

2025-12.daily_overview: On the annual checkup day, Ma Xiulan completed all the tests on an empty stomach and paid out of pocket for an additional gynecological exam. The preliminary report showed a normal BMI, and her bone density and blood sugar were both good. After returning home, she relaxed by making fabric hair flowers. In the afternoon she went to her parents' house to help pickle vegetables, and in the evening she continued practicing on the computer. The pace of life was steady.

events.name: Preparation and light activity before the physical examination.
events.description: Got up at 05:50. Because she was not allowed to eat, she only did shoulder and neck stretches and marched in place on the balcony for 10 minutes, and did not practice Baduanjin (for fear of low blood sugar). After sending her daughter off, she walked directly to the community health service center.

events.name: Annual health checkup
events.description: Blood draw, ultrasound, electrocardiogram, and other tests were done one by one, and the self-paid gynecological exam was also completed. Doctor Wang Jianguo told her that her bone density, blood sugar, and BMI were all good, and she could pick up the report in two days.

events.name: Replenishing energy and taking a midday rest after the physical examination
events.description: On the way home, I bought soy milk and steamed buns. After eating, I took a 45-minute nap. When I woke up, my lower back was a bit sore, probably because I'd been standing too long in the morning, so I did a 10-minute cat stretch to relieve it.

events.name: In the afternoon, went to her parents' home to help pickle sour cabbage
events.description: She rode the electric bike with her second son and youngest daughter to her parents' home. She helped her mother Li Xiuying wash cabbages and stack them in the vat, while her father Ma Jianguo repaired a stool nearby. Ma Xiulan talked about her ideas for improving the chili sauce, and her mother suggested adding a bit of local ground sesame oil.

events.name: In the evening, she made new styles of fabric hair flowers.
events.description: After dinner, she sat by the living room window and used leftover scraps from the garment factory to make three kinds of children's hair ornaments with pom-poms. Her younger daughter tried them on and kept saying they were pretty. She planned to give them to Liu Chunmei's granddaughter when she went to the market on the weekend.

events.name: Computer practice and evening stretches.
events.description: Before bed, she practiced on the computer for 20 minutes and updated the family's monthly expense table in Excel. Then she stretched her back, soaked her feet, and took deep breaths, and fell asleep at 23:00.

start_state.mood: Calm and serious.

end_state.mood: Peace of mind

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, 10 minutes of stepping in place on the balcony, 30 minutes of walking to take the child to school, and lower back stretches.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ma Xiulan practiced Baduanjin with neighbors in the community open space in the morning, and then the whole family did a thorough cleaning. In the afternoon, she made the draft for the embroidery order 'Blooming Flowers, Wealth and Honor'; in the evening, she reviewed the monthly budget with her husband and persisted with extra Baduanjin practice.

events.name: Practice Baduanjin in the community open space in the morning
events.description: After getting up at 06:30, Ma Xiulan put on her exercise clothes and went to the open space downstairs. Liu Chunmei and Zhang Shufen had already arrived, and the three of them practiced Baduanjin twice, focusing on correcting the [Shake Head and Wag Tail] posture. Neighbor Wang Guilan passed by and joined in with a few moves.

events.name: Household deep cleaning
events.description: After breakfast, her husband and children joined in, wiping windows, mopping floors, and tidying the yard. Ma Xiulan bundled up the old newspapers and cardboard boxes she had saved and had her second son take them to the recycling station and sell them for 8 yuan, to be used as his pocket money.

events.name: Design the embroidery draft
events.description: After the lunch break, she spread out the embroidery cloth and outlined the peonies and butterflies according to the customer's requirements. Her second son came over curiously to watch, and she took the opportunity to teach him a few flower patterns. It took her two hours to finalize the design, and she was very satisfied with her composition.

events.name: Household bookkeeping and monthly savings check
events.description: At 7 p.m., Ma Xiulan opened the ledger, checked the week's expenses, confirmed that the 150 yuan education savings for December had been deposited, and reminded her husband to keep his cigarette spending to 10 yuan a day. Her husband nodded and said he had indeed been smoking less recently.

events.name: Evening: extra Baduanjin practice and family stretching
events.description: At 20:00, she practiced Baduanjin in the master bedroom and asked her husband to help check her movements. Afterward, she led the whole family in a 10-minute group stretching session. Her youngest daughter did the cat stretch quite convincingly. She went to bed at 23:15.

start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Two sets of Baduanjin (30 minutes + 20 minutes), about 2 hours of housework, and 10 minutes of group stretching.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ma Xiulan picked up her physical examination report and was relieved that all indicators were normal. After buying groceries at the market, she did crafts with the children, took an evening walk with her neighbor, and continued computer practice and her bedtime routine at night.

events.name: Morning exercise and collecting the physical examination report
events.description: After getting up early and practicing Baduanjin with Liu Chunmei and Zhang Shufen, she went directly to the community health service center. Dr. Wang explained the report item by item: blood pressure 118/76, blood lipids normal, and mild anemia had improved. She happily took a photo and sent it to her husband.

events.name: Shopping at the vegetable market and chatting with a regular customer
events.description: At Sun Guifang's stall, she picked some spinach, Chinese yam, and a crucian carp. When Aunt Sun heard that all her health checkup results were normal, she kept saying, "When the family is harmonious, everything prospers." Ma Xiulan bought some apples, planning to make dried apple slices for the children in the afternoon.

events.name: Let Mother know I'm safe
events.description: On the way home, she called her mother. Her mother also breathed a sigh of relief and told her not to work too hard. Ma Xiulan promised to go help wash the bedding next week.

events.name: Parent-child crafts and Aunt Wu's needlework practice.
events.description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan taught her youngest daughter to sew a small purse from scrap cloth, while her second son played with building blocks nearby. She took out the crochet hook that Aunt Wu had given her, practiced basic single crochet stitches, and crocheted a small coaster. Although it was crooked, she felt quite accomplished.

events.name: Take the children to school and change the stall location.
events.description: In the evening, she took the three children for a walk along Jingwen Road. They met Zhang Shufen with her grandson, and the two families walked together to the square. The children played on scooters, while Ma Xiulan and Zhang Shufen chatted about the community's New Year's Day event. Zhang Shufen said she would definitely go to watch the Baduanjin performance.

events.name: Evening computer practice and pre-bed stretching.
events.description: At 20:30 she practiced making a recipe document in Word, entering the method for [low-fat yam and crucian carp soup]. Afterward she did back stretches, soaked her feet, and took deep breaths, then fell asleep at 23:20.

start_state.mood: Relaxation.

end_state.mood: Gratified and at peace

state.daily_exercise: 30 minutes of Baduanjin, 20 minutes of evening walk, waist and back stretches.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Monday, after her morning exercise, Ma Xiulan handled her first online pickled-vegetable orders, carefully packing and shipping them. In the evening, she sat in the kitchen with her husband, going over the year’s income and expenses, and planning for the family’s future together — warm and resolute.

events.name: Morning exercise and friendly practice with old friends
events.description: Got up at 06:00, stretched her shoulders and neck, sent her daughter to school, then went to the open area in the neighborhood to practice Baduanjin with Liu Chunmei and Zhang Shufen. Today she tried leading the exercises; although she swayed a bit in [Shaking the Head and Wagging the Tail], she kept a good rhythm.

events.name: Verified online sales orders and prepared stock.
events.description: In the morning, she checked three orders at home: two in Tianjin city and one in Beijing. She packed the pickled vegetables into 12 jars, affixed newly printed labels, and packed them tightly in foam boxes.

events.name: Send packages by electric bike and collect payment
events.description: Rode the electric bike to the courier point to send three boxes of pickled vegetables. She paid 18 yuan in shipping and received 120 yuan via mobile payment. After returning home, she sent a notice in the customer group, along with storage instructions.

events.name: Tidy the courtyard after the afternoon nap
events.description: After a 45-minute nap, she went to the courtyard, trimmed the dead branches of the roses, covered the wintering vegetables with a layer of straw mat, and moved the fuchsia indoors. Her second son was responsible for banking soil around the base of the persimmon tree.

events.name: Couple's year-end financial review.
events.description: At 21:00, after the children were asleep, Ma Xiulan made two cups of tea and sat down face to face with her husband. She opened the account book and read out the year's income and expenses item by item: total income about 42,000 yuan, with a balance of 3,800 yuan. The two discussed increasing the production of pickled vegetables next year to save enough for the children's education fund by the end of the year. Her husband held her hand and said she had worked hard. She shook her head with a smile and said [the whole family will carry the burden together].

events.name: Stretching and foot soaking before bed
events.description: After finishing lower back stretches and foot soaking at 23:00, she went to bed soon after, feeling much more at ease.

start_state.mood: Full of drive

end_state.mood: Moved and determined

state.daily_exercise: Baduanjin for 30 minutes, walking to take the children to school, going out by electric bike, waist and back stretches.

2025-12.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan started a three-day large-scale embroidery project. Today she focused on outlining the pattern of [Blooming Flowers and Wealth], stitching patiently and carefully. In the evening, after helping the children with their homework, she rested early.

events.name: Regular morning activities and preparation
events.description: Got up at 06:05, did shoulder and neck stretches, took my daughter to school, walked briskly in the courtyard for 5 minutes, and did one set of Baduanjin. After breakfast, I prepared the embroidery hoop and various colored silk threads, and saved the best-lit spot in the living room for embroidery.

events.name: Focusing on the embroidery outline.
events.description: She spent the whole morning sitting by the window, sketching peony petals and leaf outlines with single lines, occasionally comparing with the reference image on her phone. When her second son came home from school and said he was hungry, she suddenly realized it was almost noon.

events.name: After the lunch break, continue and finish the outline.
events.description: After a 45-minute nap, she continued her afternoon work and finished the outline of the butterfly wings. During this time, neighbor Wang Guilan came over to borrow soy sauce, took a look and praised her skillful hands. Ma Xiulan smiled and promised to teach her the basics of embroidery after finishing.

events.name: Evening parent-child check and bookkeeping
events.description: After dinner, she checked the children's homework. Her eldest son got two math problems wrong, and she patiently explained them. After recording today's grocery expenses, her waist was a little sore from sitting for a long time, so she asked her husband to help massage it for a while.

events.name: Simplify evening routine
events.description: Today I did not do extra Baduanjin practice; I only stretched my lower back and soaked my feet in hot water. I went to bed at 23:15 to save energy for tomorrow's fine work.

start_state.mood: Focused and calm.

end_state.mood: Satisfactory progress

state.daily_exercise: Baduanjin for 20 minutes, brisk walk in the courtyard for 5 minutes, walk to school with the kids, lower back and waist stretches.

2025-12.daily_overview: Second day of embroidery. Ma Xiulan focused intently on the peony stamens and butterfly antennae, repeatedly touching up the fine details. In the evening, she video-called her mother to share the progress, and the praise gave her more motivation.

events.name: Morning exercise and breakfast
events.description: Got up at 06:05, took her daughter to school, then went directly to the open space in the neighborhood. Liu Chunmei was already there waiting to do Baduanjin with her. Today the two practiced along with music on the phone, so their rhythm was more in sync. Breakfast was the leftover multigrain porridge from last night and half a steamed bun.

events.name: Fine embroidery: flower stamen details
events.description: In the morning, she switched to very fine needle and thread and used the seed-stitch embroidery technique to dot in the peony stamens, stepping back to examine each cluster after finishing it. Her younger daughter had a half-day off from kindergarten and sat nearby on a small stool watching, without crying or fussing. Ma Xiulan felt gratified.

events.name: Frustration in handling butterfly antennae.
events.description: In the afternoon, while embroidering the antennae with gold thread, she was not satisfied with the curve and undid it three times. Then she remembered Aunt Wu's hand-stabilizing technique when crocheting. After taking a deep breath, she finished it in one go and finally succeeded.

events.name: Video call with mother to share
events.description: Before dinner, had a video call with her mother to show the embroidery. Her mother suggested adding some sequins to the butterfly wings to make them more lively. Ma Xiulan noted this and planned to try it when finishing up tomorrow.

events.name: Caring for the Family and Relaxing
events.description: In the evening, while tutoring her second son, she found that he had made quite a few mistakes in today's homework. She felt a little impatient, but held back her temper and explained at a slower pace. After the children went to bed, she applied a hot towel to her eyes, did waist and back stretches, and went to bed at 23:00.

start_state.mood: Focused engagement

end_state.mood: Tired but satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Baduanjin for 30 minutes, walking to school drop-off, waist and back stretches

2025-12.daily_overview: [Blooming Flowers and Prosperity] was finally finished. Ma Xiulan carefully mounted it and delivered it in person. The client was very satisfied and paid a deposit for the next piece. The successful delivery filled her with confidence in her handicraft business.

events.name: Finished the embroidery and detail finishing
events.description: Woke up at 06:00 and did the usual morning exercise, then spent the last two hours finishing the binding stitches and sequin embellishments, cutting the threads, and using a steam iron on low temperature to smooth the embroidered surface. The finished piece is 50 cm × 60 cm, elegant and luxurious.

events.name: Framing and Packaging
events.description: She took out the wooden frame, stretched the embroidery tightly and fixed it, and backed it with cardboard. She wrapped it in red wrapping paper and tied it with a ribbon, like a precious gift.

events.name: Door-to-door delivery and payment collection.
events.description: In the afternoon, walked to deliver it to client Wang Lihua's home. After unfolding it, Ms. Wang praised it repeatedly, paid the remaining 350 yuan on the spot, and prepaid a 100 yuan deposit to order another embroidered piece of "Magpies on a Plum Tree" before next Spring Festival. Ma Xiulan happily agreed, and the two arranged to pick the pattern after the New Year.

events.name: Bookkeeping and Planning
events.description: After returning home, she recorded the 350 yuan in the side-income account, noting it as a deposit. After discussing with her husband, she put 200 yuan of the balance into the education reserve fund and kept 150 yuan for household use.

events.name: Evening extra Baduanjin practice and celebration
events.description: To celebrate the completion, she made a video call in the evening so Aunt Wu could watch her extra Baduanjin practice remotely, and her movements were much smoother. The family dinner added a dish of sweet and sour pork tenderloin, and her husband made an exception and bought two bottles of beer; the family had a small celebration.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to completion

end_state.mood: Delighted and proud

state.daily_exercise: Two rounds of Baduanjin (morning and evening), walking for school drop-offs, walking for deliveries

2025-12.daily_overview: On Friday, Ma Xiulan and her mother settled on a plan for the whole family to take a bath over the weekend and bought bath tickets. In the evening, she began selecting photos of the year, full of memories, occasionally her eyes welling up.

events.name: Morning exercise and vegetable garden care.
events.description: Got up at 06:10, saw off her daughter, then did Baduanjin with Liu Chunmei, adding 15 minutes of free stretching today. After returning home, she picked a few cabbages in the vegetable garden and prepared to make pickled vegetables.

events.name: Discussed taking a family bath with her mother.
events.description: Mother called, saying the weather was dry and cold, and suggested the whole family go to the old public bathhouse to soak and relax. Ma Xiulan agreed right away and decided to go together on Saturday afternoon, and she would be in charge of buying tickets.

events.name: Buying bath tickets and notifying family members
events.description: She rode her electric bike to the Old Street Bathhouse and bought seven tickets (for her parents and her own family of five; the youngest daughter was free of charge). She called her husband and parents to inform them. Her husband said he happened to be off work, and her father also agreed happily.

events.name: Daughter's excited preparations.
events.description: Knowing they were going to take a bath, the youngest daughter proactively packed her own small towel and bath puff, and dug out her favorite plastic duck. Ma Xiulan smiled and helped her put them into the bag.

events.name: Start selecting the annual photos.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan imported photos from her phone and camera into the computer, created folders by month, and started sorting them. When she saw the photos of the National Day trip to Beijing and the sunflowers planted in spring, she felt a pang of emotion and sighed that a year of the whole family being safe was a blessing. She didn't finish selecting until 23:20, picking out about 80 photos for later use.

events.name: Brief stretching before bed.
events.description: Before bed, she only did 5 minutes of waist and back stretches. Because she went to bed late, she hurriedly soaked her feet and went to bed at 23:30.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

end_state.mood: Warm and pleasant

state.daily_exercise: Baduanjin 30 minutes, free stretching 15 minutes, walking to take the children to school, waist and back stretching 5 minutes.

2025-12.daily_overview: Saturday was family day. In the morning, Ma Xiulan sorted photos and placed an order to make a photo album; in the afternoon, the whole family, old and young, went to a time-honored bathhouse for a soak. In the steaming heat, the family relaxed and chatted, and the way home was full of warmth.

events.name: Take photos of the potted plants and send them to the family group chat.
events.description: After getting up, she took a photo of the fuchsia for this month and sent it to the family group with the caption [It's still lush and green indoors in winter]. Her mother replied with a thumbs-up.

events.name: Go to the print shop to make a family photo album.
events.description: She took her USB drive to [Good Times] Print Shop, confirmed the album size with the clerk, decided on a family portrait for the cover, requested rush service, agreed to pick it up on the 15th, and prepaid 80 yuan.

events.name: The whole family of seven soaking in the public bathhouse
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan, her husband, her three children, and her parents—seven people in all—came to the Old Street Bathhouse. In the women's section, she and her mother scrubbed each other's backs, while her youngest daughter played with ducks in the children's pool; in the men's section, her husband soaked with his father in the big pool, and the two sons learned to swim. After bathing, the whole family sat in the lounge drinking hot soy milk and playing Chinese chess. Her father and husband talked about next year's retirement plans, while Ma Xiulan dried the children's hair, everyone cheerful and content.

events.name: Warm family dinner after coming home.
events.description: After bathing, feeling refreshed all over, the family walked home. Ma Xiulan and her mother made noodles with gravy and stir-fried mixed vegetables. At the dinner table, everyone discussed getting together once more before the New Year.

events.name: Evening extra practice of Baduanjin and bookkeeping
events.description: At 20:30 she practiced Baduanjin in the master bedroom and recorded a video to send to Aunt Zhao for advice. Afterward she noted down today's bathhouse expenses and deposited 50 yuan into the emergency fund. She fell asleep at 23:15.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

end_state.mood: Feeling relaxed and refreshed

state.daily_exercise: Two sets of Baduanjin (morning and evening), walk to and from the bathhouse, light activity in the bathing pool

2025-12.daily_overview: Sunday was the handicraft market day. Ma Xiulan stocked up early in the morning and caught a ride with a neighbor to the square to set up a stall. The pickled vegetables and small embroidered items sold well, bringing in 185 yuan. After packing up, she shared the results with her craft friends, feeling fulfilled and satisfied.

events.name: Pre-departure stocking up and morning exercise
events.description: Got up at 06:00, quickly stretched her neck and shoulders, took her daughter to grandma's (because her mother Li Xiuying had come to help look after her for half a day), then hurried home to practice Baduanjin. After that, she packed the goods: 20 jars of pickled vegetables, 10 sets of embroidered coasters, 5 small cloth dolls, two large bags.

events.name: Got a ride on a neighbor's electric bike to the market.
events.description: Zhang Shufen came to pick her up in a canopied electric car, and the two chatted and laughed all the way to the Jinghai District Cultural Square. Ma Xiulan had signed up in advance, and her stall was in the middle, right next to Zhou Xiuqin's paper-cutting stall.

events.name: Stall vending and sales
events.description: Spread a red flannel cloth, laid out the pickled vegetables in a row, and placed embroidered items beside them. In the morning, she sold 8 jars of pickled vegetables, 5 sets of coasters, and 2 small cloth dolls. Liu Chunmei also came to help call out to customers and sold two pairs of her crocheted wool shoes on commission.

events.name: Market lunch and socializing.
events.description: At noon, the three of them chipped in for boxed lunches and chatted while eating: Zhou Xiuqin planned to open a Taobao store before the New Year and invited Ma Xiulan to cooperate; Liu Chunmei said the supermarket was almost out of the pickles and asked her to deliver another 20 jars next week. Ma Xiulan noted everything down.

events.name: Closing the stall, returning home, and sharing the accounts
events.description: They packed up the stall at 3 p.m. After deducting the 10 yuan stall fee, the net income was 185 yuan. After returning home, she recorded the income in her accounts and posted photos in the handicraft group. Aunt Wu and Chen Yulan both liked them. Her husband had already picked up the children, and her daughter ran over and said [Mom is really amazing].

events.name: Evening habits and a later bedtime
events.description: Although tired, she still insisted on tutoring her second son, doing lower back stretches, and soaking her feet. She looked at her phone for a while before bed and did not go to sleep until 23:25.

start_state.mood: Positive

end_state.mood: Gained satisfaction

state.daily_exercise: One set of Baduanjin, shoulder and neck stretches, walking to school (to grandma's house), standing and carrying goods at the stall

2025-12.daily_overview: On Monday, Ma Xiulan picked up the beautifully made family photo album and wrote a message on the last page. In the early evening, she gathered the whole family to look through it, and the memories in the album filled the home with laughter. That night, she continued to practice Baduanjin hard for the performance.

events.name: Full morning routine
events.description: Got up at 05:55, did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, walked 30 minutes to take my daughter to school, did 10 minutes of brisk walking in the courtyard because it was sunny, and after returning home practiced one set of Baduanjin, paying special attention to lower-body stability in the "Shaking the Head and Wagging the Tail" posture.

events.name: Went to the print shop to pick up the photo album.
events.description: In the morning, she went to the print shop to inspect the finished photo album: hardcover cover, gold-stamped family portrait, 60 pages of photos arranged in chronological order, and a blank page left at the end. She paid the remaining 40 yuan, satisfied.

events.name: Handwritten thank-you message
events.description: After returning home, in the study, she neatly wrote on a blank page with a pen: [Thank you for this year, we are still together. 2025.12.15]. She looked at it for a moment, and her eyes grew moist.

events.name: Making New Year hanging ornaments after the noon break.
events.description: After her afternoon nap, she made three hanging ornaments with the Chinese character "fu" (blessing) from red non-woven fabric and bells, planning to give them to her parents and neighbor Wang Guilan. Her younger daughter helped string beads and had a blast.

events.name: Evening: whole family enjoys the photo album together
events.description: Her husband finished work early. After dinner, Ma Xiulan brought the photo albums into the living room, and the whole family squeezed onto the sofa to look through them. Her second son saw that the persimmon tree he had watered had borne small fruit and excitedly pointed it out to everyone; her eldest son turned to a group photo taken in front of Tiananmen during the Beijing trip and said he wanted to go again. Laughter filled the room; the albums held a year of memories and love.

events.name: Extra Baduanjin practice and writing exercises in the evening
events.description: At 20:00, she practiced an extra set of Baduanjin for the New Year's Day performance. She had her husband record a video, and when she reviewed it, she found her legs were stronger. After that, she opened her computer to practice Excel and tried to create a pickled vegetable inventory management table. While soaking her feet in hot water, she listened to a health program on the radio. At 23:50, she ended all tasks and soon fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

end_state.mood: Happy and warm

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes, walking for 30 minutes to take the children to school, brisk walking in the courtyard for 10 minutes, two sets of Baduanjin (morning and evening), and lower back stretching for 20 minutes.

2025-12.daily_overview: On a bitterly cold winter day, I got up and did the usual stretches and took the children to school. After indoor exercise, I went to the vegetable market to shop. In the morning, I focused on cloth hair flowers; in the afternoon, I cut fabric for the New Year; in the evening, I tutored the children and soaked my feet to warm up. Life was regular and fulfilling.

events.name: Morning neck and shoulder stretches and taking the daughter to school
events.description: Woke up at 5:50 in the morning. Ma Xiulan did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching in the living room, then woke up her younger daughter Ma Yuxin and helped her dress warmly. Mother and daughter walked hand in hand along Jingwen Road to the primary school. On the way they met neighbor Wang Guilan, and the three walked together for a while, chatting about the Winter Solstice cleaning arrangements.

events.name: Indoor walking in place and Baduanjin morning exercise
events.description: After taking the children to school and returning home, Ma Xiulan marched in place on the balcony for 10 minutes, combined with arm stretches and lunge leg presses, to dispel the chill. Then she practiced a full set of Baduanjin alone in the living room, focusing on the stability of the "Sway the Head and Shake the Tail" movement, breathing deeply and slowly.

events.name: Shopping and small talk at Xingwang Vegetable Market.
events.description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market and picked out radishes, scallions, and tofu at Sun Guifang's stall. Sun Guifang reminded her that the temperature would drop in a couple of days and suggested buying more Chinese cabbage to store. Ma Xiulan smiled and grabbed an extra head of cabbage.

events.name: Morning fabric hair flower making.
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan spread out the fabric by the living room window and continued making cloth hair flowers. She combined pink and blue scraps into a new style, stood up every 20 minutes to stretch her neck, and kept the lighting bright. The hair flower her daughter begged for last night was almost finished.

events.name: Cutting fabric for New Year hanging ornaments in the afternoon
events.description: After a 45-minute nap, Ma Xiulan took out the fabric scraps she had collected, drew the outlines of a fortune pouch and auspicious clouds on the tea table with a piece of chalk, and carefully cut them out to prepare for the subsequent embroidery. A quyi program was playing on the radio, and she occasionally hummed along.

events.name: Help with homework in the evening and soak feet in hot water
events.description: After dinner, she checked the second son's and youngest daughter's homework and urged the eldest son to review Chinese. After the tutoring session, she boiled water and soaked her feet for 15 minutes with mugwort and ginger slices, flipping through the household ledger while chatting with her husband. Before bed, she did lower back stretches and deep breathing, then went to bed at 23:50.

start_state.mood: Regular

end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches 5 minutes, walk to school 30 minutes, marching in place 10 minutes, Baduanjin 20 minutes, back and waist stretches.

events.name: Chatted with neighbor Wang Guilan at the doorway about winter solstice dumplings.
events.description: Around noon, the sun briefly appeared. Ma Xiulan brought a stool to the doorway and sat picking vegetables. Wang Guilan came over and brought up making dumplings for the Winter Solstice, saying her family's radish filling was the best. Ma Xiulan smiled and asked for her seasoning secrets, and they agreed to give each other a few dumplings to sample at the Winter Solstice.

events.description: After her lunch break, Ma Xiulan opened her laptop to practice Excel. She entered yesterday's market expenses and her husband's cigarette money, checked the balance, and found that this month's cigarette spending was well controlled. She sent her husband a thumbs-up on WeChat.

events.name: Evening extra Baduanjin practice and a family foot soak
events.description: Before dinner, I practiced an extra round of Baduanjin in the living room to polish the movements for the community performance. In the evening, while the whole family was soaking their feet, I discussed the arrangements for Saturday's award ceremony with my husband, and he agreed to finish work early. Before bed, I did back and waist stretches and deep breathing, and went to bed at 23:00.

As planned, she made traditional pickled vegetables for the elderly assistance program, and in the evening used the computer to organize the accounts of her side business.

events.name: Early morning winter-preparation check of the courtyard roses and a surprise
events.description: After getting up at 6:00 in the morning and taking her daughter to school, she came home, put on a cotton coat, and went into the courtyard. When she parted the straw at the base of the rose plant, she discovered a bright red bud pushing up through the frozen soil. Ma Xiulan crouched down in surprise, took out her phone, snapped two close-up shots in a row, and muttered, "This little thing really resists the cold."

events.name: Sent photos of Hongya to the family group and interacted.
events.description: Ma Xiulan sent the photo to the WeChat group 'Ma Family Big Family'. Her husband replied, 'This guy is really cold-resistant,' and her second son sent three thumbs-up in a row. She smiled and replied, 'I'll transplant it to the middle of the flower bed once spring comes.' Then she video-called her mother to show the red sprouts, and her mother said it was a good omen.

events.name: Indoor Baduanjin and back-and-waist stretching
events.description: Excited by the discovery of red sprouts, she did Baduanjin especially smoothly; during the cat stretch she felt flexible in the waist, and after the whole set she worked up a slight sweat.

events.name: Making traditional pickled vegetables in the kitchen to prepare for helping the elderly.
events.description: In the morning, wash the white radish and cucumber and cut them into strips, salt them to draw out water, then put them into jars, pour the boiled sauce over them, and seal. I plan to give some to elderly people living alone during Saturday's elder-care visit, and keep a jar for my parents to try.

events.name: Afternoon: clean the kitchen and tidy the yard.
events.description: In the afternoon, she deep-cleaned the stove top and range hood, and swept the dead branches and fallen leaves from the courtyard. During that time, her second son came home from school and helped take out the trash, and Ma Xiulan praised him for being sensible.

events.name: Evening homework tutoring and computer bookkeeping
events.description: After dinner, tutored the children in their homework, then practiced bookkeeping on the computer, entering this month's pickled vegetable costs and online sales income into Excel, and calculated the net profit. Before bed, soaked feet and pressed the Hegu acupoint, and went to bed at 23:30.

events.name: Morning stretching and school drop-off.

events.name: Zhang Shufen's supermarket shopping and small talk

Zhang Shufen mentioned that her daughter had done well in her final exams, and Ma Xiulan shared her eldest son's recent progress. The two encouraged each other.

events.name: Continued cutting fabric for handicrafts in the afternoon.

When the younger daughter came back from kindergarten, she brought a small stool and sat nearby to watch, so Ma Xiulan taught her to recognize a few colors.

events.name: In the evening, I got my husband to do waist and back stretches.
events.description: After dinner, her husband said his back was stiff from driving all day, so Ma Xiulan pulled him onto the living room rug to do cat-cow stretch and wall-assisted waist twists together, guiding his movements as they went. He joked that she was almost half a coach. Before bed, while soaking their feet, they discussed plans for the year-end financial review. Went to bed at 23:45.

At night, the family snuggled under the quilt watching TV, overflowing with happiness.

events.name: Simplified morning exercise
events.description: Because she had to help the elderly in the morning, after getting up at 6:10 she only did shoulder and neck stretches and the four core Baduanjin moves; there was no school drop-off walk because it was the weekend. Breakfast was low-fat milk and oatmeal.

events.name: Morning senior assistance service: delivering pickled vegetables and taking blood pressure
events.description: At nine o'clock, she took homemade pickled vegetables and a blood pressure monitor to Granny Zhang's house, who lives alone. Her blood pressure was normal. She told her to go out less in snowy weather and put the pickles in the kitchen cabinet. Granny Zhang held her hand and thanked her again and again.

events.name: Attend the community's annual Most Beautiful Family awards ceremony in the afternoon.
events.description: At two o'clock, at the community activity center, the director announced that her family had won the Harmonious Family Nomination Award and presented a thick organic cotton quilt. Ma Xiulan took the quilt, exchanged a few words with the director and other award winners, and thanked the community for the recognition.

events.name: After the award ceremony, walked home and ran into a neighbor, sharing the joy
events.description: Carrying the quilt and walking along Jingwen Road, she ran into Wang Guilan at the entrance of the alley. Wang Guilan offered congratulations again and again. Ma Xiulan happily said it was an honor for the whole family and showed her the quilt and the certificate.

events.name: Show her husband the prize upon entering the house.
events.description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was sitting on the sofa looking at his phone. Ma Xiulan held the cotton quilt high and said loudly: This is our family's certificate! Ma Zhiqiang got up, touched the quilt, nodded in praise, and then asked about the award details.

events.name: In the evening, the whole family squeezed together in the living room watching TV, sharing a cozy moment.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Zhiqiang spread the new quilt on the living room sofa, and the family of five huddled under it to watch the New Year's Eve program rehearsal, feeling warm and cozy. Ma Xiulan leaned on her husband's shoulder and watched the children playing and laughing, a wave of contentment rising in her heart. Because they were excited, they didn't fall asleep until 23:59.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

2025-12.daily_overview: On the winter solstice, the whole family pitched in for a thorough cleaning. In the afternoon, they worked together to make dumplings. In the evening, three generations sat together to eat the reunion dumplings. The warmth drove away the severe cold, and family cohesion reached a new level.

events.name: Morning family meeting to assign house-cleaning tasks
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan called her husband and three children to the living room and divided up the chores: her husband would clean windows and move heavy items, the eldest son would tidy the bookshelf, the second son would sweep and pick up toys, the youngest daughter would wipe the tables, and she herself would take care of the kitchen and courtyard. Everyone got their tools and set to work.

events.name: Husband cleaned the windows and moved furniture.
events.description: Ma Zhiqiang carried a ladder and washed all the windows in the house, not missing even the gaps in the window frames, and moved the sofa and coffee table aside for easy cleaning. Ma Xiulan handed him towels and reminded him to be safe.

events.name: Children divide the work to clean the rooms and courtyard
events.description: The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, organized the bookshelf and wiped the desk; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, sorted toys into boxes, swept the floor, and then took the initiative to go to the courtyard to sweep fallen leaves into bags; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, wiped the coffee table and low cabinet. Ma Xiulan saw her second son sweeping fallen leaves from the kitchen window and praised him for growing up.

events.name: Ma Xiulan deep-cleaned the kitchen, tidied the courtyard, and hung up the certificate of merit.
events.description: Ma Xiulan scrubbed the grease stains on the stove with a degreasing cleaner, cleaned up dead branches and clutter in the yard, and finally hung the Harmonious Family certificate she received yesterday squarely on the most prominent wall in the living room. Looking at the completely refreshed home, she let out a long sigh of relief.

events.name: Final check and praise after the big cleaning.
events.description: At 4 p.m., the whole family checked each room one by one: windows were sparkling, floors were clean, and items were in place. Ma Xiulan praised everyone for their efforts, cut fruit and made tea for the family to rest.

events.name: Ma Xiulan called her parents to invite them over for dumplings.
events.description: After finishing the big cleanup, Ma Xiulan called her parents and invited them to come for dumplings in the evening. Her mother Li Xiuying gladly agreed and said she would come over early to help.

events.name: After the big cleaning, started preparing to make dumplings for the Winter Solstice.
events.description: After a short rest, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to make dumplings. Her husband helped chop the meat while she mixed the filling and kneaded the dough. Her mother, Li Xiuying, arrived as promised and washed the vegetables and chopped the scallions and ginger. The children gathered around the table, too curious to leave.

events.name: The whole family sat together making dumplings, warm and joyful.
events.description: Once the ingredients were ready, the whole family gathered around the table to make dumplings. Ma Zhiqiang kneaded the dough and cut it into pieces, Ma Xiulan demonstrated rolling wrappers and filling them, and the children's oddly shaped dumplings drew constant laughter. Li Xiuying neatly pinched out ingot-shaped dumplings.

events.name: Three generations gathered to eat dumplings for the Winter Solstice reunion
events.description: The dumplings were boiled and cooked. Her husband prepared the Laba vinegar, and her father Ma Jianguo arrived right on time. The whole family sat around the table, dipping dumplings in vinegar. Ma Jianguo said with emotion: the winter solstice is as important as the New Year; a family together is better than anything. Warmth and aroma filled the room. Because of the lively atmosphere, they didn't go to sleep until 00:30 after cleaning up after the meal.

start_state.mood: Full of drive

end_state.mood: Warm and fulfilling

events.name: Resuming regular morning exercise

events.name: In the morning, update the side-business income and expense account on the computer.

She marveled that learning computerized bookkeeping was such a relief.

events.name: Afternoon grocery shopping at the market and chatting with Sun Guifang.
events.description: At 3 p.m., she rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market and weighed chives and eggs at Sun Guifang's stall, planning to make chive pockets. Sun Guifang mentioned that her husband had also learned to order groceries on his phone, and the two of them laughed as they discussed the pros and cons of buying groceries online.

events.name: Evening homework help and back stretches.
events.description: Before dinner, she supervised the children's homework. Ma Mingzhe mischievously cut an eraser into small pieces; Ma Xiulan patiently admonished him and then continued tutoring. At 8 p.m., she did waist and back stretches.

events.name: In the evening, embroidering small New Year blessing-bag ornaments under the lamp.
events.description: After the children went to bed, Ma Xiulan took out red fabric scraps and golden embroidery thread under the lamp to embroider a small blessing pouch. Her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin couldn't sleep, ran out, and leaned over the table to watch. Ma Xiulan guided her hand to make two stitches, and the mother and daughter chuckled softly. Afterwards she embroidered alone until 22:30, and the pouch was basically complete. Went to bed at 23:30.

Her daughter occasionally ran over, took a quick look, and then went back to her picture books. Two hours later, the auspicious cloud embroidery was basically finished. 2025-12.daily_overview: At the community gathering, the Baduanjin performance went smoothly and won the Healthy Group Award. She gave the scarf to her father to pass on warmth, and in the evening she finished embroidering the pomegranate ornament, feeling proud and satisfied.

events.name: Getting up early in the morning to prepare and take the children to school.
events.description: Got up at 5:45, earlier than usual. After doing shoulder and neck stretches, she took her daughter to school, practicing breathing on the way. When she got home, she quickly ate a low-fat breakfast.

events.name: Baduanjin group gathering and final preparations
events.description: At eight in the morning, I gathered with eight team members including Liu Chunmei and Zhang Shufen at the community activity center, changed into red practice uniforms, helped each other tidy our clothes and fix our hair buns, and reviewed the movements again, nervous but expectant.

events.name: Take the stage to perform Baduanjin
events.description: At 9:30, the Baduanjin group was the third to take the stage. Ma Xiulan stood in the middle of the second row and began the routine to the music. She wobbled slightly on the second movement but quickly steadied herself, and the rest of the movements were smooth and well coordinated, drawing warm applause from the audience.

events.name: Won the Healthy Group Award and received a scarf.
events.description: After the performance, the community director announced that the group had won the Healthy Group Award, and each person received a soft cashmere scarf. Ma Xiulan took it with both hands and felt that the persistence in exercising over the past six months or more had been worth it.

events.name: Take a group photo after the performance and share the joy
events.description: The group members took a group photo in front of the stage and congratulated each other. Ma Xiulan rode her e-bike home. When she walked in, she showed the scarf to her family. Her youngest daughter excitedly touched it and said it was so soft.

events.name: Give the award-winning scarf to her father
events.description: At lunch, thinking of her father's high blood pressure, she took a scarf and walked to her father's house. Upon entering, she handed it to him and said, "Your blood pressure should run as smoothly as brocade; you must keep your neck warm in the cold."

events.name: Father was moved and took a selfie to send to the family group
events.description: Ma Jianguo immediately put on the scarf, had his wife take a photo, sent it to the family group chat, and left a voice message: 'The scarf my daughter gave me is warm and thoughtful.' Ma Xiulan replied, 'Glad you like it, Dad.'

events.name: In the evening, embroider the third New Year ornament: pomegranate.
events.description: In the evening, she prepared the last piece of red cloth and green thread and quietly embroidered a pomegranate. Stitch by stitch, she embroidered plump fruit and leaves, and added tassels at the bottom. She lined up the three pendants and trimmed loose threads, ready to hang them tomorrow. Before bed, she did a simple lower back stretch and went to bed at 23:30.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous

First she hung the little fortune pouch on the inner door frame of the entrance, symbolizing fortune entering the home; she hung the auspicious cloud by the living room window and the pomegranate by the bedroom door. The mother and daughter stepped back to admire them, and Xinxin clapped her hands, saying they looked nice.

events.name: In the afternoon, sorted household receipts to prepare for the inventory.
events.description: After the nap, I emptied out all kinds of receipts accumulated in the study drawer, including pay stubs, payment receipts, and utility bills. I sorted and filed them by month, to organize the materials for the annual financial review starting tomorrow. Because I had been looking down for a long time, I did some neck exercises in between.

events.name: Picking up the children in the evening and tutoring
events.description: Picked up the children from school. Her second son said the teacher praised his handwriting for improving. Ma Xiulan was happy and rewarded him and his sister with a piece of homemade dried fruit each. After dinner, she helped with homework and patiently explained the wrong answers.

events.name: In the evening, had a video call with her younger sister Ma Xiufen.
events.description: At 7 p.m., she made a video call to her younger sister Ma Xiufen on her phone. The sisters talked for nearly half an hour. Ma Xiufen said she planned to bring her children back during the Chinese New Year and stay for a few extra days. Ma Xiulan was very happy, and the two discussed going shopping together on Binjiang Road. Before bed, she stretched her lower back and waist, then soaked her feet, and went to bed at 23:50.

2025-12.daily_overview: After depositing this month's education fund in the morning, she spent the whole day buried in calculating the family's annual income and expenses, focused and meticulous. She found a few forgotten expenses and had a draft to check with her husband tomorrow.

events.name: Morning exercise and school drop-off.
events.description: Got up at 5:55, stretched, then took my daughter to school. The sun was nice but the temperature was still low, so mother and daughter walked quickly. After returning home, did 10 minutes of marching in place on the balcony and one round of Baduanjin.

events.name: In the morning, walked to the bank to make the December education savings deposit.
events.description: At nine o'clock, I took 150 yuan and walked to the Postal Savings Bank. At the counter, I filled out a form and deposited the money into the education savings account. The teller printed the new passbook, and the balance showed 3,500 yuan, getting closer to the 5,000 yuan goal. I figured it would take about 5 more months.

events.name: Spreading out the account book in the living room to calculate the year's income and expenses
events.description: Returning from the bank, she cleared the coffee table, spread out a thick stack of receipts and account books, and opened the calculator to enter items one by one. She began with her husband's salary records, then added her own part-time income and his subsidy, repeatedly checking the totals. When she came across an illegible receipt, she paused and thought back for a long time. In the end, she calculated a total income of 43,200 yuan, total expenses of about 41,000 yuan, and a surplus of about 2,200 yuan. Because she was too focused, she delayed her lunch break by an hour, but she still ensured a 45-minute nap.

events.name: In the afternoon, she continued checking the calculations and discovered an omission.
events.description: Continued in the afternoon. I found a supermarket shopping receipt from October that I had forgotten to record, so I quickly added it. When my neck felt stiff, I did resistance exercises.

events.name: In the evening, gave her husband a heads-up
events.description: After dinner, she showed her husband the preliminary accounting results. He nodded and said they would go over them together on Sunday. After tutoring the children, Ma Xiulan did lower back stretches. While soaking her feet, she was still thinking about which entry might be off. Went to bed at 23:55.

events.name: Sleeping in and simplified exercise
events.description: On the weekend, I got up at 6:00, didn't need to take the kids to school, and just did shoulder and neck stretches and the five core Baduanjin moves, then marched in place on the balcony for 10 minutes. Breakfast was low-fat scallion pancakes.

events.name: In the morning, checked the education savings balance on her phone.
events.description: After breakfast, she checked the education savings account via mobile banking. The balance was 3,500 yuan including interest. She took a screenshot and saved it, and recorded it in the family ledger. She also sent a WeChat message to her younger sister Ma Xiufen asking about her plans for a trip next summer.

events.name: Sorted through old clothes in the afternoon to donate them.
events.description: On Saturday, she picked out the cotton-padded jackets and sweaters that the children had outgrown, folded a few of her husband's jackets that he no longer wore, and put them in plastic bags, planning to take them to the community clothing recycling bin next week. The freed-up cabinet space was intended for new cotton quilts.

events.name: In the afternoon, discussed summer vacation plans with her younger sister over the phone
events.description: Her sister called back and said bringing the kids back for summer vacation was no problem, suggesting they drive to Beidaihe together. Ma Xiulan smiled and agreed, but said it depended on how the pickled vegetable business went next year. After hanging up, a glimmer of hope rose in her heart.

events.name: Played origami with her daughter in the evening
events.description: After dinner, the youngest daughter brought out a paper-folding set and begged to play together. Ma Xiulan patiently taught her how to fold paper cranes and little frogs, creating a table full of colorful paper crafts. Her husband and sons watched variety shows nearby, laughing constantly. Before bed, she did her usual stretches and went to sleep at 23:45.
