2025-12.daily_overview: In the morning, I exchanged volunteer points for daily necessities; in the afternoon, I tidied the medicine cabinet; in the evening, I checked accounts with my husband, confirmed the year's balance, and decided to make a fixed deposit. The whole family's dental check-up results were gratifying, and the year ended on a fulfilling note.

events.name: Full weekend morning exercise routine
events.description: Got up at 6:05, did not take the children to school, did a full set of Baduanjin and lower back stretches in the living room, and then marched in place indoors for 10 minutes. Ate low-fat porridge for breakfast.

events.name: Redeem daily necessities with points
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., she took her community volunteer service points card to the community service center and redeemed it for a bag of rice, a jug of cooking oil, and a bag of flour. The staff helped carry them onto the footboard of her electric bike, and she felt a strong sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Tidied up the family medicine cabinet in the afternoon.
events.description: After returning home and putting away the supplies, she organized the family medicine cabinet, threw away expired medicines, and made a list of band-aids and iodine to replenish. Meanwhile, her husband helped carry the rice and flour into the kitchen.

events.name: After dinner, review the accounts together with my husband.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang sat at the dining table and went through the annual income and expense statement item by item. The two confirmed total income of 43,200 yuan, total expenses of 41,000 yuan, and a surplus of 2,200 yuan. Ma Zhiqiang closed the account book and said in a low voice, "We'll do better next year." Ma Xiulan nodded.

events.name: Confirm the year's balance and decide to put it in a fixed deposit.
events.description: After checking, Ma Xiulan wrote 'balance 2200 yuan' in red pen on the last page of the ledger and discussed with her husband going to the bank the next day to deposit it as a one-year fixed deposit, as a family emergency and education reserve fund. Her husband supported it.

events.name: Check the education savings account again and record it
events.description: Ma Xiulan logged into the education savings account again and took a screenshot of 12 deposit records, with a balance of 3,500 yuan. She told her husband and children that this was the first dedicated fund saved for the three children's schooling. They were still 1,500 yuan short of 5,000, and the whole family would keep working hard.

events.name: The last group dental checkup of the year
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ma Xiulan had the three children line up and carefully checked each one's teeth with a flashlight. She announced that after persisting for three months, none of them had developed new cavities. She praised everyone and stressed that the rules of brushing and rinsing must always be followed. The check took only about ten minutes, and the whole family felt relaxed and happy. Before bed, they did deep breathing to relax and went to bed at 23:50.

start_state.mood: Pragmatic

end_state.mood: Relieved and gratified

state.daily_exercise: Baduanjin 20 minutes, waist and back stretching, indoor marching in place 10 minutes, household chores

2025-12.daily_overview: In the morning she deposited the year-end surplus as a fixed deposit; in the afternoon she prepared for the New Year's Eve online tea party; in the evening the six sisters chatted warmly over a video call, friendship and craftsmanship blending across the distance, and late at night she still felt moved when recalling it.

events.name: Morning school drop-off and exercise
events.description: Got up at 5:55, did shoulder and neck stretches, then took my daughter to school. There were many students on the road on Monday, and my daughter chattered about getting a certificate today. After returning home, I walked in place for 10 minutes and did a set of Baduanjin.

events.name: Walk to the bank in the morning to make a fixed deposit
events.description: After breakfast, she put 2,200 yuan in cash into her small wallet and walked along Jingwen Road to the Postal Savings Bank. At the counter, she filled out a one-year fixed deposit form, double-checked the amount and maturity date, folded the deposit receipt, and put it away.

events.name: Returned home to record the deposit and store the deposit certificate.
events.description: Approaching noon, she went home, put the fixed deposit certificate into the file folder in the bedroom drawer, and wrote in the account book: "December 29, 2025: deposited 2,200 yuan into a one-year fixed deposit, reserved for emergencies and education." She nodded as she closed the account book.

events.name: In the afternoon, prepare for the New Year's Eve craft tea party.
events.description: After waking from her nap, she tidied the coffee table, set out the family photo album and the jar of Hebei chili sauce made together with Aunt Wu, and prepared a phone stand and charging cable. One by one, she @Zhou Xiuqin, @Liu Chunmei, @Wang Guilan, her mother, and Aunt Wu in the WeChat group to confirm the connection time and software.

events.name: In the evening, six people chatted animatedly over a video call.
events.description: At exactly 7 p.m., she initiated a video call, and Zhou Xiuqin, Liu Chunmei, her mother, Wang Guilan, and Aunt Wu, who was far away in Hebei, appeared on the screen. The six of them took turns holding up their works: Ma Xiulan showed a photo album and chili sauce, Zhou Xiuqin displayed new Spring Festival paper-cutting designs, Aunt Wu shook out a newly crocheted shawl, and Liu Chunmei held up a handmade chair cushion. Everyone chimed in with praise, and Aunt Wu immediately invited them to go to Hebei next spring to exchange skills. Laughter kept ringing out.

events.name: Cleaning up after the tea party and having private chats.
events.description: After the video call ended, she said goodnight to her sisters in the group chat and agreed to share photos of their works. She separately sent a private message to Aunt Wu to confirm the plan to go to Hebei in early spring. Before bed, she flipped through the family photo album again, savoring the lively memories. After stretching her waist and back, she soaked her feet and didn't sleep until 23:55.

start_state.mood: In an orderly manner

end_state.mood: Touched and satisfied.

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, 30-minute walk to take child to school, 10 minutes of marching in place, 15 minutes of Baduanjin, walking to and from the bank, waist and back stretches

2025-12.daily_overview: The day before New Year's Eve, she went to the vegetable market to stock up on New Year goods. In the afternoon, she steamed glutinous rice cakes, and the whole house was filled with a sweet aroma. In the evening, she cut paper window decorations with her daughter to decorate the doorway. The New Year atmosphere was growing stronger, and her heart was full of anticipation.

events.name: Morning school drop-off and indoor exercise.
events.description: Got up at 6:00, stretched her shoulders and neck, then took her daughter to school. The temperature had dropped again, so she added an extra scarf for her daughter. After returning home, she marched in place on the balcony for 10 minutes and did one set of Baduanjin.

events.name: In the morning, go to the vegetable market to stock up on Chinese New Year goods
events.description: In the morning, she rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market and bought glutinous rice flour, brown sugar, and a few red dates at Sun Guifang's stall. Sun Guifang smiled and asked if she was going to steam rice cakes. Ma Xiulan nodded, and Sun added another handful of dried osmanthus. Sun Guifang also recommended the newly arrived dried persimmons, and Ma Xiulan bought some as a snack for the children.

events.name: Steamed glutinous rice cakes at home in the afternoon.
events.description: After lunch, she mixed glutinous rice flour with warm water, added brown sugar and chopped red dates, stirred it into a paste, poured it into a steaming tray lined with a cloth, and steamed it over high heat. Forty minutes later the rice cake came out, filling the room with a sweet aroma. She cut a small piece for her daughter to taste first, and her daughter exclaimed it was delicious. The remaining pieces were cut and placed on a plate to eat on New Year's Eve.

events.name: In the evening, cut paper window decorations with her daughter and arrange them.
events.description: When it was getting dark, she took out red paper and scissors, taught her youngest daughter to cut simple window flower patterns, and herself cut a pair of "carp leaping over the Dragon Gate". The mother and daughter pasted the paper cuttings on the living room window, straightened the lucky-bag ornament by the door, and the room immediately took on a New Year feel.

events.name: In the evening, the whole family watched TV and chatted.
events.description: After dinner, the whole family watched more than half an hour of TV previews for New Year's Eve programs. The children excitedly said that tomorrow was New Year's Eve. Ma Xiulan reminded them to go to bed early tonight so they would have energy tomorrow. Before bed, she stretched her waist and back, and while soaking her feet, her husband said he would try to get off work early tomorrow. Because of the excitement, she didn't fall asleep until 00:05.

start_state.mood: Slightly excited.

end_state.mood: Full of anticipation

state.daily_exercise: Shoulder and neck stretches, 30-minute walk for school drop-off, 10 minutes of marching in place, 15 minutes of Baduanjin, back and waist stretches.

2025-12.daily_overview: On the last day of 2025, she accompanied her husband in the early morning for a pre-departure check before he went out with the truck, reviewed her volunteer experience and filed it away. In the afternoon, she prepared a New Year's Eve family feast. During dinner, warm interactions left a heartwarming mark in the photo album. At night, the whole family took a walk and checked the potted plants, bringing the day to a perfect close.

events.name: Early in the morning, accompanied her husband for a pre-departure vehicle inspection.
events.description: At 5:55 in the early dawn, after stretching his neck and shoulders, Ma Zhiqiang checked the truck in the yard. Ma Xiulan wrapped herself in a cotton coat and followed alongside, helping him double-check the last batch of transport documents and certificate expiration dates for the year. After the inspection, she handed him a new pair of thickened knee pads and urged, "The roads are complicated, drive slowly." This was the last time this year they followed their pre-departure truck-check routine. Ma Zhiqiang nodded and started the engine.

events.name: Morning walk with daughter (instead of taking her to school)
events.description: School was already on holiday, but Ma Xiulan still took her younger daughter for a 30-minute walk along Jingwen Road, continuing their mother-daughter walking habit. The child hopped and skipped, saying that today was New Year's Eve. Ma Xiulan smiled and promised to help her cut a rabbit window decoration in the evening. After returning home, she marched in place indoors for 10 minutes and did one round of Baduanjin, with smooth movements and deep breathing.

events.name: Go to the market to buy ingredients for New Year's Eve
events.description: After seeing her husband off, she rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market. At Sun Guifang's stall, she picked a fresh carp, a piece of pork belly, and some baby bok choy, planning to make braised fish, steamed pork with rice flour, and sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin. Sun Guifang gave her a bunch of cilantro to wish the family happiness.

events.name: In the morning, review volunteer experience and archive it.
events.description: After buying groceries, she sat at the desk and organized this year's thank-you letters and the Harmonious Family Nomination Award certificate into a transparent folder. She decided to continue participating in elderly assistance every quarter next year, with pickled vegetables and blood pressure measurement becoming regular service items.

events.name: Afternoon: elaborately cook the New Year's Eve family feast in the kitchen
events.description: From 2 p.m., she kept busy in the kitchen, pan-frying the carp until golden on both sides, then braising it; coating the pork belly with rice flour and steaming it until tender; and deep-frying the tenderloin in sweet and sour sauce. The four dishes and one soup came out one after another. She set them on the round table and took the family photo album out of the drawer, placing it at the corner of the table.

events.name: In the evening, the couple had a warm New Year's Eve dinner together with affectionate interaction.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Zhiqiang came home after finishing his shift, and the two sat facing each other at the table. Ma Zhiqiang poured a small cup of baijiu for his wife, raised his glass, and said softly, "Wife, let's keep it up next year!" Ma Xiulan felt a warm surge of emotion, picked up a piece of sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, and fed it to her husband. They smiled at each other, clinked glasses, and took a light sip.

events.name: Sauce dripped onto the photo album, leaving an unintended stain.
events.description: While serving food, a drop of sauce slipped from the pork tenderloin and splashed onto the hard cover of the photo album on the edge of the table. Ma Xiulan quickly wiped it with a tissue, but it left a light brown mark that looked like a piece of amber under the light. Ma Zhiqiang smiled and smoothed things over: "It's fine; the mark actually looks like tree rings." Ma Xiulan examined the stain and, instead of being upset, felt that life had simply gone on enjoyably like this.

events.name: After-dinner cleanup and savoring the memories in the photo album.
events.description: After dinner, she put the dishes and chopsticks away in the kitchen. While clearing the table, she picked up the photo album again and looked at the light brown mark for a long time. Her husband's words echoed in her ears, and all the hardships and warmth of the past year welled up in her heart, making the corners of her mouth curl into an unconscious smile.

events.name: Family evening walk to reinforce the screen-time limit habit
events.description: After tidying up, she suggested the whole family go out for a stroll. Carrying a small radio, she and her husband walked slowly along Jingwen Road with their three children. They talked about the changes brought by less screen time and more walking over the past two months; the children said their eyes no longer felt so tired. Ma Xiulan encouraged everyone to keep it up in the new year, and once spring warmed up and flowers bloomed, they could add badminton.

events.name: The year's last check on the potted fuchsia.
events.description: After returning from the walk, she went to the corner of the balcony, lifted the greenhouse plastic film, and tested the pot soil with her fingertips. Finding it somewhat dry, she watered it with some water that had been left to reach room temperature. She carefully trimmed the dead leaves from winter dormancy, then wiped the leaves with a damp cloth, letting the plants welcome the New Year in a neat state. She hurriedly added the final care notes of the year to her journal. Before bed, she stretched her lower back, soaked her feet in hot water with mugwort and ginger slices, reviewed the little blessings, took deep breaths to relax, and went to bed at 23:50.

start_state.mood: Solemnity and expectation

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and full of hope, light in body, and full of anticipation for the new year.

state.daily_exercise: Neck and shoulder stretching for 5 minutes, morning walk for 30 minutes, marching in place for 10 minutes, one set of Baduanjin, waist and back stretching, evening family walk for 30 minutes.

2025-04.daily_overview: She got up early in the morning and tried a 20-minute brisk walk, but during the day suffered a heavy blow when the pickled vegetables were returned. Financial pressure suddenly increased, and Ma Xiulan fell into deep self-blame and lay awake all night.

events.name: Brisk walking in the neighborhood park in the early morning.
events.description: At 5:45 in the morning, waking up half an hour earlier than usual, Ma Xiulan decided to go out for a longer walk. From her home on Jingwen Road, she walked briskly along the sidewalk to the street-corner park, circled the park twice in about 20 minutes, matching a rhythm of four steps inhaling and four steps exhaling, and recorded the new route with a step-counter app on her phone. On the way home, she met Sun Guifang, who was out early to buy groceries, and they exchanged a brief greeting. She got home before 6:30 to prepare breakfast, feeling slightly sweaty but refreshed.

events.name: Pickle returns and loss accounting
events.description: In the morning, the community supermarket called to inform her that the second batch of "Xiulan's Handmade Pickles" had been complained about by customers for being too salty, tasting "salty enough to taste bitter," and demanded a full return and suspension of cooperation. After calculating, Ma Xiulan suffered a net loss of 200 yuan in ingredients and labor. Her childhood friend Liu Chunmei complained on the phone that she had been careless. She was silent for a long time.

events.name: Household spending tightening and savings plan adjustment
events.description: In the afternoon, because household expenses had increased recently, Ma Xiulan discussed with her husband and decided to adjust the family budget. Starting this month, they reduced the monthly education savings deposit from 200 yuan to 100 yuan to keep daily expenses balanced while continuing to save without interruption. She revised the ledger and wrote the new figure on the flyleaf.

events.name: Sleepless night and self-reflection
events.description: That night, because of the financial loss from the returned pickled vegetables and her self-blame, Ma Xiulan tossed and turned in the bedroom, repeatedly replaying the production process, and was still unable to fall asleep even after 3 a.m. Her husband's comforting was of no avail.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Anxiety and guilt

2025-04.daily_overview: After morning exercise, she found a formula error at home. Feeling down, she turned to her childhood friend for help. Chunmei came over immediately and talked with her late into the night, finally helping her regain confidence and decide to attend the training.

events.name: Brisk walking in the neighborhood park in the early morning.
events.description: Despite having slept less than 4 hours, Ma Xiulan got up at 6:00, washed up quickly, and went out. She walked briskly along Jingwen Road to the street park and completed two laps in about 20 minutes. The morning air was humid; she deliberately slowed her breathing and recorded it with a step-counting app. On the way home, she ran into Zhang Shufen at the entrance of Shufen Convenience Store, who was opening the rolling shutter door, so she bought three cups of fresh soy milk on the way. She got home at 7:15 to prepare breakfast, feeling a bit more refreshed.

events.name: Checked notes to find the mistake in the recipe
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan took out 'The Complete Guide to Home Pickling' in the living room and compared it with her own production notes, carefully recalling the second production process. She found that during the second production, she had mistakenly written '1 tablespoon' for the '1/2 teaspoon' of salt. She re-measured accurately, wrote down the correct proportion, circled the mistake in red pen, and put a sticky note as a warning.

events.name: Pouring out her frustration to Chunmei on WeChat
events.description: Because the pickled vegetables had been returned, Ma Xiulan felt low. She sent a voice message on WeChat to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, her voice choked with emotion as she poured out her frustration and confusion, hoping for comfort and advice. After sending the voice message, she regretted it a little, afraid of causing Chunmei trouble, but the message could no longer be recalled.

events.name: Chunmei hurried over to comfort her in person.
events.description: After receiving the message, Liu Chunmei immediately put down her work at the supermarket, rode her e-bike to Jingwen Road, and sat down with Ma Xiulan on a bench in the street park. Chunmei shared how, when she first started working at the supermarket, she was publicly criticized by a customer for misremembering a price, and later overcame the difficulty by silently memorizing prices over and over. She encouraged Ma Xiulan, 'You have a solid foundation when it comes to flavor; with a little more care, it's bound to work.'

events.name: Late-night heart-to-heart talk restores confidence
events.description: The two chatted in the park until it was completely dark, then went back to Ma Xiulan's living room and talked for a long time. Chunmei looked through the notes with her and suggested she attend the district's free training class on pastry making and pickling techniques. Ma Xiulan's mood gradually improved, and she decided on the spot to go to the community service center the next day to ask about signing up. Though a trace of fear of failure still lingered, looking at the mistakes circled in red pen in her notebook, she felt that this time she had finally found the root cause. After seeing Chunmei off, she washed up briefly and went to bed at 23:00.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Frustrated and low

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Confidence is starting to appear, though still with a touch of unease

2025-04.daily_overview: To prepare for Qingming Festival, she made a test batch of pickled vegetables with a new recipe and asked her family to taste them. Her mother called to express concern, but she politely declined. In the afternoon, she bought sacrificial offerings and continued her morning exercise.

events.name: Brisk walking in the neighborhood park in the early morning.
events.description: At 6:00 sharp, Ma Xiulan went out as usual. Following Jingwen Road straight to the street park, she power-walked two laps in 20 minutes, and her breathing rhythm gradually steadied. On the way back, at the park entrance, she walked a short stretch with Zhang Shufen, who was carrying soy milk, and they agreed to go for a walk together on the weekend. She got home before 7:00 and made egg drop soup with the soy milk bought yesterday.

events.name: Test new pickled vegetable recipes in the kitchen.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan, in her own kitchen, strictly following the newly adjusted salt ratio, made small test batches of pickled vegetables using one jin of cucumbers, half a jin of radishes, and other ingredients. She deliberately double-checked the measurements with an electronic scale and added the Sichuan peppercorns her mother gave her last year to the cooled pickling liquid. When finished, she asked her husband and eldest son to taste. Her husband commented, 'This time it's not too salty, just right,' and the eldest son nodded.

events.name: Mother called to offer help
events.description: Ma Xiulan's mother, Li Xiuying, learned about the return incident from Liu Chunmei and took the initiative to call, offering to help improve the flavor, saying she had been pickling vegetables for decades and knew what she was doing. Since Ma Xiulan's emotions had just settled and she wanted to solve the problem independently, she politely declined, saying, "Mom, let me adjust it for two days first; if it still doesn't work, I'll ask you." They agreed to meet and talk during the Qingming tomb-sweeping.

events.name: Buy Qingming Festival offerings at the vegetable market.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan rode the family tricycle to the vegetable market in Jinghai District and bought joss paper, white chrysanthemums, and fresh fruit from Sun Guifang. After returning home, she washed the pickled radish she had made last year and put it into a small pottery jar. She also folded the cyan handkerchief she had embroidered earlier and placed it in a cloth bag, ready to wipe the tombstone when sweeping the grave.

start_state.mood: Slightly relaxed.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Calm and content after the successful trial production.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Qingming Festival day, she went to the supermarket and sincerely apologized to Chunmei, winning back the trial sales opportunity. Then she returned to her parents' home and worked with her mother to improve the recipe, with warm mother-daughter interaction.

events.name: Brisk walking in the neighborhood park in the early morning.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Ma Xiulan went out with an umbrella in the light rain. By the time she walked to the street park, the rain had lightened, so she put away her umbrella and walked briskly for two laps, 20 minutes. The cool air made her mind especially clear. The pedometer app showed a steady pace. On the way home, a fine rain started again, and she jogged a few steps back home. At 7 she prepared breakfast; her husband said, "You still went out in the rain?" She replied, "I'm used to it."

events.name: The supermarket apologized and resumed the trial sales.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan brought the newly made pickled vegetable samples to the community supermarket, placed the glass jars in front of Liu Chunmei, apologized sincerely, and explained in detail the recipe error she had discovered and the adjustment process. Liu Chunmei picked up a slice and tasted it, sighed, and said, “The flavor has actually come back about 90 percent.” She finally agreed to take 6 jars on a trial sales basis and talk after they were sold. Ma Xiulan thanked her repeatedly.

events.name: Mother and daughter work together to adjust the recipe.
events.description: After leaving the supermarket, Ma Xiulan rode her tricycle directly to her mother Li Xiuying's home on Shengli Street. In the kitchen, the mother and daughter heated up a sample of the pickled vegetables and tasted it. Her mother suggested, 'Add half a spoon more sugar to enhance the freshness; dissolve it in warm water and mix it in,' and brought out her treasured dried tangerine peel for her to try next time. As she was leaving, her mother pressed a jar of homemade fermented bean paste into her hand and patted it. Ma Xiulan's eyes grew warm and she nodded in agreement.

events.name: Brisk walking in the neighborhood park in the early morning.
events.description: At 6 a.m., the rain had stopped and the ground was slightly damp. Ma Xiulan went out for her usual walk; her newly purchased sneakers did not slip on the wet ground. After briskly walking two laps for 20 minutes, she ran into Wang Guilan at the park gate, who was returning from grocery shopping, and the two chatted briefly about how to make shepherd's purse dumplings. She got home before 7 o'clock and urged the children to get up and wash up.

events.name: The whole family went to the cemetery to sweep the graves
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan met up with her husband, their three children, and her parents, who had arrived early, and walked with sacrificial offerings to the Jinghai District cemetery. On the way, her second son Ma Mingzhe hopped and skipped, stepped into a small puddle and wet his shoes. Ma Xiulan did not scold him; she took out a spare pair of socks from her backpack and changed them for him.

events.name: Wiping the tombstone and paying respects
events.description: After arriving at the cemetery, Ma Xiulan carefully wiped the tombstones of her grandfather and father with a prepared wet handkerchief, brushing away fallen leaves. She placed pickled radish and white chrysanthemums, lit spirit money, and knelt before the graves, speaking softly about recent events. Her husband and the children bowed one by one, and her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin imitated her mother and kowtowed.

events.name: Gathering shepherd's purse in the field.
events.description: After tomb sweeping, they headed back along the small path. Mother Li Xiuying pointed at the shepherd's purse beside the road and suggested picking some. Ma Xiulan, her husband, and the children bent down to pick them, while her husband collected them in a cloth bag. In about half an hour, they had picked a full bag. The mother taught the grandchildren to tell shepherd's purse from weeds, while Ma Xiulan and her father lagged behind talking about blood pressure.

events.name: The whole family makes shepherd's purse wontons
events.description: In the evening, when she got home, Ma Xiulan and her mother picked and washed shepherd's purse, chopped it and mixed it into the lean pork filling, deliberately using less salt. Her husband kneaded the dough and rolled out the wrappers, and the children bustled around helping. Though the dumplings were lopsided, everyone was enthusiastic. After boiling, the whole family sat around the table, dipping them in vinegar and a little chili oil. Ma Xiulan remarked, 'spring has entered the bowl,' and the children each ate two bowls. After dinner, she cleaned up the kitchen while her husband watched TV with the children.

start_state.mood: Solemn gratitude

2025-04.daily_overview: The first family low-salt dinner was held successfully; her father cooked the fish himself. She steamed shepherd's purse dumplings and gave them to the neighbors. Inspired, she decided to plant wild vegetables in the courtyard next year and wrote down the plan.

events.name: Brisk walking in the neighborhood park in the early morning.
events.description: Woke up naturally at 6:00, drank a glass of warm water, and went out. I took a brisk walk around the neighborhood park for two laps (20 minutes), thinking about the menu for today's gathering on the way. I got home before 7:00, feeling as bright as the weather.

events.name: Prepare and host a low-salt family dinner.
events.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan hosted the family's first low-salt gathering at her parents' home. She made shepherd's purse wontons and steamed bass. Her father, Ma Jianguo, took the initiative in the kitchen and cooked a low-oil braised tofu. Her older sister Li Xiuyun brought cold spinach salad, and her younger sister Ma Xiufen bought low-salt roast chicken. The whole family sat together, and her father helped himself to another half bowl of rice, joking, 'If I eat like this, I can even cut back on my medicine.'

events.name: Steamed shepherd's purse balls to give to neighbors
events.description: In the afternoon, using the leftover shepherd's purse from the gathering, Ma Xiulan kneaded dough and prepared filling in her own kitchen, steaming two trays of shepherd's purse balls. She first sent a plate to Wang Guilan across the hall, and Wang Guilan gave her a bag of eggs from her own chickens in return, remarking, 'The older generation really knows good food.' She took the other plate to Shufen Convenience Store. Zhang Shufen praised it repeatedly after tasting it and asked if she could put it on consignment at the store. Ma Xiulan smiled and agreed to give it a try.

events.name: Neighbor feedback and the budding plan to grow wild vegetables
events.description: On the way home, Ma Xiulan kept thinking, 'Wild vegetables can also be sold for money.' Once home, she immediately took out her account book and under the 'Next Year's Plans' page wrote: 'Plant shepherd's purse and purslane in the east corner of the yard, for personal use and to try selling in spring,' and noted that a fence is needed to keep chickens from pecking.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

2025-04.daily_overview: Seven consecutive days of early-morning brisk walking came to a successful end, and she felt refreshed in body and mind. After exchanging exercise tips with a neighbor, she started the new week with regular housework and bookkeeping.

events.name: Brisk walking in the neighborhood park in the early morning.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Ma Xiulan easily completed 20 minutes of brisk walking, two laps around the neighborhood park. She opened her step-counting app and reviewed the week's records, finding that her total steps had increased by 20% compared with last week. At the park exit, she met Zhang Shufen, and the two exchanged stretching tips. Zhang Shufen said her knees occasionally hurt, and Ma Xiulan suggested she walk more slowly. She returned home before 7 to make breakfast, frying three eggs with steamed buns.

events.name: Housework and picking up/dropping off the children
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan did laundry, swept the floor, and watered the persimmon tree in the courtyard. Then she took her second son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin to school. At the school gate, she met Teacher Han Mei and briefly asked about her eldest son's English dictation. On the way back, she made a detour to Xingwang Vegetable Market and bought fresh scallions and tofu from Sun Guifang.

events.name: Evening bookkeeping and weekly plan
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan sorted out the family income and expenses at the dining table and checked the education savings record of the 100 yuan just deposited. In her notebook, she listed next week's tasks: contact Zheng Xiuying to ask about the pickled vegetable training time, call her mother to schedule the regular blood pressure report, and prepare the embroidered tablecloth for the market.

2025-04.daily_overview: Her father's stable blood pressure inspired her to develop low-salt pickled vegetables. She went to the vegetable market early in the morning to buy ingredients, and also measured her father's blood pressure, helped a neighbor watch the store for a while, and did her morning exercise as usual.

events.name: Brisk walking in the neighborhood park in the early morning.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Ma Xiulan as usual walked from home to the neighborhood park and did two laps of brisk walking for 20 minutes, breathing steadily. On the way, she saw winter jasmine blooming by the roadside, slowed down, and took a photo with her phone. She got home before 7 to make breakfast and reheated the leftover shepherd's purse wontons from yesterday for the children.

events.name: Measuring father's blood pressure and teaching him WeChat
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan went to her parents' home and, as usual, took her father's blood pressure: 139/85, slightly fluctuating but normal. She again taught her father to send voice messages on WeChat. He learned to press and hold to speak, but after releasing he always forgot to wait a moment; father and daughter laughed together.

events.name: Designing a low-salt pickled vegetable recipe and purchasing ingredients
events.description: After returning from her parents' home, Ma Xiulan resolved to develop low-salt pickled vegetables. Referring to her training notes, she designed a recipe that replaced 40% of ordinary salt with sea salt and added celery juice for umami. After making a list, she went to Xingwang Vegetable Market and bought sea salt, celery, cucumbers, radish, and spices from Sun Guifang. Sun Guifang enthusiastically recommended the newly arrived small chili peppers, but she only took a little.

events.name: Help Zhang Shufen look after the store
events.description: On her way back from shopping, she passed Shufen Convenience Store. Zhang Shufen was in a hurry to pick up her grandson from school, so she asked Ma Xiulan to watch the store for ten minutes. Ma Xiulan agreed and stood behind the counter for a while. She sold a pack of salt and two bottles of soy sauce, getting a taste of being a "shopkeeper." When Zhang Shufen came back, she thanked her again and again and insisted on giving her a pack of goji berries.

2025-04.daily_overview: She strictly followed the new recipe to pickle low-salt vegetables, carefully recording each ingredient. In the afternoon, her youngest daughter sprained her ankle, but it turned out to be a false alarm; she handled it calmly, fully demonstrating her motherly responsibility.

events.name: Brisk walking in the neighborhood park in the early morning.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Ma Xiulan, as usual, went to the neighborhood park and power-walked for 20 minutes. Along the way she heard cuckoos calling, and the air smelled of freshly turned soil. She stretched for 5 minutes by the park pavilion and felt her shoulders and neck loosen up. She got home before 7.

events.name: Pickle the first batch of low-salt pickles
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan washed and cut the vegetables she had bought in the kitchen, and prepared the pickling liquid according to a new formula: sea salt and regular salt mixed in a 2:3 ratio, add celery juice, Sichuan peppercorns, star anise, and cloves, bring to a boil and let cool, then pour into a clean jar containing the vegetables and seal it. She took out the newly bought small spring scale, weighed and recorded as she went, even the total amount of water was accurate to the gram, and pasted a label on the outside of the jar reading 'Low-Salt No. 1, pickled April 9'.

events.name: Caring for the courtyard and doing household chores
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan watered the newly planted scallion seedlings in the courtyard and pulled up the weeds. When she went back inside to tidy the room, she heard her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin crying in the yard — she had twisted her ankle while chasing a butterfly. Ma Xiulan ran out to check and found only slight redness and swelling. She carried her daughter inside, applied a hot water bottle to the ankle, and comforted her softly. After dinner, her daughter could walk normally again, and Ma Xiulan felt relieved.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road
start_state.mood: Focus

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road

2025-04.daily_overview: Inviting relatives and friends to try the new pickled vegetables won their approval; although the sharing on Moments got little response, a neighbor's down-to-earth encouragement made her turn to real feedback with a more pragmatic attitude.

events.name: Early-morning brisk walk in the rain.
events.description: At 6 a.m., it was raining moderately. Ma Xiulan hesitated but still took an umbrella and went out. At the street park, she only brisk-walked for about 15 minutes before returning because the rain got heavier. After getting home, she dried her hair, drank a cup of brown sugar ginger water, and began making breakfast.

events.name: Family and friends try the low-salt pickled vegetables
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan invited her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, neighbor Wang Guilan, and her mother Li Xiuying to her home to taste the "Low-Salt No. 1" that had been pickled for a day and a half. She put the pickled vegetables into small dishes and served them with steamed bun slices. Liu Chunmei praised the saltiness as just right and the texture crisp; Wang Guilan felt the flavor was undiminished; after tasting, her mother suggested adding a little rock sugar to neutralize the slight bitterness of sea salt, and contributed her treasured persimmon vinegar. Ma Xiulan noted everything down.

events.name: Shared the pickle-making progress on WeChat Moments.
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan put the newly pickled vegetables into carefully selected glass jars, took a photo with her phone, and posted it to Moments with the caption 'Low-salt new recipe, healthy and delicious'. Within an hour she had only three likes, and she felt a little disappointed.

events.name: Neighbor private-message purchase and mindset change
events.description: Soon, Wang Guilan commented on Moments, 'It looks really appetizing.' Zhang Shufen even sent a private message asking, 'Give me two bottles of the new recipe. How much?' Ma Xiulan replied, '10 yuan a bottle, neighbor price.' Zhang Shufen transferred the money immediately. Ma Xiulan put away her disappointment and realized that the real customers were right beside her. She simply changed her Moments permission from 'Visible for three days' to 'All', deciding to use it as a pickled vegetable diary.

start_state.mood: Apprehensive but positive

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Relieved and determined

2025-04.daily_overview: Went on a morning walk with a neighbor and was pleasantly surprised to notice and record the physical improvements from consistent exercise; during the day organized ideas for pickle packaging, and also had breakfast with Zhang Shufen, feeling relaxed.

events.name: Go for a walk with Zhang Shufen
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan and Zhang Shufen met at the street corner. The two walked along Jingwen Road to the street park and back, about 40 minutes round trip. During the walk, Ma Xiulan noticed that her complexion had improved and her morning dizziness was gone. Zhang Shufen also said she was at just the right weight. After returning home, she immediately wrote in her phone memo: "After a month of morning walks, my waist no longer aches and I feel energetic."

events.name: Having breakfast together
events.description: After their walk, Zhang Shufen invited Ma Xiulan to a street breakfast stall for soy milk and fried dough sticks. As they ate, they chatted about the supermarket business. Ma Xiulan mentioned she wanted to improve the packaging of her pickled vegetables. Zhang Shufen suggested using small glass jars with handwritten labels, and said her supermarket could sell this 'homemade' version on consignment.

events.name: Brainstorming packaging upgrades for pickled vegetables
events.description: After returning home in the morning, Ma Xiulan took out leftover embroidery fabric scraps and tried making cloth covers for the pickled vegetable jar lids, and also sketched out a label in a few strokes. She decided to use this packaging set on the day of the market, and added a homemade persimmon-shaped sachet as a free gift.

events.name: Checked the vegetable plot and prepared lessons in the evening.
events.description: In the afternoon, she went to the courtyard to check the sprouting of the scallions and spinach and watered them. In the evening, she reviewed the notes from the training course at the beginning of the month, focusing on the food hygiene chapter, to prepare herself with knowledge for the market sales.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road

2025-04.daily_overview: In the early morning, she prepared goods in the dark for the market, did a brief stretch before leaving, and with support from relatives and friends sold 13 jars of pickled vegetables, getting a first taste of success. But late at night, she had a fierce argument with her husband over savings, and her mood took a sharp turn for the worse.

events.name: Preparing goods in the early morning, with husband helping to transport them
events.description: Because the community handicraft market was finally held, Ma Xiulan got up at 4:50 a.m., packed 20 jars of pickled vegetables (including 8 jars of a new trial recipe), embroidered tablecloths, price signs, tasting dishes, and handmade sachets into the tricycle. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was woken by the noise and, without a word, helped push the tricycle to the market stall and put up the sun umbrella for her.

events.name: A brief stretch before heading to the market in the early morning
events.description: Before going out, Ma Xiulan remembered that she couldn't go for a brisk walk in the park today, so she did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches in the living room, telling herself that setting up the stall was also exercise and that today's step count would definitely not be low.

events.name: Made successful sales at the market stall.
events.description: In the morning, at first there were many onlookers but few buyers, and Ma Xiulan grew a little anxious. Her childhood friend Liu Chunmei took special leave from work to help her hawk the goods, and opened a jar of spicy pickled vegetables for free tasting, which quickly gathered a crowd. Zhou Xiuqin, the paper-cutting artist at the neighboring stall, also came over to help. The two agreed to share a stall and split the costs next time. She sold 13 jars in total (including 2 pre-ordered), earning 260 yuan. After packing up, she gave a small jar each to her parents and Wang Guilan along the way, thinking to herself that she should bring more spicy flavor next time.

events.name: Argued with her husband about the savings plan.
events.description: That evening, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang had a fierce argument in the living room over his proposal to suspend the education savings plan. Ma Xiulan insisted on the importance of saving for education, while her husband thought money was tight now and they should focus on immediate needs. The shouting frightened their second son Ma Mingzhe, who hid in his room, and their youngest daughter burst into tears. The couple parted on bad terms, and Ma Xiulan sat alone in the dark living room until the early morning before lying down fully dressed.

start_state.mood: Nervous and excited

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Tired and sad

2025-04.daily_overview: After lying awake until the early morning, she got up late. She had a calm communication with her husband via a long WeChat message and reached a consensus on minimum savings. In the afternoon, she turned over the soil and planted vegetables, and her daughter's innocent actions brought long-missed laughter, warming the family atmosphere.

events.name: Sent a long WeChat message in the early morning
events.description: Because she had hardly slept the night before, Ma Xiulan did not wake up groggily until the sun was high in the morning. Seeing the sky outside the window already bright, she realized that for the first time she had missed the morning exercise in the park, but she had no time to feel sorry, because there was a more important battle to fight. She drank a glass of warm water, sat in the bedroom, and sent a long WeChat message to her husband on her phone, first apologizing for her attitude the night before, then attaching a photo of her handwritten education expense forecast table, explaining that even if they saved only 100 yuan a month, they could save more than 10,000 yuan in ten years. What she suggested stopping was not saving money but her husband's cigarette spending.

events.name: The couple reconciled over the phone and reached a consensus.
events.description: In the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang called from a freight trip. His first words were, 'I was the one who got impatient. I'll smoke less.' The two calmly agreed that no matter how hard things got, they would save at least 100 yuan each month for education. The husband promised to keep his daily cigarette spending to 8 yuan. After hanging up, Ma Xiulan used a refrigerator magnet to stick a note reading 'Save at least 100 yuan per month for education' on the wall next to the dining table.

events.name: Turning the soil, sowing seeds, and playing with the youngest daughter
events.description: In the afternoon, to ease her mood, Ma Xiulan took out scallion and spinach seeds from the storage room, loosened about 2 square meters of soil in the east corner of the courtyard, sowed the seeds, covered them with soil, and watered them. Her little daughter Ma Yuxin excitedly carried a toy watering can to help, but stepped on and knocked several soil ridges askew. The daughter was startled and pouted, which amused Ma Xiulan instead. She picked up her daughter and taught her hand by hand to water slowly. In the afternoon sunshine, the mother and daughter's laughter rang clear.

start_state.mood: Tired but calm

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Reconciled and as warm as ever

2025-04.daily_overview: She proactively learned from neighbors how to set up a WeChat customer group. In the afternoon she recorded a video about pickled vegetables and successfully expanded her online sales channels. She also received the first inquiry about custom gift boxes, and her side-business operation officially moved toward digitalization.

events.name: Brisk walking in the neighborhood park in the early morning.
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Ma Xiulan resumed her early morning walk. She did 20 minutes of brisk walking, two laps, in the street park and breathed in the fresh air. On the way home, she stopped by Shufen's Convenience Store to buy soy milk and fried dough sticks to improve the children's breakfast. Zhang Shufen teased, "Good morning, Boss Ma!"

events.name: Ask Zhang Shufen for WeChat marketing tips
events.description: In the morning, she went to Zhang Shufen's shop and formally asked how to create group chats, post to Moments, and manage customers. Zhang Shufen demonstrated how to create a group chat, set a group announcement, and add pictures and videos, and also taught her to use a sign-up list to tally orders. The two of them immediately tried setting up a customer group called "Xiulan Handmade Pickled Vegetables."

events.name: Record a short video of making pickled vegetables and share it.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan used a phone stand in her kitchen to record a 2.5-minute video showing the pickling process and the gloss of the finished product, emphasizing 'low-salt, healthy, neighborhood recipe.' She then posted the video to her Moments and the 'Jingwen Road Parent-Child Exchange Group' with the message 'The best pickles at the market, now available for pre-order.'

events.name: Establish a customer group and record taste preferences
events.description: That evening, she added Liu Chunmei, Wang Guilan, Zhang Shufen, and a few customers she had connected with on WeChat at the market to the 'Xiulan Handmade Pickles' group and posted a group announcement previewing the new products. Then she took out her notebook and noted preferences such as 'Chunmei (mildly spicy), Aunt Wang (regular), Sister Zhang (slightly sour), Sister Zhao (no garlic).' A customer also sent a private message asking whether she could customize a birthday gift box, and she promised to reply the next day.

start_state.mood: High enthusiasm.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road
end_state.mood: Fulfilling and rewarding

2025-04.daily_overview: She carefully budgeted and completed this month's education savings deposit. After her husband's salary arrived in the evening, they allocated various expenses together. Late at night, she did a careful mid-month review of the family finances, and the total balance was 1,210 yuan. The sense of security eased the shadow of the earlier conflicts.

events.name: Squeeze 100 yuan out of the grocery money and put it into education savings.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan counted the week's remaining grocery money, took out 100 yuan and put it in an envelope, then walked to the Postal Savings Bank on Jingwen Road and deposited it into the education savings account at the counter. The teller, Sister Zhang, greeted her familiarly. After returning home, she neatly wrote down the deposit record in the "April 15" column of her account book, and calculated that at this rate she could save 2,400 yuan in two years. Although it was half of the original plan, she no longer felt anxious.

events.name: Husband's salary arrival and family fund allocation
events.description: In the evening, her husband received a text message about a salary of 5,800 yuan. Ma Xiulan and her husband used mobile banking in the living room: first they repaid 2,300 yuan of the mortgage, then transferred 200 yuan to her parents as support. Then she took out the account book, and the two of them planned and set aside 1,500 yuan for food, 300 yuan for school fees, 200 yuan for water, electricity and gas, 300 yuan for emergencies, and specially kept 100 yuan as the next month's market stall fee. Her husband laughed and said, "You're more meticulous than an accountant."

events.name: Mid-month family financial review.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan carefully checked the month's income and expenses. Up to the 15th, the family's total income was 6,340 yuan (husband 5,800 + pickle sales 260 + previous deposit interest, etc.), expenses were 5,130 yuan, leaving a surplus of 1,210 yuan. Satisfied, she closed the ledger and wrote on the next month's budget page: "Reserve 100 for market stall fee, 200 for father's check-up expenses." Finally, she added: "No matter how hard it gets, don't stop saving."

events.name: Courtyard walk and counting stars with my daughter.
events.description: Before bed, Ma Xiulan stood with her youngest daughter in the courtyard for a while. Her daughter pointed at the sky and said, 'Mom, the stars are moving.' She bent down, picked up her daughter, and watched the night sky for a moment, feeling calm inside. After settling the child down, she and her husband each soaked their feet and briefly talked about their eldest son's midterm exam date. They turned off the lights at exactly 23:00.

2025-04.daily_overview: After a pleasant morning walk with her neighbor Zhang Shufen, Ma Xiulan focused all her attention on beautifying the courtyard. In the morning she went to a flower-growing friend's home to get flower seeds, and used the income from pickles to buy rose and hydrangea seedlings online; then she turned the soil and mixed in fertilizer. In the afternoon, she planted the first batch of flowers and plants with her two children, and the courtyard immediately came to life.

events.name: Morning: walk with companions and check in.
events.description: At 6:35 in the morning, Ma Xiulan met her neighbor Zhang Shufen on Jingwen Road and they walked briskly along the road to the street park. She deliberately adjusted her gait to be lighter and steadier, and after returning home she conscientiously checked in on her phone notes app, recording how comfortable she felt today.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Before the walk, Ma Xiulan did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch in the living room at home, combined with deep breathing. She felt her shoulders and neck relax, and the movements had become as natural as breathing.

events.name: Visiting a community gardening friend and receiving flower seeds
events.description: After finishing her housework in the morning, Ma Xiulan walked to the home of a fellow gardening enthusiast in the same Jinghai District community to exchange ideas about garden planting plans. The friend warmly shared experience and gave her sunflower and impatiens seeds. She carefully put them away, planning to plant them that very day.

events.name: Online shopping for rose seedlings and hydrangeas.
events.description: After returning from a flower-enthusiast friend's home, Ma Xiulan used the income she had saved from previous handcraft odd jobs and pickled vegetables to buy rose seedlings and hydrangeas online through her phone. She carefully compared the seedling quality reviews and, after placing the order, eagerly looked forward to the express delivery arriving soon.

events.name: Loosened the garden soil and mixed in compost
events.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan marked out a flower bed against the courtyard wall, used a spade to deeply till the compacted soil, evenly mixed in the kitchen waste compost she had asked for at the vegetable market, and turned it into soft, fertile bed soil for sowing seeds and transplanting flower seedlings.

events.name: Parent-child collaboration to plant the first batch of flowers
events.description: After leveling the soil, Ma Xiulan called her second son Ma Mingzhe and younger daughter Ma Yuxin. Ma Mingzhe used a small shovel to dig shallow pits, Ma Yuxin carefully sprinkled sunflower and balsam seeds into the pits, and Ma Xiulan then covered them with fine soil and gave them a good watering. The first family flower planting was completed amidst laughter, and a corner of the courtyard has since held the promise of flower sprouts.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan completed a 5-minute deep breathing exercise by the bedside in her bedroom, inhaling through her nose and exhaling through her mouth, reviewing the joy of planting flowers during the day, feeling calm and fulfilled.

start_state.mood: Energetic and looking forward to the new day.

end_state.mood: Content, watching the child laugh happily despite the mud on his hands

2025-04.daily_overview: Zhang Shufen had something come up and could not do morning exercise, so Ma Xiulan completed the walk alone and felt fulfilled by persisting independently. During the day she was busy doing seasonal laundry and tidying the courtyard. In the evening, when she picked up her younger daughter, she also brought fresh vegetables along the way.

events.name: Solo morning walk and check-in reflection
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Zhang Shufen was absent because of a family emergency, so Ma Xiulan walked alone along Jingwen Road to the street park. As she walked, she observed the new leaves on the locust trees by the roadside. After returning home, she opened her memo as usual to check in and wrote in the remarks: 'Today alone, my heart is calmer; persistence is progress.'

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Before the walk, as usual, she did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching. The weather was slightly cool today, and after stretching, her neck and shoulders felt comfortable.

events.name: Washing winter clothes and airing quilts and bedding
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan took advantage of the warmer weather and put the family's heavy coats and bedsheets into the washing machine in batches. The clothesline was soon full of bedding. She beat the quilts in the sunlight, feeling like the whole home was breathing with the change of seasons.

events.name: Tidy up the courtyard flower beds and check how the sprouts are doing.
events.description: During the afternoon free time, Ma Xiulan went to the courtyard to check on the flower seeds she had planted the day before. She pulled out a few weeds that had just sprouted, used a watering can to moisten the surface soil, and noticed that the impatiens seeds were already a bit swollen; she was secretly delighted.

events.name: Pick up the youngest daughter from school and shop at the vegetable market
events.description: In the evening, after kindergarten let out, Ma Xiulan took Ma Yuxin by the hand and turned into Xingwang Vegetable Market. At Sun Guifang’s stall she bought green peppers, potatoes, and a bunch of scallions. Auntie Sun rounded off the odd change and said she had been looking much better lately.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan did five minutes of deep breathing in the bedroom. Feeling content from her solitary walk, she was calm and soon fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Slightly disappointed but soon perked up

end_state.mood: Calm, reflecting on the sense of accomplishment from the solo walk.

2025-04.daily_overview: Ma Xiulan was busy early in the morning preparing for her father's follow-up checkup, and then accompanied him throughout the medical visit. Dr. Wang Jianguo's affirmation and dietary advice made her more determined to follow a low-salt diet. In the evening, she shared the benefits of walking with the whole family, planting the seed of exercising together.

events.name: Morning walk and check-in with Zhang Shufen.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan met Zhang Shufen at the appointed place on Jingwen Road, and the two walked briskly to the street park. Today her steps were steadier and she was hardly out of breath. After returning home, she immediately opened her memo app to record how she felt.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Stretched for 5 minutes before the walk. Because she was worried about her father's follow-up checkup, she moved a little faster, but she still completed it.

events.name: Organize father's medical records and remind him to fast
events.description: After going home and washing up briefly, Ma Xiulan found her father Ma Jianguo's medical records and recent self-measured blood pressure records, and neatly placed them in a document folder. She called to remind her father not to eat breakfast and to bring his medical insurance card, her tone full of concern.

events.name: Accompanying father to the community health service center for a follow-up checkup
events.description: At 7:30, Ma Xiulan set out from home with her father and walked to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center. She supported her father along the way. Only when he saw the sign for the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center in the distance did his expression relax. After registering, she kept comforting him softly in the waiting area.

events.name: Doctor Wang Jianguo measured blood pressure and affirmed the control effect
events.description: In the examination room, Dr. Wang Jianguo measured Ma Jianguo's blood pressure: 138/85 mmHg, steadily lower than at discharge. The doctor nodded with satisfaction and praised Ma Xiulan for proper home monitoring and excellent low-salt diet control.

events.name: Consulting on dietary recommendations for summer blood pressure management
events.description: Ma Xiulan seized the opportunity to ask her father for dietary advice on managing blood pressure in summer. Dr. Wang advised eating more potassium-rich vegetables such as celery and winter melon, and eating less salted vegetables and pickled vegetables. She carefully noted the key points and said she would try to make the family's pickled vegetables in a low-salt version.

events.name: Return home to record the doctor's advice and plan low-salt pickled vegetables.
events.description: After returning home from the follow-up visit, Ma Xiulan copied Doctor Wang's dietary advice in detail into the family health memo notebook. Sitting on a small stool in the kitchen, she thought about how to use vinegar and fresh spices to replace some of the soy sauce and salt, determined to try low-salt pickles soon.

events.name: Share the benefits of walking at dinner and encourage the whole family to exercise.
events.description: During dinner, Ma Xiulan told her husband Ma Zhiqiang and their three children that after sticking with walking, her complexion had improved, her bowel movements were regular, and her dizziness had disappeared. She smiled and suggested that the whole family do activities together on the weekend. Her husband did not agree immediately, but he put down his chopsticks and listened carefully.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: In the evening, because her father's follow-up examination went smoothly, Ma Xiulan was in a good mood. The 5-minute deep breathing was completed quickly, and she grew sleepy.

start_state.mood: Awake, thinking about her father's follow-up checkup

end_state.mood: Gratified; father's health is stable, and family members are beginning to accept the concept of exercise

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 30 minutes, neck-and-shoulder stretches for 5 minutes, accompanied father on foot to and from the clinic, and 5 minutes of deep breathing before bed.
