2025-04.daily_overview: On a weekend morning, Ma Xiulan finally persuaded her husband to go for a walk together. Although he only walked half the way, the two of them agreed to do morning exercise together again next week. During the day she did some housework, and in the afternoon she talked with her younger sister on the phone.

events.name: Husband joined the morning walk for the first time.
events.description: At 6:20 in the morning, Ma Xiulan gently woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and said with a smile, "You promised to go for a walk with me." Ma Zhiqiang rubbed his eyes and walked along Jingwen Road with her for a while, but halfway he waved his hand and said, "Too sleepy," then turned back to catch up on sleep. Ma Xiulan was not angry and briskly walked the rest of the way alone, a smile on her lips.

events.name: Check in as usual after the walk and agree to walk again on Saturday
events.description: Back home, Ma Xiulan opened her memo app to check in and wrote, 'Zhiqiang accompanied me for half the route today. It's a good start. We agreed to walk together again next Saturday.' She put her phone on the table, feeling that this agreement made her happier than the step count.

events.name: Wash the embroidered tablecloth for the trade fair
events.description: While doing laundry in the morning, Ma Xiulan took out the embroidered tablecloth she planned to bring to the trade fair to check it. Finding some creases at the corners, she gently hand-rinsed it and hung it in a shady place. Thinking about how the table would look at the fair, she added a few stitches to reinforce the hem.

events.name: Had a casual phone chat with younger sister Ma Xiufen
events.description: In the afternoon, her younger sister Ma Xiufen called via WeChat, and the two chatted for half an hour. Xiufen said there were many discounts at malls in Binhai New Area recently and she wanted to buy summer clothes for her nephews; Ma Xiulan told her about growing flowers and making pickled vegetables. The sisters agreed to meet around May Day.

events.name: Shelter the courtyard flower seedlings from rain
events.description: In the evening, a few drops of rain fell. Ma Xiulan quickly used an old plastic sheet to set up a simple rain shelter over the newly sprouted flower bed. She squatted beside it for a while, and only after confirming that the rain would not wash away the flower seeds did she go back inside with peace of mind.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: In the evening, because of the novelty of her husband accompanying her on a walk, Ma Xiulan did 5 minutes of deep breathing with him. Although her husband was perfunctory, it was still progress, and she was secretly pleased.

start_state.mood: Full of anticipation, wanting to share the early morning with her husband.

end_state.mood: Relaxed. Her husband's involvement was limited, but it was a good start.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 30 minutes (husband accompanied her for the first half), 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, 5 minutes of deep breathing before bed

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with a gentle spring breeze.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Ma Xiulan finished her walk alone, and in her heart she had already come to regard this activity as a daily ritual. In the morning she took the three children to the neighborhood park, and in the afternoon she received a long-distance call from her elder sister. The day passed peacefully and fully.

events.name: Take a solo morning walk and deepen the check-in ritual
events.description: Early Sunday morning, Ma Xiulan left the house on time at 6:20, walking briskly along Jingwen Road to the central park. She no longer needed to adjust her pace deliberately; her body had adapted to this rhythm. When she checked in after returning, she wrote in her memo: "A walk has become the key to starting the day."

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: After stretching before bed, she felt her shoulders and neck were flexible, and she also kept up a 5-minute stretch before today's walk.

events.name: Take the children to the street park to play.
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan told the three children to set aside their homework and walk together to the street-side park. Ma Mingxuan practiced shooting hoops with a basketball, Ma Mingzhe chased and played with classmates, and Ma Yuxin made a castle in the sandpit. Ma Xiulan sat on a bench watching, occasionally using her phone to capture a few smiling faces.

events.name: Talked on the phone with older sister Li Xiuyun about how things have been.
events.description: At a little past three in the afternoon, her elder sister Li Xiuyun called from Beijing, and the two sisters chatted for nearly an hour. Xiuyun said she wanted to bring their parents to Beijing for a while during summer vacation, and Ma Xiulan immediately expressed support. The topic turned to the children's studies, and Xiuyun gave some advice.

events.name: Air-drying and folding seasonal clothes.
events.description: Taking advantage of the sunny Sunday, Ma Xiulan took down all the thick coats washed a few days earlier, folded them neatly, and placed them in the corresponding sections of each family member's wardrobe. Then she took out the summer thin shirts and spread them on the bed, thinking about which ones needed mending.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: Ma Xiulan took deep breaths for 5 minutes before bed, deliberately recalled the children's smiling faces, and fell asleep peacefully.

start_state.mood: Calm and resolute; walking has become a habit.

end_state.mood: Warm, pleasant time with the children, and the phone call with her elder sister was also heartwarming

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk 30 minutes, neck and shoulder stretches 5 minutes, deep breathing 5 minutes before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with a brief clear spell in the afternoon.

2025-04.daily_overview: Monday returned to routine. After an early morning walk with Zhang Shufen, Ma Xiulan reviewed the week's progress, then cleaned winter supplies. In the afternoon, she went to the community supermarket and heard about a sales fair, feeling motivated for the new week.

events.name: Walk together and review this week's exercise progress.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, while walking with Zhang Shufen, Ma Xiulan counted off on her fingers and reviewed the week: her complexion had clearly improved, her bowel movements were regular, and her husband participated for the first time. Her voice was full of pride, and Zhang Shufen was also inspired, saying she would keep going.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: The 5-minute stretch was as usual; Ma Xiulan felt her shoulders and neck were supple, and her mood was even better.

events.name: Organize the storage room and wash winter cotton shoes.
events.description: While doing housework in the morning, Ma Xiulan opened the storage room, took out the family's cotton shoes, scrubbed them, and hung them out to dry. As she washed, she thought that next winter the children's feet would grow another size, and these shoes would probably have to be given away. She couldn't help sighing at how fast time flies.

events.name: Go shopping and chat at Zhang Shufen's small supermarket
events.description: In the afternoon, when going out to buy groceries, Ma Xiulan stopped by Zhang Shufen's small supermarket. She bought salt, vinegar, and other seasonings. Zhang Shufen told her that the Jinghai District Spring Agricultural Products Fair would be held at the stadium next week and urged her to sign up quickly. Ma Xiulan's eyes lit up and she immediately said she would seize the opportunity.

events.name: Help younger daughter learn characters and read picture books.
events.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan gave Ma Yuxin a bath and sat with her at the small table to read pinyin flashcards. Whenever she read well, the little girl giggled. Ma Xiulan held her close and read "Guess How Much I Love You" before coaxing her to sleep.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: Excited about the news of the trade fair, Ma Xiulan took deep breaths for five minutes before bed to force herself to calm down, and planned the details for participating in the exhibition at the same time.

start_state.mood: Energetic and ready for the new week

end_state.mood: Satisfied and excited about the trade fair opportunity

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk 30 minutes, neck and shoulder stretches 5 minutes, deep breathing 5 minutes before bed.

2025-04.daily_overview: In the morning, Ma Xiulan finished her housework. In the afternoon, she attended the canal history lecture at the library before her daughter got out of school and was completely absorbed. In the evening, she excitedly told the family about the lecture, and the whole family had a lively discussion about old hometown memories.

events.name: Morning housework and preparing ingredients for lunch
events.description: After her morning walk, Ma Xiulan finished cleaning, took the pork belly she bought yesterday out of the fridge to thaw, and peeled and soaked the potatoes. She mentally planned her schedule: she needed to go to the library in the afternoon, so lunch had to be prepared early.

events.name: Walked to the district library to attend the Grand Canal lecture.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Ma Xiulan estimated the time well and walked from home to the Jinghai District Library. On the way, she remembered the canal tracking chants her grandfather told her when she was little, and walked briskly, looking forward to hearing more little-known stories.

events.name: Listening to the public lecture 'The Canal Stories of Jinghai'
events.description: In the second-floor lecture hall, a retired old teacher spoke in authentic Jinghai dialect about the changes of the Grand Canal in Jinghai. Ma Xiulan heard for the first time that Duliu Old Wharf and Jingwen Road had once been an ancient post road. The old grandmother sitting next to her with her grandson also softly echoed the old scenes, and the two nodded repeatedly.

events.name: Borrow a book on Tianjin folk customs and thank the librarian
events.description: After the lecture, Ma Xiulan went downstairs to the borrowing area and borrowed a copy of “The Folk Customs of Tianjin Wei” with her ID card. She told the librarian that events like this help Jinghai people better understand their hometown and hoped more would be held. The librarian smiled and told her to follow the official account.

events.name: Sharing canal stories at dinner sparked a family discussion
events.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan finished cooking the dishes and set them on the table, then eagerly told the stories she had just heard about the ancient wharf and post road. The three children stopped their chopsticks to listen, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang also added the old wharf legends he had heard. As everyone chimed in at the dinner table, Ma Xiulan felt her roots growing deeper.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: In the evening, the couple did 5 minutes of deep breathing together. Ma Zhiqiang also listened with great interest today, and after a brief exchange, the two fell asleep peacefully.

start_state.mood: Curious; looking forward to the afternoon talk.

end_state.mood: Excited, gained a new understanding of hometown history, and felt a warm family atmosphere

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk 30 minutes, neck and shoulder stretch 5 minutes, walking to and from the library, deep breathing 5 minutes before bed.

2025-04.daily_overview: In the evening, a phone call from the homeroom teacher brought good news and threw the whole family into jubilation: the second son had made significant progress in math. Ma Xiulan took her son to the vegetable market to buy meat, went home and cooked his favorite dishes, and the family celebrated this hard-won effort with laughter.

events.name: Morning walk and discussing children's education with Zhang Shufen.
events.description: During morning exercise, Ma Xiulan and Zhang Shufen talked about the children's midterm exams. Zhang Shufen said her granddaughter did well in English, while Ma Xiulan was a bit worried about her second son's math. She thought to herself that the results should be out, and on the way home she felt uneasy.

events.name: Answered the class teacher's phone call with good news.
events.description: A little after 5 p.m., Ma Xiulan was cutting vegetables in the kitchen when her phone rang. It was Yang Jianguo, the homeroom teacher of her second son, Ma Mingzhe. The teacher sounded gratified, saying Ma Mingzhe's midterm math score had improved by 15 points and his class participation had become much more active. Ma Xiulan thanked him repeatedly, and after hanging up, her eyes were a little moist.

events.name: Took the second son to the vegetable market and praised him along the way
events.description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Xiulan grabbed Ma Mingzhe's hand and headed straight to the vegetable market. On the way, she put her arm around the child's shoulder and praised him, "You've really grown up, and you earned it through your own efforts." For once, her second son didn't avoid it and whispered, "I want to make Mom happy."

events.name: Bought celebration ingredients at Xingwang Vegetable Market.
events.description: Mother and daughter came to Sun Guifang's familiar stall. Ma Xiulan specially bought pork belly, potatoes, and tomatoes, saying she would make the children's favorite braised pork and tomato salad with sugar. Aunt Sun, hearing it was to celebrate grades, gave two extra small cucumbers.

events.name: Carefully cooking braised pork and tomato slices with sugar.
events.description: Back home, Ma Xiulan deftly put the braised pork on to stew and asked her second son to help peel garlic and wash tomatoes. Her younger daughter Ma Yuxin dragged a small stool over to the kitchen door and peered in, now asking, “Mom, when will it be ready to eat?” and now helping to hand over the sugar jar.

events.name: The whole family had a meal together to celebrate the second son.
events.description: At dinner, her husband Ma Zhiqiang made an exception and put two large pieces of braised pork into the second son's bowl, saying, 'That's how it should be—work hard and you'll get good food.' The youngest daughter joined in clamoring for some too, and the elder brother Ma Mingxuan even cracked a rare smile. Watching everyone at the table, Ma Xiulan felt warmer inside than the fragrant meat.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: Because she had eaten a few extra pieces of meat during the celebration, Ma Xiulan took deep breaths for 5 minutes before bed to help digestion, and felt especially pleased by her son's progress.

start_state.mood: Faintly worrying about her son's grades

end_state.mood: Extremely gratified, family cohesion further strengthened

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk 30 minutes, neck and shoulder stretches 5 minutes, deep breathing 5 minutes before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning partly cloudy, with light fog in the morning

2025-04.daily_overview: The preparations for the trade fair proceeded methodically. After her morning walk, Ma Xiulan started pickling and packing the last batch of pickled vegetables. In the afternoon she went to Zheng Xiuying's home to settle the stall details, and in the evening she checked the checklist, making full preparations for Saturday's trade fair.

events.name: Morning walk and brief conversation with Zhang Shufen
events.description: In the early morning, with the fog not yet lifted, Ma Xiulan and Zhang Shufen slowed their pace and walked along Jingwen Road to the street park. Zhang Shufen asked about the trade fair preparations. Ma Xiulan said they were almost ready, and the two agreed to meet at the trade fair on Saturday.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: After today's shoulder and neck stretching, Ma Xiulan deliberately rotated her right wrist to prevent strain from making pickled vegetables.

events.name: Make the last batch of low-salt pickled vegetables and label them
events.description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and in the kitchen put the cut radishes and cucumbers into jars. Following the new recipe, she reduced the soy sauce and added more white vinegar and Sichuan peppercorns. As she packed the jars, she wrote labels by hand in neat characters: "Xiulan Low-Salt Pickles, net weight 500g".

events.name: Inspect and secure the goods for the exhibition
events.description: After finishing work, Ma Xiulan checked the jars of pickled vegetables she had packed earlier and found that one jar was not sealed tightly. She immediately resealed it, making sure the lid was airtight. She packed all 30 jars of pickled vegetables into two heavy-duty shopping bags, and separately wrapped the embroidered tablecloth, afraid of creasing the embroidery.

events.name: Went to Zheng Xiuying's home to confirm the trade fair registration.
events.description: At three in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan took a small jar of pickled vegetables to Zheng Xiuying's home. Sister Zheng brought out the booth assignment sheet for the trade fair and told her that her booth number was A12, right next to the entrance. Ma Xiulan felt relieved and thanked her again and again.

events.name: Discussed the division of labor for the day of the trade fair with her husband.
events.description: After the children went to bed in the evening, Ma Xiulan told Ma Zhiqiang that she needed him to help transport goods early on Saturday for the sales fair, then come back to take care of the children's lunch. Her husband nodded and said he would just take half a day off. Ma Xiulan felt grateful and began planning what to say when selling that day.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: Taking five minutes of deep breathing before bed, Ma Xiulan silently rehearsed the sales pitch for the trade fair and fell asleep with anticipation.

start_state.mood: Awake, planning things to accomplish today

end_state.mood: Nervous but excited, everything is ready and just waiting for the trade fair.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 25 minutes, shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes, and deep breathing for 5 minutes before sleep.

2025-04.daily_overview: While tending the courtyard in the early morning, she was delighted to find that the sunflowers and impatiens had quietly begun to bloom. Ma Xiulan hurriedly fetched her camera to record the moment and excitedly shared it with relatives and friends. In the evening, she did a final check of the items for the exhibition sale, even folding the embroidered tablecloths neatly.

events.name: Photograph the courtyard flowers just beginning to bloom after a morning walk.
events.description: Just as she stepped out of the house for a walk, Ma Xiulan noticed that the sunflowers in the corner, which had still been buds yesterday, had opened their petals, and the impatiens had also put out a tiny bit of purplish red. Surprised and delighted, she crouched down and watched for a while; when she returned from the walk, she immediately took out an old digital camera from the cabinet.

events.name: Using an old camera to photograph spring scenery in the courtyard.
events.description: Ma Xiulan walked around the courtyard holding her camera and took more than twenty photos of the sunflowers, balsam flowers, the tender green new leaves of the persimmon tree, and the whole flower bed. In the viewfinder, the courtyard looked full of life, and she thought to herself that these could all be made into a family wall calendar.

events.name: Selecting photos and sharing them in the family WeChat group
events.description: Back in the house, Ma Xiulan picked out the nine most satisfying flower close-ups and courtyard panoramas on the camera screen, took photos of them again with her phone, and sent them to the family WeChat group with the message, “Our little courtyard is blooming!” Soon relatives and friends gave likes one after another, and her sister commented, “So much prettier than my balcony.” She smiled and replied to each one.

events.name: Save to the computer and archive the photos.
events.description: Ma Xiulan connected the camera to her computer, imported all the photos into the “2025” folder, and created a new subfolder called “April Courtyard Flowers.” She thought that at the end of the year she would pick the best twelve and print a family wall calendar, so that every day would be accompanied by flowers.

events.name: Completed final registration for the trade fair by phone
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan received a phone call from Zheng Xiuying confirming that the booth for the trade fair had been approved. Based on the information she had previously filled in, she verified the details with the organizer over the phone and completed the final registration.

events.name: Counting and packing all the items for the sales exhibition.
events.description: Before dinner, Ma Xiulan did a final check in the living room: 15 jars of low-salt pickled vegetables, 15 jars of wild vegetable pickles, 1 embroidered tablecloth, 1 change box, and several small tasting dishes. She carefully packed everything into two large shopping bags and placed them by the door, making sure she could pick them up and leave first thing in the morning.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: In the evening, excited about the upcoming sales expo, Ma Xiulan did deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed, deliberately slowing down her pace to ensure adequate sleep.

start_state.mood: Surprise, elated because the flowers bloomed

end_state.mood: Excited and steady, all is ready for the trade fair

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk 30 minutes, neck and shoulder stretches 5 minutes, deep breathing 5 minutes before bed.

2025-04.daily_overview: Before dawn, Ma Xiulan had her husband accompany her on a walk, then headed straight to the trade fair with two large bags full of goods. All day she smiled and greeted customers, sold most of the pickled vegetables, and even received expressions of interest from three supermarkets to stock her products. On the way home, her steps felt light.

events.name: Walked the entire route with her husband in the morning and reached an exercise agreement
events.description: At 6:15 on Saturday morning, Ma Xiulan persuaded her husband Ma Zhiqiang to get up. The two walked the full route from Jingwen Road to the street-corner park and then back. Along the way, Ma Xiulan said, 'A walk like this does your spirits more good than sleeping an extra hour.' Ma Zhiqiang took a deep breath and promised that starting next month he would walk with her once every weekend.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Before the trade fair, Ma Xiulan still insisted on 5 minutes of stretching to prevent strain from standing for a long time.

events.name: Husband helped transport goods to the trade fair venue.
events.description: At 7:30, Ma Zhiqiang tied two heavy shopping bags to the back of his bicycle and walked the bike with Ma Xiulan to the district stadium. At stall A12, he helped his wife spread the tablecloth and arrange the pickle jars before hurrying home to look after the children.

events.name: At the exhibition, warmly solicited customers and sold 28 jars of pickled vegetables.
events.description: Ma Xiulan spread the embroidered tablecloth on the table and arranged the pickle jars in two rows by flavor. She cut up a small plate of pickles for people to taste and introduced them in an authentic Jinghai accent: 'The low-salt ones are safe for the elderly and children, and the wild-vegetable pickles are made of shepherd's purse, crisp and refreshing!' By the end of the day, all 28 jars were snapped up, earning 560 yuan.

events.name: Received supply interest from three community supermarkets
events.description: During a lull in business, three purchasing representatives from community supermarkets came over to taste the pickles and left their phone numbers, saying they wanted to stock them regularly. Ma Xiulan carefully noted down the information and thanked them repeatedly. She felt that her pickled vegetables being sold in supermarkets was something she would never have dared to imagine before.

events.name: A staff member from the district agricultural committee suggested applying for a specialty product label.
events.description: Near the end of the stall, a man wearing a work badge came over and tasted the pickled vegetables. He said he was from the district agriculture committee and suggested Ma Xiulan apply for the 'Jinghai Specialty Agricultural Products' label. Ma Xiulan quickly noted down key words of the application process, her heart burning with even greater hope.

events.name: After packing up the stall in the evening, shared the good news with family
events.description: When she got home in the evening, Ma Xiulan put the box full of loose change on the table and excitedly told her husband and children about what she had earned that day. Ma Zhiqiang, for once, said, 'You've worked hard,' and her little daughter played beside them counting coins. The whole home was bathed in joy.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: Because her calves were sore from standing too long, Ma Xiulan did 5 minutes of deep breathing before bed and applied a warm compress to her calves. Her husband took the initiative to help massage them, and she felt especially warm inside.

start_state.mood: Nervous and excited at the same time, determined to make the trade fair a success.

end_state.mood: Extremely encouraged, seeing greater possibilities for the pickled vegetable business.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 30 minutes (with husband all the way), shoulder and neck stretching for 5 minutes, standing customer service at the sales fair, and deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, turning overcast in the afternoon with scattered light rain

2025-04.daily_overview: The day after the trade fair, Ma Xiulan followed up on contacts while taking advantage of the cloudy day to apply spring fertilizer to the persimmon tree. Her second son participated in watering and observing the whole time, and the mother and son chatted for a while under the tree about how things grow.

events.name: Trade fair follow-up: call three community supermarkets.
events.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan took out the phone numbers she had written down yesterday and called the three purchasing representatives one by one. She briefly introduced the varieties of pickled vegetables and her supply capacity. All of them said they were willing to have further face-to-face discussions, and she arranged to visit their shops separately next week for detailed talks.

events.name: Search online and call the Agriculture Committee to inquire about the label application
events.description: After the call, Ma Xiulan searched on her phone for the Jinghai District Agriculture Committee's official account and found the public phone number. She called and carefully asked what materials were needed to apply for "Jinghai Specialty Agricultural Products". The other party asked her to prepare product descriptions, business certificates, and photos, and she wrote them down one by one in her notebook.

events.name: Take out the matured soybean cake fertilizer and prepare tools
events.description: In the afternoon, before the rain came, Ma Xiulan carried out the fermented soybean cake fertilizer from the utility room and found a spade, a small shovel, and a bucket. Thinking that the persimmon tree needed its spring fertilizer, she set about the work.

events.name: Digging a trench around the persimmon tree and applying soybean cake fertilizer.
events.description: Ma Xiulan used a shovel to dig a shallow trench around the roots of the persimmon tree, evenly scattered dark brown soybean cake fertilizer into it, then carefully covered it with soil and tamped it down. As the smell of fertilizer mixed with earth spread, she seemed to see the branches laden with persimmons in autumn.

events.name: Her second son volunteered to water the plants and observe the tender leaves.
events.description: As soon as the soil was leveled, her second son Ma Mingzhe came over carrying a bucket and said, “I’ll water it.” He slowly watered it thoroughly, then stared at the newly sprouted leaves and called out, “Mom, the trunk looks a bit thicker!” Ma Xiulan smiled and taught him to distinguish the terminal bud from the lateral buds, and the mother and son spent a long time gesturing and discussing under the tree.

events.name: Took a photo of fertilizing and sent it to her husband, and received a warm reply.
events.description: Ma Xiulan used her phone to take a photo from behind of her and her son squatting under a tree, and sent it to her husband, who was working away from home, via WeChat. Before long, Ma Zhiqiang replied, 'Hard work!' Those three short words made Ma Xiulan feel that no matter how tired she was, it was worth it.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: She did deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed. Because her lower back was slightly sore from the fertilizing work, she did a few cat stretches and gradually relaxed.

start_state.mood: Languid, with lingering echoes of the trade fair

end_state.mood: Peaceful and fulfilling; both the trees and the children are growing.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk for 20 minutes (shortened due to rain), shoulder and neck stretches for 5 minutes, fertilizing and watering manual work, and deep breathing for 5 minutes before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with a slight drop in temperature.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Monday, Ma Xiulan struck while the iron was hot. She visited two community supermarkets with pickled vegetable samples and initially finalized a consignment arrangement. In the afternoon she calculated the costs for the trade fair, and in the evening she worked out future profits in the family ledger.

events.name: Morning walk and sharing the trade fair results with Zhang Shufen
events.description: In the early morning, while taking a walk, Ma Xiulan described in detail the grand scene of the trade fair and her intention to supply goods to Zhang Shufen. Zhang Shufen was happy for her and suggested she strike while the iron was hot and go talk immediately. Ma Xiulan nodded and decided to take action today.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: After stretching, she moved her wrists to get her body ready for going out to negotiate.

events.name: Visited the first community supermarket to discuss supply
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ma Xiulan carried two jars of pickled vegetables into a community supermarket on Jingwen Road. After tasting them, the store manager thought the flavor was good and agreed to sell 10 jars on consignment first, with payment settled after they were sold. Ma Xiulan carefully noted the date the items were put on the shelf and the profit-sharing ratio.

events.name: Visit the second supermarket and reach a restocking agreement.
events.description: Then she rode her electric bike to another slightly farther supermarket. The purchasing lady was very straightforward and immediately agreed to a fixed monthly supply of 12 jars, settled at the end of each month. Ma Xiulan was delighted but also reminded herself to make sure the quality remained guaranteed.

events.name: Calculate the costs and profits of the trade fair
events.description: Back home in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan took out her account book and listed the income of 560 yuan from the exhibition, material costs of about 190 yuan, and the income from the earlier market separately. She calculated that the gross profit from pickled vegetables in April was already nearly 700 yuan. She drew a smiley face after it with a red pen.

events.name: Pick up the children from school and supervise their homework.
events.description: After picking up the three children in the evening, Ma Xiulan first checked the eldest son's homework, then watched over the second son as he corrected his math mistakes. The youngest daughter drew pictures nearby, drawing her mother selling pickled vegetables at the fair, which made the whole family laugh.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: Because of a day of rushing around, Ma Xiulan took deep breaths for 5 minutes before bed, while mentally planning the May delivery routes, and soon fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Full of energy and eager to push the cooperation forward quickly.

end_state.location: By the desk in the living room.
end_state.mood: Satisfied; the pickled vegetable business is on track.

state.daily_exercise: Morning walk 30 minutes, neck and shoulder stretches 5 minutes, deep breathing 5 minutes before bed.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, windy in the evening

2025-04.daily_overview: In the morning, Ma Xiulan made a trip to the Agricultural Committee to submit materials. In the afternoon, she rushed to make a new batch of pickled vegetables to keep in stock. In the evening, she also asked her mother for advice on new flavors. Near the end of the month, her time was completely filled with pickled vegetables and family.

events.name: Went to the District Agriculture Committee to submit application materials for the specialty product label
events.description: Following the checklist she got over the phone, Ma Xiulan brought all the product descriptions, business certificates, and trade fair photos, and rode her e-bike to the Agricultural Committee of Jinghai District. The staff accepted the application and told her to wait for notification. She felt one step closer to being legitimate.

events.name: Buying fresh vegetables for the ingredients of a new batch of pickled vegetables
events.description: After leaving the Agricultural Committee, she stopped by the vegetable market on the way and ordered twenty jin of white radish and ten jin of cucumbers from Sun Guifang. Aunt Sun heard that her business was doing well, voluntarily gave her wholesale prices, and promised to deliver the goods to her door tomorrow morning.

events.name: In the afternoon, she rushed to make a batch of low-salt pickled vegetables and wild vegetable pickles.
events.description: Aunt Sun's vegetables were delivered in the morning. Ma Xiulan washed, cut, and packed them into jars, making fifteen jars of pickled vegetables in one go. She strictly followed the low-salt recipe, weighed each jar, affixed labels, and stacked them neatly in a cool place.

events.name: Called her mother to ask for ideas for new flavors.
events.description: After finishing the pickled vegetables, Ma Xiulan called her mother and mentioned she wanted to develop a soy-pickled radish flavored with Sichuan peppercorns. Her mother carefully taught her the ratio of Sichuan peppercorns to salt over the phone, and said to briefly fry the peppercorns in hot oil first to make them more aromatic. Ma Xiulan listened and took notes, planning to try it next month.

events.name: In the evening, organize household expenses and prepare for tomorrow’s inventory
events.description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan spread open the ledger and jotted down the income and expenses of the past few days, including grocery money, packaging material costs, and transportation fares. She took out a calculator and made an estimate, looking forward to the formal end-of-month inventory with a bright mood.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed

2025-04.daily_overview: On the last day of April, Ma Xiulan started with a morning walk and ended with checking the accounts late at night. She was pleasantly surprised to find that walking had brought her average daily step count to 8,000, the pickled vegetable income was satisfactory, and the family balance of 1,770 yuan was within reach. After making the May plan, she fell asleep peacefully with a sense of security.

events.name: The last early-morning walk of this month and exchange of reflections.
events.description: At 6:40 in the morning, Ma Xiulan and Zhang Shufen met on Jingwen Road; on the last day their steps were especially light. On the way home, they shared with each other the changes of the past month: better complexion, slimmer waist. Ma Xiulan also told Zhang Shufen that her husband had started joining in as well. They agreed to continue in May, rain or shine.

events.name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Completed a 5-minute stretch before the walk; now the shoulders and neck are completely free of stiffness, and the movements are standard.

events.name: After taking her youngest daughter to kindergarten, she went home to do a thorough cleaning.
events.description: After the walk and seeing the children off, Ma Xiulan took advantage of the end of the month to give the house a thorough cleaning: wiping windows, mopping floors, washing sheets, and even taking down the kitchen exhaust fan to scrub it. She wanted to welcome May Day with a clean home, and it was also a tidy end to the month.

events.name: Do the April family financial review in the evening
events.description: After the children were lulled to sleep, Ma Xiulan sat down at the dining table and opened the thick ledger and a ballpoint pen. She checked item by item: her husband's salary was 5,800 yuan, pickled vegetable income totaled 920 yuan (including 560 yuan from the trade fair and 360 yuan from the market and consignment), and embroidery odd jobs brought in 200 yuan; on the expense side, the mortgage was 2,300 yuan, food costs 1,480 yuan, and so on, totaling 5,150 yuan. After pressing the calculator, this month's surplus was 1,770 yuan, and she neatly copied it into the monthly summary column.

events.name: Made a family budget and side-job plan for May
events.description: Right after that, Ma Xiulan wrote the May plan at the bottom of the ledger: continue saving 100 yuan for education, set a monthly income target of 500 yuan from pickled vegetable sales, and meanwhile try to take on more embroidery side jobs. She put down the pen and felt a genuine sense of relief; all the setbacks of this month had turned into progress in numbers.

events.name: Check the pedometer to review this month's exercise results
events.description: Closing the account book, Ma Xiulan opened the step-counting app on her phone, and the step chart for the entire month of April came into view: the average daily step count reached 8,000, far exceeding the initial goal of 6,000. She wrote down her reflections in a notebook: a better complexion, regular bowel movements, her husband beginning to participate, and a strengthened friendship with Zhang Shufen. Then she marked the May goals on the family calendar: raise the average daily steps to 9,000, and have her husband join in at least once every weekend.

events.name: Order professional sports shoes
events.description: After setting the new goal, Ma Xiulan felt that the old cloth shoes on her feet really needed replacing. She opened the shopping app, compared several domestic walking shoes, and finally used part of the income from the sales exhibition to order a pair of black sneakers with air cushions. They are expected to arrive in early May, adding gear for next month's walks.

events.name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
events.description: Before bed, Ma Xiulan stood side by side with her husband and did five minutes of deep breathing. She mindfully reflected on the roses in the courtyard, her son's progress, and her husband's change, and drifted off to sleep with deep peace.
